/* ============================================================
 * 数字孪生 · 本地监控中枢 — 数据服务 (零依赖, Node 原生)
 * 静态托管 public/  +  /api/metrics 本机指标采集
 * ============================================================ */
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const { execFile } = require('child_process');

const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT || 3210);
const HOST = process.env.HOST || '127.0.0.1';
const PUBLIC_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'public');
const MIME = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
  '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
  '.png': 'image/png',
  '.jpg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
  '.ico': 'image/x-icon',
  '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
};

/* ---------------- CPU 采样 (两次调用差值) ---------------- */
let lastCpus = os.cpus();

function sampleCpu() {
  const now = os.cpus();
  const cores = now.map((c, i) => {
    const p = lastCpus[i] || c;
    const d = (k) => Math.max(0, c.times[k] - p.times[k]);
    const idle = d('idle');
    const total = d('user') + d('nice') + d('sys') + d('idle') + d('irq');
    return total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (1 - idle / total) * 100)) : 0;
  });
  lastCpus = now;
  const avg = cores.length ? cores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / cores.length : 0;
  return {
    coresPct: cores.map((v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10),
    avgPct: Math.round(avg * 10) / 10,
    speedMhz: now[0] ? Math.round(now[0].speed) : 0,
  };
}

/* ---------------- PowerShell 辅助 ---------------- */
function ps(command, timeout = 8000) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    execFile(
      'powershell.exe',
      ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-Command', command],
      { timeout, windowsHide: true },
      (err, stdout) => resolve(err ? '' : String(stdout || ''))
    );
  });
}
const parseLines = (out) =>
  String(out).split(/\r?\n/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

/* ---------------- 磁盘 ---------------- */
async function sampleDisks() {
  const out = await ps(
    "Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3' | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.DeviceID)|$($_.Size)|$($_.FreeSpace)\" }"
  );
  return parseLines(out)
    .map((line) => {
      const [drive, size, free] = line.split('|');
      const total = Number(size) || 0;
      const freeB = Number(free) || 0;
      const used = Math.max(0, total - freeB);
      return {
        drive,
        totalGB: +(total / 2 ** 30).toFixed(1),
        usedGB: +(used / 2 ** 30).toFixed(1),
        freeGB: +(freeB / 2 ** 30).toFixed(1),
        pct: total > 0 ? Math.round((used / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0,
      };
    })
    .filter((d) => d.totalGB > 0);
}

/* ---------------- 网络 (累计字节差值 -> 速率) ---------------- */
let lastNet = null;
async function sampleNet() {
  const out = await ps(
    'Get-NetAdapterStatistics | ForEach-Object { "$($_.ReceivedBytes)|$($_.SentBytes)" }'
  );
  const t = Date.now();
  let rx = 0, tx = 0;
  for (const line of parseLines(out)) {
    const [r, s] = line.split('|');
    rx += Number(r) || 0;
    tx += Number(s) || 0;
  }
  let rxBps = 0, txBps = 0;
  if (lastNet) {
    const dt = Math.max(1, (t - lastNet.t) / 1000);
    rxBps = Math.max(0, (rx - lastNet.rx) / dt);
    txBps = Math.max(0, (tx - lastNet.tx) / dt);
  }
  lastNet = { rx, tx, t };
  return { rxBps: Math.round(rxBps), txBps: Math.round(txBps), rxTotal: rx, txTotal: tx };
}

/* ---------------- GPU (只需取一次) ---------------- */
let gpuName = '';
async function sampleGpu() {
  const out = await ps('Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }');
  gpuName = parseLines(out).filter((n) => n && n.length < 120).join(' + ') || '未知设备';
  return gpuName;
}

/* ---------------- 汇总 ---------------- */
function netIps() {
  const res = [];
  for (const [name, addrs] of Object.entries(os.networkInterfaces())) {
    for (const a of addrs) if (a.family === 'IPv4' && !a.internal) res.push(`${a.address}(${name})`);
  }
  return res;
}

async function collectMetrics() {
  const cpu = sampleCpu();
  const [disks, net] = await Promise.all([sampleDisks(), sampleNet()]);
  if (!gpuName) await sampleGpu();
  const total = os.totalmem();
  const free = os.freemem();
  const used = total - free;
  return {
    ts: Date.now(),
    sys: {
      hostname: os.hostname(),
      platform: `${os.platform()} ${os.release()}`,
      arch: os.arch(),
      cpuModel: (os.cpus()[0] && os.cpus()[0].model.trim()) || 'Unknown CPU',
      cores: os.cpus().length,
      uptimeSec: Math.round(os.uptime()),
      gpu: gpuName,
      ips: netIps(),
      nodeVersion: process.version,
    },
    cpu,
    mem: {
      totalGB: +(total / 2 ** 30).toFixed(2),
      usedGB: +(used / 2 ** 30).toFixed(2),
      freeGB: +(free / 2 ** 30).toFixed(2),
      pct: Math.round((used / total) * 1000) / 10,
    },
    disks,
    net,
  };
}

/* 5s 内的请求直接返回缓存, 避免重复拉起 PowerShell */
let cache = { at: 0, data: null };
let inflight = null;
function getMetrics() {
  if (cache.data && Date.now() - cache.at < 5000) return Promise.resolve(cache.data);
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  inflight = collectMetrics()
    .then((data) => {
      cache = { at: Date.now(), data };
      return data;
    })
    .finally(() => { inflight = null; });
  return inflight;
}

/* ---------------- 编码活动事件流 (DSH / ZCODE 智能体 -> 大屏) ---------------- */
const EVENT_MAX = 200;
const eventBuf = [];
let eventSeq = 0;
const sseClients = new Set();
const CORS_HEADERS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
};
function broadcast(payload) {
  for (const res of sseClients) {
    if (res.destroyed || res.writableEnded) { sseClients.delete(res); continue; }
    try { res.write(`data: ${payload}\n\n`); } catch { sseClients.delete(res); }
  }
}
setInterval(() => broadcast(': ping'), 25000).unref();

/* 哨兵专用事件通道: 与 /api/event 同缓冲, 供编码活动流/大屏 SSE 复用 */
function ingestEvent(e) {
  eventBuf.push(e);
  if (eventBuf.length > EVENT_MAX) eventBuf.shift();
  broadcast(JSON.stringify({ type: 'event', event: e }));
}

/* 监控服务必须常驻: 任何意外异常记日志后继续运行 */
process.on('uncaughtException', (e) => console.error('[monitor] uncaught:', String(e && e.stack || e)));
process.on('unhandledRejection', (e) => console.error('[monitor] rejection:', String(e && e.stack || e)));
function countEvents() {
  /* null 原型: 防止恶意 kind(如 "constructor")命中 Object 原型键 */
  const c = Object.assign(Object.create(null), { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 });
  for (const e of eventBuf) if (e.kind in c) c[e.kind]++; else c.other++;
  return c;
}

/* ---------------- 文件注册表 (代码城市数据源) ---------------- */
const fileRegistry = new Map();
let registrySaveTimer = null;
const REGISTRY_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'state', 'file-registry.json');

function registerFile(rawPath, cwd) {
  try {
    let p = String(rawPath || '').trim();
    if (!p || p.length < 2 || p.length > 400) return null;
    /* 带空格的 target 只有真实存在才认作路径 (排除命令片段) */
    if (/\s/.test(p)) {
      let probe = p;
      if (!path.isAbsolute(probe) && cwd) probe = path.join(String(cwd), probe);
      if (!fs.existsSync(probe)) return null;
    }
    let abs = p;
    if (!path.isAbsolute(p) && cwd) abs = path.join(String(cwd), p);
    abs = path.normalize(abs);
    const key = abs.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    let f = fileRegistry.get(key);
    if (!f) {
      f = { key, name: path.basename(key) || key, dir: path.dirname(key), edits: 0, lastTs: 0, bytes: 0, exists: false };
      fileRegistry.set(key, f);
      if (fileRegistry.size > 300) {
        let oldest = null, oldTs = Infinity;
        for (const x of fileRegistry.values()) if ((x.lastTs || 0) < oldTs) { oldTs = x.lastTs || 0; oldest = x; }
        if (oldest) fileRegistry.delete(oldest.key);
      }
    }
    f.edits++;
    f.lastTs = Date.now();
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(abs);
      if (st.isFile()) { f.bytes = st.size; f.exists = true; }
      else f.exists = false;
    } catch { f.exists = false; }
    scheduleRegistrySave();
    return { key: f.key, name: f.name, dir: f.dir, edits: f.edits, lastTs: f.lastTs, bytes: f.bytes, exists: f.exists };
  } catch { return null; }
}

function scheduleRegistrySave() {
  if (registrySaveTimer) return;
  registrySaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    registrySaveTimer = null;
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(REGISTRY_FILE), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(REGISTRY_FILE, JSON.stringify({ files: [...fileRegistry.values()] }));
    } catch { /* 持久化失败不影响运行 */ }
  }, 1500);
  if (registrySaveTimer.unref) registrySaveTimer.unref();
}

/* 启动时扫描项目目录, 让城市有初始地貌 */
function seedScan() {
  const skip = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'state']);
  const walk = (dir, depth) => {
    if (depth > 2) return;
    let ents;
    try { ents = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
    for (const e of ents) {
      if (e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
      if (skip.has(e.name)) continue;
      const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
      if (e.isDirectory()) { walk(full, depth + 1); continue; }
      try {
        const st = fs.statSync(full);
        if (!st.isFile()) continue;
        const key = full.replace(/\\/g, '/');
        if (!fileRegistry.has(key)) {
          fileRegistry.set(key, {
            key, name: e.name, dir: path.dirname(key),
            edits: 0, lastTs: st.mtimeMs, bytes: st.size, exists: true,
          });
        }
      } catch { /* 忽略不可读项 */ }
    }
  };
  walk(__dirname, 0);
}

function loadRegistry() {
  try {
    const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(REGISTRY_FILE, 'utf8'));
    for (const f of (d && d.files) || []) if (f && f.key) fileRegistry.set(f.key, f);
  } catch { /* 首次运行无持久化文件 */ }
}

/* ---------------- HTTP 服务 ---------------- */
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost');

  if (url.pathname === '/api/metrics') {
    try {
      const data = await getMetrics();
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
      res.end(JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (e) {
      res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: String((e && e.message) || e) }));
    }
    return;
  }

  /* ---- 编码活动: 事件上报 / 历史 / SSE 实时流 ---- */
  if (url.pathname === '/api/event' && req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204, CORS_HEADERS); res.end(); return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/event' && req.method === 'POST') {
    let body = '';
    req.on('data', (c) => { body += c; if (body.length > 65536) req.destroy(); });
    req.on('end', () => {
      try {
        const b = JSON.parse(body || '{}');
        const e = {
          seq: ++eventSeq,
          ts: Number(b.ts) || Date.now(),
          source: String(b.source || 'external').slice(0, 16),
          kind: String(b.kind || 'tool').slice(0, 16),
          tool: String(b.tool || '').slice(0, 40),
          target: String(b.target || '').slice(0, 140),
          status: String(b.status || 'ok').slice(0, 16),
        };
        /* 写码事件 -> 登记文件 + 捕获真实代码 diff, 供大屏展示 */
        let fi = null;
        if (e.kind === 'code') {
          fi = registerFile(b.target, b.cwd);
          if (fi) e.file = fi;
        }
        if (b.diff && typeof b.diff === 'object') {
          e.diff = {
            del: String(b.diff.del || '').slice(0, 1200),
            ins: String(b.diff.ins || '').slice(0, 1200),
          };
          if (fi) fi.lastDiff = e.diff;
        }
        eventBuf.push(e);
        if (eventBuf.length > EVENT_MAX) eventBuf.shift();
        broadcast(JSON.stringify({ type: 'event', event: e }));
      } catch { /* 脏数据直接丢弃, 不影响服务 */ }
      res.writeHead(204, CORS_HEADERS); res.end();
    });
    return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/events') {
    const from = url.searchParams.get('from');
    const to = url.searchParams.get('to');
    // Validate: if either from/to is provided but not a valid number → 400
    if ((from !== null && isNaN(Number(from))) || (to !== null && isNaN(Number(to)))) {
      res.writeHead(400, { ...CORS_HEADERS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'from/to must be valid epoch milliseconds' }));
      return;
    }
    const fromNum = from !== null ? Number(from) : null;
    const toNum = to !== null ? Number(to) : null;
    const filtered = eventBuf.filter((e) => {
      const ts = e.ts;
      if (fromNum !== null && ts < fromNum) return false;
      if (toNum !== null && ts > toNum) return false;
      return true;
    });
    res.writeHead(200, { ...CORS_HEADERS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ events: filtered, counts: countEvents() }));
    return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/files') {
    const files = [...fileRegistry.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => (b.lastTs || 0) - (a.lastTs || 0))
      .slice(0, 60);
    res.writeHead(200, { ...CORS_HEADERS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ files }));
    return;
  }
  /* 真实文件内容(仅限注册表内的文件, 截断 64KB) — 左屏"正在写"数据源 */
  if (url.pathname === '/api/file') {
    const key = url.searchParams.get('key') || '';
    const f = fileRegistry.get(key);
    res.writeHead(200, { ...CORS_HEADERS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    if (!f) { res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'unknown file' })); return; }
    let content = '';
    try { content = fs.readFileSync(f.key, 'utf8').slice(0, 65536); } catch { content = ''; }
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ key: f.key, name: f.name, bytes: f.bytes, exists: f.exists, edits: f.edits, content }));
    return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/stream') {
    res.writeHead(200, {
      ...CORS_HEADERS,
      'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
    });
    res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', ts: Date.now() })}\n\n`);
    res.on('error', () => sseClients.delete(res));
    sseClients.add(res);
    req.on('close', () => sseClients.delete(res));
    return;
  }

  /* ---- 哨兵智能体: 状态 / 手动巡查 / 审计尾 (只读+手动触发, 无任何 L3 端点) ---- */
  if (url.pathname === '/api/sentinel/state') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    try { res.end(JSON.stringify(sentinel ? sentinel.publicState() : { state: 'OFF' })); }
    catch (e) { res.end(JSON.stringify({ state: 'ERROR', error: String((e && e.message) || e) })); }
    return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/sentinel/run' && req.method === 'POST') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    if (!sentinel) { res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'sentinel off' })); return; }
    sentinel.manualRun()
      .then((r) => res.end(JSON.stringify(r)))
      .catch((e) => res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: String((e && e.message) || e) })));
    return;
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/api/sentinel/audit') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ lines: sentinel ? sentinel.audit.tail(80) : [] }));
    return;
  }
  /* L3 一次性批准: 仅接受本机回环请求 (手册§8确认机制: 写明动作/对象/时限, 超时视为拒绝, 不可复用) */
  if (url.pathname === '/api/sentinel/approve' && req.method === 'POST') {
    const ra = String(req.socket.remoteAddress || '');
    if (!/^(::1|127\.0\.0\.1)$/.test(ra)) {
      res.writeHead(403, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: '仅限本机批准' }));
      return;
    }
    let body = '';
    req.on('data', (c) => { body += c; if (body.length > 4096) req.destroy(); });
    req.on('end', () => {
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
      if (!sentinel) { res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'sentinel off' })); return; }
      try {
        const b = JSON.parse(body || '{}');
        res.end(JSON.stringify(sentinel.approve(Number(b.proposalId))));
      } catch (e) {
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: String((e && e.message) || e) }));
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  let p;
  try {
    p = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);
  } catch {
    res.writeHead(400); res.end(); return;
  }
  if (p === '/') p = '/index.html';
  const file = path.normalize(path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, p));
  if (!file.startsWith(PUBLIC_DIR + path.sep) && file !== PUBLIC_DIR) {
    res.writeHead(403); res.end(); return;
  }
  fs.readFile(file, (err, buf) => {
    if (err) {
      res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
      res.end('404 Not Found');
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream' });
    res.end(buf);
  });
});

loadRegistry();
seedScan();

/* ---------------- 哨兵智能体 (手册§10 P1 影子模式: 只提案不执行) ----------------
 * 进程内调度 (综述§6"主动触发"备选): 随大屏服务常驻, 每 intervalSec 巡查一轮。
 * 任何哨兵故障只降级, 不影响指标服务本身。 */
let sentinel = null;
try {
  const { Sentinel } = require('./sentinel/sentinel.cjs');
  sentinel = new Sentinel().init({
    collectMetrics: () => getMetrics(),
    pushEvent: (e) => ingestEvent({
      seq: ++eventSeq, ts: e.ts || Date.now(), source: e.source || 'sentinel',
      kind: e.kind || 'task', tool: e.tool || '', target: e.target || '', status: e.status || 'ok',
    }),
    toast: (msg, urgent) => broadcast(JSON.stringify({ type: 'sentinel_toast', msg, urgent: !!urgent, ts: Date.now() })),
    onState: (s) => broadcast(JSON.stringify({ type: 'sentinel', s })),
  });
} catch (e) {
  console.error('[sentinel] init failed (监控服务继续运行):', String(e && e.stack || e));
}

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
  console.log('==============================================');
  console.log('  数字孪生 · 本地监控中枢  DATA SERVICE ONLINE');
  console.log(`  http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log('  数据同步周期: 180s (每3分钟)');
  console.log(`  哨兵智能体: ${sentinel ? `影子巡查 ${sentinel.cfg.intervalSec}s` : '未启用'}`);
  console.log('==============================================');
  getMetrics().catch(() => {});
});

/* Ctrl+C 优雅退出: 先关服务器再退出 */
process.on('SIGINT', () => {
  console.log('\n[monitor] SIGINT — closing server...');
  server.close(() => process.exit(0));
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 1500).unref();
});

  gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,40,80,0)');
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}

  composer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
  composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera));
  bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(innerWidth, innerHeight), 0.5, 0.55, 0.25);
  composer.addPass(bloomPass);
  composer.addPass(new OutputPass());

  /* ---- 交互 ---- */
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    pointer.x = (e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -(e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
    pointerClient = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
  });
  let downAt = null;
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { downAt = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
    if (downAt && Math.hypot(e.clientX - downAt.x, e.clientY - downAt.y) < 6 && hoveredKey) setFocusFile(hoveredKey, true);
    downAt = null;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {
    controls.reset();
    toast('视角已复位 VIEW RESET');
  });

  addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    composer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
  });
}

/* ---- 代码城市: 文件注册表的 3D 数字孪生 ----
 * 每个被智能体触达的文件 = 一座楼宇:
 *   楼高 ~ 文件大小, 颜色/亮度 ~ 最近修改时间,
 *   编辑事件 -> 该楼脉冲 + 长高 + 射向核心的数据光束 + 中央显示文件名 */
function hashStr(s) {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); }
  return h >>> 0;
}
function buildSpiral() {
  city.spiral.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 460; i++) {
    const a = i * 2.399963; /* 黄金角: 均匀散射不重叠 */
    const r = 5.2 + 1.12 * Math.sqrt(i);
    city.spiral.push([Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r]);
  }
}
function slotFor(key) {
  let idx = hashStr(key) % city.spiral.length;
  while (city.occupied.has(idx)) idx = (idx + 1) % city.spiral.length;
  city.occupied.add(idx);
  return city.spiral[idx];
}
const heightFor = (fi) => 1.1 + Math.min(4.0, Math.log10((fi.bytes || 0) + 1) * 1.0);
const fmtBytes = (n) => n >= 1048576 ? (n / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB' : n >= 1024 ? (n / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB' : (n || 0) + ' B';

const _cc = new THREE.Color();
function recencyColor(ms) {
  if (ms < 30e3) return _cc.set(0xd9ffff);
  if (ms < 120e3) return _cc.set(0x00e5ff);
  if (ms < 600e3) return _cc.set(0x2b8fd8);
  return _cc.set(0x22659c);
}

function textSprite(text, { w = 256, h = 64, font = 'bold 30px Consolas', color = '#cfffff' } = {}) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = w; c.height = h;
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  const sp = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
  sp.userData.canvas = c;
  sp.userData.tex = tex;
  sp.userData.font = font;
  sp.userData.color = color;
  drawTextSprite(sp, text);
  return sp;
}
function drawTextSprite(sp, text) {
  const c = sp.userData.canvas;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  g.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
  g.font = sp.userData.font;
  g.textAlign = 'center';
  g.textBaseline = 'middle';
  g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,229,255,.9)';
  g.shadowBlur = 12;
  g.fillStyle = sp.userData.color;
  g.fillText(text, c.width / 2, c.height / 2);
  sp.userData.tex.needsUpdate = true;
}

function createBuilding(fi) {
  const slot = slotFor(fi.key);
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.position.set(slot[0], 0, slot[1]);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: 0x03141f, emissive: 0x00e5ff, emissiveIntensity: 0.25,
    metalness: 0.55, roughness: 0.4,
    transparent: !fi.exists, opacity: fi.exists ? 1 : 0.4,
  });
  const body = new THREE.Mesh(cityGeo, mat);
  body.userData.key = fi.key;
  const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(
    cityEdgeGeo,
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00e5ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55 })
  );
  edges.scale.setScalar(1.002);
  body.add(edges);
  const baseRing = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.RingGeometry(0.7, 0.92, 32),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00e5ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.28, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
  );
  baseRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  baseRing.position.y = 0.02;
  const label = textSprite(fi.name);
  label.scale.set(3.0, 0.75, 1);
  label.position.y = 1.3;
  g.add(body, baseRing, label);
  scene.add(g);
  return {
    key: fi.key, info: { ...fi }, group: g, body, edges, label, mat,
    curH: 0.1, targetH: heightFor(fi), flash: 0, beam: null, beamT: undefined,
  };
}

function disposeBuilding(b) {
  scene.remove(b.group);
  b.label.userData.tex.dispose();
  b.label.material.dispose();
  b.body.material.dispose();
  b.edges.material.dispose();
  const bi = city.bodies.indexOf(b.body);
  if (bi >= 0) city.bodies.splice(bi, 1);
  city.map.delete(b.key);
}

function upsertBuilding(fi, live) {
  if (!renderer || !fi || !fi.key) return;
  let b = city.map.get(fi.key);
  if (!b) {
    if (city.map.size >= CITY_MAX) {
      let oldest = null, oldTs = Infinity;
      for (const x of city.map.values()) {
        const ts = x.info.lastTs || 0;
        if (ts < oldTs) { oldTs = ts; oldest = x; }
      }
      if (oldest) disposeBuilding(oldest);
    }
    b = createBuilding(fi);
    city.map.set(fi.key, b);
    city.bodies.push(b.body);
  } else {
    Object.assign(b.info, fi);
  }
  b.targetH = heightFor(b.info);
  if (live) {
    b.info.lastTs = fi.lastTs || Date.now();
    b.flash = 1;
    flashBeam(b);
    drawTextSprite(b.label, b.info.name + (b.info.edits > 1 ? ' ×' + b.info.edits : ''));
    setFocusFile(b.key, false);
  }
}

function flashBeam(b) {
  if (!b.beam) {
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(), new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.6, 0)]);
    b.beam = new THREE.Line(g, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x9ff2ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0 }));
    scene.add(b.beam);
  }
  b.beam.visible = true;
  b.beamT = 0;
}

function initCity() {
  buildSpiral();
  fetch('/api/files', { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((d) => {
      for (const f of ((d && d.files) || []).slice(0, CITY_MAX)) upsertBuilding(f, false);
      const top = ((d && d.files) || [])[0];
      setFocusFile(top ? top.key : null, false);
      /* 恢复最近一次真实代码 diff */
      const withDiff = ((d && d.files) || []).find((f) => f.lastDiff);
      if (withDiff) renderDiff({ file: withDiff, diff: withDiff.lastDiff, tool: '恢复 RESTORED', ts: withDiff.lastTs });
    })
    .catch(() => {});
}

/* ---- 同步冲击波 ---- */
function spawnWave(color, delay = 0) {
  if (!renderer) return;
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.RingGeometry(0.94, 1.0, 96),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
    })
  );
  m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  m.position.y = 0.12;
  scene.add(m);
  waves.push({ m, t: -delay });
}

/* ---- 每帧渲染 ---- */
const _m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
const _q = new THREE.Quaternion();
const _e = new THREE.Euler();
const _v3 = new THREE.Vector3();
const _s3 = new THREE.Vector3();
const tip = () => $('tooltip');

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
  const t = clock.elapsedTime;

  if (renderer) {
    controls.update();

    /* 核心 */
    const avg = state.metrics ? state.metrics.cpu.avgPct : 0;
    coreGroup.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.045 + (avg / 100) * 0.3);
    coreInner.rotation.y = t * 0.5;
    coreInner.rotation.z = t * 0.23;
    shellA.rotation.y = -t * 0.35;
    shellA.rotation.x = t * 0.18;
    shellB.rotation.y = t * 0.22;
    shellB.rotation.z = -t * 0.12;
    ringA.rotation.x = t * 0.7; ringA.rotation.y = t * 0.3;
    ringB.rotation.x = -t * 0.45; ringB.rotation.z = t * 0.5;
    ringC.rotation.x = t * 0.3; ringC.rotation.z = -t * 0.6;
    haloSprite.material.opacity = 0.28 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.08 + (avg / 100) * 0.3;
    coreLight.intensity = 40 + avg * 1.1 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 8 + activity.heat * 35;
    if (bloomPass) bloomPass.strength = 0.5 + activity.heat * 0.18;

    /* 代码城市: 楼宇呼吸/冷却/脉冲/光束 */
    const nowMs = Date.now();
    for (const b of city.map.values()) {
      b.flash *= Math.exp(-dt * 2.2);
      b.curH += (b.targetH - b.curH) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3));
      b.body.scale.y = Math.max(0.06, b.curH);
      b.label.position.y = b.curH + 0.62;
      const rec = nowMs - (b.info.lastTs || 0);
      const base = rec < 30e3 ? 1.05 : rec < 120e3 ? 0.7 : rec < 600e3 ? 0.45 : 0.34;
      b.body.material.emissiveIntensity =
        base + b.flash * 2.4 +
        (b.key === state.focus ? 0.55 : 0) +
        Math.sin(t * 2.4 + (hashStr(b.key) % 97)) * 0.04;
      b.edges.material.color.copy(recencyColor(rec)).lerp(WHITE, 0.25 + Math.min(0.5, b.flash * 0.5));
      b.label.material.opacity = Math.min(1, 0.6 + b.flash * 0.4);
      if (b.beamT !== undefined && b.beam) {
        b.beamT += dt;
        if (b.beamT > 1.2) { b.beam.visible = false; b.beamT = undefined; }
        else {
          b.beam.material.opacity = Math.sin(Math.PI * (b.beamT / 1.2)) * 0.85;
          const arr = b.beam.geometry.attributes.position.array;
          arr[0] = b.group.position.x;
          arr[1] = b.curH;
          arr[2] = b.group.position.z;
          b.beam.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
        }
      }
      if (b.card && b.cardT !== undefined) {
        b.cardT += dt;
        b.card.position.set(b.group.position.x, b.curH + 2.5, b.group.position.z);
        if (b.cardT > 8) b.card.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - (b.cardT - 8) / 1.5);
        if (b.cardT > 9.5) { b.card.visible = false; b.cardT = undefined; }
      }
    }
    focusSprite.position.y = 7.1 + Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.15;

    /* 冲击波 */
    for (let i = waves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const w = waves[i];
      w.t += dt;
      if (w.t <= 0) { w.m.visible = false; continue; }
      w.m.visible = true;
      w.m.scale.setScalar(1 + w.t * 16);
      w.m.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.9 - w.t * 0.5);
      if (w.m.material.opacity <= 0) {
        scene.remove(w.m);
        w.m.geometry.dispose();
        w.m.material.dispose();
        waves.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    /* 数据环立方体 */
    for (let i = 0; i < cubeData.length; i++) {
      const d = cubeData[i];
      const y = Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph) * 0.45;
      _e.set(t * 0.8 + d.ph, t * 0.6, 0);
      _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _v3.set(Math.cos(d.a) * 9.3, y, Math.sin(d.a) * 9.3);
      _s3.setScalar(0.7 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i * 1.7)));
      _m4.compose(_v3, _q, _s3);
      cubes.setMatrixAt(i, _m4);
    }
    cubes.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    haloGroup.rotation.y = t * (0.12 + activity.heat * 0.55);

    /* 尘埃上浮 */
    const dp = dustGeo.attributes.position.array;
    for (let i = 0; i < dustData.length; i++) {
      const d = dustData[i];
      d.y += d.sp * dt;
      if (d.y > 16) d.y = 0.1;
      dp[i * 3] = Math.cos(d.a + t * 0.03) * d.r;
      dp[i * 3 + 1] = d.y;
      dp[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(d.a + t * 0.03) * d.r;
    }
    dustGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

    /* 悬停拾取: 文件楼宇 */
    if (city.map.size) {
      raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(city.bodies, false);
      const key = hits.length ? hits[0].object.userData.key : null;
      if (key !== hoveredKey) {
        hoveredKey = key;
        renderer.domElement.style.cursor = key ? 'pointer' : 'default';
      }
      const el = tip();
      if (hoveredKey) {
        const b = city.map.get(hoveredKey);
        if (b) {
          const ago = Math.max(0, Math.round((nowMs - (b.info.lastTs || 0)) / 1000));
          el.style.display = 'block';
          el.style.left = Math.min(pointerClient.x + 16, innerWidth - 280) + 'px';
          el.style.top = Math.max(pointerClient.y - 12, 10) + 'px';
          el.innerHTML = `<b>${esc(b.info.name)}</b> · ${b.info.edits} 次修改 · ${fmtBytes(b.info.bytes)} · ${ago}s 前${b.info.exists ? '' : ' · 未落盘'}`;
        }
      } else el.style.display = 'none';
    }

    composer.render();
  }

  processTweens(now);
  tickCountdown();
  updateMode(now);

  frames++;
  if (now - fpsAt > 500) {
    $('fps').textContent = Math.round((frames * 1000) / (now - fpsAt));
    frames = 0;
    fpsAt = now;
  }
}

/* ============================ HUD ============================ */
function toast(msg, isErr = false) {
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'toast' + (isErr ? ' err' : '');
  d.textContent = msg;
  $('toasts').appendChild(d);
  setTimeout(() => d.classList.add('out'), 3600);
  setTimeout(() => d.remove(), 4200);
}

function setSvc(s) {
  const el = $('svc');
  el.textContent = s;
  el.className = s === 'ONLINE' ? 'ok' : s === 'SYNCING' ? 'warn' : 'err';
}

/* 数字缓动 */
const tweens = [];
function tweenNum(el, to, dec = 0, fmt = null, dur = 900) {
  const from = el._v !== undefined ? el._v : 0;
  el._v = to;
  tweens.push({ el, from, to, dec, fmt, start: performance.now(), dur });
}
function processTweens(now) {
  for (let i = tweens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const tw = tweens[i];
    let k = (now - tw.start) / tw.dur;
    if (k >= 1) { k = 1; tweens.splice(i, 1); }
    const v = tw.from + (tw.to - tw.from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3));
    tw.el.textContent = tw.fmt ? tw.fmt(v) : v.toFixed(tw.dec);
  }
}

function setGauge(arcEl, pct) {
  const p = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, pct));
  arcEl.style.strokeDasharray = `${p} 100`;
  arcEl.style.stroke = p >= 88 ? 'url(#gradCrit)' : p >= 70 ? 'url(#gradWarn)' : 'url(#gradCyan)';
}

/* CPU 核心柱 */
function buildCoreBars(n) {
  const box = $('coreBars');
  if (box.childElementCount === n) return;
  box.innerHTML = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'cbar';
    d.innerHTML = `<div class="track"><div class="fill"></div></div><em>${pad(i + 1)}</em>`;
    box.appendChild(d);
  }
}
function updateCoreBars(cpu) {
  buildCoreBars(cpu.coresPct.length);
  const bars = $('coreBars').children;
  for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
    const p = cpu.coresPct[i] ?? 0;
    const fill = bars[i].querySelector('.fill');
    fill.style.height = p + '%';
    fill.style.setProperty('--c', cssColor(p));
    bars[i].title = `CORE ${pad(i + 1)} — ${p}% · ${loadStateText(p)}`;
    bars[i].classList.toggle('focus', i === state.focus);
  }
}

/* 磁盘条 */
const diskNodes = new Map();
function renderDisks(disks) {
  const box = $('diskBars');
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const d of disks) {
    seen.add(d.drive);
    let n = diskNodes.get(d.drive);
    if (!n) {
      n = document.createElement('div');
      n.className = 'dbar';
      n.innerHTML = `<div class="dl"><span>${d.drive} 卷</span><b></b></div><div class="dt"><div class="df"></div></div>`;
      box.appendChild(n);
      diskNodes.set(d.drive, n);
    }
    n.querySelector('b').textContent = `${d.usedGB.toFixed(1)} / ${d.totalGB.toFixed(0)} GB · ${d.pct}%`;
    const f = n.querySelector('.df');
    f.style.width = d.pct + '%';
    f.style.setProperty('--c', cssColor(d.pct));
  }
  for (const [k, n] of diskNodes) {
    if (!seen.has(k)) { n.remove(); diskNodes.delete(k); }
  }
}

/* 折线图 */
function drawLine(cv, series, opts = {}) {
  const dpr = Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2);
  const W = cv.clientWidth, H = cv.clientHeight;
  if (!W || !H) return;
  if (cv.width !== Math.round(W * dpr) || cv.height !== Math.round(H * dpr)) {
    cv.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    cv.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
  }
  const g = cv.getContext('2d');
  g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  g.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,0.10)';
  g.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(0, (H * i) / 4);
    g.lineTo(W, (H * i) / 4);
    g.stroke();
  }

  const n = Math.max(...series.map((s) => s.data.length), 2);
  const max = opts.max || Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((s) => s.data)) * 1.15;

  for (const s of series) {
    if (!s.data.length) continue;
    const pts = s.data.map((v, i) => [
      (i / (n - 1)) * (W - 2) + 1,
      H - 3 - (v / max) * (H - 8),
    ]);
    if (opts.fill) {
      const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      grad.addColorStop(0, s.color + '30');
      grad.addColorStop(1, s.color + '00');
      g.fillStyle = grad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(pts[0][0], H);
      pts.forEach((p) => g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]));
      g.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], H);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();
    }
    g.strokeStyle = s.color;
    g.lineWidth = 1.6;
    g.shadowColor = s.color;
    g.shadowBlur = 6;
    g.beginPath();
    pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : g.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
    g.stroke();
    g.shadowBlur = 0;
    const lp = pts[pts.length - 1];
    g.fillStyle = s.color;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(lp[0], lp[1], 2.2, 0, 7);
    g.fill();
  }

  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,220,255,0.5)';
  g.font = '9px Consolas';
  g.fillText(opts.fmt ? opts.fmt(max) : Math.round(max) + (opts.unit || ''), 4, 10);
}

function drawCharts() {
  drawLine($('cpuHist'), [{ data: state.hist.cpu, color: '#00e5ff' }], { max: 100, unit: '%' });
  drawLine($('netChart'), [
    { data: state.hist.rx, color: '#00e5ff' },
    { data: state.hist.tx, color: '#ff2fb3' },
  ], { fmt: fmtBps, fill: true });
}

/* 滚动信息条 */
function buildTicker(m) {
  const items = [
    `主机 HOST ${m.sys.hostname}`,
    `系统 OS ${m.sys.platform} · ${m.sys.arch}`,
    `CPU ${m.sys.cpuModel} × ${m.sys.cores}`,
    `GPU ${m.sys.gpu}`,
    `内存 MEM ${m.mem.usedGB.toFixed(1)}/${m.mem.totalGB.toFixed(1)}GB (${m.mem.pct}%)`,
    ...m.disks.map((d) => `磁盘 ${d.drive} ${d.pct}%`),
    `网络 NET ↓${fmtBps(m.net.rxBps)} ↑${fmtBps(m.net.txBps)}`,
    `IP ${m.sys.ips.join(' / ') || '无外部地址'}`,
    `运行 UPTIME ${fmtUptime(m.sys.uptimeSec)}`,
    `采样周期 CYCLE ${SYNC_INTERVAL / 1000}s`,
  ];
  const html = items.map((s) => `<span>${s}</span>`).join('<i>◆</i>');
  $('tickerTrack').innerHTML = html + '<i>◆</i>' + html + '<i>◆</i>';
}

/* ---------------- 编码活动通道 (DSH / ZCODE 实时上报) ---------------- */
const activity = {
  list: [],
  counts: { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 },
  heat: 0, lastAt: 0, lastKind: '',
};
const KIND_ICON = { code: '✎', exec: '▶', scan: '⌕', task: '◆', error: '✖', idle: '◌', session: '⏻', tool: '◇' };
const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));

function addActivity(e, silent = false) {
  const ev = {
    ts: e.ts || Date.now(), kind: e.kind || 'tool', tool: e.tool || '',
    target: e.target || '', source: e.source || '',
    file: e.file || null, diff: e.diff || null,
  };
  activity.list.unshift(ev);
  if (activity.list.length > 40) activity.list.pop();
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(activity.counts, ev.kind)) activity.counts[ev.kind]++;
  else activity.counts.other++;
  activity.lastAt = ev.ts;
  activity.lastKind = ev.kind;
  const now = Date.now();
  activity.heat = Math.min(1, activity.list.filter((x) => now - x.ts < 60000).length / 30);
  renderFeed();
  if (ev.diff && (ev.diff.del || ev.diff.ins)) renderDiff(ev);
  if (silent) return;
  /* 3D 联动反应 */
  if (ev.kind === 'code' && ev.file) {
    upsertBuilding(ev.file, true);
    if (ev.diff && (ev.diff.del || ev.diff.ins)) {
      const b = city.map.get(ev.file.key);
      if (b) drawDiffCard(b, ev);
    }
  } else if (ev.kind === 'exec') spawnWave(0xffb300);
  else if (ev.kind === 'error') spawnWave(0xff3b5c);
  else if (ev.kind === 'task') { spawnWave(0x00ffa3); toast('新任务下达 NEW TASK INBOUND'); }
}

/* ---------------- 真实代码 diff 上屏 ---------------- */
function renderDiff(e) {
  const fileEl = $('diffFile');
  const body = $('diffBody');
  if (!body || !e || !e.diff) return;
  const insN = String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').length;
  const delN = String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').filter((s) => s !== '').length;
  fileEl.className = 'diffFile';
  fileEl.innerHTML = `<b>${esc((e.file && e.file.name) || e.target || '变更')}</b><span>+${insN} −${delN} · ${esc(e.tool || '')} · ${timeStr(e.ts || Date.now())}</span>`;
  const rows = [];
  for (const l of String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').slice(0, 8)) rows.push(`<div class="dl-del">− ${esc(l) || ' '}</div>`);
  for (const l of String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').slice(0, 10)) rows.push(`<div class="dl-ins">+ ${esc(l) || ' '}</div>`);
  body.innerHTML = rows.join('');
  body.scrollTop = 0;
}

/* 3D 楼宇上方的真实代码变更卡片 */
function drawDiffCard(b, e) {
  if (!b.card) {
    b.card = textSprite('', { w: 512, h: 288, font: '20px Consolas', color: '#d9f6ff' });
    b.card.scale.set(4.8, 2.7, 1);
    scene.add(b.card);
  }
  const c = b.card.userData.canvas;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  g.clearRect(0, 0, 512, 288);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(2,14,26,.92)';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 288);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,.65)';
  g.lineWidth = 2;
  g.strokeRect(1, 1, 510, 286);
  g.font = 'bold 22px Consolas';
  g.textAlign = 'left';
  g.textBaseline = 'top';
  g.shadowColor = 'transparent';
  g.shadowBlur = 0;
  g.fillStyle = '#7fe9ff';
  g.fillText((b.info.name || '').slice(0, 30), 14, 10);
  let y = 44;
  for (const l of String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').slice(0, 5)) {
    g.fillStyle = '#ff8b9d';
    g.fillText('− ' + l.slice(0, 46), 14, y);
    y += 24;
  }
  for (const l of String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').slice(0, 6)) {
    g.fillStyle = '#7dffc8';
    g.fillText('+ ' + l.slice(0, 46), 14, y);
    y += 24;
  }
  b.card.userData.tex.needsUpdate = true;
  b.card.visible = true;
  b.card.material.opacity = 1;
  b.cardT = 0;
}

function renderFeed() {
  const box = $('feedList');
  if (!box) return;
  box.innerHTML = activity.list.slice(0, 9).map((e) => {
    const d = new Date(e.ts);
    return `<div class="fitem k-${esc(e.kind)}"><span class="t">${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}</span><span class="k">${KIND_ICON[e.kind] || '◇'}</span><span class="tg" title="${esc(e.tool)} ${esc(e.target)}">${esc(e.tool || e.kind)}${e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : ''}</span><span class="src">${esc(e.source)}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
  $('cntCode').textContent = activity.counts.code;
  $('cntExec').textContent = activity.counts.exec;
  $('cntScan').textContent = activity.counts.scan;
  $('cntErr').textContent = activity.counts.error;
}

function initActivityStream() {
  fetch('/api/events', { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((d) => {
      for (const e of (d.events || []).slice(-14)) addActivity(e, true);
      renderFeed();
    })
    .catch(() => {});
  /* 自动化/无头环境不开 SSE 长连接(会挂住虚拟时间调度), 只拉一次历史 */
  if (navigator.webdriver || qs.has('nostream')) return;
  try {
    const es = new EventSource('/api/stream');
    es.onmessage = (m) => {
      try {
        const d = JSON.parse(m.data);
        if (d.type === 'event' && d.event) addActivity(d.event);
        else if (d.type === 'sentinel' && d.s) renderSentinel(d.s);
        else if (d.type === 'sentinel_toast') toast((d.urgent ? '⚠ ' : '🛡 ') + d.msg, !!d.urgent);
      } catch { /* 脏帧忽略 */ }
    };
  } catch { /* EventSource 不可用则跳过 */ }
}

let modeAt = 0;
function updateMode(now) {
  if (now - modeAt < 500) return;
  modeAt = now;
  const el = $('agentMode');
  const led = $('feedLed');
  const ago = activity.lastAt ? now - activity.lastAt : Infinity;
  let m, cls;
  if (ago < 9000) {
    switch (activity.lastKind) {
      case 'code': m = '编码中 CODING'; cls = 'coding'; break;
      case 'exec': m = '调试中 DEBUGGING'; cls = 'debug'; break;
      case 'error': m = '排障中 FIXING'; cls = 'fault'; break;
      case 'task': m = '规划中 PLANNING'; cls = 'coding'; break;
      default: m = '检索中 SCANNING'; cls = 'scan';
    }
  } else if (ago < 60000) { m = '活跃 ACTIVE'; cls = 'scan'; }
  else { m = '待机 IDLE'; cls = 'idle'; }
  if (el.textContent !== m) {
    el.textContent = m;
    el.className = cls;
    if (led) led.className = 'led ' + (cls === 'fault' ? 'err' : 'ok');
  }
}

/* ---------------- 事件范围过滤 ---------------- */
function applyEventFilter() {
  const from = Number($('filterFrom').value) || null;
  const to = Number($('filterTo').value) || null;
  if (isNaN(from) && $('filterFrom').value !== '') { alert('from 必须是有效的毫秒数'); return; }
  if (isNaN(to) && $('filterTo').value !== '') { alert('to 必须是有效的毫秒数'); return; }
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if ($('filterFrom').value !== '') params.set('from', $('filterFrom').value);
  if ($('filterTo').value !== '') params.set('to', $('filterTo').value);
  fetch('/api/events?' + params.toString(), { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((d) => {
      const list = $('feedList');
      if (!list) return;
      list.innerActivity.list = (d.events || []).map((e) => ({
        ts: e.ts, kind: e.kind, tool: e.tool, target: e.target, source: e.source,
        file: e.file, diff: e.diff,
      }));
      // render the last 14 events
      const recent = (d.events || []).slice(-14);
      list.innerHTML = recent.map((e) => {
        const date = new Date(e.ts);
        return `<div class="fitem k-${esc(e.kind)}"><span class="t">${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}:${pad(date.getSeconds())}</span><span class="k">${KIND_ICON[e.kind] || '◇'}</span><span class="tg" title="${esc(e.tool)} ${esc(e.target)}">${esc(e.tool || e.kind)}${e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : ''}</span><span class="src">${esc(e.source)}</span></div>`;
      }).join('');
      $('cntCode').textContent = activity.counts.code;
      $('cntExec').textContent = activity.counts.exec;
      $('cntScan').textContent = activity.counts.scan;
      $('cntErr').textContent = activity.counts.error;
    })
    .catch((e) => console.error('事件过滤错误:', e));
}

$('filterBtn').addEventListener('click', applyEventFilter);

/* 按 Enter 错也触发过滤 */
$('filterFrom').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') applyEventFilter(); });
$('filterTo').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') applyEventFilter(); });

/* ---------------- 指标渲染 ---------------- */
function applyMetrics(m) {
  state.metrics = m;
  const { cpu, mem, sys, disks, net } = m;

  /* 仪表 */
  tweenNum($('cpuPct'), cpu.avgPct, 1);
  setGauge($('cpuArc'), cpu.avgPct);
  tweenNum($('memPct'), mem.pct, 1);
  setGauge($('memArc'), mem.pct);
  $('memUsed').textContent = mem.usedGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  $('memTotal').textContent = mem.totalGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  $('memFree').textContent = mem.freeGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';

  updateCoreBars(cpu);

  $('cpuModel').textContent = sys.cpuModel;
  $('cpuModel').title = sys.cpuModel;
  $('cpuCores').textContent = sys.cores + ' 核心';
  $('cpuClock').textContent = cpu.speedMhz ? (cpu.speedMhz / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' GHz' : '--';

  renderDisks(disks);

  tweenNum($('rxBps'), net.rxBps, 0, fmtBps);
  tweenNum($('txBps'), net.txBps, 0, fmtBps);

  $('hostName').textContent = sys.hostname;
  $('osInfo').textContent = sys.platform;
  $('archInfo').textContent = sys.arch;
  $('gpuInfo').textContent = sys.gpu;
  $('gpuInfo').title = sys.gpu;
  $('ipInfo').textContent = sys.ips.join(' / ') || '无外部地址';
  $('ipInfo').title = sys.ips.join(' / ');
  $('upTime').textContent = fmtUptime(sys.uptimeSec);

  /* 历史 */
  state.hist.cpu.push(cpu.avgPct);
  state.hist.rx.push(net.rxBps);
  state.hist.tx.push(net.txBps);
  for (const k of ['cpu', 'rx', 'tx']) if (state.hist[k].length > HIST_MAX) state.hist[k].shift();
  drawCharts();

  buildTicker(m);
}

function setFocusFile(key, toastIt = true) {
  state.focus = key;
  const b = key ? city.map.get(key) : null;
  const el = $('focusFile');
  if (b) {
    drawTextSprite(focusSprite, b.info.name);
    el.textContent = `${b.info.name} · ${b.info.edits} 次修改`;
    el.className = 'ok';
    if (toastIt) toast(`已聚焦 ${b.info.name}`);
  } else {

    el.textContent = '— 点击3D文件楼宇 —';
    el.className = 'dim';
  }
}

/* ---------------- 数据同步 (每3分钟) ---------------- */
async function doSync(manual = false) {
  if (state.syncing) return;
  state.syncing = true;
  setSvc('SYNCING');
  $('syncState').textContent = '同步中 SYNCING...';
  $('syncState').className = 'dim';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/metrics', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const m = await r.json();
    if (m.error) throw new Error(m.error);
    applyMetrics(m);
    state.lastSyncAt = Date.now();
    setSvc('ONLINE');
    $('lastSyncTime').textContent = timeStr(state.lastSyncAt);
    $('syncState').textContent = '同步成功 OK';
    $('syncState').className = 'ok';
    if (manual) spawnWave(0xff2fb3);
    spawnWave(0x00e5ff);
    spawnWave(0x3b82f6, 0.25);
    toast((manual ? '手动同步完成 MANUAL' : '数据同步完成 DATA SYNCED') + ' · ' + timeStr(state.lastSyncAt));
  } catch (e) {
    setSvc('OFFLINE');
    $('syncState').textContent = '同步失败 FAILED';
    $('syncState').className = 'err';
    toast('数据同步失败: ' + e.message + ' · 15s 后重试', true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      state.syncing = false;
      state.nextSyncAt = Date.now();
    }, 15000);
    return;
  }
  state.syncing = false;
  state.nextSyncAt = Date.now() + SYNC_INTERVAL;
}

function tickCountdown() {
  if (!state.nextSyncAt) return;
  const rem = Math.max(0, state.nextSyncAt - Date.now());
  const frac = 1 - rem / SYNC_INTERVAL;
  $('syncArc').style.strokeDasharray = `${(frac * 100).toFixed(2)} 100`;
  const s = Math.ceil(rem / 1000);
  const txt = `${pad(Math.floor(s / 60))}:${pad(s % 60)}`;
  const cd = $('countdown');
  if (cd.textContent !== txt) cd.textContent = txt;
  if (rem === 0 && !state.syncing && state.booted) doSync();
}

/* ---------------- 哨兵智能体 (感知→大脑→权限闸门→影子提案) ---------------- */

/**
 * free-ladder v1.2.0-dsh — 智能化免费升梯(质量从低到高 · 健康记忆 · 任务感知)
 *
 * v1.2 新增(2026-10-31 用户指令「模型池自动化选择没做好」):
 *   ① 健康记忆:每个档位记录失败码/次数/冷却期,冷却中的档位自动跳过(不浪费重试)。
 *      冷却时长按失败码分级:QUOTA 4h(魔搭免费额度按天)、RATE_LIMIT 90s、
 *      TIMEOUT/SERVER 30s、AUTH/UNKNOWN_MODEL 12h。健康状态持久化
 *      dsh-home/free-ladder-health.json,重启不丢。
 *   ② 任务复杂度感知:每条用户消息估分(长度 + 工程关键词),首个请求直接从
 *      匹配的档位起跑——小任务从梯底零成本起步,重构类任务直接从高档起跑。
 *   ③ 升梯仍全自动、全免费;付费闸门语义原样保留(确认付费 → 10 分钟 10 次)。
 *
 * 兼容:配置 schema 向后兼容(ladder/rotateCodes/paidDefault/confirmPhrase/
 * enabled/logFile),新增 cooldownMs/complexitySteps/healthFile。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis';
import { scrubFreeTierValue } from '../../brain/outbound.mjs';
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery';

const VERSION = '1.2.1-dsh';
const NAME = 'free-ladder';
const HOME_DIR = process.env.DSH_HOME || path.join(os.homedir(), '.dsh');

/** 免费升梯(2026-10-31 用户指令:质量从低到高,全部免费,耗尽才见付费确认)。 */
const DEFAULT_LADDER = [
  'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free',
  'kilo-free/poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free',
  'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free',
  'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next',
  'ovh-free/Qwen3.5-9B',
  'kilo-free/recursive/flint-v1.0:free',
  'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B',
  'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free',
  'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B',
  'modelscope/ZhipuAI/GLM-5.2',
  'ovh-free/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B',
];

const DEFAULT_ROTATE_CODES = [
  'RATE_LIMIT', 'QUOTA', 'ACCOUNT_QUOTA', 'NO_ADAPTER', 'UNKNOWN_MODEL',
  'AUTH', 'SERVER', 'TIMEOUT', 'TRANSPORT', 'EMPTY_RESPONSE', 'CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED',
];

/** 会话确认词;命中后本会话允许在免费全空时落到付费档。 */
const DEFAULT_CONFIRM_PHRASE = '确认付费';

/** 免费全空后的付费默认档(需人工确认门)。 */
const DEFAULT_PAID_DEFAULT = 'siliconflow/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash';

/** 任务复杂度关键词(命中 +1 分;长度每 800 字 +1 分,封顶 4)。 */
const COMPLEXITY_MARKERS = [
  '重构', '架构', '实现', '系统', '完整', '全部', '多个文件', '工程', '移植',
  '端到端', '测试通过', '迁移', '搭建', 'refactor', 'architecture', 'migration', 'full',
];

/** 'provider/model'(model id 内含斜杠)→ { provider, model }。 */
function splitRoute(routeStr) {
  const s = String(routeStr || '').trim();
  const slash = s.indexOf('/');
  if (slash <= 0) return null;
  return { provider: s.slice(0, slash), model: s.slice(slash + 1) };
}

/** 复杂度估分(0..∞;启发式,可被 health 记忆纠正)。 */
function complexityScore(text) {
  const t = String(text || '');
  let s = Math.min(4, Math.floor(t.length / 800));
  const low = t.toLowerCase();
  for (const m of COMPLEXITY_MARKERS) if (low.includes(m)) s += 1;
  return s;
}

export default class FreeLadderService extends Service {
  static Config = z.object({
    ladder: z.array(z.string()).default(DEFAULT_LADDER),
    rotateCodes: z.array(z.string()).default(DEFAULT_ROTATE_CODES),
    paidDefault: z.string().default(DEFAULT_PAID_DEFAULT),
    confirmPhrase: z.string().default(DEFAULT_CONFIRM_PHRASE),
    /** 失败码 → 冷却毫秒(冷却中的档位自动跳过) */
    cooldownMs: z.any().default({
      QUOTA: 4 * 3600000, ACCOUNT_QUOTA: 4 * 3600000,
      RATE_LIMIT: 90000, TIMEOUT: 30000, SERVER: 30000, TRANSPORT: 30000,
      EMPTY_RESPONSE: 10000, CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED: 12 * 3600000,
      AUTH: 12 * 3600000, NO_ADAPTER: 12 * 3600000, UNKNOWN_MODEL: 12 * 3600000,
    }),
    /** 复杂度分 → 起始档位(分数从低到高命中哪个阈值,就从哪个档位起步) */
    complexitySteps: z.array(z.number()).default([1, 3, 6]),
    healthFile: z.string().default(path.join(HOME_DIR, 'free-ladder-health.json')),
    logFile: z.string().default(path.join(HOME_DIR, 'free-ladder.log')),
    enabled: z.boolean().default(true),
  });

  constructor(ctx, config) {
    super(ctx, 'freeLadder');
    this.config = config;
    this.routes = (config.ladder || []).map(splitRoute).filter(Boolean);
    this.paidAllowed = new Map();
    this.pending = new Map();
    /** 健康记忆: routeString → { cooldownUntil, fails:{code:n}, lastFailAt } */
    this.health = new Map();
    /** 每会话:复杂度分 / 智能起步标记 */
    this.complexity = new Map();
    this.started = new Set();
    this.loadHealth();
    this.log({
      ev: 'loaded', version: VERSION, rungs: config.ladder,
      paidDefault: config.paidDefault, smart: true,
    });

    // 用户消息:估复杂度(本轮智能起步用)+ 清智能起步标记 + 确认付费门
    ctx.on('session/event', (p1, p2) => {
      try {
        const session = (p1 && p1.session) ? p1.session : p1;
        const event = (p1 && p1.event) ? p1.event : p2;
        if (!session || !event || event.type !== 'user/message') return;
        const message = event.data && typeof event.data === 'object' ? event.data : event;
        const blocks = Array.isArray(message && message.content) ? message.content : [];
        const text = blocks
          .filter((b) => b && (b.type === 'text-input' || b.type === 'text') && typeof b.text === 'string')
          .map((b) => b.text)
          .join('\n');
        this.paidAllowed.delete(session.id);
        const pending = this.pending.get(session.id);
        if (pending && !this.isFree(pending)) this.pending.delete(session.id);
        this.complexity.set(session.id, complexityScore(text));
        this.started.delete(session.id);
        if (text.trim() === this.config.confirmPhrase && this.config.confirmPhrase.trim()) {
          this.paidAllowed.set(session.id, { expiresAt: Date.now() + 600000, remaining: 10 });
          this.log({ ev: 'paid_allowed', sessionId: session.id, ttlMs: 600000, maxRequests: 10 });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        this.log({ ev: 'session_event_error', err: String(e && e.message || e) });
      }
    });

    // 换枪正门:每次请求构建前触发。优先级:粘性换枪 > 智能起步 > 原样。
    ctx.on('agent/request', async (payload, next) => {
      const out = await next();
      try {
        const sid = payload?.agent?.session?.id ?? (payload?.agent ? this.sessionIdOf(payload.agent) : null);
        const target = sid ? this.pending.get(sid) : null;
        if (target && out && out.provider && out.model) {
          const onLadder = this.routes.findIndex((r) => r.provider === out.provider && r.model === out.model);
          if (onLadder >= 0 && !(target.provider === out.provider && target.model === out.model)) {
            this.log({ ev: 'req_route_override', turn: payload?.turn, step: payload?.step, from: `${out.provider}/${out.model}`, to: `${target.provider}/${target.model}` });
            return { ...out, provider: target.provider, model: target.model };
          }
        }
        // 智能起步:本会话首个请求,按复杂度直接落到匹配档位(仅限梯内免费路线)
        // 1.2.1 修复(2026-10-31 实弹证据 session-c3089c28):原实现只改返回值,上游不消费——
        // 日志记了跳 rung9,请求实际仍打在原档(idx0/1)。改为与轮换路径同款:直接改
        // agent.options(已证实的生效通道)+ 返回值双保险。
        // 顺带补第二洞:首请求原本不看健康表,冷却中的当前档照样发枪白吃一次 429;
        // 现在当前档冷却中则上移到最近就绪档。
        if (sid && !this.started.has(sid) && this.complexity.has(sid) && out && out.provider && out.model) {
          this.started.add(sid);
          const rung = this.routes.findIndex((r) => r.provider === out.provider && this.normModel(r.model) === this.normModel(out.model));
          if (rung >= 0) {
            const want = this.startRungFor(sid);
            let target = -1, why = '';
            if (want > rung && this.isRungReady(want)) target = want;
            else if (!this.isRungReady(rung)) {
              for (let i = rung + 1; i < this.routes.length - 1; i++) {
                if (this.isRungReady(i)) { target = i; break; }
              }
              if (target === -1) why = 'current-cooled-none-ready';
            } else why = 'rung-not-ready-or-not-higher';
            if (target > rung) {
              const t = this.routes[target];
              this.pending.set(sid, t);
              const agent = payload && payload.agent;
              if (agent && agent.options) { agent.options.provider = t.provider; agent.options.model = t.model; }
              this.log({ ev: 'smart_start', sessionId: sid, score: this.complexity.get(sid), from: `${out.provider}/${out.model}`, to: `${t.provider}/${t.model}`, rung: target, applied: 'options' });
              return { ...out, provider: t.provider, model: t.model };
            }
            this.log({ ev: 'smart_start_skip', sessionId: sid, want, rung, reason: why || 'rung-not-ready-or-not-higher' });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) { this.log({ ev: 'req_error', err: String(e && e.message || e) }); }
      return out;
    });

    ctx.on('agent/request-error', (payload, next) => this.handler(payload, next));
    ctx.inject(['llm'], (scope) => scope.on('llm/stream', (options, next) => this.admitStream(options, next)));
  }

  /* ── 健康记忆 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  loadHealth() {
    try {
      const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.config.healthFile, 'utf8'));
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d || {})) this.health.set(k, v);
      this.log({ ev: 'health_loaded', entries: this.health.size });
    } catch { /* 首次运行无文件 */ }
  }
  saveHealth() {
    try {
      const obj = {};
      for (const [k, v] of this.health) obj[k] = v;
      fs.writeFileSync(this.config.healthFile, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 1));
    } catch { /* 持久化失败不影响运行 */ }
  }
  healthOf(routeStr) {
    if (!this.health.has(routeStr)) this.health.set(routeStr, { fails: {}, cooldownUntil: 0, lastFailAt: 0 });
    return this.health.get(routeStr);
  }
  /** 失败记账 + 分级冷却 */
  markFail(routeStr, code) {
    const h = this.healthOf(routeStr);
    h.fails = h.fails || {};
    h.fails[code] = (h.fails[code] || 0) + 1;
    h.lastFailAt = Date.now();
    const cd = this.config.cooldownMs[code] ?? 30000;
    h.cooldownUntil = Math.max(h.cooldownUntil || 0, Date.now() + cd);
    this.saveHealth();
    this.log({ ev: 'cooldown', route: routeStr, code, cooldownUntil: new Date(h.cooldownUntil).toISOString() });
  }
  isRungReady(idx) {
    const r = this.routes[idx];
    if (!r) return false;
    const key = `${r.provider}/${r.model}`;
    const h = this.health.get(key);
    return !h || (h.cooldownUntil || 0) <= Date.now();
  }
  /** 复杂度分 → 起始档位(就绪优先:档位冷却中则取其上最近就绪档) */
  startRungFor(sid) {
    const score = this.complexity.get(sid) || 0;
    const steps = this.config.complexitySteps || [1, 3, 6];
    let want = 0;
    if (score >= steps[steps.length - 1]) want = this.routes.length - 2; // 顶档留给 GLM-5.2,ovh 殿后不主动起跑
    else {
      for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
        if (score < steps[i]) { want = [0, 3, 7][i] ?? 0; break; }
        if (i === steps.length - 1) want = 9;
      }
    }
    want = Math.min(want, this.routes.length - 2);
    // 就绪优先:目标档冷却中 → 向上找最近就绪档
    for (let i = want; i < this.routes.length - 1; i++) {
      if (this.isRungReady(i)) return i;
    }
    return want;
  }

  isFree(route) { return this.routes.some((r) => r.provider === route.provider && r.model === route.model); }
  hasPaidGrant(sid) {
    for (const [k, g] of this.paidAllowed) { if (g.expiresAt <= Date.now()) this.paidAllowed.delete(k); }
    const grant = this.paidAllowed.get(sid);
    if (!grant || grant.remaining < 1) { this.paidAllowed.delete(sid); return false; }
    return true;
  }
  async *admitStream(options, next) {
    if (this.config.enabled && this.isFree(options)) {
      // 出站筛查改为「检查式」(2026-11-07 用户裁决):
      // dsh-agent-loop buildRequest(:1281) 对 LOOP-built 请求 Object.freeze——瀑布监听者
      // 按框架设计只读,原地改写架构性不可能(实测必抛 read-only 赋值错)。
      // 旧的原地剥离回写自上线起从未成功过(memory_stripped 事件恒 0),却让 headless
      // 必然崩溃。现保留一条硬防线:正文检测到真实凭据值 → 拒发;键名类改写与
      // 记忆标记剥离 → 放行 + 日志留痕(筛查降级为检查式,已向用户声明)。
      const state = { blocked: false, stripped: 0, redactions: 0 };
      scrubFreeTierValue(options, state);
      if (state.blocked) {
        const error = new Error('[free-ladder:CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED] 发往免费梯队的上下文检测到真实凭据值，已取消本次请求（检查式防线，用户裁决 2026-11-07）。');
        error.code = 'CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED';
        throw error;
      }
      if (state.stripped + state.redactions > 0) {
        this.log({ ev: 'screening_passed_with_notes', stripped: state.stripped, redactions: state.redactions,
          note: 'check-only: frozen request cannot be rewritten in place; non-credential content allowed per user decision' });
      }
    }
    if (this.config.enabled && !this.isFree(options)) {
      const sid = options.sessionId;
      if (!sid || !this.hasPaidGrant(sid)) {
        const error = new Error('[free-ladder:PAID_APPROVAL_REQUIRED] 当前路线不在免费白名单。请在当前会话单独回复「' + this.config.confirmPhrase + '」：授权 10 分钟内最多 10 次付费请求；下一条用户消息、取消或重启即失效。');
        error.code = 'PAID_APPROVAL_REQUIRED';
        throw error;
      }
      this.paidAllowed.get(sid).remaining--;
      this.log({ ev: 'paid_admitted', sessionId: sid, route: options.provider + '/' + options.model, remaining: this.paidAllowed.get(sid).remaining });
    }
    yield* next();
  }

  log(entry) {
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.config.logFile), { recursive: true });
      fs.appendFileSync(this.config.logFile, `${new Date().toISOString()} ${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`, 'utf8');
    } catch { /* 日志失败绝不影响主流程 */ }
  }

  /** 档位匹配容错: 忽略 ':free' 后缀差异(默认模型与梯子 id 书写不一致的防线) */
  normModel(m) { return String(m || '').replace(/:free$/i, ''); }
  rungIndexOf(agent) {
    const opts = agent && agent.options ? agent.options : null;
    if (!opts) return -1;
    return this.routes.findIndex((r) => r.provider === opts.provider && this.normModel(r.model) === this.normModel(opts.model));
  }
  sessionIdOf(agent) {
    try { return agent.session.id ?? '?'; } catch { return '?'; }
  }

  handler({ agent, turn, step, provider, failure, signal }, next) {
    return (async () => {
      if (!this.config.enabled) return next();
      const code = (failure && failure.code) || '';
      if (!agent || !agent.options || !agent.session) return next();

      const idx = this.rungIndexOf(agent);
      const current = `${agent.options.provider ?? ''}/${agent.options.model ?? ''}`;
      this.log({ ev: 'saw', turn, step, code, idx, upstream: provider ?? '?', current, sessionId: this.sessionIdOf(agent) });
      if (idx === -1) return next(); // 不在梯上(付费/官方/手动)——绝不越权

      const downstream = await next();
      if (downstream && downstream.kind === 'retry') { this.log({ ev: 'downstream_retry', turn, step, code }); return downstream; }
      if (!this.config.rotateCodes.includes(code) || signal?.aborted) return downstream;

      const opts = agent.options;
      const sid = this.sessionIdOf(agent);
      this.markFail(current, code); // 健康记忆 + 冷却

      // 顺梯换枪:跳过冷却中的档位,取最近就绪档
      for (let i = idx + 1; i < this.routes.length; i++) {
        if (!this.isRungReady(i)) { this.log({ ev: 'skip_cooldown', turn, step, rung: i, route: `${this.routes[i].provider}/${this.routes[i].model}` }); continue; }
        const oldRoute = current;
        const nxt = this.routes[i];
        opts.provider = nxt.provider;
        opts.model = nxt.model;
        this.pending.set(sid, nxt);
        this.log({ ev: 'rotate', turn, step, code, from: oldRoute, to: `${nxt.provider}/${nxt.model}`, rung: i, sessionId: sid });
        return { kind: 'retry' };
      }

      // ── 梯底 ──
      if (this.hasPaidGrant(sid)) {
        const paid = splitRoute(this.config.paidDefault);
        if (paid) {
          const oldRoute = current;
          opts.provider = paid.provider;
          opts.model = paid.model;
          this.pending.set(sid, paid);
          this.log({ ev: 'paid_switch', turn, step, code, from: oldRoute, to: this.config.paidDefault, sessionId: sid });
          return { kind: 'retry' };
        }
      }
      if (code === 'NO_ADAPTER' || code === 'UNKNOWN_MODEL') {
        this.log({ ev: 'exhaust', turn, step, code, sessionId: sid, notice: 'suppressed-config-error' });
        return downstream;
      }
      this.notice(agent, turn, step, failure);
      this.log({ ev: 'exhaust', turn, step, code, sessionId: sid, notice: 'appended' });
      return downstream;
    })();
  }

  /** 免费全空提示:落一条 developer 消息进会话表(可见);失败则仅记账。 */
  notice(agent, turn, step, failure) {
    const code = failure?.code || 'UNKNOWN';
    const detail = String(failure?.message || '').slice(0, 180);
    const text = [
      `⚠️ 免费阶梯全部耗尽（末级失败 ${code}：${detail}）`,
      `继续本任务需要付费 API。单独回复「${this.config.confirmPhrase}」授权本会话 10 分钟内最多 10 次付费请求（`,
      `付费默认档 ${this.config.paidDefault}）；手动选付费模型也需要此授权。`,
      '下一条用户消息、取消付费或服务重启将撤销授权；子会话不继承。',
    ].join('\n');
    try {
      agent.session.append('developer/message', {
        turn, step, message: {
          role: 'developer',
          id: randomUUID(),
          source: { kind: 'tool-registry' },
          content: [{ type: 'text', text }],
        },
      }, { surfaceOp: 'append' });
    } catch (e) {
      this.log({ ev: 'notice_error', err: String(e && e.message || e) });
    }
  }
}

export const name = NAME;
export const version = VERSION;
export const DEFAULT_LADDER_T = DEFAULT_LADDER;

//
// 2026-10-27 修正（真实事故，19 小时无人察觉）：
//   原来这里写死 fail-closed —— 只要 .lock 存在就抛 EEXIST，不管持锁的人是不是还活着。
//   10-26 22:05 有个进程在锁里留了 pid 15848 就没了，锁就永久占着：
//   每一次 appendLedger 都失败 → 被 index.js 的 catch 吞掉 → 账本从那一刻起一条记录都没写，
//   而闸门本身照常在放行/拒绝（拒绝理由是对的），于是表现为"闸门在工作、账本全空"，
//   探针 0/7、边框灯的账本数据源也一起停摆，19 小时没人发现。
//
//   现在的规矩：
//     · 锁文件 pid 就是本进程、但本进程的重入表里没有这把锁 → 上一笔 unlink 失败留下的
//       自身残锁（Windows 上 EPERM/EBUSY 很常见）。直接回收，不叫偷锁。
//     · 持锁 pid 已明确不存在 → 陈旧，改名归档后抢
//     · 持锁 pid 还活着、但锁龄超过 lockStaleMs → 也回收。pid 复用或卡死都会让
//       「还活着」变成永久拒绝；账本临界区是同步的毫秒级操作，超龄就是卡死。
//     · 归档之后回读归档内容，pid/at 必须和判陈旧时一致，否则是把别人刚建的新锁
//       一起改走了，立刻改名还原。
//     · 释放时只删 pid 仍是自己的锁，unlink 重试；仍失败写 unlink-failed.log。
const held = new Set();
// 本进程**曾经**持有过的锁（跨 finally 失败存活）。自身残锁回收只认这个集合：
// pid 相同但从没持有过 → 那不是残锁，是别人（或探针伪造）的活锁，绝不偷，
// 等满 waitMs 报 LOCK_BUSY 把持锁 pid 说清楚（probe-ledger-lock case 2 钉的就是它）。
const heldEver = new Set();
const LOCK_MAX_RECLAIM = 3;
// 阈值**运行时**读，不在模块加载时定死 —— 否则测试/运维改了环境变量却不生效，
// 只剩"看着像可配"的假象。
const lockWaitMs = () => Number(process.env.CUA_LEDGER_LOCK_WAIT_MS ?? 2000);
const lockStaleMs = () => Number(process.env.CUA_LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_MS ?? 600000);

function sleepSync(ms) {

}

export function pidAlive(pid) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) return false;
  try { process.kill(pid, 0); return true; } catch (e) { return e && e.code === 'EPERM'; }
}

export function readLockMeta(file) {

export function lockIdentityMatches(got, expected) {

  return got.pid === expected.pid && got.at === expected.at;

export function reclaimLock(file, meta, why, deps = {}) {
  const readMeta = deps.readMeta || readLockMeta;
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
  const archived = `${file}.stale-${stamp}-${crypto.randomBytes(3).toString('hex')}`;
  try {
    fs.renameSync(file, archived);

    try {

    return false;
  }
  try {
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(file), 'reclaim.log'),
      `${new Date().toISOString()} reclaimed ${path.basename(file)} reason=${why} pid=${meta.pid} age=${Math.round((Date.now() - (meta.at || 0)) / 1000)}s archived=${path.basename(archived)}\n`, 'utf8');
  } catch { /* 留痕失败不影响回收 */ }

}

function releaseOwnLock(lock, fd) {
  try { fs.closeSync(fd); } catch { /* 已关 */ }
  let last = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    try {
      const meta = readLockMeta(lock);
      if (!meta) return;
      // 已被别人合法接管：绝不能替他删。
      if (meta.pid !== process.pid) return;
      fs.rmSync(lock, { force: true });

    } catch (e) {
      last = e;
      if (e && e.code === 'ENOENT') return;
      sleepSync(25);
    }
  }
  try {
    fs.appendFileSync(
      path.join(path.dirname(lock), 'unlink-failed.log'),
      `${new Date().toISOString()} pid=${process.pid} lock=${lock} err=${last && last.code ? last.code : String(last)}\n`,
      'utf8');
  } catch { /* 记不下也不能崩 */ }
}

function lockIsStale(meta, key) {
  if (!meta) return false;
  const age = Date.now() - (meta.at || 0);
  // 盘上 pid=自己，但重入表没有：上一笔 finally 没能删掉锁。
  // 只有本进程**真的持有过**这把锁（heldEver）才算自身残锁；从没碰过的同名锁
  // 是别人的活锁（或探针伪造的同 pid 锁），绝不偷 —— 等满 waitMs 报 LOCK_BUSY。
  if (meta.pid === process.pid && !held.has(key) && heldEver.has(key)) return 'self-pid-residue';
  if (meta.pid != null && !pidAlive(meta.pid)) return 'pid-dead';
  if (age > lockStaleMs()) return meta.pid != null ? 'pid-alive-aged' : 'no-pid-aged';
  return false;
}

export function locked(file, fn) {
  const key = path.resolve(file).toLowerCase();
  if (held.has(key)) return fn();
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const lock = file + '.lock';
  const waitMs = lockWaitMs();
  const deadline = Date.now() + waitMs;
  let fd = null;
  let reclaims = 0;
  for (;;) {
    try { fd = fs.openSync(lock, 'wx'); break; }
    catch (e) {
      if (e && e.code !== 'EEXIST') throw e;
      const meta = readLockMeta(lock);
      if (!meta) continue; // 锁刚好被释放，立刻再抢
      const alive = meta.pid != null ? pidAlive(meta.pid) : false;
      const age = Date.now() - (meta.at || 0);
      const why = lockIsStale(meta, key);
      if (why && reclaims < LOCK_MAX_RECLAIM) {
        reclaims++;
        if (reclaimLock(lock, meta, why)) continue;
      }
      if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
        const who = meta.pid != null ? `pid=${meta.pid}（${alive ? '仍在运行' : '已不存在'}）` : `无 pid 记录（锁年龄 ${Math.round(age / 1000)}s）`;
        throw Object.assign(
          Error(`[cua-gate] 账本链锁被占用：${who}，已等待 ${waitMs}ms。`),

  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); }
  catch (e) { if (e.code === 'ENOENT') return fallback; throw e; }

/** Windows 上目标被读者打开时 rename 会 EPERM/EBUSY，短重试几次再放弃。 */
export function renameReplace(from, to) {
  let last;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    try {
      fs.renameSync(from, to);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      last = e;
      const code = e && e.code;
      if (code === 'EPERM' || code === 'EBUSY' || code === 'EACCES') {
        sleepSync(20 + i * 15);
        continue;
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }

export function atomicWrite(file, value) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const tmp = file + '.' + crypto.randomUUID() + '.tmp';
  let fd = null;
  try {
    fd = fs.openSync(tmp, 'wx');
    fs.writeSync(fd, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));

    fs.closeSync(fd);
    fd = null;
    renameReplace(tmp, file);
  } finally {
    if (fd != null) { try { fs.closeSync(fd); } catch { /* 已关 */ } }

export function consume(file, ticket) {
  return locked(file, () => {
    const list = readState(file, []);
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw Error('Invalid ticket store');
    const current = list.find(t => t?.id === ticket.id);
    // Detect revoke, approval/target change, expiry and competing consumption.
    if (!current || JSON.stringify(current) !== JSON.stringify(ticket) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(current.remaining)) || Number(current.remaining) < 1 ||
      !(Date.parse(current.expiresAt) > Date.now())) return false;
    current.remaining = Number(current.remaining) - 1;
    atomicWrite(file, list.filter(t => t !== current || current.remaining > 0));

const HASH_RE = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/;

function readTailBuffer(file, max) {
  const size = fs.statSync(file).size;
  if (!size) return { buf: Buffer.alloc(0), size: 0 };
  const len = Math.min(size, max);
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(len);
  const fd = fs.openSync(file, 'r');
  try { fs.readSync(fd, buf, 0, len, size - len); }
  finally { try { fs.closeSync(fd); } catch { /* 已关 */ } }
  return { buf, size };
}

function hashFromComplete(buf, file) {
  if (!buf.length) return null;
  const text = buf.toString('utf8');
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  if (text.endsWith('\n')) lines.pop();
  // 只认**最后一条**非空行。旧版从这里向前跳过坏行找好哈希 —— 那等于从"已不是末行"的
  // 历史行接链，appendLedger 写出的 prev 指向一行不是账本末行的记录，verify 当场判分叉
  // （dsh-home/safeguard-ledger/2026-11-02.jsonl:1 的实证）。fail-closed：末行坏了宁可
  // 抛错拒写、让人立刻来看，也不从坏尾巴上接链制造新分叉。
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    let rec;
    try { rec = JSON.parse(line); }
    catch {
      throw new Error(`Invalid ledger tail: ${path.basename(file)}: 最后一条完整行不是合法 JSON（拒写，不从坏尾巴接链）`);
    }
    if (rec.h === undefined) return null; // legacy 无链时代的文件：整个文件跳过，prev 落到更老的文件/genesis
    if (typeof rec.h !== 'string' || !HASH_RE.test(rec.h)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid ledger tail: ${path.basename(file)}: 末行 h 不是 64 位十六进制摘要（拒写，不从坏尾巴接链）`);
    }
    return rec.h;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * 从文件尾找最后一条 h 合法的记录。
 * 半行按原始字节切在最后一个 0x0A 之后。不能先 decode 再按字符串字节数回截：
 * 撕在 UTF-8 半个字上时，替换字符会比原字节更长，把上一条好记录的换行一起切掉。
 * 合法 JSON 但缺结尾换行：补一个换行，哈希照用。
 * 返回末行的哈希；文件空 / 只有半行 / legacy 无链文件返回 null。
 * 末行损坏（非法 JSON、或 h 不是 64 位十六进制）抛 Invalid ledger tail —— appendLedger
 * 让它冒泡成"拒写"，绝不从坏尾巴接链（2026-11-02 分叉事故的根因修复）。
 */
export function repairLedgerTail(file) {
  let { buf, size } = readTailBuffer(file, 65536);
  if (!size) return null;
  if (buf.length < size && !buf.includes(0x0a)) buf = fs.readFileSync(file);
  else if (buf.length < size) buf = buf.subarray(buf.indexOf(0x0a) + 1);
  const endsNl = buf.length > 0 && buf[buf.length - 1] === 0x0a;
  let complete;
  let unfinished;
  if (endsNl) {
    complete = buf;
    unfinished = Buffer.alloc(0);
  } else {
    const lastNl = buf.lastIndexOf(0x0a);
    if (lastNl < 0) {
      complete = Buffer.alloc(0);
      unfinished = buf;
    } else {
      complete = buf.subarray(0, lastNl + 1);
      unfinished = buf.subarray(lastNl + 1);
    }
  }
  const hash = hashFromComplete(complete, file);
  if (!unfinished.length) return hash;
  let tailHash = null;
  try {
    const decoded = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(unfinished);
    const rec = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (typeof rec.h === 'string' && HASH_RE.test(rec.h)) tailHash = rec.h;
  } catch { /* 半行或非法 UTF-8 */ }
  if (tailHash) {
    fs.appendFileSync(file, '\n');
    return tailHash;
  }
  const drop = unfinished.length;
  fs.truncateSync(file, Math.max(0, size - drop));
  try {
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(file), '.tail-repair.log'),
      `${new Date().toISOString()} truncated ${path.basename(file)} drop=${drop}\n`, 'utf8');
  } catch { /* 留痕失败不影响续写 */ }
  return hash;
}

export function appendLedger(dir, entry) {
  return locked(path.join(dir, '.chain'), () => {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    // 文件名用 UTC 日期（toISOString 的前 10 位）。北京时间 08:00 前的记录落在「昨天」
    // 那个文件里。改成本地日期会把同一条链拆到两个文件名口径上，所以保持 UTC，只在这里写明。
    const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.jsonl')).sort().reverse();
    let prev = 'genesis';
    for (const file of files) {
      const hash = repairLedgerTail(path.join(dir, file));
      if (hash) { prev = hash; break; }
    }
    const rec = { ...entry, ts: new Date().toISOString(), prev };
    rec.h = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(rec)).digest('hex');
    const fd = fs.openSync(path.join(dir, rec.ts.slice(0, 10) + '.jsonl'), 'a');
    try { fs.writeSync(fd, JSON.stringify(rec) + '\n'); fs.fsyncSync(fd); }
    finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
    return true;
  });
}

# DSH 编程能力整改回信(终版)

自:执行者(ZCode 会话 / GLM-5.3-Flash)。执行、撰写、自审同一实例,无独立性,判定按自评折扣。配套卷宗:三轮评审信、16 块证据表、账本卷宗、观察窗预注册(桌面与 git 共 12 个提交)。

## 一、八问:执行链的代码级回答

1. **决策者=模型本体**。循环骨架在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js`:`while(true)`(:953)→`step(decision)`(:1043)→`prepareRequest`(:1175)→`buildRequest`(:1214,产物 :1281 `Object.freeze`)→`llm.stream`(:1084)。本地插件不在决策环:只经 `tools.guard`(cua-gate/bash-gate 拦截)与 `llm/stream`(free-ladder 供给)两缝介入。行为实证:真任务轮 1 的 22/32 次工具调用序列(todo→edit→write→bash→git diff 自查)无任何本地编排,全部模型逐轮输出。
2. **上下文**:系统提示=refreshContext+插件注入缝(memory 召回【跨会话记忆…】格式、arch 协议、claim 债务、write-verify 体检);用户消息 append;**项目目录/代码/测试输出不预先给**,靠 fs/grep/bash 按需拉取;历史=session jsonl;超长由 dsh-compaction 压缩。缺口:无项目盘点层;工具结果过大被裁剪时对报错行无保真承诺。
3. **工具结果回流**:planned calls→tools.execute(并行上限 :619)→`acceptContext`(:572)并入下一步——模型可依据结果继续(实证:跑测试→exit 0→git diff 自查,无外部触发)。
4. **会话内有持续循环**;跨会话需外部驱动。实测断点:轮间 sessionId 丢失→新会话漫游。
5. **多文件关联无专门机制**:靠模型+搜索+repomap MCP;改接口→找调用方的联动不存在。最大缺口。
6. **测试排错=模型自己**(实证:自改测试窗→重跑 exit 0);write-verify 只注入提示。
7. **目标判定**:框架 goal 服务未接线;有效形态=外置验收器,本轮真实生效(含抓出执行者验收器自己的探针错)。
8. **限制**:task-budget 80 请求/3M tokens/30 分钟任务/300 秒单调用/并发 3;免费梯配额(今日 exhaust 实证);30 分钟任务窗是复杂项目硬约束。

**定性:持续执行机制真实存在;任务连续性、多文件关联、目标判定三件空缺或外置。**

## 二、真实任务:两轮实况与最终判定

任务:在 digital-twin-monitor(生产 3210)新增事件时间范围过滤。独立验收器:隔离副本起 3999 服务、按 ts 打 API、非目标文件比对。

- **轮 1**(22 工具):完成三文件改动+自建测试+自跑 exit 0。独立验收初判 FAIL(V1c 空/V1e 形状/V3)。**取证反转**:实现正确(按 ts 判定),FAIL 源自验收器探错字段(`file`,原有 POST 处理器从不存)+未排除运行时流水——两处验收器缺陷均为执行者手笔,修正后复跑全 PASS。
- **复测(evf-retake,仅给用户症状不给缺陷位置)**:agent 自主定位 API 层、修复范围过滤——**独立验收 7/7 PASS**(V1c 只返回区间内 ts、V1e 全量三条 ts 恰为提交三档=调用方 ts 保留、V1d 400、V3 非目标 clean)。运行 `wf-evf-retake-2026-11-07T12-44-10-645Z`,32 工具调用全轨迹,轮 1 被轮限正常收割(taskkill /T 修复生效,未再挂死)。
- **但两个已知缺陷仍在**(执行者逐行复核):`app.js:951` `list.innerActivity.list`(页面筛选抛错、旧列表残留——用户可见症状未消);`server.js:321` `Number(b.ts)||Date.now()`(`ts:0` 边界,任务书点名的完成条件)。**验收器 V2b 的 loose 标识检查对页面渲染缺陷盲——三方全绿的项藏着真缺陷。**

**最终判定:API 过滤层=DSH 修复合格(独立验收);页面可用与 ts:0=未完成;整体按二审裁决维持不予验收。**

## 三、失败层归属

框架层:冻结请求×scrub 回写(已修,检查式);跨轮 sessionId 捕获(已修但本轮 summary 仍 null,待查);Windows 进程树杀(已修,本轮验证有效)。模型层:第 2 轮缺上下文后漫游、路径带空格——缺上下文时行为劣化。资源层:免费梯 11 档打尽后回血(实证)。**执行者层(新增)**:验收器探针设计与任务书规格缺口,两次误导判定——出题与判卷同责。

## 四、入口修复(验证真实调用链后)

冻结源=`dsh-agent-loop/buildRequest:1281`(框架设计,类型文档"listeners read it");cordis waterfall `next()` 经读码确认复用原 args 引用,替换传参无效——原地改写架构性不可能,且审计显示旧回写自上线从未成功(memory_stripped 恒 0)。按用户裁决改**检查式**:正文真实凭据值→拒发 CREDENTIAL_BLOCKED;键名改写/记忆标记剥离→放行+日志(`screening_passed_with_notes` 本轮实证)。遗留设计决策:清洗器误伤文档(redactions=30)、记忆召回与出站脱敏在免费档互斥。

## 五、resume 更正

`resume-task.cjs` 经全盘查证不存在,原审查信此处失实。自动续跑未实现,列为下一步。

**第一天上午——发现与修复。** 接手时日常链 16 块红灯。逐块取证分成五族:①探针桩树缺件(`mcp/cua/enforce.mjs` 未随 plugins 镜像);②10-31 深夜四连改收紧观察验收后,探针停在旧契约;③11-01 N2b 把 npm install 划入治理,探针未跟;④ollama 挂着,记忆两块一直走 SKIP 假绿;⑤账本三绿链断。修复原则:每处先判「代码对还是探针对」,判据是 git 提交信息与 tests/ 钉死的契约——判错方向就是假绿。同日挖出四个真 bug:`state.mjs` 账本坏尾被静默接链(fail-closed 修复);`sameVisionTag` 不认 `:latest`(记忆向量通道整条静默死亡);`observeResult` 不认真实管线回执形状(enforce 下 CUA 手被冻);`windowIsSensitive` 把标题当 URL 喂同形字防御(中文桌面整屏截图恒拒)。

**第二天——审查与对抗。** 交付评审 rev.1-3。审查方(用户委托 Codex)三轮抓到执行者自评盲区:版本混用、`--verify none` 穮判通过、探针口径漂移。每轮退修逼出真东西:验收器负例自测、账本独立复算包(甲 78/乙 294/丙 2 分账)、冻结请求×scrub 回写第 6 缺陷(检查式防线,用户裁决)。

**第三天——真实任务。** 入口修复(冻结源=agent-loop buildRequest:1281 框架设计,listener 只读)→ 一字任务验证梯子全链真实转动 → 发射真实多文件任务。轮 1:agent 22 次工具调用完成三文件改动、自建测试、自改测试窗、自跑 exit 0——但独立验收抓到真失败。取证反转:实现正确(按 ts 判定),两处验收器探针设计错误出自执行者之手,修正后全 PASS。轮 2:驱动弄丢 sessionId、gapPrompt 丢四条关键约束,新会话裸奔漫游;600 秒 SIGKILL 杀不死进程树,close 永不触发,驱动挂死 35 分钟人工终止。

## 二、复测期间的新发现(评审流程有效的直接证据)

按意见①要求尝试复测时,headless 首次同时激活「dsh-llm 深冻结的 LOOP-built 请求 + free-ladder 凭据剥离回写」,撞出**第 6 个生产缺陷**(补装前不可能暴露——headless 根本没有梯子):

- `free-ladder/index.js` admitStream 无条件 `options[k]=cleaned[k]`,而 scrub 恒返回深克隆 → 冻结请求上必然抛 "Cannot assign to read only property 'messages'"(turn 1 即死,活体复现)。
- 修复:无剥离零赋值(计数器判定 stripped+redactions>0);需剥离而请求冻结 → 新错误码 `CREDENTIAL_SCRUB_BLOCKED` fail-closed 拒发,**绝不降级放行未剥离上下文**。
- 钉死:probe-governance-v5 新增三断言(冻结+无凭据直行 / 冻结+含凭据拒发 / 可写+含凭据仍拦)→ **54 PASS**。

## 三、修订后的结论(按评审人口径)
