#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * probe-surface.mjs — 用假驱动验 surface.mjs 的映射逻辑。
 *
 * 为什么要假驱动：坐标换算、快照回填、期望映射这三件事**看不见**——
 * 它们错了不会报错，只会让点击落到别处、或者 verify 永远通过。
 * 所以用一个记账的假驱动，把每个动作真正收到的参数抓下来断言。
 *
 * 覆盖：
 *   T1  工具面数量与体积（回归基线）
 *   T2  find 的多窗口列出（qemu 工具栏 vs 画面是两扇窗）
 *   T3  see 窗口：元素表压缩、snapshot_id 交出、tree_markdown 不重复
 *   T4  截图缩放后坐标空间被记住，act 的 x/y 自动乘回去
 *   T5  element_index → snapshot_id / element_token 自动回填
 *   T6  act 的 9 个动作映射到正确的驱动工具与参数
 *   T7  drag 的 from/to 也参与坐标换算
 *   T8  verify 的扁平期望 → 驱动嵌套谓词
 *   T9  越界：未知工具、非法 action 不静默通过
 *   T14 settle 走哪条取图通道；断腿·取不到图时不许判稳
 *   T15 a11y 在面上、schema 对得上；列窗口三态（列出/具名失败/不许静默空成功）
 */
import assert from 'node:assert';
import { createDetective } from './_surface-testkit.mjs';

const results = [];
function t(name, fn) {
  try {
    const r = fn();
    results.push({ name, ok: true, note: r || '' });
  } catch (e) {
    results.push({ name, ok: false, note: e.message });
  }
}

let dispatcher, calls, clear;
try {
  ({ dispatcher, calls, clear } = await createDetective());
} catch (e) {
  // 夹具图是 Python+PIL 现画的。缺 Python 属于"这台机此刻没这个能力"，
  // 不是映射逻辑坏了 —— 本探针已进 repo-daily 4x，若在这里抛栈，红的是环境不是代码
  // （和票 TTL 那次连红多天同一个病：断言不许测硬盘里装了什么）。
  console.log('SKIP  工具面探针没有跑起来：' + (e && e.message));
  console.log('      原因通常在 Python+PIL（CUA_PYTHON 指向的解释器）不在位 —— 装好再跑，别当成回归。');
  process.exit(3);
}
const toolNames = dispatcher.tools().map((x) => x.name);

async function main() {
  // ── T1 工具面体积 ──────────────────────────────────────
  t('T1 task 工具面固定清单且大小受限', () => {
    const json = JSON.stringify(dispatcher.tools());
    // settle / a11y 是 2026-10-27 补上的两件（动作沉降、原生无障碍树）。
    // read / await_reply 说明压短，整份清单必须低于 9000 字符（每次会话都要带上）。
    assert.deepStrictEqual(toolNames, ['find','see','act','verify','app','clip','sys','dom_read','dom_act','settle','a11y','read','await_reply']);
    assert.ok(json.length < 9000, `清单 ${json.length} 字符，超出预期`);
    const sizes = dispatcher.tools().map((x) => ({ n: x.name, c: JSON.stringify(x).length })).sort((a, b) => b.c - a.c);
    return `${sizes.length} 个，${json.length} 字符（最胖 ${sizes[0].n} ${sizes[0].c} / 次胖 ${sizes[1].n} ${sizes[1].c}）`;
  });

  // ── T2 find 多窗口 ─────────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    const r = await dispatcher.call('find', {});
    const text = r.content[0].text;
    t('T2 find 列出 qemu 的两扇窗', () => {
      assert.ok(text.includes('win=5374852'), '缺工具栏窗口');
      assert.ok(text.includes('win=1640124'), '缺画布窗口');
      assert.ok(/qemu-system-x86_64\.exe \(pid 31276\)\n/.test(text), '多窗口应换行展开');
      return '两扇窗都在';
    });
    t('T2b find 按 name 过滤且不误留别的程序', () => {
      return '见下一条';
    });
    clear();
    const r2 = await dispatcher.call('find', { name: 'qemu' });
    const t2 = r2.content[0].text;
    t('T2b name 过滤只剩匹配项', () => {
      assert.ok(t2.includes('qemu-system'), '没有保留 qemu');
      assert.ok(!t2.includes('WorkBuddy (pid'), '未把无关程序滤掉');
      return 'ok';
    });
  })();

  // ── T3 see 窗口 ────────────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    const r = await dispatcher.call('see', { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124 });
    const texts = r.content.filter((p) => p.type === 'text').map((p) => p.text);
    const img = r.content.find((p) => p.type === 'image');
    t('T3 see 交出 snapshot_id 且把元素压成短键', () => {
      assert.ok(texts[0].includes('snapshot_id=s00000001'), texts[0]);
      const arr = JSON.parse(texts[1]);
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length === 18, `元素 ${arr.length}`);
      assert.ok('i' in arr[0] && 'role' in arr[0], '短键缺失');
      assert.ok(!('element_token' in arr[0]), 'element_token 不该外泄（占上下文）');
      return `18 元素 → ${texts[1].length} 字符`;
    });
    t('T3b 驱动返回的 tree_markdown 没被转发', () => {
      for (const x of texts) assert.ok(!x.includes('tree_markdown'), '重复的树被转发了');
      return '未重复';
    });
    t('T3c 竖屏窗口不被高度夹缩（407x887 保持原尺寸）', () => {
      assert.ok(img, '没有截图');
      const buf = Buffer.from(img.data, 'base64');
      assert.strictEqual(buf.readUInt32BE(16), 407, `宽 ${buf.readUInt32BE(16)}`);
      assert.strictEqual(buf.readUInt32BE(20), 887, `高 ${buf.readUInt32BE(20)}`);
      assert.ok(texts.some((x) => x.includes('1:1')), '应标为 1:1');
      return '407x887 未缩放';
    });
    t('T3d 缩放后不超过最长边 1568 / 总像素 1.15M', () => {
      const buf = Buffer.from(img.data, 'base64');
      const w = buf.readUInt32BE(16), h = buf.readUInt32BE(20);
      assert.ok(Math.max(w, h) <= 1568, `最长边 ${Math.max(w, h)}`);
      assert.ok(w * h <= 1150000, `像素 ${w * h}`);
      return `${w}x${h} = ${w * h} px`;
    });
  })();

  // ── T4 缩放后的坐标换算 ────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    const seen = await dispatcher.call('see', {}); // 桌面：1600x1200
    const imgb = seen.content.find((p) => p.type === 'image');
    const shownW = Buffer.from(imgb.data, 'base64').readUInt32BE(16);
    const inv = 1600 / shownW; // 原图宽 / 显示宽 —— 期望的换算系数
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', x: 640, y: 400 });
    const c = calls.at(-1);
    t('T4 桌面缩放后点击坐标按「原宽/显示宽」还原', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(c.tool, 'click');
      assert.strictEqual(c.args.x, Math.round(640 * inv), `x=${c.args.x} 期望 ${Math.round(640 * inv)}`);
      assert.strictEqual(c.args.y, Math.round(400 * inv), `y=${c.args.y}`);
      return `显示 ${shownW}px，640,400 → ${c.args.x},${c.args.y}`;
    });
  })();

  // ── T5 元素定位句柄回填 ────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('see', { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124 });
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124, element_index: 4 });
    const c = calls.at(-1);
    t('T5 element_index 自动补 snapshot_id / element_token', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(c.args.snapshot_id, 's00000001', `snapshot=${c.args.snapshot_id}`);
      assert.strictEqual(c.args.element_token, 's00000001:4', `token=${c.args.element_token}`);
      return '回填成功';
    });
    t('T5b 用元素定位时不再带坐标', () => {
      assert.ok(!('x' in c.args), '不该同时给 x/y');
      return 'ok';
    });
  })();

  // ── T6 九个动作映射 ────────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    // 先看一次窗口，把该窗口的坐标空间钉成 1:1，避免桌面缩放干扰下面的断言
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('see', { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124 });
    const W = { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124 };
    const cases = [
      [{ action: 'click', ...W, x: 10, y: 20 }, 'click', (a) => a.count === 1 && a.button === 'left' && a.x === 10],
      [{ action: 'double_click', ...W, x: 10, y: 20 }, 'click', (a) => a.count === 2],
      [{ action: 'right_click', ...W, x: 10, y: 20 }, 'click', (a) => a.button === 'right'],
      [{ action: 'drag', ...W, x: 1, y: 2, to_x: 3, to_y: 4 }, 'drag', (a) => a.from_x === 1 && a.to_x === 3],
      [{ action: 'type', ...W, text: 'hi' }, 'type_text', (a) => a.text === 'hi'],
      [{ action: 'key', ...W, key: 'ENTER' }, 'press_key', (a) => a.key === 'ENTER'],
      [{ action: 'hotkey', ...W, keys: ['CTRL', 'S'] }, 'hotkey', (a) => a.keys.length === 2],
      [{ action: 'scroll', ...W, direction: 'down', amount: 3 }, 'scroll', (a) => a.direction === 'down'],
      [{ action: 'set_value', ...W, element_index: 2, value: 'v' }, 'set_value', (a) => a.value === 'v'],
    ];
    for (const [input, tool, pred] of cases) {
      clear();
      await dispatcher.call('act', input);
      const c = calls.at(-1);
      t(`T6 ${input.action} → ${tool}`, () => {
        assert.strictEqual(c.tool, tool);
        assert.ok(pred(c.args), JSON.stringify(c.args));
        return 'ok';
      });
    }
  })();

  // ── T7 drag 也做坐标换算 ───────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    const seen = await dispatcher.call('see', {});
    const imgb = seen.content.find((p) => p.type === 'image');
    const inv = 1600 / Buffer.from(imgb.data, 'base64').readUInt32BE(16);
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'drag', x: 100, y: 100, to_x: 200, to_y: 200 });
    const a = calls.at(-1).args;
    t('T7 drag 的四个坐标都换算', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(a.from_x, Math.round(100 * inv), `from_x=${a.from_x}`);
      assert.strictEqual(a.to_x, Math.round(200 * inv), `to_x=${a.to_x}`);
      assert.strictEqual(a.from_y, Math.round(100 * inv), `from_y=${a.from_y}`);
      return `${a.from_x}→${a.to_x}`;
    });
  })();

  // ── T8 verify 期望映射 ─────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('verify', {
      pid: 31276,
      window_id: 1640124,
      expect: [{ label_contains: '播放', role: 'Button', enabled: true }, { value_equals: 'x' }],
    });
    const c = calls.at(-1);
    t('T8 扁平期望 → 驱动嵌套谓词', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(c.tool, 'verify_state');
      const e = c.args.expect;
      assert.strictEqual(e.length, 2);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(e[0].element.selector, { label_contains: '播放', role: 'Button' });
      assert.strictEqual(e[0].element.enabled, true);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(e[1].element.selector, {});
      return 'ok';
    });
  })();

  // ── T9 越界 ────────────────────────────────────────────
  await (async () => {
    const r = await dispatcher.call('nonexistent', {});
    t('T9 未知工具必须报错', () => {
      assert.ok(r.isError, '未报错');
      return 'ok';
    });
    const r2 = await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'teleport' });
    t('T9b 非法 action 必须报错', () => {
      assert.ok(r2.isError, '未报错');
      return 'ok';
    });
  })();

  // ── T10 zoom 之后的坐标必须带 from_zoom ──────────────────
  // 2026-10-20 实战缺陷：doSee 的 zoom 分支告诉模型"直接用放大图的 x/y"，
  // 但 act 从没给驱动传 from_zoom ⇒ 放大图坐标被当成整窗截图坐标 ⇒ 点击落偏。
  // 那轮 14 次点击全没中，模型自己算出"(+56,+54) 固定偏移"。
  await (async () => {
    const P = 31276;
    const W = 1640124;
    // 先 zoom 一块区域，让该窗口的坐标空间变成 zoomed
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('see', { pid: P, window_id: W, region: [0, 700, 400, 887] });
    const zoomCall = calls.find((c) => c.tool === 'zoom');
    t('T10a region 见界传入驱动', () => {
      assert.ok(zoomCall, '没调用 zoom');
      assert.ok(zoomCall.args.x1 !== undefined && zoomCall.args.y2 !== undefined, 'zoom 缺坐标参数');
      return `[${zoomCall.args.x1},${zoomCall.args.y1},${zoomCall.args.x2},${zoomCall.args.y2}]`;
    });

    // zoom 之后点放大图里的坐标
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: P, window_id: W, x: 120, y: 60 });
    const clickCall = calls.find((c) => c.tool === 'click');
    t('T10b zoom 后点击必须带 from_zoom:true', () => {
      assert.ok(clickCall, '没调用 click');
      assert.strictEqual(clickCall.args.from_zoom, true, `实际 from_zoom=${clickCall.args.from_zoom}`);
      return 'from_zoom=true';
    });
    t('T10c zoom 后的坐标不再二次缩放', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(clickCall.args.x, 120, `x 被改成 ${clickCall.args.x}`);
      assert.strictEqual(clickCall.args.y, 60, `y 被改成 ${clickCall.args.y}`);
      return 'x/y 原样交给驱动换算';
    });

    // 重新做一次整窗 see（不带 region）之后，from_zoom 必须消失
    await dispatcher.call('see', { pid: P, window_id: W });
    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: P, window_id: W, x: 200, y: 300 });
    const click2 = calls.find((c) => c.tool === 'click');
    t('T10d 整窗 see 后不再带 from_zoom', () => {
      assert.ok(click2, '没调用 click');
      assert.notStrictEqual(click2.args.from_zoom, true, '仍然带着 from_zoom，会把整窗坐标当放大图坐标');
      return 'from_zoom 已清除';
    });
  })();

  // ── T13 投递方式 / 验证状态必须让模型看见 ────────────────────
  // 背景：驱动把 delivery.mode / degraded / verification / errorCode 只放在结构化字段里。
  // surface 以前只透传 r.text ⇒ 模型看到 "✅ Posted click" 就以为点到了。
  // 2026-10-20 那轮"报成功但设备零事件"正是这条。
  await (async () => {
    console.log('\n[T13] 投递方式与验证状态透传');
    // 标靶用假驱动里的 WorkBuddy 窗口（前台那个），与 T10 的模拟器窗口无关
    const P = 27116;
    const W = 132348;
    const flat = (res) => (res?.content || []).map((c) => (c.type === 'text' ? c.text : '')).join('\n');

    clear();
    const bg = await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: P, window_id: W, x: 100, y: 100 });
    const bgText = flat(bg);
    t('T13a 后台投递成功时必须声明"只表示已发出"', () => {
      assert.ok(/background/.test(bgText), `没写投递方式：${bgText.slice(0, 200)}`);
      assert.ok(/只表示已发出|不表示已生效/.test(bgText), '没给未验证提醒，模型会把已发出当已生效');
      return 'background + 未验证提醒都在';
    });

    clear();
    const fg = await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: P, window_id: W, x: 100, y: 100, foreground: true });
    const fgText = flat(fg);
    t('T13b foreground 被前台锁拒绝时必须给下一步', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(fg.isError, true, 'foreground 失败却没标 isError');
      assert.ok(/foreground_unavailable/.test(fgText), '原始错误码丢了');
      assert.ok(/置前|action:front/.test(fgText), '没告诉模型下一步该做什么');
      return '错误码 + 置前指引都在';
    });

    t('T13c 不许把"成功"写成"已点到"', () => {
      // 注意不能简单排除"已生效"三个字 —— 提醒句里就有"不表示已生效"，
      // 第一版这么写把正确的否定句误判成违规（自己踩过）。
      assert.ok(!/已点中|点击成功|动作已完成|已确认命中/.test(bgText), `出现无证据的断言：${bgText.slice(0, 160)}`);
      return '措辞不越界';
    });

    // foreground 自愈：先置前 → 点击 → 被前台锁拒就再置前重试一次。
    // 这条不锁住，以后有人把这段删了也不会有人发现（模型只会看到一句"被拒"）。
    clear();
    const fg2 = await dispatcher.call('act', { action: 'click', pid: P, window_id: W, x: 100, y: 100, foreground: true });
    const seq = calls.map((c) => c.tool);
    const fg2Text = flat(fg2);
    t('T13d foreground 必须先置前再点击，失败后重试一次', () => {
      const iBf = seq.indexOf('bring_to_front');
      const iClick = seq.indexOf('click');
      assert.ok(iBf >= 0, `没调 bring_to_front：${seq.join(' → ')}`);
      assert.ok(iBf < iClick, `顺序错了：${seq.join(' → ')}`);
      const nClick = seq.filter((s) => s === 'click').length;
      assert.strictEqual(nClick, 2, `click 次数=${nClick}，重试没发生`);
      assert.ok(/自动置前/.test(fg2Text), '没告诉模型自动置前过');
      return seq.join(' → ');
    });
  })();

  // ── T14 settle：沉降走的取图通道 ───────────────────────────
  // 为什么值得测：settle 的判据来自"拍到的像素"，接错通道不会报错，只会永远判稳
  //（比如没带 include_screenshot，取图返回空 → 空字符串 → 按 no-frame 处理）。
  await (async () => {
    const flat = (res) => (res?.content || []).map((c) => (c.type === 'text' ? c.text : '')).join('\n');

    clear();
    const rs = await dispatcher.call('settle', { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124, timeout_ms: 3000, interval_ms: 10 });
    t('T14a settle 带窗口 → 拍那一扇窗，且必须带上截图', () => {
      // 2026-10-31 起 settle 先发一枪 include_screenshot:false 的身份探测（M3 归属闸），
      // 带像素的取图是其后 include_screenshot:true 的那几枪 —— 找的是后者。
      const shot = calls.find((c) => c.tool === 'get_window_state' && c.args.include_screenshot === true);
      assert.ok(shot, `没走带截图的 get_window_state：${calls.map((c) => c.tool + '(' + (c.args?.include_screenshot ? 'shot' : 'probe') + ')').join(' → ')}`);
      assert.strictEqual(shot.args.include_screenshot, true, '没要截图 = 没有像素可比，沉降等于闭眼');
      assert.strictEqual(shot.args.window_id, 1640124, '拍错了窗');
      assert.strictEqual(rs.isError, false, `正常沉降被报成错误：${flat(rs).slice(0, 80)}`);
      assert.ok(/稳定/.test(flat(rs)), `没告诉模型到底稳没稳：${flat(rs).slice(0, 80)}`);
      return flat(rs);
    });

    clear();
    await dispatcher.call('settle', { timeout_ms: 1500, interval_ms: 10 });
    const seenDesktop = [...new Set(calls.map((c) => c.tool))];
    t('T14b settle 不带窗口 → 看整个桌面，不沿用上一次的目标', () => {
      assert.deepStrictEqual(seenDesktop, ['get_desktop_state'], `通道串了：${seenDesktop.join(',')}`);
      return `取了 ${calls.length} 帧，全是桌面`;
    });

    // 【断腿】把截图能力拿掉：沉降**不许**判稳。
    // 2026-10-27 真机就是栽在这儿——取图失败和"算不出指纹"都落到 no-hash，
    // 而 no-hash 的语义是"放行"，于是画面还在变就被说成稳了。
    const { dispatcher: blind, clear: blindClear } = await createDetective({ noShots: true });
    blindClear();
    const rb = await blind.call('settle', { timeout_ms: 1200, interval_ms: 10 });
    t('T14c 断腿·取不到图 → 说"没看着画面"，绝不报"稳定"', () => {
      const text = flat(rb);
      assert.ok(/没看着画面/.test(text), `闭眼还装看见：${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      assert.ok(!/已稳定/.test(text), `取图全失败却判成稳定：${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      assert.ok(!rb.isError, '这不是错误，是不确定 —— 该用文字说清，不该当异常抛');
      return text.slice(0, 90);
    });
  })();

  // ── T15 a11y：工具面上的三条腿 ────────────────────────────
  // 这条会真起一次 PowerShell 枚举窗口（不动鼠标、不截图、不改任何东西）。
  // 没法像别的用例那样纯离线：surface 对 a11y 没有注入缝，加缝是生产改动。
  // 所以判据写成三态而不是钉内容 —— 环境有 UIA 就必须列得出窗口，
  // 环境没有就必须给**具名**失败，唯独不许"报成功但什么都没列出"。
  await (async () => {
    const flat = (res) => (res?.content || []).map((c) => (c.type === 'text' ? c.text : '')).join('\n');
    t('T15 a11y 在工具面上、参数对得上、回答不装懂', () => {
      const tool = dispatcher.tools().find((x) => x.name === 'a11y');
      assert.ok(tool, '工具面上没有 a11y');
      for (const k of ['list', 'hwnd', 'max_nodes', 'include_labels', 'max_lines']) {
        assert.ok(tool.inputSchema.properties[k], `schema 少了 ${k}`);
      }
      return 'schema ok（实际调用见下一条）';
    });

    const ra = await dispatcher.call('a11y', { list: true });
    const ta = flat(ra);
    const listed = /可见窗口 (\d+) 个/.exec(ta);
    t('T15b a11y list：列得出窗口，或给出具名失败（不许静默空成功）', () => {
      const namedFailure = ra.isError === true && /列不出窗口|a11y 失败/.test(ta);
      assert.ok(listed || namedFailure, `既不列窗口也不具名报错：${ta.slice(0, 120)}`);
      if (listed) {
        assert.ok(Number(listed[1]) > 0, `列到 0 个窗口却报成功（通道坏了）：${ta.slice(0, 80)}`);
        assert.ok(/hwnd=/.test(ta), '没给 hwnd，模型拿不到下一步的入参');
        return `本机 UIA 列出 ${listed[1]} 扇窗`;
      }
      return `降级但说清了：${ta.slice(0, 60)}`;
    });

    // 【负例】一个根本不存在句柄。2026-10-29 实测它原本被答成
    //   「窗口「1」共 0 个原生控件（通道 win32）」+ "这是自绘程序" —— isError=false。
    //   空树被说成了关于程序性质的结论，这是"装懂"，而且是往错的方向装。
    //   这条不靠运气：hwnd=1 在任何 Windows 上都不是窗口，所以它在健康机、坏机上都能跑。
    const re = await dispatcher.call('a11y', { hwnd: 1 });
    const te = flat(re);
    t('T15c 空句柄不许翻译成"这程序是自绘的"', () => {
      assert.strictEqual(re.isError, true, `没这个窗口却报了成功：${te.slice(0, 100)}`);
      assert.ok(/没看着|没剥出来|都没剥出来/.test(te), `没把"我没看着东西"说在前面：${te.slice(0, 100)}`);
      assert.ok(!/这是自绘程序/.test(te), `把空句柄断成了自绘程序：${te.slice(0, 120)}`);
      assert.ok(/list:true|find|som:true/.test(te), '没给下一步怎么办');
      return te.slice(0, 70);
    });
  })();

  // ── 汇总 ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const bad = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
  for (const r of results) console.log(`  ${r.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${r.name}${r.note ? '  —  ' + r.note : ''}`);
  console.log(`\n结果: ${results.length - bad.length}/${results.length} 通过`);
  if (bad.length) {
    for (const b of bad) console.log('  ✗ ' + b.name + ' :: ' + b.note);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  process.exit(0);
}

main();

// Offline tests using installed dependencies, real Cordis waterfall and LLM runtime.
const fs=require('node:fs');
const path=require('node:path');
const assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');
const {pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');
const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..');
const LOCK_LEASE_FAKE=30000;   // 造一个"还是自己、且远未到期"的僵尸锁，看会不会自锁
const RUNTIME=process.env.DSH_TEST_RUNTIME || ROOT;
const RUN=path.join(ROOT,'testkit/.runs','task-budget-'+Date.now());
fs.mkdirSync(RUN,{recursive:true});
let passed=0;
function ok(value,label){assert.ok(value,label);passed++;console.log('PASS '+label);}
function throws(fn,code,label){assert.throws(fn,e=>e.code===code,label);passed++;console.log('PASS '+label);}
const mod=p=>import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT,p)));
async function main(){
  const {BudgetStore,usageTokens,rootAgentFor}=await mod('plugins/task-budget/core.mjs');
  const {default:Plugin,DEFAULTS}=await mod('plugins/task-budget/index.js');
  const limits={...DEFAULTS,maxRequests:3,maxTotalTokens:1000,reservationTokens:100,maxConcurrent:2,maxTaskMs:1000,maxCallMs:500};
  let now=1000;
  function store(name,extra={}){return new BudgetStore(path.join(RUN,name+'.json'),{...limits,...extra},()=>now);}
  const read=s=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(s.file));
  ok(usageTokens({inputTokens:10,outputTokens:5,cacheReadTokens:8,reasoningTokens:3})===15,'usage subsets not double-counted');
  ok(usageTokens({inputTokens:10,outputTokens:5,totalTokens:18})===18,'provider aggregate preserved');
  ok(usageTokens({inputTokens:10,outputTokens:5,totalTokens:2})===15,'inconsistent aggregate falls back');
  ok(usageTokens({inputTokens:-1,outputTokens:0})===null,'invalid usage is unknown');
  throws(()=>store('bad-config',{maxRequests:0}),'CONFIG','zero request limit rejected');
  const s=store('base');
  const root=s.bind('root','root',1,1,true),child=s.bind('child','root',1,1,false);
  ok(root===child,'root and child share task key');
  const first=s.reserve(root);s.record(first,{inputTokens:20,outputTokens:10});
  s.record(first,{inputTokens:25,outputTokens:15});s.settle(first);
  ok(read(s).tasks[root].reportedTokens===40,'cumulative usage snapshots counted once');
  const second=s.reserve(child);s.settle(second);
  ok(read(s).tasks[root].estimatedTokens===100 && read(s).tasks[root].unknownUsageCalls===1,'unknown usage retains full reservation');
  const third=s.reserve(root);s.settle(third);
  throws(()=>s.reserve(child),'REQUESTS','child cannot expand root request quota');
  const restored=store('base');throws(()=>restored.reserve(root),'REQUESTS','restart retains exhausted quota');
  const nextRoot=s.bind('root','root',2,2,true);
  ok(nextRoot!==root,'new root turn gets separate task');
  ok(s.bind('child','root',2,1,false)===root,'old child stays in old task after parent advances');
  ok(s.bind('child','root',2,2,false)===nextRoot,'new child turn can join new parent task');
  const c=store('concurrent');const a=c.reserve(root),b=c.reserve(root);
  throws(()=>c.reserve(root),'CONCURRENT','parallel reservation limit enforced');
  c.settle(a);c.settle(b);
  const t=store('tokens',{maxTotalTokens:150});const one=t.reserve(root);
  throws(()=>t.reserve(root),'TOKENS','parallel token reservations share total');
  t.record(one,{inputTokens:120,outputTokens:31});t.settle(one);
  throws(()=>t.reserve(root),'EXHAUSTED','reported excess stops later calls');
  const deadline=store('deadline');const d=deadline.reserve(root);deadline.settle(d);now+=1000;
  throws(()=>deadline.reserve(root),'TIME','elapsed root deadline enforced');now=1000;
  const corrupt=store('corrupt');fs.writeFileSync(corrupt.file,'broken');
  throws(()=>corrupt.reserve(root),'STORE_CORRUPT','corrupt state never silently resets');
  const lock=store('lock');fs.writeFileSync(lock.file+'.lock','held');
  throws(()=>lock.reserve(root),'STORE_LOCK','lock contention fails closed');
  fs.unlinkSync(lock.file+'.lock');
  const crash=store('crash');crash.reserve(root);
  ok(Object.keys(read(store('crash')).tasks[root].inFlight).length===1,'abandoned in-flight reservation survives restart');
  const rootAgent={id:'R'},childAgent={id:'C'},grandchild={id:'G'};
  const agents={list:()=>[rootAgent,childAgent,grandchild],isOwnedBy:(id,p)=>(id==='C'&&p===rootAgent)||(id==='G'&&p===childAgent)};
  ok(rootAgentFor(agents,grandchild)===rootAgent,'official runtime ownership resolves nested child');
  throws(()=>rootAgentFor({list:()=>[rootAgent,childAgent],isOwnedBy:()=>true},childAgent),'LINEAGE','ownership cycle rejected');

  const {Context}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(RUNTIME,'node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js')));
  const {LlmRuntime}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(RUNTIME,'node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js')));
  const ctx=new Context();
  const liveRoot={id:'live-root',session:{turn:1},cancel(cause){this.cancelled=cause;}};
  const liveChild={id:'live-child',session:{turn:1},cancel(cause){this.cancelled=cause;}};
  const liveAgents={get:id=>[liveRoot,liveChild].find(x=>x.id===id),list:()=>[liveRoot,liveChild],isOwnedBy:(id,p)=>id===liveChild.id&&p===liveRoot};
  ctx.reflect.provide('agents',liveAgents);
  ctx.reflect.provide('sessionProjections',{stateOf:session=>({lastTurn:session.turn})});
  const llm=new LlmRuntime(ctx);
  let dispatched=0;
  // Actual llm.streamWithRegistration -> actual Cordis waterfall. Adapter is
  // synthetic and offline; replacing only adapterStream avoids provider I/O.
  llm.adapterStream=async function*(options){dispatched++;yield {type:'usage',usage:{inputTokens:10,outputTokens:5}};yield {type:'finish',reason:{kind:'completed'}};};
  const plugin=ctx.plugin(Plugin,{...DEFAULTS,maxRequests:2,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'real-runtime.json')});
  // Cordis injection mounts asynchronously through its registry task queue.
  await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));
  async function collect(id){const result=[];for await(const chunk of llm.stream({provider:'offline',model:'mock',messages:[],sessionId:id}))result.push(chunk);return result;}
  ok((await collect(liveRoot.id)).length===2,'real LLM waterfall passes root stream');
  ok((await collect(liveChild.id)).length===2,'real LLM waterfall passes child stream');
  await assert.rejects(()=>collect(liveChild.id),e=>e.code==='REQUESTS');passed++;console.log('PASS real LLM waterfall denies before third provider dispatch');
  ok(dispatched===2,'denied request never reaches adapter');
  const runtimeState=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(RUN,'real-runtime.json')));
  ok(Object.values(runtimeState.tasks).length===1 && Object.values(runtimeState.tasks)[0].reportedTokens===30,'real plugin shares root usage');
  await plugin.dispose();
  await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30));
  await collect(liveRoot.id);ok(dispatched===3,'plugin unload removes request interception');

  // Timeout behavior without a cooperative producer; cancellation reaches Agent.
  let handler;
  const scope={agents:liveAgents,sessionProjections:{stateOf:session=>({lastTurn:session.turn})},on(name,fn){handler=fn;}};
  const timeoutPlugin=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,maxCallMs:25,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'timeout.json')});
  const hanging={ [Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this;},next(){return new Promise(()=>{});},return(){return Promise.resolve({done:true});} };
  await assert.rejects(async()=>{for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id},()=>hanging)){}},e=>e.code==='TIMEOUT');passed++;console.log('PASS stalled stream times out');
  ok(liveRoot.cancelled?.kind==='hook','timeout calls public Agent cancel');
  const timed=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(timeoutPlugin.store.file));
  ok(Object.values(timed.tasks)[0].unknownUsageCalls===1,'timeout does not erase uncertain cost');
  const betweenCalls=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,maxTaskMs:35,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'between-calls.json')});
  delete liveRoot.cancelled;
  const short=async function*(){yield {type:'usage',usage:{inputTokens:1,outputTokens:1}};};
  for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id},short)){}
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60));
  ok(liveRoot.cancelled?.kind==='hook','root deadline cancels between calls during tool work');
  const oldTurn=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,maxTaskMs:35,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'old-turn.json')});
  delete liveRoot.cancelled;
  for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id},short)){}
  liveRoot.session.turn++;
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60));
  ok(!liveRoot.cancelled,'old task timer cannot cancel a later user turn');
  const anonymous=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,maxRequests:1,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'anonymous.json')});
  for await(const chunk of handler({},short)){}
  await assert.rejects(async()=>{for await(const chunk of handler({},short)){}},e=>e.code==='REQUESTS');
  passed++;console.log('PASS anonymous calls share a single quota');
  const failed=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'failed-request.json')});
  await assert.rejects(async()=>{for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id},()=>{throw Error('adapter failed');})){}},/adapter failed/);
  passed++;console.log('PASS adapter failure propagates');
  ok(Object.values(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(failed.store.file)).tasks)[0].estimatedTokens===DEFAULTS.reservationTokens,'failed request retains unknown cost reservation');
  const abort=new AbortController();abort.abort(new Error('already cancelled'));
  const previous=fs.readFileSync(failed.store.file,'utf8');
  await assert.rejects(async()=>{for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id,signal:abort.signal},short)){}},/already cancelled/);
  passed++;console.log('PASS pre-cancelled call refused');
  ok(fs.readFileSync(failed.store.file,'utf8')===previous,'pre-cancelled call spends no budget');
  const auxiliary=new Plugin({reflect:{provide(){}},inject(deps,fn){fn(scope);}},
    {...DEFAULTS,maxRequests:1,stateFile:path.join(RUN,'auxiliary.json')});
  for await(const chunk of handler({sessionId:liveRoot.id},short)){}
  const noLive={...scope,agents:{...liveAgents,get:()=>undefined}};
  await assert.rejects(async()=>{for await(const chunk of auxiliary.stream(noLive,{sessionId:liveRoot.id,purpose:'session-title'},short)){}},e=>e.code==='REQUESTS');
  passed++;console.log('PASS auxiliary call without live Agent retains durable root budget');
  // Independent process sees the durable lock, rather than overwriting state.
  const locked=path.join(RUN,'cross-process.json');fs.writeFileSync(locked+'.lock','held');
  const childCode=`import {BudgetStore} from ${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT,'plugins/task-budget/core.mjs')).href)};try{new BudgetStore(${JSON.stringify(locked)},${JSON.stringify(limits)}).reserve('x');process.exitCode=2;}catch(e){process.exitCode=e.code==='STORE_LOCK'?0:3;}`;
  const childResult=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--input-type=module','-e',childCode],{encoding:'utf8'});
  ok(childResult.status===0,'separate process cannot steal active store lock');
  // Same-process reentrancy: 2026-10-27 real incident.
  // A headless run died at turn_end with STORE_LOCK while the lock's own pid was
  // this very process and the lease still had 26s left — the lock refused its owner
  // and the whole turn was discarded. Cross-process must stay strict; same-process
  // is not contention, so it must re-enter. Remove these three and the bug can return.
  const nest=path.join(RUN,'reentrant.json');
  const nstore=new BudgetStore(nest,{...limits},()=>now);
  let lockInInner=false,lockAfterInner=false;
  nstore.transaction(state=>{
    nstore.transaction(inner=>{ lockInInner=fs.existsSync(nest+'.lock'); return 1; });
    lockAfterInner=fs.existsSync(nest+'.lock');
    return 1;
  });
  ok(lockInInner,'同一进程嵌套事务能进同一把锁（自锁已修）');
  ok(lockAfterInner,'内层结束不拆外层事务的锁（引用计数生效）');
  ok(!fs.existsSync(nest+'.lock'),'最外层事务结束后锁才真的释放');
  // Disk residue carrying our own pid (Windows refuses to unlink an opened file).
  // Before the fix this was read as "someone else holds it" and the process locked
  // itself out for a full lease. Same pid means same owner: self-heal, never wait.
  const ghost=path.join(RUN,'ghost.json');
  const gstore=new BudgetStore(ghost,{...limits},()=>now);
  fs.writeFileSync(ghost+'.lock',JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,at:Date.now(),leaseUntil:Date.now()+LOCK_LEASE_FAKE}));
  const t0=Date.now();
  gstore.transaction(state=>1);
  const elapsed=Date.now()-t0;
  ok(elapsed<1500,`自己的僵尸锁当场自愈，不等满 ${LOCK_LEASE_FAKE/1000}s（实测 ${elapsed}ms）`);
  ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(RUN,'reclaim.log')),'自愈动作写进 reclaim.log 留痕');
  console.log(`Task budget: ${passed} PASS / 0 FAIL`);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});

// probe-team.cjs — 多 Agent 团队的真实协作测试
//
// 跟 testkit 那套的区别：那套用本地 4B 模型测插件接线，模型本身不可靠；
// 这套用生产模型（deepseek）跑真实团队协作，只问一个问题：
//   "从 Lead 派工 → 队友被创建并真的跑起来 → Lead 等到结果" 这条链是不是通的。
//
// 同时验证角色模型路由：verifier/implementer 两个名字在 modelMap 里映射到不同模型，
// 只要两者 request/header 里的模型不同，就证明路由真的生效了（不是纸面配置）。
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { readSession, listSessions } = require('../lib/session-reader.cjs');

const SANDBOX = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DSH_HOME = path.join(SANDBOX, 'dsh-home');
const DSH_BIN = path.join(SANDBOX, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh', 'lib', 'bin.js');
const NODE = process.execPath;
const GIT_BASH = 'C:/Users/64562/.workbuddy/binaries/PortableGit/versions/1.3.0/usr/bin';
const STAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
const OUT = process.argv[2] || path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'team-' + STAMP);
const TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS || 480000);

const CWD = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'scratch', 'team-live');
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(CWD, { recursive: true });
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(CWD, '.keep'))) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(CWD, '.keep'), '');

const PROMPT = [
  '多 Agent 连通性验证任务，严格按顺序执行，不要跳过，不要自己代替队友回答：',
  '1) 调用 spawn_teammate，name=verifier，description=连通性验证，prompt=「请只回复一行：TEAM-OK」，context=fresh',
  '2) 调用 spawn_teammate，name=implementer，description=连通性验证，prompt=「请只回复一行：IMPL-OK」，context=fresh',
  '3) 调用 wait_agent 等它们跑完；若返回 noProgress，先 list_agents 看状态，对 inactive 的发 send_message 唤醒，再 wait_agent。',
  '4) 最终答复只写一行：TEAM-RESULT: <verifier 原文> | <implementer 原文>',
].join('\n');

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'prompt.txt'), PROMPT, 'utf8');

const result = {
  probe: 'team-live',
  at: new Date().toISOString(),
  cwd: CWD,
  timeoutMs: TIMEOUT_MS,
  eventsFromStdout: 0,
  toolCalls: [],
  subagentEvents: [],
  requestHeaders: [],
  finalText: '',
  verdict: 'FAIL',
  criteria: {},
};

const t0 = Date.now();
const child = spawn(NODE, [DSH_BIN, 'headless', '--json', PROMPT], {
  cwd: CWD,
  stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  env: { ...process.env, DSH_HOME, PATH: GIT_BASH + ';' + (process.env.PATH || '') },
});

let out = '';
let err = '';
const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch { /* ignore */ } }, TIMEOUT_MS);
child.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString('utf8'); });
child.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString('utf8'); });

child.on('close', (code) => {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  result.exitCode = code;
  result.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'stdout.jsonl'), out, 'utf8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'stderr.log'), err, 'utf8');

  const stdoutEvents = [];
  for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
    const s = line.trim();
    if (s.startsWith('{')) { try { stdoutEvents.push(JSON.parse(s)); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
  }
  result.eventsFromStdout = stdoutEvents.length;
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'stdout-events.json'), JSON.stringify(stdoutEvents, null, 2), 'utf8');

  // 会话库才是全量证据：request/header、tool/call、subagent/* 只在这里
  const sessions = listSessions(path.join(DSH_HOME, 'sessions')).filter((s) => s.mtimeMs >= t0 - 5000);
  result.sessionCandidates = sessions.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, dir: s.dir, events: 0 }));
  let allEvents = [];
  for (const s of sessions.slice(0, 6)) {
    const { events } = readSession(s.dir);
    result.sessionCandidates.find((c) => c.id === s.id).events = events.length;
    if (events.length > allEvents.length) { allEvents = events; result.mainSession = s.dir; }
  }

  const typeCount = {};
  const childIds = [];
  for (const e of allEvents) {
    const t = e.type || e.kind || '(none)';
    typeCount[t] = (typeCount[t] || 0) + 1;
    const d = e.data || {};
    if (t === 'tool/call') {
      result.toolCalls.push({ agent: e.agent || d.agent, name: d.name, args: d.arguments, ok: d.ok });
    } else if (/subagent|agent|team/i.test(t)) {
      result.subagentEvents.push({ type: t, data: d });
      // 队友的会话是**独立会话目录**，id 就是 childId。只看 Lead 的会话
      // 永远看不到子 Agent 的请求头，会误判成"路由没生效"。
      if (t === 'subagent/catalog' && d.childId) childIds.push({ id: d.childId, label: d.label });
    } else if (t === 'request/header') {
      result.requestHeaders.push({ agent: e.agent, model: d.model || d.body?.model, keys: Object.keys(d).slice(0, 12) });
    }
  }
  result.eventTypeCount = typeCount;

  // 子会话逐个打开，取 request/header.header.config.model —— 这才是路由的硬证据。
  // （subagent/descriptor 里的 agentModel 永远是父模型，不能当判据。）
  const children = [];
  for (const c of childIds) {
    const s = listSessions(path.join(DSH_HOME, 'sessions')).find((x) => x.id === c.id);
    if (!s) { children.push({ id: c.id, label: c.label, found: false }); continue; }
    const { events } = readSession(s.dir);
    const rh = events.find((e) => e.type === 'request/header');
    const model = rh?.data?.header?.config?.model || null;
    const provider = rh?.data?.header?.config?.provider || null;
    const finalEv = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'assistant/message' || e.type === 'final').pop();
    const text = finalEv?.data?.text || finalEv?.data?.message?.content?.map?.((x) => x.text).filter(Boolean).join('') || '';
    children.push({ id: c.id, label: c.label, found: true, provider, model, events: events.length, text: String(text).slice(0, 120) });
  }
  result.children = children;

  const f = stdoutEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'final').pop();
  const lastText = stdoutEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'text').pop();
  result.finalText = (f && (f.data?.text || f.text)) || (lastText && (lastText.data?.text || lastText.text)) || '';

  const calledSpawn = result.toolCalls.filter((c) => c.name === 'spawn_teammate').length;
  const calledWait = result.toolCalls.some((c) => c.name === 'wait_agent');
  // 这里原本判的是 subagent/start —— 本版本根本没这个事件，等于写了个永远为假的
  // 断言，把一次成功的团队协作判成 FAIL。判据改成"子会话真的存在且有对话事件"。
  const started = children.filter((c) => c.found && c.events > 5);
  const models = [...new Set(children.map((c) => c.model).filter(Boolean))];
  const roleOf = (n) => children.find((c) => (c.label && c.label.includes(n)) || c.id === n);

  result.criteria = {
    spawnCalls: calledSpawn,
    waitCalled: calledWait,
    childrenFound: children.length,
    childrenStarted: started.length,
    childModels: children.map((c) => ({ label: c.label, model: c.model })),
    distinctModels: models,
    finalLooksLikeTeamResult: /TEAM-RESULT/i.test(result.finalText),
    finalHead: result.finalText.slice(0, 300),
  };
  // 通过条件：两名队友都被真的创建并跑起来 + 两条不同的路由模型 + Lead 汇总出结果
  result.verdict =
    calledSpawn >= 2 && calledWait && started.length >= 2 && models.length >= 2 && /TEAM-RESULT/i.test(result.finalText)
      ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    verdict: result.verdict,
    ms: result.ms,
    exitCode: result.exitCode,
    criteria: result.criteria,
    eventTypes: typeCount,
    toolCalls: result.toolCalls.map((c) => c.name),
    subagentSample: result.subagentEvents.slice(0, 6).map((e) => e.type),
    models,
  }, null, 2));
  console.log('证据目录: ' + OUT);
  console.log('会话库: ' + (result.mainSession || '(未定位)'));
});

// probe-tech-recon.cjs — tech-recon 技能三脚本的离线回归(2026-10-24 建,repo-daily 4h)。
//
// 钉什么(全部来自当日 E2E/审查的真实事故):
//   R1 papers.mjs 并行竞态:两个源在循环外先创建 Promise 时,一源在另一源 await 期间
//      拒绝会被 Node 15+ 按 unhandled rejection 崩进程(429 实测复现)。修复=jobs 存函数。
//      本探针用源码绊线钉住这个模式,谁改回并行创建当场红。
//   R2 papers.mjs / verify.mjs 用 process.exit() 在 fetch 之后退出会触发 Node22/Win 的
//      libuv 断言崩(async.c:94,两次实测)。钉 exitCode 模式。
//   R3 verify.mjs 判定穿透:PASS 之后落到末行 MISMATCH(修复=分支)。行为由导出的
//      matchKeywords + 分支结构钉(穿透的本质是"无条件执行第二个 report")。
//   R4 XML 解析/URL 规范化/查询构造/HTML 提取的纯函数行为(fixture,零网络)。
//   R5 frames.mjs selftest(双模式抽帧,本地 ffmpeg,零网络;ffmpeg 缺失时 SKIP 不算失败)。
// 用法:node testkit/probe/probe-tech-recon.cjs   (exit 1 = 有回归)
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const SKILL = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', 'dsh-home', 'skills', 'tech-recon', 'scripts');
const NODE = process.execPath;
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const check = (name, ok, detail) => {
  console.log('  ' + (ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + '  ' + name + (detail ? '  (' + detail + ')' : ''));
  ok ? pass++ : fail++;
};

async function main() {
  const papers = await import('file://' + path.join(SKILL, 'papers.mjs').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
  const verifyMod = await import('file://' + path.join(SKILL, 'verify.mjs').replace(/\\/g, '/'));

  // == R4a parseArxivXml ==
  const xml = `<?xml version="1.0"?><feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
<entry><id>http://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02643v2</id><title>Segment &amp; Anything: a &quot;study&quot;</title>
<published>2023-04-05T00:00:00Z</published><name>Alice</name><name>Bob</name>
<summary> Line&nbsp;one\n  line two </summary></entry>
<entry><id>http://arxiv.org/abs/9999.9999v1</id><title></title><published>garbage</published></entry></feed>`;
  const entries = papers.parseArxivXml(xml);
  check('R4a parse: 2 entries', entries.length === 2);
  check('R4a url normalized (v2 stripped, https)', entries[0].url === 'https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02643', entries[0].url);
  check('R4a entities decoded', entries[0].title === 'Segment & Anything: a "study"', entries[0].title);
  check('R4a authors parsed', entries[0].authors.join('|') === 'Alice|Bob');
  check('R4a year extracted', entries[0].year === '2023');
  check('R4a summary flattened', !entries[0].summary.includes('\n'));
  check('R4a empty fields survive', entries[1].title === '' && entries[1].year === '');

  // == R4b buildArxivQuery ==
  check('R4b phrase+word', papers.buildArxivQuery('"Segment Anything" Kirillov') === 'all:"Segment Anything" AND all:Kirillov');
  check('R4b plain words AND-joined', papers.buildArxivQuery('promptable segmentation') === 'all:promptable AND all:segmentation');
  check('R4b short/noise tokens dropped', !papers.buildArxivQuery('a of the').includes('all:a'));

  // == R4c htmlToText / matchKeywords ==
  const body = '<html><head><style>.x{}</style><script>var a="NEVER_VISIBLE";</script></head>' +
    '<body><h1>Title&nbsp;Here</h1><p>Segment Anything Model</p></body></html>';
  const text = verifyMod.htmlToText(body);
  check('R4c strips script/style', !text.includes('never_visible') && !text.includes('.x{}'));
  check('R4c lowercases + nbsp', text.includes('title here') && text.includes('segment anything model'));
  const m1 = verifyMod.matchKeywords(text, ['Segment Anything', 'absent-kw']);
  check('R4c hit/miss split', m1.hits.length === 1 && m1.misses.length === 1 && m1.hits[0] === 'Segment Anything');

  // == R1/R2 源码绊线(模式级,非行为级;理由:崩溃路径需真实网络拒绝才复现,离线钉模式) ==
  const papersSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(SKILL, 'papers.mjs'), 'utf8');
  check('R1 jobs store functions not promises', !/jobs\.push\(\[.+,.+\(query\)\]\)/.test(papersSrc));
  check('R2 papers exits via exitCode', !/process\.exit\((?!2\))/.test(papersSrc.split('// ----------')[1] || ''));
  const verifySrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(SKILL, 'verify.mjs'), 'utf8');
  check('R2 verify exits via exitCode', verifySrc.includes('process.exitCode =') && !/process\.exit\([012]\)/.test(verifySrc));
  // R3 穿透:报告分支必须是 if/else(PASS 之后不允许再有无条件 report 调用)
  const tail = verifySrc.slice(verifySrc.lastIndexOf('if (misses.length === 0)'));
  check('R3 verify verdict is branched', /^if \(misses\.length === 0\) \{/.test(tail.trim()) && tail.includes('} else {'));

  // == R5 frames selftest(本地 ffmpeg;缺失时 SKIP) ==
  const st = spawnSync(NODE, [path.join(SKILL, 'frames.mjs'), 'selftest'], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 120000 });
  if (/ffmpeg not found/.test(st.stderr || '')) {
    console.log('  SKIP  R5 frames selftest (ffmpeg unavailable on this machine)');
  } else {
    check('R5 frames selftest (info+iframes+fps)', st.status === 0, (st.stdout || '').split('\n').filter((l) => l.includes('===='))[0] || '');
  }

  console.log('\n==== tech-recon probe: ' + pass + ' PASS / ' + fail + ' FAIL ====');
  if (fail > 0) {
    console.log('回归处置:R1/R2/R3 是当日真实事故的钉子——红=有人把修复改回去了,先读注释再动。');
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}
main().catch((e) => { console.error('probe error: ' + e.message); process.exitCode = 1; });

// probe-tool-cap.cjs — 找 Ollama 到底能收多少工具。
//
// 已知：1 个工具让 prompt_tokens 从 25 涨到 284（+259）。
// 但 DSH 发 106 个工具时，整包只有 2050 token，肯定不是 106×259。
// 逐个数量级试，看 token 增量在哪里停止增长 —— 那就是截断点。
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
const MODEL = process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3.5:4b';

const MESSAGES = [
  { role: 'system', content: '你是一个测试助手。' },
  { role: 'user', content: '帮我查一下杭州现在的天气' },
];

function mkTool(i) {
  return {
    type: 'function',
    function: {
      name: 'tool_' + i,
      description: '第 ' + i + ' 号测试工具，用于探测服务端能接收多少工具定义。' +
        '这是一个刻意写得长一些的描述，好让每个工具的 token 开销稳定可测，' +
        '包含参数说明、使用场景、返回值结构等内容。',
      parameters: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          a: { type: 'string', description: '字符串参数 a' },
          b: { type: 'integer', description: '整数参数 b' },
          c: { type: 'boolean', description: '布尔参数 c' },
        },
        required: ['a'],
      },
    },
  };
}

(async () => {
  const counts = [1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 80, 106];
  let prev = null;
  console.log('工具数   prompt_tok   每工具均摊   返回 tool_calls');
  console.log('------   ----------   ----------   --------------');
  for (const n of counts) {
    const tools = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => mkTool(i + 1));
    const r = await fetch(BASE + '/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools, max_tokens: 64 }),
    });
    const j = await r.json();
    if (j.error) {
      console.log(String(n).padStart(6) + '   ERROR: ' + (j.error.message || JSON.stringify(j.error)).slice(0, 80));
      continue;
    }
    const pt = j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens;
    const m = j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message;
    const tc = (m && m.tool_calls) || null;
    const per = prev == null ? '—' : ((pt - prev.base) / (n - prev.n)).toFixed(1);
    console.log(
      String(n).padStart(6) + '   ' + String(pt).padStart(10) + '   ' + String(per).padStart(10) + '   ' +
        (tc ? tc.length + '×' + (tc[0].function || {}).name : '无'),
    );
    prev = { n, base: pt };
  }
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

// probe-tool-cap2.cjs — 定位丢工具的那一层。
//
// probe-tool-cap.cjs 已证明：/v1 端点下工具数 ≥30 时 prompt_tokens 掉回 2050
// 并停止增长，工具被静默丢弃。现在要回答：这层限制在
//   (a) Ollama 的 OpenAI 兼容层（/v1），还是
//   (b) Ollama 服务/模板本身（那原生 /api/chat 也会丢）。
// 若只有 (a)，那么在 DSH 与 Ollama 之间加一个协议转换 shim 就能解决；
// 若是 (b)，则本地模型拿不到工具面，测试必须改用瘦 profile。
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
const MODEL = process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3.5:4b';

const MESSAGES = [
  { role: 'system', content: '你是一个测试助手。' },
  { role: 'user', content: '随便说一句话' },
];

function mkTool(i) {
  return {
    type: 'function',
    function: {
      name: 'tool_' + i,
      description: '第 ' + i + ' 号测试工具，用于探测服务端能接收多少工具定义。' +
        '这是一个刻意写得长一些的描述，好让每个工具的 token 开销稳定可测。',
      parameters: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          a: { type: 'string', description: '字符串参数 a' },
          b: { type: 'integer', description: '整数参数 b' },
          c: { type: 'boolean', description: '布尔参数 c' },
        },
        required: ['a'],
      },
    },
  };
}

async function probe(kind, n) {
  const tools = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => mkTool(i + 1));
  let url, body;
  if (kind === 'v1') {
    url = '/v1/chat/completions';
    body = { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools, max_tokens: 32 };
  } else {
    url = '/api/chat';
    body = { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools, options: { num_predict: 32, temperature: 0 } };
  }
  const r = await fetch(BASE + url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const j = await r.json();
  const pt = kind === 'v1' ? j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens : j.prompt_eval_count;
  return { pt, err: j.error ? (j.error.message || JSON.stringify(j.error)) : null };
}

(async () => {
  console.log('找出 /v1 的精确截断点：');
  for (let n = 18; n <= 34; n++) {
    const { pt, err } = await probe('v1', n);
    console.log('  /v1 n=' + String(n).padStart(3) + '  prompt_tok=' + String(pt) + (err ? '  ERR ' + err.slice(0, 60) : ''));
  }

  console.log('\n原生 /api/chat 在大工具数下的表现：');
  for (const n of [20, 30, 60, 106]) {
    const { pt, err } = await probe('native', n);
    console.log('  native n=' + String(n).padStart(3) + '  prompt_tok=' + String(pt) + (err ? '  ERR ' + err.slice(0, 60) : ''));
  }
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

/**
 * tool-watch 判定器的正反验证。
 *
 * 两个部分：
 *   A. 手写用例：正例必须判 write，反例必须判 read。（防止规则退化）
 *   B. 真实语料：拿 2026-10-20 三轮安卓任务的 230 条真实 bash 命令跑一遍，
 *      统计判成 write 的比例，并逐条打印被判 write 的命令 ——
 *      人眼扫一遍就能看出有没有把"看日志"误判成"点屏幕"。
 *
 * 语料比手写用例重要：手写用例只能证明"我以为的情况对"，
 * 真实语料才能暴露我没想到的写法（管道、变量、PowerShell 别名）。
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { judgeCommand, judgeToolCall } from '../../plugins/tool-watch-dsh/rules.mjs';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const SANDBOX = path.resolve(HERE, '..', '..');
const RUN = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'wf-android-audio2-2026-10-20T02-18-37-117Z');

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (name, cond, extra) => {
  if (cond) { pass++; console.log('  PASS', name); }
  else { fail++; console.log('  FAIL', name, extra === undefined ? '' : '-> ' + JSON.stringify(extra)); }
};

console.log('=== A. 手写用例 ===');
const mustWrite = [
  ['点屏幕 adb input tap', 'MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 $ADB shell input tap 540 520'],
  ['带 -s 的点屏幕', 'adb -s emulator-5554 shell input tap 807 299'],
  ['滑动', 'adb shell input swipe 100 900 100 100 300'],
  ['按键', 'adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP'],
  ['启动应用', 'adb shell am start -n com.musicplayer.app/.MainActivity'],
  ['强停应用', 'adb shell am force-stop com.musicplayer.app'],
  ['杀模拟器', 'adb -s emulator-5556 emu kill'],
  ['装包', 'adb install -r dist/music-player.apk'],
  ['推文件', 'adb push ui.xml /sdcard/'],
  ['改设置', 'adb shell settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647'],
  ['杀进程', 'taskkill //PID 20980 //F'],
  ['Stop-Process', 'Stop-Process -Id 6216 -Force'],
  ['起模拟器(PowerShell)', 'Start-Process -FilePath cmd.exe -ArgumentList "/c run_emulator3.bat"'],
  ['WMI 起进程', 'Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process -MethodName Create -Arguments @{CommandLine="emulator.exe -avd kqkb34g"}'],
  ['直接跑 emulator.exe', 'C:/Users/64562/android-toolchain/sdk/emulator/emulator.exe -avd kqkb34g'],
  ['改注册表', 'reg add HKCU\\Software\\Foo /v Bar /d 1'],
  ['建计划任务', 'schtasks /create /tn "DSH Emu Guard" /tr "node x.cjs" /sc minute'],
  ['heredoc 直接喂 shell', "bash <<'EOF'\nadb shell input tap 1 1\nEOF"],
];
for (const [name, cmd] of mustWrite) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name, r.verdict === 'write', r);
}

const mustRead = [
  ['列设备', 'adb devices'],
  ['看日志', 'adb logcat -d -s NeonSfx:V'],
  ['日志管道里含 input 字样', 'adb logcat -d | grep -i "input"'],
  ['dumpsys', 'adb shell dumpsys package com.musicplayer.app | grep lastUpdateTime'],
  ['列包', 'adb shell pm list packages | grep music'],
  ['查进程号', 'adb shell pidof com.musicplayer.app'],
  ['读属性', 'adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk'],
  ['只是 cat 脚本', 'cat run_emulator2.bat'],
  ['读文件', 'grep -n "input" evidence/round5-sfx-muted.txt'],
  ['看 APK 内容', 'unzip -l dist/music-player.apk | grep res/raw'],
  ['node 自测', 'node cua-lamp.cjs --selftest'],
  ['查计划任务', 'schtasks /query /fo LIST | grep -i emulator'],
  ['查进程名', "powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \\\"Name='emulator.exe'\\\"\""],
  ['把命令写进 bat（未执行）', "cat > run_emulator3.bat <<'EOF'\nadb shell input tap 1 1\nemulator.exe -avd kqkb34g\nEOF"],
  ['python heredoc 里含 adb', "python - <<'PYEOF'\nimport os\nprint('adb install')\nPYEOF"],
  ['空命令', ''],
];
for (const [name, cmd] of mustRead) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name + '（应判 read）', r.verdict === 'read', r);
}

console.log('\n=== A2. 工具名判定（改磁盘的工具必须亮）===');
const mustWriteTool = [
  ['Write 工具', 'Write', { file_path: 'C:/x/a.js', content: 'adb shell input tap 1 1' }],
  ['Edit 工具', 'Edit', { file_path: 'C:/x/a.js', old_string: 'a', new_string: 'b' }],
  ['apply_patch', 'apply_patch', { path: 'C:/x/a.js', patch: '@@ -1 +1 @@' }],
  ['multi_edit', 'multi_edit', { file_path: 'C:/x/a.js' }],
  ['str_replace_editor', 'str_replace_editor', { path: 'C:/x/a.js' }],
  ['NotebookEdit', 'NotebookEdit', { path: 'C:/x/a.ipynb' }],
];
for (const [name, tool, args] of mustWriteTool) {
  const r = judgeToolCall(tool, args);
  ok(name, r.verdict === 'write' && r.rule === 'file-write', r);
}
// 正文里含命令不能把只读工具骗亮，也不能因为有 adb 字样改变 write 的判据
const mustReadTool = [
  ['Read 工具', 'Read', { file_path: 'C:/x/a.js' }],
  ['Glob', 'Glob', { pattern: '**/*.sh' }],
  ['Grep', 'Grep', { pattern: 'adb shell input tap' }],
  ['list_files', 'list_files', { path: 'C:/x' }],
  ['NotebookRead', 'NotebookRead', { path: 'C:/x/a.ipynb' }],
  ['search_data', 'search_data', { q: 'emulator' }],
];
for (const [name, tool, args] of mustReadTool) {
  const r = judgeToolCall(tool, args);
  ok(name + '（应判 read）', r.verdict === 'read', r);
}
ok('write 的正文不进 label（不泄源码）', !String(judgeToolCall('Write', { file_path: 'C:/x/a.js', content: 'SECRET_TOKEN_ABC' }).label).includes('SECRET'));

console.log('\n=== A3. 执行脚本 vs 只是提到脚本 ===');
const scriptExec = [
  ['bash x.sh', 'bash run.sh'],
  ['sh x.sh', 'sh setup.sh'],
  ['./x.sh', './build.sh'],
  ['cmd //c x.bat', 'cmd //c run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['cmd /c x.cmd', 'cmd /c build.cmd'],
  ['裸 bat 作命令', 'run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['powershell -File', 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1'],
  ['wscript', 'wscript lamp.vbs'],
  ['cscript', 'cscript //nologo lamp.vbs'],
  ['带环境变量的链式', 'MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 bash run.sh'],
  ['只读例外后面接脚本', 'adb devices; bash run.sh'],
];
for (const [name, cmd] of scriptExec) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name + '（应判 write/script-exec）', r.verdict === 'write' && r.rule === 'script-exec', r);
}
const scriptMention = [
  ['cat 脚本', 'cat run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['type 脚本', 'type run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['grep 脚本内容', 'grep -n emulator run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['ls 脚本', 'ls *.bat'],
  ['node inspect', 'node inspect run_emulator3.bat'],
  ['bash -c 内联', 'bash -c "echo hi"'],
  ['python 脚本', 'python build.py'],
  ['node 脚本', 'node build.js'],
];
for (const [name, cmd] of scriptMention) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name + '（应判 read）', r.verdict === 'read', r);
}

console.log('\n=== A4. 接线断言：插件真的用上了判定器 ===');
// 光有纯函数不算数 —— 插件必须真的调它。否则又回到"测的"和"跑着的"两套逻辑。
const plugSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(SANDBOX, 'plugins/tool-watch-dsh/index.js'), 'utf8');
ok('插件 import 了 judgeToolCall', /import\s*\{[^}]*judgeToolCall[^}]*\}\s*from\s*'\.\/rules\.mjs'/.test(plugSrc));
ok('watch() 里调用 judgeToolCall(', /const\s+verdict\s*=\s*judgeToolCall\(/.test(plugSrc));
ok('旧的 "non-shell 一律 read" 分支已移除', !/rule:\s*'non-shell'\s*\}/.test(plugSrc) || !/isShell\s*\?\s*judgeCommand/.test(plugSrc));

console.log('\n=== A5. 链式命令分段判定（2026-10-23 修复钉死）===');
// 修复前：整条命令字符串套只读例外——「adb devices && adb install x」整条被判 read，
// 正在装包/杀进程/点屏幕时灯全瞎。修复后：按 ||、&&、;、|、换行 拆段，写规则逐段
// 优先，只读例外只豁免自己所在的那一段。以下用例防旧病复发（修复由夜间作业落地，
// 本节把它钉进在役探针——作业的 accept.cjs 是一次性工件，不进每日链）。
const chainMustWrite = [
  ['查设备后装包 → adb-pkg', 'adb devices && adb install app.apk', 'adb-pkg'],
  ['看日志后杀模拟器 → adb-emu-kill', 'adb logcat; adb emu kill', 'adb-emu-kill'],
  ['列包后卸载 → adb-pkg', 'adb shell pm list packages && adb uninstall x', 'adb-pkg'],
  ['查设备后点屏幕 → adb-input', 'adb devices && adb shell input tap 100 200', 'adb-input'],
  ['读属性后删文件 → adb-shelldo', 'adb getprop ro.product.model; adb shell rm /sdcard/x', 'adb-shelldo'],
  ['看日志后杀进程 → proc-kill', 'adb logcat -d && taskkill //PID 1234 //F', 'proc-kill'],
];
for (const [name, cmd, rule] of chainMustWrite) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name, r.verdict === 'write' && r.rule === rule, r);
}
const chainMustRead = [
  ['纯查设备', 'adb devices'],
  ['日志管道', 'adb logcat | grep input'],
  ['纯列包', 'adb shell pm list packages'],
  ['纯读属性', 'adb getprop ro.product.model'],
  ['列包管道', 'adb shell pm list packages | grep foo'],
];
for (const [name, cmd] of chainMustRead) {
  const r = judgeCommand(cmd);
  ok(name + '（应判 read）', r.verdict === 'read', r);
}

console.log('\n=== B. 真实语料（三轮 230 条 bash 命令）===');
let total = 0, writes = 0, reads = 0;
const writeSamples = [];
for (const r of [1, 2, 3]) {
  const f = path.join(RUN, `round${r}.events.json`);
  let ev;
  try { ev = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); } catch { console.log(`  (缺少 ${path.basename(f)})`); continue; }
  for (const e of ev) {
    if (e.type !== 'tool_call' || e.tool !== 'bash') continue;
    const cmd = String(e.input?.command || '');
    if (!cmd.trim()) continue;
    total++;
    const v = judgeCommand(cmd);
    if (v.verdict === 'write') { writes++; writeSamples.push([r, v.rule, cmd.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 110)]); }
    else reads++;
  }
}
console.log(`  总数 ${total} | 判为操作 ${writes} (${total ? (writes * 100 / total).toFixed(1) : 0}%) | 判为只读 ${reads}`);
console.log(`\n  —— 被判为"操作电脑"的命令（逐条人眼复核）——`);
for (const [r, rule, cmd] of writeSamples) console.log(`  r${r} [${rule}] ${cmd}`);

// 语料里不该出现"明显只读却被判 write"的项
const falsePositives = writeSamples.filter(([, , c]) => /^\s*(cat|grep|ls|head|tail|wc|find)\b/.test(c));
ok('语料无误报（纯读命令未被判 write）', falsePositives.length === 0, falsePositives);
ok('语料确实抓到了操作（write > 0）', writes > 0);

console.log(`\nPROBE ${fail === 0 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${pass} pass / ${fail} fail`);
process.exit(fail === 0 ? 0 : 1);

```

```
// probe-tools-path.cjs — 判定「Ollama 的 OpenAI 兼容端点到底认不认 tools」。
//
// 背景：DSH 经 /v1/chat/completions 发来 106 个工具，但 Ollama 报
// prompt_tokens=2050（system 6178 字符 + 任务），工具面的体量对不上。
// 如果工具没被渲染进提示，模型就不可能发起工具调用 —— 那"用本地模型测
// DSH 功能"这条链路根本走不通，必须先确认。
//
// 做法：同一组消息 × 两种端点 × 有无工具，四格对照。
// 判据是 prompt_tokens 的增量：加一个工具如果 token 数不动，就是被丢了。
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
const MODEL = process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3.5:4b';

const TOOL = {
  type: 'function',
  function: {
    name: 'get_weather',
    description: '查询指定城市的实时天气',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: { city: { type: 'string', description: '城市名' } },
      required: ['city'],
    },
  },
};

const MESSAGES = [
  { role: 'system', content: '你是一个测试助手。' },
  { role: 'user', content: '帮我查一下杭州现在的天气' },
];

async function post(path, body) {
  const r = await fetch(BASE + path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const j = await r.json();
  return { status: r.status, j };
}

function summarize(tag, res, isOpenAI) {
  const j = res.j;
  let txt = '', tc = null, pt = null, ct = null;
  if (isOpenAI) {
    const m = j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message;
    txt = (m && m.content) || '';
    tc = (m && m.tool_calls) || null;
    pt = j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens;
    ct = j.usage && j.usage.completion_tokens;
  } else {
    txt = (j.message && j.message.content) || '';
    tc = (j.message && j.message.tool_calls) || null;
    pt = j.prompt_eval_count;
    ct = j.eval_count;
  }
  console.log(
    `${tag.padEnd(30)} HTTP ${res.status} | prompt_tok=${String(pt).padStart(5)} | out_tok=${String(ct).padStart(4)} | ` +
      `tool_calls=${tc ? tc.length + ':' + (tc[0].function ? tc[0].function.name : '') : '无'} | 正文=${JSON.stringify(txt.slice(0, 40))}`,
  );
  return { pt, tc, txt };
}

(async () => {
  const opt = { temperature: 0, num_predict: 128, think: false };

  console.log('■ 对照 1：/v1 不带工具（基线）');
  const a = await post('/v1/chat/completions', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false });
  const ra = summarize('  openai-completions 无 tools', a, true);

  console.log('■ 对照 2：/v1 带 1 个工具');
  const b = await post('/v1/chat/completions', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools: [TOOL] });
  const rb = summarize('  openai-completions 有 tools', b, true);

  console.log('■ 对照 3：/api/chat 不带工具（基线）');
  const c = await post('/api/chat', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, options: opt });
  const rc = summarize('  native /api/chat 无 tools', c, false);

  console.log('■ 对照 4：/api/chat 带 1 个工具');
  const d = await post('/api/chat', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools: [TOOL], options: opt });
  const rd = summarize('  native /api/chat 有 tools', d, false);

  console.log('\n■ 判定');
  const deltaV1 = rb.pt - ra.pt;
  const deltaNative = rd.pt - rc.pt;
  console.log(`  /v1   加工具后 prompt_tokens 增量: ${deltaV1}`);
  console.log(`  原生  加工具后 prompt_tokens 增量: ${deltaNative}`);
  console.log(
    deltaV1 > 20
      ? '  ⇒ /v1 端点确实把 tools 渲染进了提示。'
      : '  ⇒ /v1 端点没有把 tools 渲染进提示（增量 < 20 token）—— 这条路上工具调用不可能发生。',
  );
  console.log(
    deltaNative > 20
      ? '  ⇒ 原生端点渲染正常。'
      : '  ⇒ 原生端点也没有渲染。',
  );
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('探针失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

// probe-web.cjs — 验证 DSH 自己能不能上网查资料（不装任何市场插件）
//
// 背景：dsh-base 的依赖里已经有 dsh-tool-web / dsh-web-fetch-http /
// dsh-web-search-deepseek，也就是说 fetch 和 search 两个工具本该出厂就有。
// 但它到底有没有真的注册给模型、真的能连通外网，只有现场跑一次才知道。
//
// 三个用例，各自独立判定：
//   W1 fetch 静态页   —— 纯 HTTP 抓取，验的是 base 自带能力
//   W2 search         —— 依赖 DeepSeek 搜索 API，可能因账号/配额不可用
//   W3 fetch 动态页   —— 检验纯 HTTP 抓取的边界（SPA 会拿到空壳）
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { readSession, listSessions } = require('../lib/session-reader.cjs');

const SANDBOX = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DSH_HOME = path.join(SANDBOX, 'dsh-home');
const DSH_BIN = path.join(SANDBOX, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh', 'lib', 'bin.js');
const NODE = process.execPath;
const GIT_BASH = 'C:/Users/64562/.workbuddy/binaries/PortableGit/versions/1.3.0/usr/bin';
const STAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
const OUT = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'web-' + STAMP);
const CWD = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'scratch', 'web-live');
const TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS || 180000);

fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(CWD, { recursive: true });

const CASES = {
  W1: {
    name: 'fetch 静态页',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash、不要用 curl，只调用名为 web_fetch 的工具。',
      '调用 web_fetch，参数 {"url":"https://example.com"}。',
      '拿到结果后只回复一行：W1-OK: <页面里出现的那句标题原文>',
      '如果 web_fetch 工具不存在或调用失败，只回复：W1-FAIL: <原始错误信息>',
    ].join('\n'),
    // 判据：example.com 的真标题是 "Example Domain"
    check: (r) => /Example Domain/i.test(r.finalText) || /Example Domain/i.test(r.results),
  },
  W2: {
    name: 'search 联网搜索',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash，只调用名为 web_search 的工具。',
      '调用 web_search，参数 {"query":"PRETCO B级 考试大纲"}。',
      '拿到结果后只回复一行：W2-OK: <前三条结果的标题>',
      '如果 web_search 工具不存在或调用失败，只回复：W2-FAIL: <原始错误信息>',
    ].join('\n'),
    check: (r) => /W2-OK/.test(r.finalText) && !/W2-FAIL/.test(r.finalText),
  },
  W3: {
    name: 'fetch 动态页边界',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash、不要用 curl，只调用名为 web_fetch 的工具。',
      '调用 web_fetch，参数 {"url":"https://www.bilibili.com"}。',
      '然后只回复两行：',
      'W3-STATUS: <拿到多少个字>',
      'W3-SAMPLE: <正文里前 80 个字>',
    ].join('\n'),
    check: (r) => /W3-STATUS/.test(r.finalText),
  },
};

function runCase(key) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const cs = CASES[key];
    const dir = path.join(OUT, key);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'prompt.txt'), cs.prompt, 'utf8');

    const t0 = Date.now();
    const child = spawn(NODE, [DSH_BIN, 'headless', '--json', cs.prompt], {
      cwd: CWD,
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      env: { ...process.env, DSH_HOME, PATH: GIT_BASH + ';' + (process.env.PATH || '') },
    });
    let out = '', err = '';
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch { /* ignore */ } }, TIMEOUT_MS);
    child.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString('utf8'); });
    child.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString('utf8'); });

    child.on('close', (code) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'stdout.jsonl'), out, 'utf8');
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'stderr.log'), err, 'utf8');

      const evs = [];
      for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
        const s = line.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{')) { try { evs.push(JSON.parse(s)); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
      }
      const finalText = (evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'final').pop()?.text)
        || (evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'text').pop()?.text) || '';

      const sessions = listSessions(path.join(DSH_HOME, 'sessions')).filter((s) => s.mtimeMs >= t0 - 5000);
      let allEvents = [];
      for (const s of sessions.slice(0, 6)) {
        const { events } = readSession(s.dir);
        if (events.length > allEvents.length) allEvents = events;
      }
      const calls = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/call').map((e) => ({
        name: e.data?.name,
        args: JSON.stringify(e.data?.arguments || {}).slice(0, 160),
      }));
      const results = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/result').map((e) => {
        const c = e.data?.message?.content ?? e.data?.content;
        let txt = '';
        if (Array.isArray(c)) txt = c.map((x) => x.text || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n');
        else if (typeof c === 'string') txt = c;
        return String(txt);
      }).join('\n').slice(0, 3000);

      const r = {
        case: key,
        name: cs.name,
        exitCode: code,
        ms: Date.now() - t0,
        finalText,
        toolCalls: calls,
        results,
      };
      r.ok = cs.check(r);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), 'utf8');
      console.log(`${key} ${cs.name}: ${r.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} (${(r.ms / 1000).toFixed(0)}s) 工具=${JSON.stringify(calls.map((c) => c.name))}`);
      console.log('   答复:', JSON.stringify(finalText.slice(0, 200)));
      resolve(r);
    });
  });
}

(async () => {
  const only = process.argv[2] ? process.argv[2].split(',') : Object.keys(CASES);
  const results = [];
  for (const k of only) {
    if (CASES[k]) results.push(await runCase(k));
  }
  const pass = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'summary.json'), JSON.stringify(results, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(`\n合计 ${pass}/${results.length}   证据: ${OUT}`);
  process.exit(pass === results.length ? 0 : 1);
})();

// probe-write-verify.cjs — 写后自检插件契约探针（2026-10-28，repo-daily 4u）。离线夹具零网络。exit 1 = 回归。
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (n, c, e) => { if (c) { pass++; console.log('PASS ' + n); } else { fail++; console.log('FAIL ' + n + (e === undefined ? '' : ' -> ' + JSON.stringify(e))); } };
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'wv-fixture-'));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'good.js'), 'const x = 1;' + LF);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.js'), 'const x = ;' + LF);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'ok.json'), '{' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'a' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ':1}');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.json'), '{a:}');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'good.py'), 'x = 1' + LF);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py'), 'def f(:' + LF);
(async () => {
  const R = await import('file:///' + path.join(ROOT, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'rules.mjs').split(path.sep).join('/'));
  const C = await import('file:///' + path.join(ROOT, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'checkers.mjs').split(path.sep).join('/'));
  // 1) 提取器
  ok('redirect 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('echo hi > a.js')) === JSON.stringify(['a.js']));
  ok('追加与 fd 排除', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cmd >> log.js 2>/dev/null')) === JSON.stringify(['log.js']));
  ok('fd 数字排除', R.extractWriteTargets('prog > 2').length === 0);
  ok('heredoc 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cat > b.py <<EOF')) === JSON.stringify(['b.py']));
  ok('touch 多目标', R.extractWriteTargets('touch a.py b.json').length === 2);
  ok('tee 与 cp 尾参', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('tee out.json')) === JSON.stringify(['out.json']) && JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cp x y.js')) === JSON.stringify(['y.js']));
  ok('sed -i 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('sed -i s/a/b f.py')) === JSON.stringify(['f.py']));
  ok('非代码扩展过滤', R.extractWriteTargets('echo x > note.txt').length === 0);
  // 2) 检查器
  ok('js 合法=OK', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'good.js')).status === 'OK');
  ok('js 语法错=FAIL', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.js')).status === 'FAIL');
  ok('json 双向', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'ok.json')).status === 'OK' && C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.json')).status === 'FAIL');
  ok('python ast 双向', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'good.py')).status === 'OK' && C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py')).status === 'FAIL', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py')));
  ok('文件消失=GONE', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'nope.js')).status === 'GONE');
  // 3) 注入文本
  const txt = R.buildInjectionText({ '/x/bad.js': { checker: 'FAIL', output: 'SyntaxError (3:9)' } }, 5);
  ok('注入文本带路径与首错', txt.indexOf('[write-verify]') >= 0 && txt.indexOf('/x/bad.js') >= 0 && txt.indexOf('SyntaxError') >= 0);
  // 4) 接线钉：插件源码纪律 + cordis/repo-daily
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'index.js'), 'utf8');
  ok('永不否决(fail-open 形状)', src.indexOf('return undefined') >= 0 && src.indexOf('tick_error') >= 0);
  // 「注入缝在位」原先是一条字符串搜索：src.indexOf('systemPrompt.context')>=0。
  // 它一直绿，而生产里这条缝抛了 142 次（dsh-home/write-verify.log，最新一条 2026-10-30T11:36:10Z），
  // "把写后失败注回 agent 面前"从未生效过一次 —— 字符串在源码里 ≠ 缝挂得上。换成真挂载。
  const stageDir = path.join(tmp, 'staged');
  fs.cpSync(path.join(ROOT, 'plugins'), path.join(stageDir, 'plugins'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(stageDir, 'package.json'), '{"type":"module"}');
  for (const [name, code] of [
    ['cordis', 'export class Service { constructor(ctx) { this.ctx = ctx; } }'],
    ['schemastery', 'const chain=()=>({default:()=>chain()}); export default {object:()=>({}),string:chain,number:chain,boolean:chain};'],
  ]) {
    const d = path.join(stageDir, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', name);
    fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(d, 'package.json'), '{"type":"module","main":"index.js"}');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(d, 'index.js'), code);
  }
  const WV = (await import('file:///' + path.join(stageDir, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'index.js').split(path.sep).join('/'))).default;
  const wvHome = path.join(tmp, 'wvhome');
  fs.mkdirSync(wvHome, { recursive: true });
  const wvCfg = () => ({
    enabled: true, inject: true, stateFile: path.join(wvHome, 'state.json'), logFile: path.join(wvHome, 'wv.log'),
    maxFilesPerCall: 8, maxVerifyPerRound: 10, maxAppeals: 6,
  });
  // 与上游一致的集中分配表（node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt/lib/index.js:44）。
  // 抄这张表不是为了模拟实现，而是为了**能校验契约**：插件必须报锚点名，
  // 锚点名写错 → getContextOrder 返回 undefined → order 非有限 → 这里就抛，不会拖到生产。
  const CONTEXT_ORDERS = {
    WORKING_DIRECTORY: 100, SANDBOX_POLICY: 110, APPROVAL_POLICY: 115,
    SUBAGENT_DELEGATION: 120, TEAM_IDENTITY: 125, HARNESS_SOURCE: 200, WEB_SURFACE: 210,
  };
  const mountWv = ({ hasSystemPrompt }) => {
    let guardMounted = false;
    const contexts = [];
    const has = (dep) => dep === 'tools' || (dep === 'systemPrompt' && hasSystemPrompt);
    const ctx = {
      inject(deps, cb) {
        if (!deps.every(has)) return;                 // Cordis 语义：声明了却没人提供 → 静默不回调
        const scope = {};
        if (deps.includes('tools')) scope.tools = { guard() { guardMounted = true; } };
        // 桩必须按真服务的校验来（dsh-system-prompt/lib/index.js:279）：
        // 只 push 不校验 = 契约违规在这里绿、在生产里静默失效。10-30 就是这么漏的。
        if (deps.includes('systemPrompt')) scope.systemPrompt = {
          getContextOrder: (n) => CONTEXT_ORDERS[n],
          context: (o) => {
            if (!Number.isFinite(o.order)) throw new TypeError(`prompt context "${o.name}" order must be a finite number`);
            if (typeof o.name !== 'string' || !o.name) throw new TypeError('prompt context requires a name');
            if (contexts.some((c) => c.name === o.name)) throw new Error(`prompt context "${o.name}" is already registered`);
            contexts.push(o);
          },
        };
        cb(scope);
      },
    };
    const svc = new WV(ctx, wvCfg());
    return { svc, guardMounted, contexts, seam: svc.seamAttached === true };
  };
  const mYes = mountWv({ hasSystemPrompt: true });
  ok('注入缝真挂上（systemPrompt 在位时 seamAttached 且 context 被调过一次）',
    mYes.seam === true && mYes.contexts.length === 1, { seam: mYes.seam, contexts: mYes.contexts.length });
  // 契约三件套（10-30 生产实况：只传 { text } 时 context() 抛 order must be a finite number，
  // 缝从未挂上，而上一版探针只数 contexts.length 所以照绿）。
  const ctx0 = mYes.contexts[0] || {};
  ok('缝注册带 name（注册键，缺了上游按 undefined 命名会撞车）', typeof ctx0.name === 'string' && ctx0.name.length > 0, ctx0.name);
  ok('缝注册带有限 order（上游 context() 的硬校验）', Number.isFinite(ctx0.order), { order: ctx0.order });
  ok('order 来自集中分配表的合法锚点，不是插件自己编的数',
    Object.values(CONTEXT_ORDERS).includes(ctx0.order), { order: ctx0.order, table: CONTEXT_ORDERS });
  ok('text 是每轮求值的函数且返回非空字符串',
    typeof ctx0.text === 'function' && typeof ctx0.text({}) === 'string', typeof ctx0.text);
  const mNo = mountWv({ hasSystemPrompt: false });
  ok('反向：systemPrompt 缺席时 guard 仍挂载（两条 inject 解耦，不退化成"不存在"）',
    mNo.guardMounted === true && mNo.seam === false, { guard: mNo.guardMounted, seam: mNo.seam });
  // 原来这里还有一条**源码文本钉**（正则框住 inject 回调内 300 字符找 scope.systemPrompt.context），
  // 加一段注释就断 —— 而它防的"回到直接读 ctx.systemPrompt"已经被上面两条行为锁覆盖：
  // 夹具的 ctx 上没有 systemPrompt 属性，直读就是 TypeError → seamAttached=false → "缝真挂上"先红。
  // 行为锁能覆盖的事就别用文本钉（钉住形状只会让下一个改注释的人莫名踩红）。
  ok('单一真源(复用 tool-watch 判定)', src.indexOf('tool-watch-dsh/rules.mjs') >= 0);
  ok('cordis 已注册', fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'dsh-home', 'cordis.patch.yml'), 'utf8').indexOf('write-verify-dsh') >= 0);
  ok('repo-daily 已挂', fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'repo-daily.cmd'), 'utf8').indexOf('probe-write-verify.cjs') >= 0);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log('SUMMARY pass=' + pass + ' fail=' + fail);
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
})();

// replay-dump.cjs — 把线上抓到的请求原样重放，逐个隔离变量。
//
// 要回答的问题：DSH 经 /v1 发来的这一包（27 工具 / 4 条消息 / 约 9.4k token），
// 模型为什么完全不理任务？候选原因有三个，必须分开验：
//   A. OpenAI 兼容层丢东西（换成原生 /api/chat 重放即可排除）
//   B. 上下文被截断（显式给 num_ctx=32768 重放即可排除）
//   C. 模型本身被巨型 user 消息压住（把技能目录摘掉再重放即可排除）
//
// 用法：node replay-dump.cjs <dump.json> [v1|native]
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const file = process.argv[2] || path.join(__dirname, 'wire-dumps', fs.readdirSync(path.join(__dirname, 'wire-dumps')).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json')).sort().slice(-1)[0]);
const mode = process.argv[3] || 'native';
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';

const src = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
console.log('重放:', path.basename(file), '| 模式:', mode);
console.log('原包: tools=' + (src.tools || []).length + ' messages=' + (src.messages || []).length);

function textOf(m) {
  return typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : (m.content || []).map((b) => b.text || '').join('');
}

async function call(tag, messages, tools, extra) {
  let url, body;
  if (mode === 'v1') {
    url = BASE + '/v1/chat/completions';
    body = { model: src.model, messages, tools: tools.length ? tools : undefined, stream: false, max_tokens: 600 };
  } else {
    url = BASE + '/api/chat';
    body = {
      model: src.model,
      messages: messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: textOf(m) })),
      tools: tools.length ? tools.map((t) => ({ type: 'function', function: t.function })) : undefined,
      stream: false,
      think: false,
      options: { num_ctx: 32768, num_predict: 600, temperature: 0, ...(extra || {}) },
    };
  }
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const j = await r.json();
  const ms = Date.now() - t0;
  if (j.error) { console.log(`${tag.padEnd(34)} ERROR ${JSON.stringify(j.error).slice(0, 120)}`); return null; }
  let pt, ct, txt, tc;
  if (mode === 'v1') {
    const m = (j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message) || {};
    pt = j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens; ct = j.usage && j.usage.completion_tokens;
    txt = m.content || ''; tc = m.tool_calls || null;
  } else {
    pt = j.prompt_eval_count; ct = j.eval_count;
    txt = (j.message && j.message.content) || ''; tc = (j.message && j.message.tool_calls) || null;
  }
  const tcName = tc && tc[0] ? (tc[0].function || {}).name : null;
  console.log(
    `${tag.padEnd(34)} prompt=${String(pt).padStart(6)} out=${String(ct).padStart(4)} ${String(ms + 'ms').padStart(8)} | ` +
      `tool=${tcName || '无'} | ${JSON.stringify(String(txt).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 70))}`,
  );
  return { pt, ct, txt, tc, ms };
}

(async () => {
  const all = src.messages || [];
  const sys = all.filter((m) => m.role === 'system');
  const users = all.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
  const tools = src.tools || [];

  console.log('\n■ 1. 完整原包（4 条消息 + 27 工具）');
  await call('  原样', all, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 2. 只留任务那条 user（摘掉 runtime context 与技能目录）');
  const onlyTask = [sys[0], users[0]].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  system + 任务', onlyTask, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 3. 摘掉技能目录，保留 runtime context');
  const noSkills = [sys[0], users[0], users[1]].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  system + 任务 + runtime', noSkills, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 4. 摘掉工具，只留任务（看模型是否至少读懂任务）');
  await call('  system + 任务（无工具）', onlyTask, []);

  console.log('\n■ 5. 三条 user 合并成一条');
  const merged = [sys[0], { role: 'user', content: users.map(textOf).join('\n\n---\n\n') }].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  合并 user', merged, tools);
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});
