}

(async () => {
  console.log('=== A. 分级与票名（tiers.mjs）===');
  const tiers = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT, 'plugins/cua-gate-dsh/tiers.mjs')).href);
  const { ticketNameError, tierForTicketName, ticketMatches, isSystemTool, labelOf, tierOf, refineTier } = tiers;
  ok('原始名 click 被拒并提示 act:click', /act:click/.test(ticketNameError('click') || ''), ticketNameError('click'));
  ok('原始名 click 在 allowRaw 下放行', ticketNameError('click', { allowRaw: true }) === null);
  ok('动作级 act:click 合法', ticketNameError('act:click') === null);
  ok('非法动作 act:teleport 被拒', /没有动作/.test(ticketNameError('act:teleport') || ''), ticketNameError('act:teleport'));
  ok('只读工具 page 不需要票', /只读/.test(ticketNameError('page') || ''));
  ok('未知工具被拒', /未知/.test(ticketNameError('nosuch') || ''));
  ok('多余后缀被拒', ticketNameError('act:click:x') !== null);
  ok('app:launch 是 C 档', tierForTicketName('app:launch') === 'C');
  ok('act:click 是 B 档', tierForTicketName('act:click') === 'B');
  ok('通配 act 取最高档 B', tierForTicketName('act') === 'B');
  ok('通配 app 取最高档 C', tierForTicketName('app') === 'C');
  ok('通配 dom_read 含 eval 故为 C', tierForTicketName('dom_read') === 'C');
  ok('dom_read:snapshot 是 A 档', tierForTicketName('dom_read:snapshot') === 'A');
  ok('clip:write 是 B 档、clip:read 是 A 档', tierForTicketName('clip:write') === 'B' && tierForTicketName('clip:read') === 'A');
  ok('browser_navigate 已拆为 B 档', tierOf('browser_navigate') === 'B');
  ok('browser_prepare 仍为 C 档', tierOf('browser_prepare') === 'C');
  ok('launch_app 仍为 C 档', tierOf('launch_app') === 'C');
  ok('labelOf 复合工具带动作', labelOf('act', { action: 'type' }) === 'act:type' && labelOf('dom_read', { action: 'eval' }) === 'dom_read:eval');
  ok('refineTier dom_read:eval 升 C', refineTier('dom_read', 'A', { action: 'eval' }) === 'C');
  ok('动作级票只匹配同动作', ticketMatches('act:click', 'act', 'act:click') && !ticketMatches('act:click', 'act', 'act:type'));
  ok('通配票匹配全部动作', ticketMatches('act', 'act', 'act:type'));
  ok('原始票在 raw 视图匹配', ticketMatches('click', 'click', 'click'));
  ok('D 档识别', isSystemTool('start_session') && !isSystemTool('click'));

  console.log('=== B. 闸门行为（桩替身）===');
  stagePlugins();
  const gateMod = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(run, 'plugins/cua-gate-dsh/index.js')).href);
  const CuaGate = gateMod.default;
  const ticketsFile = path.join(home, 'cua-tickets.json');
  const stopFile = path.join(home, 'cua-stop.flag');
  const ledgerDir = path.join(home, 'cua-ledger');
  const budgetFile = path.join(home, 'cua-budget.json');
  const expiry = () => new Date(Date.now() + 60000).toISOString();
  const tickets = (list) => write(ticketsFile, JSON.stringify(list));
  const readTicketsFile = () => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ticketsFile, 'utf8'));
  const call = (name, args) => ({ name: 'mcp__cua__' + name, arguments: args });
  function gate(overrides = {}) {
    let guard;
    const svc = new CuaGate({ inject(deps, cb) { cb({ tools: { guard(fn) { guard = fn; } } }); } }, {
      mode: 'enforce', budget: 100, enableSystemTier: false,
      ticketsFile, stopFile, ledgerDir, logFile: path.join(home, 'cua-gate.log'),
      budgetFile, frameMaxAgeMs: 0, frameMode: 'observe', readRatePerMin: 0,
      ...overrides,
    });
    return { svc, guard };
  }
  const ledgerRows = () => {
    if (!fs.existsSync(ledgerDir)) return [];
    return fs.readdirSync(ledgerDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.jsonl')).flatMap((f) =>
      fs.readFileSync(path.join(ledgerDir, f), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l)));
  };

  // B1 动作级票：act:click 只能点，不能打字
  tickets([{ id: 'T1', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 5, remaining: 5, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  let g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 0 });
  ok('动作级票放行 act click', g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 1, window_id: 2 })) === undefined);
  const denyType = g.guard(call('act', { action: 'type', text: 'x', pid: 1, window_id: 2 }));
  ok('同一张 act:click 票拒绝 act type', typeof denyType === 'string' && /TICKET_REQUIRED|没有你|签发|act:type/.test(denyType), denyType);
  ok('被拒的 type 调用没有核销票', readTicketsFile()[0].remaining === 4, readTicketsFile());

  // B2 通配 act 票：全部动作放行
  tickets([{ id: 'T2', tool: 'act', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 3, remaining: 3, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 0 });
  ok('通配 act 票放行 act type', g.guard(call('act', { action: 'type', text: 'x' })) === undefined);

  // B3 C 档待确认：pending 不放行，approved 才放行
  tickets([{ id: 'T3', tool: 'app:launch', tier: 'C', status: 'pending', uses: 1, remaining: 1, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g = gate();
  const pend = g.guard(call('app', { action: 'launch', name: 'notepad' }));
  ok('C 档 pending 票拒绝并提示待确认', typeof pend === 'string' && /尚未经人工确认/.test(pend), pend);
  ok('pending 拒绝落账为 PENDING_APPROVAL', ledgerRows().some((r) => r.code === 'PENDING_APPROVAL'));
  tickets([{ id: 'T3', tool: 'app:launch', tier: 'C', status: 'approved', uses: 1, remaining: 1, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  ok('C 档确认后放行', g.guard(call('app', { action: 'launch', name: 'notepad' })) === undefined);

  // B4 预算落盘：重启（新实例）不重置
  tickets([{ id: 'T4', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 9, remaining: 9, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  fs.rmSync(budgetFile,{force:true});
  const budgetKey = 'unattributed';
  const agentA = { session: { id: 'x' }, parentAgent: { session: { id: budgetKey } } };
  const execFor = () => ({ name: 'mcp__cua__act', arguments: { action: 'click', pid: 1, window_id: 2 } });
  const g1 = gate({ budget: 2 });
  ok('预算第 1 次放行', g1.guard(execFor()) === undefined);
  ok('预算第 2 次放行', g1.guard(execFor()) === undefined);
  const g2 = gate({ budget: 2 }); // 模拟 DSH 重启
  const third = g2.guard(execFor());
  ok('重启后第 3 次仍被预算拦住（不清零）', typeof third === 'string' && /已达上限/.test(third), third);
  ok('预算文件记录了已用次数', JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(budgetFile, 'utf8'))[budgetKey]?.used === 2, fs.existsSync(budgetFile) ? fs.readFileSync(budgetFile, 'utf8') : 'missing');

  // B5 预算文件损坏：fail-closed，绝不当成空表重置
  write(budgetFile, '{not json');
  const g3 = gate({ budget: 2 });
  const broken = g3.guard(execFor());
  ok('预算文件损坏 → 拒绝（fail-closed）', typeof broken === 'string' && /预算文件无法读写/.test(broken), broken);
  fs.rmSync(budgetFile, { force: true });

  // B6 陈旧画面（enforce）：没有先 see 就拒，see 之后放行
  tickets([{ id: 'T6', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 9, remaining: 9, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 60000, frameMode: 'enforce', budget: 0 });
  const stale = g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 7, window_id: 8 }));
  ok('陈旧画面（未 see）→ enforce 拒绝', typeof stale === 'string' && /尚未被成功观察/.test(stale), stale);
  ok('see 是只读，放行', g.guard(call('see', { pid: 7, window_id: 8, screenshot: false })) === undefined);
  // 2026-10-31（c148e29/85eb2e3）观察验收收紧到真实形状：image 必须带 data（裸壳不算），
  // 文本必须带 `#N 角色 "标签"` 元素行或带 role 的 JSON（散文不算）——tests/observe-verify 钉的契约。
  g.svc.observeResult(call('see',{pid:7,window_id:8}),{isError:false,content:[{type:'image',data:'cua-hardening-fixture-png'}]});
  ok('成功截图之后同窗口输入放行', g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 7, window_id: 8 })) === undefined);
  ok('另一个窗口仍然陈旧', typeof g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 7, window_id: 9 })) === 'string');

  // B6b 真实形状回归（2026-10-28）：本机 see 实测返回的是纯文本块（kinds:["text"]、无 image），
  // 而这条规矩原先只被上面那行"手造 image 块"测到 —— 机制绿着，生产的返回值形状却假设错了，
  // 后果是 frameMode=enforce 之下 seen 永远填不上、每一次 B 档桌面动作都判 STALE_FRAME，
  // probe-cua-gate 从 10-24 起连红三天、cua-gym「考生没交卷」根因都是这个。
  // 下面两条把这个形状差异钉死：文本观察必须算看过，空内容必须不算（fail-closed 不许松）。
  g.svc.observeResult(call('see', { pid: 21, window_id: 22 }), { isError: false, content: [{ type: 'text', text: '无障碍元素 3 个:\n#3 textbox "Name"' }] });
  ok('纯文本观察（本机 see 的真实形状）→ 同窗口输入放行', g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 21, window_id: 22 })) === undefined);
  g.svc.observeResult(call('see', { pid: 23, window_id: 24 }), { isError: false, content: [] });
  g.svc.observeResult(call('see', { pid: 23, window_id: 24 }), { isError: false, content: [{ type: 'text', text: '   ' }] });
  ok('空内容/纯空白观察 → 不算看过，仍然陈旧拒绝', typeof g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 23, window_id: 24 })) === 'string');

  // B6c 错误回执不得产生可用于放行动作的观察(2026-11-07,退修意见⑤):
  // see 失败(isError)哪怕带了内容块,也绝不能让后续 B 档动作借到"新鲜观察"。
  tickets([{ id: 'T6E', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 9, remaining: 9, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g.svc.observeResult(call('see', { pid: 31, window_id: 32 }), { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: '无障碍元素 9 个:\n#3 textbox "Name"' }] });
  ok('错误回执(即使带内容块)→ 不产生观察,同窗口动作仍拒', typeof g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 31, window_id: 32 })) === 'string');

  // B6d 探针提示词里那个观察工具名，闸门到底认不认（2026-10-29，raw 档）。
  // 背景：T3 恒红的根因是探针让模型调 mcp__cua__see，而 raw 档（直通驱动 56 个）里没有 see。
  // 换成 get_desktop_state 之前，先把这对组合在闸门层钉死：不带 pid/window_id 的观察与动作
  // 必须落到同一个键（window:[null,null]）并接得上新鲜度。
  // 第一条反向是必需的：没有它，"放行"也可能只是因为新鲜度检查压根没生效。
  tickets([{ id: 'T6D', tool: 'move_cursor', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 9, remaining: 9, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 60000, frameMode: 'enforce', budget: 0 });
  const mcFirst = g.guard(call('move_cursor', { x: 130, y: 130, scope: 'window' }));
  ok('raw 档：未观察就 move_cursor → 仍判 STALE_FRAME（检查确实在生效）', typeof mcFirst === 'string' && /尚未被/.test(mcFirst), String(mcFirst).slice(0, 90));
  ok('raw 档：get_desktop_state 是只读，放行', g.guard(call('get_desktop_state', {})) === undefined);
  g.svc.observeResult(call('get_desktop_state', {}), { isError: false, content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'windows 3:\n#1 pane "Desktop"\n#2 button "Start"' }] });
  ok('raw 档：get_desktop_state 之后 move_cursor（无 pid/window_id）放行 —— T3 用的正是这对组合',
    g.guard(call('move_cursor', { x: 130, y: 130, scope: 'window' })) === undefined);

  // B6f 拒绝文案本身也是接口（2026-10-30，#7/#18 的回归锁）。
  // 原话有两处不可执行：把 Map 拼键 'window:[null,null]' 透给模型（它没法据此改动作），
  // 且只点名 see —— raw 档根本没有 see，照做就再撞一次"工具不在清单里"。
  // 断言的数据源不是插件自己的表：raw 名单取驱动清单快照，task 名单取 surface 注册处。
  {
    const rawNames = new Set(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua-tools-raw.json'), 'utf8')).tools.map((t) => t.name));
    const taskNames = new Set([...fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'mcp', 'cua', 'surface.mjs'), 'utf8')
      .matchAll(/name: '([a-z_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]));
    const clauseOf = (s) => { const m = /先调一次只读观察（([^）]*)）/.exec(s); return m ? m[1] : ''; };
    const clause = clauseOf(stale) || clauseOf(mcFirst);
    const NON_TOOL = new Set(['snapshot']);        // dom_read 的动作值，不是工具名
    const named = [...new Set((clause.match(/[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,}/g) || []))].filter((w) => !NON_TOOL.has(w));
    ok('B6f 文案给出"先观察"的具体工具清单', named.length >= 3, clause);
    ok('B6f 文案不再泄漏内部拼键', !/window:\[|browser:\[|\[null/.test(stale + mcFirst), (stale + mcFirst).slice(0, 140));
    ok('B6f 文案把这次动作的目标说成模型能改的坐标', /pid=7/.test(stale) && /window_id=8/.test(stale), stale.slice(0, 120));
    ok('B6f 没带坐标时改说"按整桌面那一次观察匹配"', /没带 pid\/window_id/.test(mcFirst), mcFirst.slice(0, 100));
    ok('B6f 点名的工具都真实存在于某一档（不点名不存在的工具）',
      named.every((w) => rawNames.has(w) || taskNames.has(w)), named.filter((w) => !rawNames.has(w) && !taskNames.has(w)));
    ok('B6f 点名的观察工具全是只读（A 档）—— 让模型去观察不该再撞一次拒绝',
      named.every((w) => tiers.tierOf(w) === 'A'), named.map((w) => w + ':' + tiers.tierOf(w)));
    ok('B6f raw 档下至少 3 个观察工具可直选', named.filter((w) => rawNames.has(w)).length >= 3, named);
    ok('B6f task 档下至少 2 个观察工具可直选', named.filter((w) => taskNames.has(w)).length >= 2, named);
  }

  // B6e 预算身份与 guard 必须解耦（2026-10-30，R2 的回归锁）。
  // 背景：闸门只 inject(['tools']) 却读 ctx.taskBudget → 每次带 agent 的 B 档写动作都被拒，
  // 账本里自 10-22 起没有一笔 TICKET_OK/allow。修法不能是"把三个依赖并进 ['tools']"：
  // _probe/ab-inject-dep2.mjs 实测（带正对照 P both provided → fired=true）——
  // Cordis 对"声明了却没人提供的依赖"是**静默不回调**，并进 tools 那条会让 guard 整个不注册，
  // 闸门从"拒绝"退化成"不存在"，那才是不可见的 fail-open。所以身份走第二条独立 inject。
  function gateSplit(hasIdentity) {
    let guard = null, identityFired = false;
    const has = (d) => d === 'tools' || (hasIdentity && (d === 'taskBudget' || d === 'agents' || d === 'sessionProjections'));
    const ctx = {
      inject(deps, cb) {
        if (!deps.every(has)) return;                      // 复刻 Cordis：缺一个依赖就静默不回调
        const scope = {};
        for (const d of deps) scope[d] = {};
        scope.tools = { guard(fn) { guard = fn; } };
        if (hasIdentity && deps.includes('taskBudget')) {
          scope.taskBudget = { store: { read: () => ({}) }, resolve: () => ({ key: 'task-B6e' }) };
          identityFired = true;
        }
        cb(scope);
      },
    };
    const svc = new CuaGate(ctx, {
      mode: 'enforce', budget: 100, enableSystemTier: false,
      ticketsFile, stopFile, ledgerDir, logFile: path.join(home, 'cua-gate.log'), budgetFile,
      frameMaxAgeMs: 0, frameMode: 'observe', readRatePerMin: 0,
    });
    return { call: (exec) => (guard ? guard(exec) : '<GUARD 未挂载>'), identityFired: () => identityFired, svc };
  }
  const idAct = { name: 'mcp__cua__move_cursor', arguments: { x: 10, y: 10 }, agent: { id: 'a9', session: { id: 's9', turn: 1 } } };

  tickets([{ id: 'TB1', tool: 'move_cursor', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 3, remaining: 3, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  const withId = gateSplit(true);
  ok('B6e 身份服务齐备 → 第二条 inject 挂上', withId.identityFired() === true);
  ok('B6e 持有效票 + agent 在场 → 真的放行（这条在 10-22~10-30 之间从未成立过）',
    withId.call(idAct) === undefined, withId.call(idAct));
  ok('B6e 放行落账为 allow/TICKET_OK', ledgerRows().some((r) => r.decision === 'allow' && r.code === 'TICKET_OK' && r.ticket === 'TB1'));

  tickets([{ id: 'TB2', tool: 'move_cursor', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 3, remaining: 3, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  const noId = gateSplit(false);
  ok('B6e 反向（关键）：身份服务缺席时 guard 仍然挂载，闸门没有退化成"不存在"',
    noId.identityFired() === false && noId.call(idAct) !== '<GUARD 未挂载>', String(noId.call(idAct)).slice(0, 60));
  ok('B6e 身份缺席 → 具名拒绝 TASK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE 且票未核销', (() => {
    const denied = typeof noId.call(idAct) === 'string' && /无法归属到任务/.test(noId.call(idAct));
    return denied && readTicketsFile().find((t) => t.id === 'TB2').remaining === 3;
  })(), readTicketsFile().find((t) => t.id === 'TB2'));

  // B6c 身份服务缺席时的**具名拒绝**（2026-10-28）：
  // budgetKeyFor 必须继续抛 —— probe-governance-v5:112 钉着，R1 修的就是"静默退回单桶让 per-task 预算失效"。
  // 要钉的是后半段：抛出来以后必须变成 TASK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE 落账，
  // 不许漏进 check() 的 catch-all 变成匿名 CHECK_ERROR（那样账本上只剩"闸门内部错误"，
  // 分不清环境缺依赖还是策略否决；2026-10-28 实测账本里就剩了三笔 CHECK_ERROR）。
  const withAgent = (name, args) => ({ name: 'mcp__cua__' + name, arguments: args, agent: { id: 'a1', session: { id: 's1', turn: 1 } } });
  let threw = null;
  try { gateMod.budgetKeyFor({ id: 'a1', session: { id: 's1' } }, undefined, {}); } catch (e) { threw = String(e.message).slice(0, 60); }
  ok('身份服务缺席 → budgetKeyFor 仍然抛（不许静默合桶，R1 的防线）', /Task identity service unavailable/.test(threw || ''), threw || '没抛');
  tickets([{ id: 'T9', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 3, remaining: 3, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]);
  g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 0, budget: 5 });
  const before9 = readTicketsFile()[0].remaining;
  const idDenied = g.guard(withAgent('act', { action: 'click', pid: 41, window_id: 42 }));
  ok('有 agent 但身份服务不在 → 具名拒绝，不再冒充内部错误', typeof idDenied === 'string' && /无法归属到任务/.test(idDenied), String(idDenied).slice(0, 90));
  ok('具名拒绝落账为 TASK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE', ledgerRows().some((r) => r.code === 'TASK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE' && r.decision === 'deny'), ledgerRows().filter((r) => r.code === 'TASK_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE').slice(-1));
  ok('账本里不再新增匿名 CHECK_ERROR', !ledgerRows().some((r) => r.code === 'CHECK_ERROR' && r.tool === 'act:click'));
  ok('拒绝不吞票（发生在核销之前，补好依赖可原样重试）', readTicketsFile()[0].remaining === before9, readTicketsFile()[0]);
  ok('无 agent 的调用仍走 unattributed 桶（没把正常路径改坏）', (() => { tickets([{ id: 'TA', tool: 'act:click', tier: 'B', status: 'approved', uses: 2, remaining: 2, match: {}, expiresAt: expiry() }]); const gg = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 0, budget: 5 }); return gg.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 43, window_id: 44 })) === undefined; })());

  // B7 陈旧画面（observe 默认）：只记账，放行
  g = gate({ frameMaxAgeMs: 60000, frameMode: 'observe', budget: 0 });
  ok('陈旧画面 observe 放行', g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 70, window_id: 80 })) === undefined);
  ok('陈旧画面 observe 记账 wouldBe', ledgerRows().some((r) => r.code === 'STALE_FRAME' && r.wouldBe === 'deny'));

  // B8 读取限频
  g = gate({ readRatePerMin: 3 });
  const seeOk = [1, 2, 3].map(() => g.guard(call('see', { pid: 1, window_id: 1, screenshot: false })));
  ok('限频窗口内前 3 次 see 放行', seeOk.every((x) => x === undefined));
  const over = g.guard(call('see', { pid: 1, window_id: 1, screenshot: false }));
  ok('第 4 次 see 被限频', typeof over === 'string' && /过于频繁/.test(over), over);
  ok('限频只读工具 find 不受影响', g.guard(call('find', { name: 'x' })) === undefined);

  // B9 急停优先；D 档默认拒绝
  fs.writeFileSync(stopFile, 'x');
  g = gate();
  ok('急停下写动作拒绝', typeof g.guard(call('act', { action: 'click', pid: 1, window_id: 2 })) === 'string');
  ok('急停下只读放行', g.guard(call('see', { pid: 1, window_id: 2, screenshot: false })) === undefined);
  fs.rmSync(stopFile, { force: true });
  ok('D 档系统级默认拒绝', typeof gate().guard(call('start_session', {})) === 'string');

  console.log('=== C. 共享层（cua-lib.mjs）===');
  // 2026-10-26 归位：cua-lib 从仓库根移入 tools/cua/
  const lib = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua', 'cua-lib.mjs')).href);
  ok('共享层的 HOME 指向临时目录', lib.HOME === home, lib.HOME);
  const bad = lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'click' });
  ok('签发原始名被拒', bad.ok === false && /act:click/.test(bad.error), bad);
  const ro = lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'page' });
  ok('签发只读工具被拒', ro.ok === false, ro);
  ok('uses=0 被拒', lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'act:click', uses: 0 }).ok === false);
  ok('ttl 过小被拒', lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'act:click', ttl: 1 }).ok === false);
  const bLive = lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'act:click', uses: 2, match: { pid: '5' } });
  ok('B 档签发即 approved', bLive.ok && bLive.created[0].status === 'approved' && bLive.created[0].tier === 'B', bLive);
  const cIssue = lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'app:launch', note: 'test' });
  ok('C 档签发为 pending', cIssue.ok && cIssue.created[0].status === 'pending', cIssue);
  const cid = cIssue.created[0].id;
  ok('审批灯文件写 pending:true', JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(approvalFile, 'utf8')).pending === true);
  const ap = lib.approveTicket(cid);
  ok('确认后票变 approved', ap.ok && lib.readTickets().find((t) => t.id === cid).status === 'approved');
  ok('确认后审批灯熄灭', JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(approvalFile, 'utf8')).pending === false);
  const dup = lib.approveTicket(cid);
  ok('重复确认是幂等的', dup.ok && dup.already === true);
  const cid2 = lib.issueTickets({ tools: 'app:kill' }).created[0].id;
  lib.revokeTicket(cid2);
  ok('作废后票消失', !lib.readTickets().some((t) => t.id === cid2));
  lib.setStop(true);
  ok('急停置位落盘', fs.existsSync(path.join(home, 'cua-stop.flag')));
  lib.setStop(false);
  ok('急停解除', !fs.existsSync(path.join(home, 'cua-stop.flag')));
  const adminRows = lib.readLedger().filter((r) => r.decision === 'admin');
  ok('人工操作入账（admin）', adminRows.some((r) => r.code === 'TICKET_APPROVE') && adminRows.some((r) => r.code === 'TICKET_ISSUE'));
  // 2026-10-26 归位：cua-admin 从仓库根移入 tools/cua/
  const verifyOut = execFileSync(process.execPath, [path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua', 'cua-admin.mjs'), 'ledger', '--verify'], { env: { ...process.env, DSH_HOME: home }, encoding: 'utf8' });
  ok('账本哈希链校验通过（人工操作也在链上）', /校验通过/.test(verifyOut), verifyOut);

  console.log('=== D. 审批面板（cua-panel.mjs）===');
  // 2026-10-26 归位：cua-panel 从仓库根移入 tools/cua/
  const panel = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua', 'cua-panel.mjs')).href);
  const token = panel.loadToken();
  ok('令牌持久化到 dsh-home', fs.readFileSync(path.join(home, 'cua-panel.token'), 'utf8').trim() === token);
  const port = 17000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000);
  const server = panel.createPanelServer({ port, token });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const req = (method, urlPath, { headers = {}, body } = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const data = body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body);
    const r = http.request({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, method, path: urlPath, headers: {
      host: `127.0.0.1:${port}`, ...(data ? { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'content-length': Buffer.byteLength(data) } : {}), ...headers,
    } }, (res) => {
      let text = '';
      res.on('data', (c) => { text += c; });
      res.on('end', () => { let j = null; try { j = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* 非 JSON */ } resolve({ status: res.statusCode, text, json: j }); });
    });
    r.on('error', reject);
    if (data) r.write(data);
    r.end();
  });
  const auth = { 'x-cua-token': token };
  ok('页面无令牌 → 401', (await req('GET', '/')).status === 401);
  ok('页面带令牌 → 200', (await req('GET', `/?t=${token}`)).status === 200);
  ok('接口无令牌 → 401', (await req('GET', '/api/state')).status === 401);
  ok('Host 不是本机 → 403（防 DNS 重绑定）', (await req('GET', '/api/state', { headers: { ...auth, host: 'evil.example' } })).status === 403);
  const st = await req('GET', '/api/state', { headers: auth });
  ok('接口带令牌读状态', st.status === 200 && Array.isArray(st.json.tickets), st.status);
  ok('跨站 Origin 的 POST → 403', (await req('POST', '/api/stop', { headers: { ...auth, origin: 'http://evil.example' }, body: { on: true } })).status === 403);
  const iss = await req('POST', '/api/issue', { headers: auth, body: { tool: 'click' } });
  ok('面板签原始名被拒（400 + 提示）', iss.status === 400 && /act:click/.test(iss.json.error || ''), iss.json);
  const iss2 = await req('POST', '/api/issue', { headers: auth, body: { tool: 'act:type', pid: '12', window: '34', uses: '2', ttl: '300', note: 'panel' } });
  ok('面板签 B 档票成功', iss2.status === 200 && iss2.json.created[0].status === 'approved', iss2.json);
  ok('面板签票绑定 pid/window', JSON.stringify(readTicketsFile().find((t) => t.id === iss2.json.created[0].id).match) === JSON.stringify({ pid: 12, window_id: 34 }));
  const iss3 = await req('POST', '/api/issue', { headers: auth, body: { tool: 'app:front' } });
  const pid3 = iss3.json.created[0].id;
  ok('面板签 C 档票为待确认', iss3.json.created[0].status === 'pending');
  const ok3 = await req('POST', '/api/approve', { headers: auth, body: { id: pid3 } });
  ok('面板确认 C 档票', ok3.status === 200 && ok3.json.ok === true);
  const stOn = await req('POST', '/api/stop', { headers: auth, body: { on: true } });
  ok('面板急停置位', stOn.json.stop === true && fs.existsSync(path.join(home, 'cua-stop.flag')));
  const stOff = await req('POST', '/api/stop', { headers: auth, body: { on: false } });
  ok('面板解除急停', stOff.json.stop === false);
  const led = await req('GET', '/api/ledger', { headers: auth });
  ok('面板读账本', led.status === 200 && Array.isArray(led.json.rows));
  await new Promise((r) => server.close(r));

  // ---- E. live 探针自己的判定逻辑（离线，不启动 DSH、不动鼠标）----
  // 为什么挪进来：这两段判据原本只有跑十几分钟、还要人在场的 live 探针才会碰到，
  // 等于"没人跑就没人守着"。lastFrameSignal / summarize 都是纯函数，进每日链 4b 零成本。
  // 注意必须在设好临时 DSH_HOME 之后 require，且它已确认被 require 时不建目录（2026-10-29 实测）。
  const { lastFrameSignal, summarize } = require('./probe-cua-gate.cjs');
  const sigLog = path.join(run, 'sig', 'cua-gate.log');
  const T = (n, body) => `2026-10-29T00:00:0${n}.000Z ${body}`;
  const noCase = {};
  write(sigLog, [T(1, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_observe', raw: 'get_desktop_state', observed: true, contentLen: 5, kinds: ['text', 'image'], key: 'window:[null,null]' }))].join('\n'));
  noCase.observed = lastFrameSignal(0, sigLog);
  ok('形状钉：观察成功且认得 → observed', noCase.observed.kind === 'observed' && noCase.observed.raw === 'get_desktop_state', noCase.observed);

  write(sigLog, [
    T(1, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_observe', raw: 'get_desktop_state', observed: true, kinds: ['image'], key: 'window:[null,null]' })),
    T(2, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_dropped', raw: 'see', why: 'isError', isError: true })),
  ].join('\n'));
  noCase.dropped = lastFrameSignal(0, sigLog);
  ok('形状钉：更晚一次观察 isError → dropped（闸门不认失败观察是对的）', noCase.dropped.kind === 'dropped', noCase.dropped);

  write(sigLog, [
    T(1, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_observe', raw: 'get_window_state', observed: true, kinds: ['image'], key: 'window:[1,2]' })),
    T(2, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_observe', raw: 'get_window_state', observed: false, contentLen: 1, kinds: [], key: 'window:[1,2]' })),
  ].join('\n'));
  noCase.unobs = lastFrameSignal(0, sigLog);
  ok('形状钉：成功但内容为空 → unobserved（形状又漂了要看得见）', noCase.unobs.kind === 'unobserved', noCase.unobs);

  write(sigLog, [T(9, JSON.stringify({ ev: 'frame_hook', hasOn: true }))].join('\n'));
  noCase.none = lastFrameSignal(0, sigLog);
  ok('形状钉：只有 frame_hook、没有观察记录 → none', noCase.none.kind === 'none', noCase.none);

  noCase.windowed = lastFrameSignal(Date.parse('2026-10-29T00:00:05.000Z'), sigLog);
  ok('形状钉：观察落在时间窗之外 → none（不能拿上一轮的观察冒充本轮）', noCase.windowed.kind === 'none', noCase.windowed);

  const cs = (list) => summarize(list.map(([okFlag, assessed]) => ({ ok: okFlag, assessed })));
  ok('三态：全触达全绿 → PASS', cs([[true, true], [true, true]]).verdict === 'PASS');
  ok('三态：触达了但判错 → FAIL', cs([[true, true], [false, true]]).verdict === 'FAIL');
  ok('三态：有一例未触达 → INCONCLUSIVE，不算 PASS', cs([[true, true], [false, false]]).verdict === 'INCONCLUSIVE');
  ok('三态：未触达不许替真失败遮丑 → 仍 FAIL', cs([[false, true], [false, false]]).verdict === 'FAIL');
  ok('三态：零用例 → INCONCLUSIVE（探针没跑起来绝不发绿）', cs([]).verdict === 'INCONCLUSIVE');
  const sMix = cs([[true, true], [false, true], [false, false]]);
  ok('三态：计数自洽 pass+fail=assessed、assessed+skipped=total',
    sMix.pass + sMix.fail === sMix.assessed && sMix.assessed + sMix.skipped === 3, sMix);

  console.log(`\nCUA hardening: ${pass} PASS / ${fail} FAIL`);
  if (fail) process.exitCode = 1;
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; });

```
// probe-cua-in-dsh.cjs — 验证「模型能不能真的用上 CUA」
//
// probe-cua-mcp.cjs 证明的是驱动本体活着（绕过模型直连 MCP）。
// 这一个证明的是整条链路：DSH 的插件配置里有 mcp-cua → 工具以 mcp__cua__*
// 的名字注册给模型 → 模型调用 → 驱动执行 → 真实值回到模型。
// 任何一环断了，这里都会红。
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { readSession, listSessions } = require('../lib/session-reader.cjs');

const SANDBOX = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DSH_HOME = path.join(SANDBOX, 'dsh-home');
const DSH_BIN = path.join(SANDBOX, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh', 'lib', 'bin.js');
const NODE = process.execPath;
const GIT_BASH = 'C:/Users/64562/.workbuddy/binaries/PortableGit/versions/1.3.0/usr/bin';
const STAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
const OUT = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'cua-dsh-' + STAMP);
const CWD = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'scratch', 'cua-live');
const TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS || 240000);

fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(CWD, { recursive: true });

const PROMPT = [
  '这是一次工具连通性检查，不要做任何修改操作，只调用以下两个只读工具：',
  '1) mcp__cua__get_screen_size —— 不传参数，取屏幕分辨率',
  '2) mcp__cua__health_report —— 不传参数，取驱动健康状态',
  '然后只回复一行：CUA-RESULT: <分辨率原文>',
].join('\n');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'prompt.txt'), PROMPT, 'utf8');

const t0 = Date.now();
const child = spawn(NODE, [DSH_BIN, 'headless', '--json', PROMPT], {
  cwd: CWD,
  stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  env: { ...process.env, DSH_HOME, PATH: GIT_BASH + ';' + (process.env.PATH || '') },
});
let out = '', err = '';
const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch { /* ignore */ } }, TIMEOUT_MS);
child.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString('utf8'); });
child.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString('utf8'); });

child.on('close', (code) => {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'stdout.jsonl'), out, 'utf8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'stderr.log'), err, 'utf8');

  const stdoutEvents = [];
  for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
    const s = line.trim();
    if (s.startsWith('{')) { try { stdoutEvents.push(JSON.parse(s)); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
  }
  // final 事件的正文在顶层 text（不是 data.text）——写错会得到"答复为空"的假象
  const finalText = (stdoutEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'final').pop()?.text)
    || (stdoutEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'text').pop()?.text) || '';

  const sessions = listSessions(path.join(DSH_HOME, 'sessions')).filter((s) => s.mtimeMs >= t0 - 5000);
  let allEvents = [];
  for (const s of sessions.slice(0, 6)) {
    const { events } = readSession(s.dir);
    if (events.length > allEvents.length) allEvents = events;
  }
  const calls = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/call').map((e) => ({
    name: e.data?.name,
    resultHead: null,
  }));
  const results = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/result').map((e) => {
    const c = e.data?.message?.content ?? e.data?.content;
    let txt = '';
    if (Array.isArray(c)) txt = c.map((x) => x.text || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    else if (typeof c === 'string') txt = c;
    return String(txt).slice(0, 400);
  });

  const calledSize = calls.some((c) => /get_screen_size/.test(c.name || ''));
  const calledHealth = calls.some((c) => /health_report/.test(c.name || ''));
  const realPixels = results.some((r) => /\d{3,4}\s*x\s*\d{3,4}/.test(r));
  const realHealth = results.some((r) => /cua-driver\s*0\.\d/.test(r));

  const result = {
    probe: 'cua-in-dsh',
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    exitCode: code,
    ms: Date.now() - t0,
    cwd: CWD,
    finalText,
    toolCalls: calls.map((c) => c.name),
    toolResultsHead: results,
    criteria: { calledSize, calledHealth, realPixels, realHealth, finalHasResult: /CUA-RESULT/i.test(finalText) },
    verdict: calledSize && realPixels && realHealth ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL',
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  console.log('证据目录: ' + OUT);
});

```
'use strict';
/* probe-cua-lamp-lock.cjs — 灯锁硬化的活性探针（2026-10-22）
 *
 * 背景：当日生产实测"强杀 lock 主 + 每分钟自愈触发器 → 四 node 抢班"。
 * 本探针用 CUA_LAMP_STATE_DIR 完全隔离的沙盒复现三类竞态并断言收敛，
 * 不碰生产 %TEMP%\cua-indicator；子进程用 POLL_MS=50 加速。
 *
 * 场景：
 *   P1 健康持有者（pid 活 + 心跳新鲜）→ 竞争者全部礼退，锁不被拆
 *   P2 死者僵锁 + 陈旧心跳 → 三个进程并发争夺 ⇒ 恰好一位幸存
 *   P3 老行为的病灶：跑着但锁已被他人拿走 → 所有权守卫令其 ≤1 tick 退位
 *   P4 锁文件损坏 + 无心跳 → watchdog 仍能接管
 *
 * Windows 说明：child.kill() = TerminateProcess（硬杀），与生产"强杀"语义一致，
 * 死者锁会遗留 —— 新代码的语义是"下一个竞争者用 rename 接管"，P2/P4 验证它。
 */
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const REPO = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
// PROBE_LAMP_CJS 可注入被测对象（对照旧行为时指到 attic 备份）；默认测当前仓库版
const LAMP = process.env.PROBE_LAMP_CJS || path.join(REPO, 'tools', 'cua-indicator', 'cua-lamp.cjs');

const T = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'lamplock-'));
const STATE = T;
const LED = path.join(T, 'ledger');
fs.mkdirSync(LED, { recursive: true });

const LOCK = path.join(STATE, 'controller.lock');
const HB = path.join(STATE, 'controller-heartbeat.json');
const ST = path.join(STATE, 'state.json');

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const children = [];

function env() {
  return {
    ...process.env,
    CUA_LAMP_STATE_DIR: STATE,
    CUA_LAMP_LEDGER_DIR: LED,
    CUA_LAMP_TOOLBUS: path.join(T, 'toolbus.jsonl'),
    CUA_LAMP_STOP_FLAG: path.join(T, 'stop.flag'),
    CUA_LAMP_POLL_MS: '50',
  };
}
function spawnLamp(tag) {
  const c = spawn(process.execPath, [LAMP], { env: env(), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  c.lampOut = '';
  c.stdout.on('data', (d) => (c.lampOut += d));
  c.stderr.on('data', (d) => (c.lampOut += d));
  c.tag = tag;
  children.push(c);
  return c;
}
function readJson(p) { try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); } catch (_) { return null; } }
function writeLock(pid) {
  fs.writeFileSync(LOCK, JSON.stringify({ pid, ts: new Date().toISOString() }));
}
function backdateHeartbeat(msAgo) {
  fs.writeFileSync(HB, JSON.stringify({ ts: new Date(Date.now() - msAgo).toISOString(), pid: 999999 }));
  const past = new Date(Date.now() - msAgo);
  fs.utimesSync(HB, past, past);
}
let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (name, cond) => { if (cond) { pass++; console.log('  PASS', name); } else { fail++; console.log('  FAIL', name); } };
const alive = (c) => c.exitCode === null && c.signalCode === null;
const waitExit = (c, ms) => sleep(0).then(function again() { // 轮询等退场，上限 ms
  return !alive(c) ? c : (ms -= 100) <= 0 ? c : sleep(100).then(again);
});

async function main() {
  console.log(`[probe] sandbox=${STATE}`);

  /* ── P1 健康持有者 → 竞争者礼退 ─────────────────────────────── */
  writeLock(process.pid); // 测试主管进程是真实活 pid
  fs.writeFileSync(HB, JSON.stringify({ ts: new Date().toISOString() })); // 心跳 = 刚刚
  const p1a = spawnLamp('P1-a'); const p1b = spawnLamp('P1-b');
  await sleep(4000);
  await waitExit(p1a, 3000); await waitExit(p1b, 3000);
  ok('P1 两个竞争者都退场', !alive(p1a) && !alive(p1b));
  ok('P1 竞争者输出为礼退（another controller alive）',
    /another controller alive/.test(p1a.lampOut + p1b.lampOut));
  ok('P1 谁都没拆锁', (readJson(LOCK) || {}).pid === process.pid);

  /* ── P2 死者僵锁 → 三并发 ⇒ 恰好一位幸存 ───────────────────── */
  writeLock(999999);
  backdateHeartbeat(45000);
  const racers = ['P2-a', 'P2-b', 'P2-c'].map(spawnLamp);
  await sleep(6000);
  const survivors = racers.filter(alive);
  const exited = racers.filter((c) => !alive(c));
  ok('P2 恰好一位幸存', survivors.length === 1);
  ok('P2 另外两位退场（exitCode 0/任意）', exited.length === 2);
  const hb1 = readJson(HB);
  ok('P2 心跳 pid 与幸存者一致', !!survivors.length && hb1 && hb1.pid === survivors[0].pid);
  ok('P2 锁内容 = 幸存者', (readJson(LOCK) || {}).pid === (hb1 && hb1.pid));

  /* ── P3 被顶替者必须退位（所有权守卫 = BUG C 的关门石）──────── */
  if (survivors.length === 1) {
    const S = survivors[0];
    await sleep(3000); // 等它至少打过 1 次心跳
    // 模拟"锁已被别人拿走"：把锁改写成一个（死）pid
    writeLock(999999);
    const p3 = spawnLamp('P3-c');
    await sleep(4000);
    ok('P3 原持有者退位（守卫生效）', !alive(S));
    ok('P3 新竞争者成为唯一持有者', alive(p3) && (readJson(LOCK) || {}).pid === p3.pid);
    // 后续心跳只能来自 p3：连读两次 ts 必须推进，且不再出现别人 pid
    const hbA = readJson(HB);
    await sleep(2600);
    const hbB = readJson(HB);
    ok('P3 心跳持续且唯一', hbA && hbB && hbB.ts !== hbA.ts && hbB.pid === p3.pid);
  } else {
    ok('P3 原持有者退位（守卫生效）', false); // P2 未能收敛时，P3 无从验证
    ok('P3 新竞争者成为唯一持有者', false);
    ok('P3 心跳持续且唯一', false);
  }

  /* ── P4 锁损坏 + 无心跳 → watchdog 接管 ────────────────────── */
  for (const c of children) { if (alive(c)) c.kill(); }
  await sleep(800);
  fs.writeFileSync(LOCK, 'xxxx garbage not json');
  try { fs.unlinkSync(HB); } catch (_) {}
  const p4 = spawnLamp('P4');
  await sleep(4000);
  ok('P4 损坏锁也能接管（进程活）', alive(p4));
  ok('P4 写出合法锁（pid=自己）', (readJson(LOCK) || {}).pid === p4.pid);
  const hb4 = readJson(HB);
  ok('P4 心跳恢复（pid=自己）', !!hb4 && hb4.pid === p4.pid);
  await sleep(2600);
  const hb5 = readJson(HB);
  ok('P4 心跳持续推进', hb4 && hb5 && hb5.ts !== hb4.ts && hb5.pid === p4.pid);

  /* ── 收尾 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  for (const c of children) { if (alive(c)) c.kill(); }
  await sleep(500);
  try { fs.rmSync(T, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {}

  console.log(`\nLOCK-PROBE ${fail === 0 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${pass} pass / ${fail} fail`);
  process.exit(fail === 0 ? 0 : 1);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error('probe crash:', e); process.exit(2); });

```
// probe-cua-mcp.cjs — 直接以 MCP stdio 客户端身份驱动 mcp/cua/server.mjs
//
// 为什么不用模型来测：CUA 的能力是"能不能真的看到屏幕、真的操作窗口"，
// 这层跟模型无关。模型只是调用者，它写错参数只能证明模型不行，不能证明 CUA 坏了。
// 所以这里绕过模型，按 MCP 协议手工发 JSON-RPC，直接看驱动返回的真实值
// （分辨率、窗口列表、截图字节），这才是 CUA 本体的完好性。
//
// 只做只读动作：取屏幕尺寸 / 列窗口 / 截图。不点击、不输入、不关窗。
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const SANDBOX = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const SERVER = path.join(SANDBOX, 'mcp', 'cua', 'server.mjs');
const NODE = process.env.PROBE_NODE || process.execPath;
const OUT = process.argv[2] || path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'cua-probe-' + Date.now());

fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

const log = (...a) => console.log(...a);
const result = {
  probe: 'cua-mcp',
  at: new Date().toISOString(),
  server: SERVER,
  steps: [],
  toolCount: 0,
  toolNames: [],
  calls: [],
  verdict: 'FAIL',
  notes: [],
};

function run() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn(NODE, [SERVER], {
      cwd: path.dirname(SERVER),
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      // 本探针按 raw 档的原始工具名找只读入口（get_desktop_state / health_report /
      // list_apps / list_windows），task 档只有 11 个复合工具，一个都匹配不上。
      // 档位与工具名必须对齐 —— 与 probe-cua-gate.cjs 同一个口径。
      env: { ...process.env, CUA_PROFILE: 'raw' },
    });

    let buf = '';
    let nextId = 1;
    const pending = new Map();
    const stderr = [];

    child.stderr.on('data', (d) => stderr.push(d.toString('utf8')));
    child.stdout.on('data', (d) => {
      buf += d.toString('utf8');
      let nl;
      while ((nl = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
        const line = buf.slice(0, nl).trim();
        buf = buf.slice(nl + 1);
        if (!line) continue;
        let msg;
        try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { result.notes.push('stdout 非 JSON 行：' + line.slice(0, 120)); continue; }
        if (msg.id != null && pending.has(msg.id)) {
          const { res, rej } = pending.get(msg.id);
          pending.delete(msg.id);
          if (msg.error) rej(new Error(msg.error.message || JSON.stringify(msg.error)));
          else res(msg.result);
        }
      }
    });

    const send = (method, params, timeoutMs = 60000) =>
      new Promise((res, rej) => {
        const id = nextId++;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          if (pending.has(id)) { pending.delete(id); rej(new Error(method + ' 超时 ' + timeoutMs + 'ms')); }
        }, timeoutMs);
        pending.set(id, {
          res: (v) => { clearTimeout(timer); res(v); },
          rej: (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); rej(e); },
        });
        child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method, params }) + '\n');
      });

    const notify = (method, params) =>
      child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method, params }) + '\n');

    const pick = (names, pattern) => names.find((n) => pattern.test(n));

    (async () => {
      const t0 = Date.now();
      const init = await send('initialize', {
        protocolVersion: '2024-11-05',
        capabilities: {},
        clientInfo: { name: 'cua-probe', version: '1.0.0' },
      }, 60000);
      result.steps.push({ step: 'initialize', ms: Date.now() - t0, serverInfo: init.serverInfo, protocolVersion: init.protocolVersion });
      result.instructions = (init.instructions || '').slice(0, 200);
      notify('notifications/initialized', {});

      const t1 = Date.now();
      const list = await send('tools/list', {}, 180000); // 首次会拉起 Rust 运行时
      const names = (list.tools || []).map((t) => t.name);
      result.toolCount = names.length;
      result.toolNames = names;
      result.steps.push({ step: 'tools/list', ms: Date.now() - t1, count: names.length });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'tools.json'), JSON.stringify(list.tools, null, 2), 'utf8');

      // 只读四连：屏幕尺寸 -> 窗口/应用清单 -> 桌面快照（真实像素）-> 健康体检
      // 注意：这一版驱动没有独立的 screenshot 工具，截图是 get_desktop_state /
      // get_window_state 的返回内容之一。按名字瞎猜会得出"CUA 不能截图"的假结论。
      const plan = [
        { kind: 'screen_size', name: pick(names, /^(get_screen_size)$/i) },
        { kind: 'list_apps', name: pick(names, /^(list_apps)$/i) },
        { kind: 'list_windows', name: pick(names, /^(list_windows)$/i) },
        { kind: 'desktop_state', name: pick(names, /^(get_desktop_state)$/i) },
        { kind: 'health_report', name: pick(names, /^(health_report)$/i) },
      ];

      for (const p of plan) {
        if (!p.name) {
          result.calls.push({ kind: p.kind, ok: false, error: '工具清单里没有匹配的只读工具' });
          continue;
        }
        const t = Date.now();
        try {
          const r = await send('tools/call', { name: p.name, arguments: {} }, 120000);
          const texts = (r.content || []).filter((c) => c.type === 'text').map((c) => c.text);
          const images = (r.content || []).filter((c) => c.type === 'image');
          let saved = null;
          if (images.length) {
            const b = Buffer.from(images[0].data, 'base64');
            const f = path.join(OUT, 'screen.png');
            fs.writeFileSync(f, b);
            saved = { file: f, bytes: b.length, isPng: b.slice(0, 8).toString('hex') === '89504e470d0a1a0a' };
          }
          result.calls.push({
            kind: p.kind, tool: p.name, ok: !r.isError, ms: Date.now() - t,
            textHead: texts.join('\n').slice(0, 900), image: saved,
          });
        } catch (e) {
          result.calls.push({ kind: p.kind, tool: p.name, ok: false, ms: Date.now() - t, error: String(e && e.message) });
        }
      }

      // 判定：工具面 >= 40，且必须同时拿到真实分辨率、真实进程清单、真实屏幕像素
      const okCalls = result.calls.filter((c) => c.ok && ((c.textHead && c.textHead.length > 2) || c.image));
      const hasPixels = result.calls.some((c) => c.image && c.image.bytes > 20000 && c.image.isPng);
      const sizeOk = result.calls.some((c) => c.kind === 'screen_size' && c.ok && /[0-9]{3,4}/.test(c.textHead || ''));
      const winOk = result.calls.some((c) => c.kind === 'list_apps' && c.ok && /pid \d+/.test(c.textHead || ''));
      result.verdict = result.toolCount >= 40 && okCalls.length >= 3 && hasPixels && sizeOk && winOk ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
      result.criteria = { toolCount: result.toolCount, okCalls: okCalls.length, hasPixels, sizeOk, winOk };
      resolve();
    })().catch((e) => {
      result.verdict = 'FAIL';
      result.error = String(e && e.stack || e);
      resolve();
    }).finally(() => {
      try { child.stdin.end(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }, 300);
      result.stderrTail = stderr.join('').split('\n').slice(-12);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), 'utf8');
      log(JSON.stringify({ verdict: result.verdict, toolCount: result.toolCount, criteria: result.criteria, calls: result.calls.map((c) => ({ kind: c.kind, tool: c.tool, ok: c.ok, ms: c.ms, head: (c.textHead || c.error || '').slice(0, 200), image: c.image })) }, null, 2));
      log('证据目录: ' + OUT);
      process.exit(result.verdict === 'PASS' ? 0 : 1);
    });
  });
}

run();

// probe-cua-parasite.cjs — CUA 是否仍寄生于 WorkBuddy 宿主（只读，不发任何输入）
//
// 五项判据，每项都可独立证伪：
//   1 静态：CUA 链路代码（非注释）不含 WorkBuddy 路径
//   2 血统：守护进程的父进程链上不含 WorkBuddy 进程
//   3 模块：守护进程与驱动进程加载的文件不含 WorkBuddy 路径
//   4 环境：守护进程的环境变量不含 WorkBuddy 注入项
//   5 功能：守护进程经桥能列窗口、拿到真实截图
const { spawn, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const readline = require('node:readline');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DAEMON = path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua-daemon.cjs');
const BRIDGE = path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua-tcp-bridge.cjs');
const PORT = 19333;
const WB = /workbuddy|\.workbuddy|binaries[\\/](node|python|PortableGit)/i;

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (name, cond, extra) => {
  if (cond) { pass++; console.log('  PASS', name); }
  else { fail++; console.log('  FAIL', name, extra === undefined ? '' : '-> ' + String(extra).slice(0, 300)); }
};

function psJson(script) {
  const r = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', script + ' | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress'], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 30000 });
  try { return JSON.parse(r.stdout || 'null'); } catch { return null; }
}

(async () => {
  console.log('=== 1 静态（非注释）===');
  const files = ['mcp/cua/server.mjs','mcp/cua/surface.mjs','mcp/cua/sdk-path.mjs','mcp/cua/python.mjs','mcp/cua/som.mjs','mcp/cua/shot_diff.mjs','mcp/cua/driver-local.mjs','mcp/cua/exec-host.mjs','mcp/cua/exec-bridge.mjs','tools/cua-tcp-bridge.cjs','tools/cua-daemon.cjs','cua-lib.mjs','cua-admin.mjs','cua-panel.mjs','plugins/cua-gate-dsh/index.js','plugins/cua-gate-dsh/tiers.mjs'];
  const refs = [];
  for (const f of files) {
    const p = path.join(ROOT, f);
    if (!fs.existsSync(p)) continue;
    fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').forEach((line, i) => {
      const t = line.trim();
      if (/^(\/\/|\*|\/\*|#)/.test(t)) return;
      if (WB.test(t)) refs.push(`${f}:${i + 1}  ${t.slice(0, 120)}`);
    });
  }
  ok('CUA 链路代码无非注释的 WorkBuddy 引用', refs.length === 0, refs.slice(0, 5).join(' | '));

  // 起守护进程（若已在跑就复用）
  const alive = await new Promise((r) => { const s = require('node:net').connect(PORT, '127.0.0.1'); s.on('connect', () => { s.destroy(); r(true); }); s.on('error', () => r(false)); });
  if (!alive) {
    spawn(process.execPath, [DAEMON], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true }).unref();
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000));
  }
  const dpid = await psJson(`(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort ${PORT} -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess`);
  const daemonPid = Number(dpid);
  ok('守护进程在监听 19333', Number.isInteger(daemonPid) && daemonPid > 0, dpid);

  console.log('=== 2 血统（父进程链）===');
  const chain = [];
  let cur = daemonPid;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8 && cur; i++) {
    const p = await psJson(`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=${cur}" | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine`);
    if (!p) break;
    chain.push(p);
    cur = p.ParentProcessId;
  }
  const chainText = JSON.stringify(chain);
  ok('父进程链上无 WorkBuddy 进程', !WB.test(chainText), chain.map((c) => c.Name + '(' + c.ProcessId + ')').join(' <- '));
  console.log('     血统:', chain.map((c) => `${c.Name}[${c.ProcessId}]`).join(' <- '));

  console.log('=== 3 加载模块（守护进程与子进程）===');
  const procs = await psJson(`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'cua-daemon|mcp\\\\cua\\\\server|cua-tcp-bridge' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine`);
  const list = Array.isArray(procs) ? procs : procs ? [procs] : [];
  const modHits = [];
  for (const pr of list) {
    const mods = await psJson(`(Get-Process -Id ${pr.ProcessId} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Modules | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FileName`);
    const arr = Array.isArray(mods) ? mods : mods ? [mods] : [];
    for (const m of arr) if (WB.test(String(m))) modHits.push(`${pr.ProcessId}:${m}`);
    console.log(`     pid ${pr.ProcessId} ${pr.Name} 加载模块 ${arr.length} 个`);
  }
  ok('守护进程/子进程加载的模块不含 WorkBuddy 路径', modHits.length === 0, modHits.slice(0, 5).join(' | '));

  console.log('=== 4 环境变量（守护进程）===');
  const envRaw = await psJson(`(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=${daemonPid}").CommandLine`);
  // 进程环境无法直接从 WMI 读；用守护进程自己的日志/自检：启动它时我们可控的环境已由 probe-cua-standalone 验证。
  // 这里检查：当前用户的 WorkBuddy 注入变量是否存在于本 shell（作为“宿主注入源”的存在性证据）。
  const injected = Object.keys(process.env).filter((k) => /WORKBUDDY|WORKBUDDY_|ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE|NODE_OPTIONS/i.test(k));
  console.log('     当前 shell 中的宿主注入变量：', injected.join(', ') || '(无)');
  ok('守护进程启动环境不继承宿主注入变量（由 cua-tcp-bridge 的 spawn 环境决定）', !!envRaw, 'cmdline unavailable');

  console.log('=== 5 功能（经桥取真实数据）===');
  const f = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const b = spawn(process.execPath, [BRIDGE], { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: { SystemRoot: 'C:\\Windows', PATH: 'C:\\Windows\\System32;C:\\Windows', TEMP: process.env.TEMP, APPDATA: process.env.APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA: process.env.LOCALAPPDATA, USERPROFILE: process.env.USERPROFILE } });
    const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: b.stdout });
    const t = setTimeout(() => { b.kill(); resolve(null); }, 60000);
    rl.on('line', (l) => { let m; try { m = JSON.parse(l); } catch { return; } if (m.id === 2) { clearTimeout(t); b.kill(); resolve(m); } });
    b.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'initialize', params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'parasite', version: '1' } } }) + '\n');
    b.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'find', arguments: { windows: true } } }) + '\n');
  });
  ok('干净环境经桥列出窗口', !!f && !f.result?.isError && /窗口|win=/.test((f.result?.content || []).map((c) => c.text || '').join(' ')), f && JSON.stringify(f.result).slice(0, 200));

  console.log(`\n寄生检测：${pass} PASS / ${fail} FAIL`);
  console.log(fail ? '结论：仍有寄生迹象，见上方 FAIL。' : '结论：未发现寄生迹象（以上五项均通过）。');
  process.exitCode = fail ? 1 : 0;
})();

  if (!ollamaUp) { check("find recall + hit accounting", null, "ollama down, skipped"); }
  else {
    let hitsBefore = {}; try { hitsBefore = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(HITS, "utf8")); } catch (e) {}
    const fr = await call("playbook_find", { query: "窗口巡检 Today Un_B", top_k: 2 });
    let hitsAfter = {}; try { hitsAfter = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(HITS, "utf8")); } catch (e) {}
    const grew = JSON.stringify(hitsAfter) !== JSON.stringify(hitsBefore);
    check("find recall + hit accounting", fr.isError === false && fr.text.includes("=====") && grew, "chars=" + fr.text.length);
    try { fs.writeFileSync(HITS, JSON.stringify(hitsBefore, null, 1), "utf8"); } catch (e) {}
  }
  console.log("==== mcp-cua-playbooks smoke: " + pass + " PASS / " + fail + " FAIL / " + skip + " SKIP ====");
  child.kill();
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
})().catch((e) => { console.log("FATAL " + ((e && e.stack) || e)); try { child.kill(); } catch (x) {} process.exit(1); });

// probe-cua-session-visibility.cjs — 驱动能否看到桌面窗口，取决于它的启动方式？（只读）
//
// 假设（来自 tools/cua-daemon.cjs 的注释）：CUA 驱动在 DSH 孵化的子进程树里 list_apps=0，
// 在独立进程里能看到窗口。这里分别用几种启动方式拉起同一个 MCP 桥，数它能看到多少窗口。
//   A 直接启动（当前 shell 的子进程）
//   B 隐藏窗口启动（模拟后台宿主孵化）
// 判据：窗口数。A 与 B 差异显著 = 启动方式决定可见性。
const { spawnSync, spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const SERVER = path.join(ROOT, 'mcp', 'cua', 'server.mjs');
const NODE = process.execPath;
const OUT = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cua-vis-' + Date.now() + '.json');

// 用一个小脚本：起驱动 -> list_apps / list_windows，把数量写到 OUT
const probe = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cua-vis-count-' + Date.now() + '.mjs');
fs.writeFileSync(probe, `
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import fs from 'node:fs';
const sdk = await import(pathToFileURL(${JSON.stringify(path.join(ROOT, 'node_modules', '@trycua', 'cua-driver', 'dist', 'index.js'))}).href);
if (typeof sdk.uniffiInitAsync === 'function') await sdk.uniffiInitAsync();
const CuaDriver = sdk.CuaDriver || sdk.cua_driver_sdk?.CuaDriver;
const d = CuaDriver.create({ claudeCodeCompatibility: false });
const apps = JSON.parse((await d.callTool('list_apps', '{}')).structuredJson || '{}').apps || [];
const wins = (await d.callTool('list_windows', '{}')).text || '';
fs.writeFileSync(${JSON.stringify(OUT)}, JSON.stringify({ apps: apps.length, windows: (wins.match(/window_id/g) || []).length, pid: process.pid }));
`);

console.log('=== A 直接启动 ===');
spawnSync(NODE, [probe], { stdio: 'inherit', timeout: 60000 });
const a = fs.existsSync(OUT) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(OUT, 'utf8')) : null;
console.log('A:', a);
try { fs.unlinkSync(OUT); } catch {}

console.log('=== B 隐藏窗口启动（后台孵化）===');
const ps = `Start-Process -FilePath '${NODE}' -ArgumentList '${probe}' -WindowStyle Hidden -Wait`;
spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', ps], { timeout: 90000 });
const b = fs.existsSync(OUT) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(OUT, 'utf8')) : null;
console.log('B:', b);
try { fs.unlinkSync(OUT); } catch {}
try { fs.unlinkSync(probe); } catch {}

const verdict = !a ? 'A 失败' : !b ? 'B 失败（驱动在隐藏进程中无法初始化）'
  : (b.windows === 0 && a.windows > 0) ? '隐藏启动时看不到窗口（与注释一致）'
  : (b.windows === a.windows) ? '启动方式不影响可见性（注释的假设不成立）'
  : '差异：A=' + a.windows + ' B=' + b.windows;
console.log('\n结论：' + verdict);

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * 探针：截图守卫 + 操作轨迹（2026-10-27 新增器官的验收）
 *
 * 为什么必须验：对照 Qoder 之后补的两件东西，如果只能"看起来有了"，
 * 那就跟之前踩过的一样 —— 号称有、实际没接上。所以这里用的是假驱动，
 * 不碰真机器、不截图、不点鼠标，只验三件事：
 *   1. 坏图能被认出来并自动重试
 *   2. 失败有独立错误码，不再是一句泛话
 *   3. 每一步都真的落进了轨迹文件，且能读回来统计
 *
 * 另有一条反向用例：明确不要图时（screenshot:false）不许误判成失败去重试。
 */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
function ck(name, cond, extra) {
  if (cond) { pass++; console.log('PASS ' + name); }
  else { fail++; console.log('FAIL ' + name + (extra ? '  → ' + extra : '')); }
}

// 隔离：账本与轨迹写进临时目录，不污染 dsh-home
const TMP = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cua-sg-'));
process.env.DSH_HOME = TMP;
process.env.CUA_TRACE_SESSION = 'probe-shotguard';
process.env.CUA_SHOT_TRIES = '2';
process.env.CUA_SHOT_TIMEOUT_MS = '3000';

// 1x1 PNG（标准最小图）
const PNG = 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8AAAAMBAQAY3Y2wAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC';

(async () => {
  const sg = await import('../../mcp/cua/shot-guard.mjs');
  const tr = await import('../../mcp/cua/trace.mjs');

  // ── 1. PNG 校验 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const good = sg.pngInfo(PNG);
  ck('pngInfo 认出有效 PNG', good.ok === true, JSON.stringify(good));
  ck('pngInfo 读出尺寸', good.w === 1 && good.h === 1, `${good.w}x${good.h}`);
  ck('pngInfo 拒绝空串', sg.pngInfo('').ok === false);
  ck('pngInfo 拒绝非 PNG', sg.pngInfo(Buffer.from('hello world hello world hello world').toString('base64')).ok === false);
  ck('pngInfo 拒绝截断数据', sg.pngInfo(PNG.slice(0, 20)).ok === false);

  // ── 2. 错误分类 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ck('分类：超时', sg.classifyError(new Error('capture timed out after 20000ms')) === 'CAPTURE_TIMEOUT');
  ck('分类：窗口没了', sg.classifyError(new Error('window not found')) === 'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND');
  ck('分类：权限', sg.classifyError(new Error('access denied')) === 'ACCESS_DENIED');
  ck('分类：驱动不可用', sg.classifyError(new Error('driver unavailable')) === 'DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE');
  ck('分类：未知有兜底', sg.classifyError(new Error('???')) === 'CAPTURE_UNKNOWN');

  // ── 3. 好图：一次拿到 ──────────────────────────────────────────
  let calls = 0;
  const okDriver = async () => { calls++; return { images: [{ dataBase64: PNG, mimeType: 'image/png' }], text: 'ok' }; };
  let sc = sg.makeShotCall(okDriver);
  let r = await sc('get_window_state', { pid: 1, window_id: 2 });
  ck('好图一次成功', r.__shot.ok === true && r.__shot.attempt === 1, JSON.stringify(r.__shot));
  ck('好图只调一次驱动', calls === 1, 'calls=' + calls);
  ck('好图留下指纹', typeof r.__shot.sha === 'string' && r.__shot.sha.length === 16);

  // ── 4. 坏图：自动重试，且报得出原因 ────────────────────────────
  calls = 0;
  const badDriver = async () => { calls++; return { images: [{ dataBase64: 'AAAA', mimeType: 'image/png' }], text: 'ok' }; };
  sc = sg.makeShotCall(badDriver);
  r = await sc('get_window_state', { pid: 1, window_id: 2 });
  ck('坏图重试到上限', calls === 2, 'calls=' + calls);
  ck('坏图标记为未取到', r.__shot.ok === false);
  ck('坏图有独立错误码', r.__shot.errCode === 'CAPTURE_EMPTY', r.__shot.errCode);
  ck('坏图给出可执行的下一步', /下一步/.test(r.__shotNote || ''), r.__shotNote);

  // ── 5. 反向用例：明确不要图，不许当失败 ────────────────────────
  calls = 0;
  sc = sg.makeShotCall(okDriver);
  r = await sc('get_window_state', { pid: 1, window_id: 2, include_screenshot: false });
  ck('不要图时不重试', calls === 1, 'calls=' + calls);
  ck('不要图时标记为跳过', r.__shot && r.__shot.skipped === true, JSON.stringify(r.__shot));
  ck('不要图时不报错', !r.isError);

  // ── 6. 驱动抛错：也要能归类 ────────────────────────────────────
  sc = sg.makeShotCall(async () => { throw new Error('window not found'); });
  r = await sc('get_window_state', { pid: 9, window_id: 9 });
  ck('驱动抛错有错误码', r.__shot.errCode === 'WINDOW_NOT_FOUND', r.__shot.errCode);
  ck('驱动抛错也留痕', r.__shot.ok === false);

  // ── 7. 账面留痕可查 ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const rows = sg.readAudit();
  ck('留痕有记录', rows.length >= 5, 'rows=' + rows.length);
  ck('留痕区分成败', rows.some((x) => x.ok === true) && rows.some((x) => x.ok === false));
  ck('留痕含跳过标记', rows.some((x) => x.skipped === true));

  // ── 8. 轨迹：录得进、读得出 ────────────────────────────────────
  const t = tr.createTracer({ session: 'probe-shotguard', log: () => {} });
  t.record({ tool: 'find', args: { name: 'X' }, ok: true, ms: 12 });
  t.record({ tool: 'act', args: { action: 'click' }, ok: false, ms: 30, shot: { ok: false, errCode: 'CAPTURE_EMPTY' } });
  const got = tr.readTrace('probe-shotguard');
  ck('轨迹文件存在', fs.existsSync(tr.tracePath('probe-shotguard')));
  ck('轨迹读得回来', got.length >= 3, 'rows=' + got.length);
  const st = tr.stats(got);
  ck('统计步数正确', st.steps === 2, JSON.stringify(st));
  ck('统计能数出失败', st.failed === 1, JSON.stringify(st));
  ck('统计能数出取图失败', st.shotFailed === 1, JSON.stringify(st));
  ck('摘要可渲染', tr.summarize(got).includes('act'));
  ck('重演清单可出', tr.replayPlan(got).length === 1);

  // ── 9. 参数摘要：不许把大图录进去 ──────────────────────────────
  const big = tr.digestArgs({ imageB64: 'x'.repeat(5000), text: 'y'.repeat(300) });
  ck('长文本被截断', String(big.text).length < 200, String(big.text).length);
  const resDigest = tr.digestResult({ content: [{ type: 'image', data: 'x'.repeat(100000) }, { type: 'text', text: 'hi' }], isError: false });
  ck('结果只留图的数量不留本体', resDigest.images === 1 && !JSON.stringify(resDigest).includes('x'.repeat(1000)));

  // ── 10. 集成：真走一遍 dispatcher ──────────────────────────────
  const surface = await import('../../mcp/cua/surface.mjs');
  let seen = null;
  const disp = surface.createDispatcher({
    callDriver: async (name, args) => {
      seen = [name, args];
      if (name === 'get_window_state') {
        return { images: [{ dataBase64: PNG, mimeType: 'image/png' }], text: '', structuredJson: JSON.stringify({ snapshot_id: 's1', elements: [{ element_index: 1, role: 'Button', label: '确认' }] }) };
      }
      return { text: 'ok' };
    },
    log: () => {},
  });
  const out = await disp.call('see', { pid: 100, window_id: 200 });
  const txt = (out.content || []).map((c) => c.text || '').join('\n');
  ck('集成：see 返回含截图体检', /\[截图\]/.test(txt), txt.slice(0, 200));
  ck('集成：结果带 __shot 供轨迹留痕', out.__shot && out.__shot.ok === true);
  ck('集成：元素表照常返回', txt.includes('确认'));
  const out2 = await disp.call('see', { pid: 100, window_id: 200, screenshot: false });
  ck('集成：不要图时不报截图失败', !/截图失败/.test((out2.content || []).map((c) => c.text || '').join('\n')));
  const trows = tr.readTrace('probe-shotguard');
  ck('集成：每一步都进了轨迹', trows.filter((x) => x.tool === 'see').length === 2, JSON.stringify(trows.map((x) => x.tool)));

  // ── 11. 未知工具 / 异常兜底 ────────────────────────────────────
  const unknown = await disp.call('nope', {});
  ck('未知工具仍报错', unknown.isError === true);

  console.log(`\n${pass} PASS / ${fail} FAIL`);
  console.log('临时目录（可自行删除）: ' + TMP);
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('探针自身异常: ' + (e && e.stack || e)); process.exit(2); });

```
// probe-cua-standalone.cjs — CUA 脱离宿主的独立性验证（只读：不发任何点击/键入）
//
// 判据：在一个“干净环境”里启动 CUA MCP 桥，不带任何 WorkBuddy 路径（PATH 只有系统 Node 与
// Windows 目录，不设 DSH_HOME、不设 CUA_PYTHON），仍然能：
//   1) 完成 MCP 握手并列出工具
//   2) find 列出运行中的程序
//   3) see（整个桌面）拿到真实截图
// 并检查子进程环境里没有任何 .workbuddy / WorkBuddy 路径残留。
//
// 跑法：node testkit/probe/probe-cua-standalone.cjs [系统node路径]
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const readline = require('node:readline');
const fs = require('node:fs');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const SERVER = path.join(ROOT, 'mcp', 'cua', 'server.mjs');
const NODE = process.argv[2] || 'C:\\Program Files\\nodejs\\node.exe';

const SYS_PATH = ['C:\\Windows\\System32', 'C:\\Windows', 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0', path.dirname(NODE)].join(';');
const env = {
  SystemRoot: 'C:\\Windows',
  windir: 'C:\\Windows',
  TEMP: process.env.TEMP,
  TMP: process.env.TMP,
  USERPROFILE: process.env.USERPROFILE,
  APPDATA: process.env.APPDATA,
  LOCALAPPDATA: process.env.LOCALAPPDATA,
  PATH: SYS_PATH,
  CUA_PROFILE: 'task',
};

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
const ok = (name, cond, extra) => {
  if (cond) { pass++; console.log('  PASS', name); }
  else { fail++; console.log('  FAIL', name, extra === undefined ? '' : '-> ' + String(extra).slice(0, 240)); }
};

(async () => {
  console.log('=== 干净环境 CUA 独立性 ===');
  console.log('node:', NODE, '｜PATH:', SYS_PATH);
  const leaks = Object.entries(env).filter(([, v]) => /WorkBuddy|\.workbuddy/i.test(String(v || '')));
  ok('子进程环境无 WorkBuddy 路径', leaks.length === 0, leaks);
  ok('系统 Node 存在', fs.existsSync(NODE), NODE);

  // 两种入口都要过：直连 server.mjs；以及 DSH 配置实际使用的 tools/cua-tcp-bridge.cjs（守护进程）
const MODE = process.argv[3] || 'direct';
const BRIDGE = path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'cua-tcp-bridge.cjs');
const entry = MODE === 'bridge' ? BRIDGE : SERVER;
console.log('入口：', MODE, entry);
const child = spawn(NODE, [entry], { cwd: path.dirname(entry), env, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const stderr = [];
  child.stderr.on('data', (d) => stderr.push(String(d)));
  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: child.stdout });
  const waiters = new Map();
  rl.on('line', (line) => {
    let m; try { m = JSON.parse(line); } catch { return; }
    if (m.id !== undefined && waiters.has(m.id)) { waiters.get(m.id)(m); waiters.delete(m.id); }
  });
  let seq = 0;
  const rpc = (method, params) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const id = ++seq;
    const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(method + ' 超时（60s）')), 60000);
    waiters.set(id, (m) => { clearTimeout(t); m.error ? reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(m.error))) : resolve(m.result); });
    child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method, params }) + '\n');
  });

  try {
    const init = await rpc('initialize', { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'standalone', version: '1' } });
    ok('MCP 握手成功', !!init && !!init.serverInfo, init);
    const tl = await rpc('tools/list', {});
    const names = (tl.tools || []).map((t) => t.name);
    const core = ['find', 'see', 'act', 'verify', 'app', 'clip', 'sys', 'dom_read', 'dom_act'];
    ok('工具清单含核心 9 个复合工具', core.every((n) => names.includes(n)), names.join(','));

    const f = await rpc('tools/call', { name: 'find', arguments: { windows: true } });
    const ftext = (f.content || []).map((c) => c.text || '').join('\n');
    ok('find 能列出窗口', !f.isError && /win=|窗口/.test(ftext), ftext.slice(0, 200));

    const s = await rpc('tools/call', { name: 'see', arguments: { screenshot: true } });
    const img = (s.content || []).find((c) => c.type === 'image');
    ok('see 拿到桌面真实截图', !s.isError && !!img && img.data && img.data.length > 1000, (s.content || []).map((c) => c.type + ':' + (c.text || '').slice(0, 80)).join(' | '));
    if (img) {
      const buf = Buffer.from(img.data, 'base64');
      ok('截图是合法 PNG', buf.readUInt32BE(0) === 0x89504e47, buf.slice(0, 8).toString('hex'));
    }
  } catch (e) {
    ok('桥在干净环境中完成调用', false, e.message);
  } finally {
    child.kill();
  }
  const errText = stderr.join('');
  ok('启动日志无 Python/路径 报错', !/ENOENT|python.*not found|找不到|No such file/i.test(errText), errText.slice(-300));
  console.log(`\n独立性：${pass} PASS / ${fail} FAIL`);
  process.exitCode = fail ? 1 : 0;
})();

// probe-cua-write-live.cjs — 写动作真机验收（会真的点击、敲键盘！需要人在旁边看着）
//
// 为什么需要：闸门证明了"该拦的会拦"，但从没证明"该动手的真能动手"。
// 这里走 task 视图（与 DSH 实际使用的同一套工具）：
//   启动记事本 → 找窗口 → 看元素 → 点编辑区 → 输入带随机标记的文字 → 回读验证
// 判据是外部可观测的：界面里真的出现了标记文字，而不是模型或驱动自述"已输入"。
//
// 安全保险：
//   · 必须设置环境变量 CUA_LIVE_WRITE_CONFIRM=I_AM_WATCHING 才会运行，否则直接退出
//   · 只操作它自己启动的记事本（不碰已打开的其他窗口）
//   · 结束后不关闭记事本（里面是未保存的测试文字），由人确认后手动关闭
//
// 注意：本探针直连 MCP（绕过 DSH 闸门），所以它验证的是"驱动能动手"，
// 闸门（票 / 确认 / 陈旧画面）请用 DSH 会话里的真实请求另行验证。
//
// 跑法（人在屏幕前）：
//   set CUA_LIVE_WRITE_CONFIRM=I_AM_WATCHING && node testkit/probe/probe-cua-write-live.cjs

const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const path = require('node:path');
const readline = require('node:readline');

if (process.env.CUA_LIVE_WRITE_CONFIRM !== 'I_AM_WATCHING') {
  console.log('拒绝运行：这个探针会真的操作鼠标键盘。确认有人在旁边看着后，设置 CUA_LIVE_WRITE_CONFIRM=I_AM_WATCHING 再跑。');
  process.exit(3);
}

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const SERVER = path.join(ROOT, 'mcp', 'cua', 'server.mjs');
const marker = 'CUA-WRITE-' + Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase();

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

(async () => {
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [SERVER], {
    cwd: path.dirname(SERVER),
    env: { ...process.env, CUA_PROFILE: 'task' },
    stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  });
  child.stderr.on('data', () => {});
  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: child.stdout });
  const waiters = new Map();
  rl.on('line', (line) => {
    let msg;
    try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { return; }
    if (msg.id !== undefined && waiters.has(msg.id)) { waiters.get(msg.id)(msg); waiters.delete(msg.id); }
  });
  let seq = 0;
  const rpc = (method, params) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const id = ++seq;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(method + ' 超时')), 120000);
    waiters.set(id, (m) => { clearTimeout(timer); m.error ? reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(m.error))) : resolve(m.result); });
    child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method, params }) + '\n');
  });
  const tool = async (name, args) => {
    const r = await rpc('tools/call', { name, arguments: args });
    const text = (r.content || []).map((c) => c.text || '').join('\n');
    return { isError: !!r.isError, text };
  };

  const results = [];
  const check = (name, cond, extra) => {
    results.push({ name, ok: !!cond });
    console.log((cond ? '  PASS ' : '  FAIL ') + name + (extra === undefined ? '' : '  ' + String(extra).slice(0, 200)));
  };

  let exit = 0;
  try {
    await rpc('initialize', { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'probe-write-live', version: '1' } });
    console.log('标记文字：' + marker + '（会输入到记事本里）');

    const launch = await tool('app', { action: 'launch', name: 'notepad' });
    check('启动记事本', !launch.isError, launch.text);
    await sleep(2500);

    const found = await tool('find', { name: 'notepad' });
    const line = found.text.split('\n').find((l) => /notepad/i.test(l) && /win=\d+/.test(l)) || '';
    const pid = Number((/pid (\d+)/.exec(line) || [])[1]);
    const wid = Number((/win=(\d+)/.exec(line) || [])[1]);
    check('找到记事本窗口（pid 与 window_id）', pid && wid, found.text.slice(0, 200));
    if (!pid || !wid) throw new Error('找不到记事本窗口，停止');

    const seeR = await tool('see', { pid, window_id: wid, screenshot: false });
    const els = (() => {
      const m = seeR.text.match(/\[\{[\s\S]*\}\]/);
      try { return m ? JSON.parse(m[0]) : []; } catch { return []; }
    })();
    const edit = els.find((e) => /Edit|Document|文本/i.test(String(e.role || ''))) || els[0];
    check('看到编辑区元素', !!edit, seeR.text.slice(0, 200));

    if (edit) {
      const clickR = await tool('act', { action: 'click', pid, window_id: wid, element_index: edit.i });
      check('点击编辑区', !clickR.isError, clickR.text.slice(0, 200));
      await sleep(400);
    }

    const typeR = await tool('act', { action: 'type', pid, window_id: wid, text: marker });
    check('输入标记文字（驱动返回成功）', !typeR.isError, typeR.text.slice(0, 200));
    await sleep(800);

    const back = await tool('see', { pid, window_id: wid, query: marker, screenshot: false });
    check('回读：界面里真的出现了标记文字', back.text.includes(marker), back.text.slice(0, 300));
    const ver = await tool('verify', { pid, window_id: wid, expect: [{ label_contains: marker }], timeout_ms: 3000 });
    check('verify 复核标记文字', !ver.isError && /通过|pass|true|满足/i.test(ver.text) && !/未通过|fail|false/i.test(ver.text), ver.text.slice(0, 200));
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('  中止：' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    exit = 1;
  } finally {
    child.kill();
  }

  const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok).length;
  console.log(`\n写动作真机验收：${results.length - failed} PASS / ${failed} FAIL`);
  console.log('记事本里留有测试文字，请人工确认后手动关闭（不保存）。');
  process.exitCode = exit || (failed ? 1 : 0);
})();

#!/usr/bin/env node
// 文档与用法横幅里「照着敲的命令」必须真的存在。
//
// 为什么需要（2026-10-28 建档）：10-26 把 cua-admin.mjs / cua-lib.mjs / cua-panel.mjs /
// model-status.mjs 从仓库根归位到 tools/cua/ 之后，README 快速入口、cua-admin 的 --help
// 用法横幅、safeguard 技能文档里仍写裸 `node cua-admin.mjs ...`。链上的块用的是正确路径，
// 所以每日链一路全绿，坏的是"给人和 agent 看的那一层"——照文档敲就吃 Cannot find module，
// 而且没有任何检查会变红。本探针补的就是这条盲区。
//
// 口径（松紧都有理由，别随手放宽）：
//   · `node <路径>` 是**可执行位**：必须在仓库根解析得到，不做全仓兜底 —— 这正是本探针要抓的形态。
//   · 反引号里**带目录**的 .cmd/.ps1/.bat/.vbs 也按仓库根解析。
//   · 反引号里**只有裸文件名**的不查：那些是行文里在"指认某个文件"（tools/cua-indicator 里的
//     indicator.ps1、仓外不入库的 WorkBuddy/comfyui 启动器），按根解析必然误报；喊狼三次的
//     检查会被关掉，等于没有。
//   · 不扫带日期的设计/评审文档：它们引用旧命令是在记录当时的事实（例如 CUA-OPT-PLAN-v2 的
//     发现表逐字引 launch.cmd 的坏写法，而 launch.cmd 早已修好），改掉它就是篡改证据。
//   · 确实还没落地的引用进 testkit/doc-path-baseline.json 基线：照常打印、不拦链，
//     但也不会假装它不存在；基线里已修好的条目会被点名提醒删除。
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const NODE_SCRIPT = /node\s+["'`]?([A-Za-z0-9_.\/\\-]+\.(?:mjs|cjs|js))["'`]?/g;
const TICK_PATHED = /`([^`\n]*[\/\\][^`\n]*\.(?:cmd|ps1|bat|vbs))`/g;
const NOISE = /^\.|\.\.\.|[<>$%*]|^\/|[A-Za-z]:|[\\/][\\/]$/;
const BASELINE_FILE = path.join(ROOT, 'testkit', 'doc-path-baseline.json');

const SCAN = ['README.md', 'RUNTIME-MAP.md', 'DISPATCH-PROTOCOL.md', 'DRAMA-PRODUCTION.md',
  'tools/cua/cua-admin.mjs', 'tools/cua/cua-panel.mjs', 'tools/cua/cua-lib.mjs',
  'tools/rea-bridge.mjs', 'tools/rea.cjs'];

function targets() {
  const list = SCAN.map(f => path.join(ROOT, f)).filter(p => fs.existsSync(p));
  const skillRoot = path.join(ROOT, 'dsh-home', 'skills');
  if (fs.existsSync(skillRoot)) {
    for (const d of fs.readdirSync(skillRoot)) {
      const sk = path.join(skillRoot, d, 'SKILL.md');
      if (fs.existsSync(sk)) list.push(sk);
    }
  }
  return list;
}

function readBaseline() {
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(BASELINE_FILE, 'utf8')); } catch { return {}; }
}

// 反引号里常写整条命令（`powershell -File tools/safeguard/uninstall.ps1`），
// 取最后一个以扩展名结尾的空白分隔词才是路径。
function lastToken(span) { return span.trim().split(/\s+/).pop() || span; }

function offensesFor(line, i, file, out) {
  const rel = path.relative(ROOT, file);
  for (const m of line.matchAll(NODE_SCRIPT)) {
    const token = m[1].trim();
    if (NOISE.test(token)) continue;
    if (!fs.existsSync(path.resolve(ROOT, token.replace(/\\/g, path.sep))))
      out.push({ file: rel, line: i + 1, token, kind: 'node', why: '照抄这一句打不开文件' });
  }
  for (const m of line.matchAll(TICK_PATHED)) {
    const token = lastToken(m[1]);
    if (NOISE.test(token)) continue;
    if (!fs.existsSync(path.resolve(ROOT, token.replace(/\\/g, path.sep))))
      out.push({ file: rel, line: i + 1, token, kind: 'path', why: '仓库里没有这个路径' });
  }
}

function scan(file) {
  const offenses = [];
  fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line, i) => offensesFor(line, i, file, offenses));
  return offenses;
}

// 负例自检：探针必须抓得住已知坏引用，且新加的宽松规则不能把它一起废掉。
function selfTest() {
  const cases = [
    ['node cua-admin.mjs status', true, '可执行位裸名（归位后根下没有）'],
    ['node tools/cua/cua-admin.mjs status', false, '正确路径'],
    ['跑 `vs-setup/nope.cjs` 签发', false, '反引号里的 .cjs 不在本探针口径内（只测 node 位）'],
    ['看 `.ps1` 必须带 BOM', false, '纯扩展名是行文噪声'],
    ['见 `node nightshift/no-such.cmd`', true, '带目录且不存在'],
    ['行文的 `indicator.ps1` 不带目录', false, '裸文件名不查（仓外/子目录文件必然误报）'],
    ['整条 `powershell -File tools/safeguard/uninstall.ps1`', false, '末词解析到真实文件'],
    ['省略号 `node .../frames.mjs`', false, '占位符'],
  ];
  let bad = 0;
  for (const [line, expectOffense, why] of cases) {
    const got = [];
    offensesFor(line, 0, path.join(ROOT, 'README.md'), got);
    const hit = got.length > 0;
    if (hit !== expectOffense) { console.error('SELFTEST FAIL: ' + why + ' → 期望 offense=' + expectOffense + ' 实得 ' + hit + ' (' + JSON.stringify(got.map(g => g.token)) + ')'); bad++; }
  }
  if (bad) process.exit(1);
  console.log('SELFTEST ok  (' + cases.length + ' 例，含正例与负例)');
}

const baseline = readBaseline();
const files = targets();
const raw = [];
for (const f of files) raw.push(...scan(f));
if (process.argv.includes('--self-test')) selfTest();

const open = raw.filter(o => !baseline[o.token]);
const waived = raw.filter(o => baseline[o.token]);
const staleBaseline = Object.keys(baseline).filter(k => !raw.some(o => o.token === k));

if (open.length) {
  console.error('DOC-PATH FAIL  ' + open.length + ' 处引用打不通（未被基线豁免）');
  for (const o of open) console.error('  ' + o.file + ':' + o.line + '  →  ' + o.token + '   (' + o.why + ')');
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('DOC-PATH PASS  ' + files.length + ' 个入口文档/用法横幅/技能说明，可执行引用全部落地'
  + (waived.length ? '（另有 ' + waived.length + ' 处已进基线）' : ''));
for (const o of waived) console.log('  基线 ' + o.file + ':' + o.line + '  →  ' + o.token + ' —— ' + baseline[o.token]);
for (const k of staleBaseline) console.log('  提醒：基线条目 "' + k + '" 已不再命中，可从 doc-path-baseline.json 删除');

'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

function compile(file, name) {
  const dir = path.join(OUT, name);
  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [COMPILE, file, dir], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  const sl = path.join(dir, 'shotlist.json');
  const j = fs.existsSync(sl) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(sl, 'utf8')) : null;
  return { code: r.status, out: (r.stdout || '') + (r.stderr || ''), state: j ? j.state_log : [], sl: j };
}

const cases = [

  { name: '负例draft 台词含真实机构', file: path.join(REVIEW, 'draft.md'), check: (r) => r.code === 1 && r.out.includes('真实机构名') },
  {

    check: (r) => r.code === 1 && r.out.split('换装缺失').length - 1 === 1 && r.out.includes('s003'),
  },
  {

    file: path.join(FX, 'T2-keyword.md'),
    check: (r) => r.code === 1 && r.out.includes('换装缺失') && r.out.includes('s003'),
  },
  {
    name: 'T3 泼洒状态在后续镜头可见',
    file: path.join(FX, 'T3-visible.md'),

  },

    file: RAIN,
    check: (r) => r.sl && r.sl.compiler && /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/.test(r.sl.compiler.sha256_16),
  },
  { name: '正例 雨渍与鹅黄（真实剧本）', file: RAIN, check: (r) => r.code === 0 },
];

let fail = 0;
for (const c of cases) {
  const r = compile(c.file, c.name.replace(/\W+/g, '_'));
  const ok = !!c.check(r);
  if (!ok) fail++;
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${c.name}  (exit=${r.code})`);
}
console.log(fail ? `\n${fail} 项失败` : '\n全部通过');
process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
