// probe-tools-path.cjs — 判定「Ollama 的 OpenAI 兼容端点到底认不认 tools」。
//
// 背景：DSH 经 /v1/chat/completions 发来 106 个工具，但 Ollama 报
// prompt_tokens=2050（system 6178 字符 + 任务），工具面的体量对不上。
// 如果工具没被渲染进提示，模型就不可能发起工具调用 —— 那"用本地模型测
// DSH 功能"这条链路根本走不通，必须先确认。
//
// 做法：同一组消息 × 两种端点 × 有无工具，四格对照。
// 判据是 prompt_tokens 的增量：加一个工具如果 token 数不动，就是被丢了。
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
const MODEL = process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3.5:4b';

const TOOL = {
  type: 'function',
  function: {
    name: 'get_weather',
    description: '查询指定城市的实时天气',
    parameters: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: { city: { type: 'string', description: '城市名' } },
      required: ['city'],
    },
  },
};

const MESSAGES = [
  { role: 'system', content: '你是一个测试助手。' },
  { role: 'user', content: '帮我查一下杭州现在的天气' },
];

async function post(path, body) {
  const r = await fetch(BASE + path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const j = await r.json();
  return { status: r.status, j };
}

function summarize(tag, res, isOpenAI) {
  const j = res.j;
  let txt = '', tc = null, pt = null, ct = null;
  if (isOpenAI) {
    const m = j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message;
    txt = (m && m.content) || '';
    tc = (m && m.tool_calls) || null;
    pt = j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens;
    ct = j.usage && j.usage.completion_tokens;
  } else {
    txt = (j.message && j.message.content) || '';
    tc = (j.message && j.message.tool_calls) || null;
    pt = j.prompt_eval_count;
    ct = j.eval_count;
  }
  console.log(
    `${tag.padEnd(30)} HTTP ${res.status} | prompt_tok=${String(pt).padStart(5)} | out_tok=${String(ct).padStart(4)} | ` +
      `tool_calls=${tc ? tc.length + ':' + (tc[0].function ? tc[0].function.name : '') : '无'} | 正文=${JSON.stringify(txt.slice(0, 40))}`,
  );
  return { pt, tc, txt };
}

(async () => {
  const opt = { temperature: 0, num_predict: 128, think: false };

  console.log('■ 对照 1：/v1 不带工具（基线）');
  const a = await post('/v1/chat/completions', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false });
  const ra = summarize('  openai-completions 无 tools', a, true);

  console.log('■ 对照 2：/v1 带 1 个工具');
  const b = await post('/v1/chat/completions', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools: [TOOL] });
  const rb = summarize('  openai-completions 有 tools', b, true);

  console.log('■ 对照 3：/api/chat 不带工具（基线）');
  const c = await post('/api/chat', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, options: opt });
  const rc = summarize('  native /api/chat 无 tools', c, false);

  console.log('■ 对照 4：/api/chat 带 1 个工具');
  const d = await post('/api/chat', { model: MODEL, messages: MESSAGES, stream: false, tools: [TOOL], options: opt });
  const rd = summarize('  native /api/chat 有 tools', d, false);

  console.log('\n■ 判定');
  const deltaV1 = rb.pt - ra.pt;
  const deltaNative = rd.pt - rc.pt;
  console.log(`  /v1   加工具后 prompt_tokens 增量: ${deltaV1}`);
  console.log(`  原生  加工具后 prompt_tokens 增量: ${deltaNative}`);
  console.log(
    deltaV1 > 20
      ? '  ⇒ /v1 端点确实把 tools 渲染进了提示。'
      : '  ⇒ /v1 端点没有把 tools 渲染进提示（增量 < 20 token）—— 这条路上工具调用不可能发生。',
  );
  console.log(
    deltaNative > 20
      ? '  ⇒ 原生端点渲染正常。'
      : '  ⇒ 原生端点也没有渲染。',
  );
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('探针失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

// probe-web.cjs — 验证 DSH 自己能不能上网查资料（不装任何市场插件）
//
// 背景：dsh-base 的依赖里已经有 dsh-tool-web / dsh-web-fetch-http /
// dsh-web-search-deepseek，也就是说 fetch 和 search 两个工具本该出厂就有。
// 但它到底有没有真的注册给模型、真的能连通外网，只有现场跑一次才知道。
//
// 三个用例，各自独立判定：
//   W1 fetch 静态页   —— 纯 HTTP 抓取，验的是 base 自带能力
//   W2 search         —— 依赖 DeepSeek 搜索 API，可能因账号/配额不可用
//   W3 fetch 动态页   —— 检验纯 HTTP 抓取的边界（SPA 会拿到空壳）
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { readSession, listSessions } = require('../lib/session-reader.cjs');

const SANDBOX = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DSH_HOME = path.join(SANDBOX, 'dsh-home');
const DSH_BIN = path.join(SANDBOX, 'node_modules', '@deepseek-ai', 'dsh', 'lib', 'bin.js');
const NODE = process.execPath;
const GIT_BASH = 'C:/Users/64562/.workbuddy/binaries/PortableGit/versions/1.3.0/usr/bin';
const STAMP = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
const OUT = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'runs', 'web-' + STAMP);
const CWD = path.join(SANDBOX, 'testkit', 'scratch', 'web-live');
const TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS || 180000);

fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(CWD, { recursive: true });

const CASES = {
  W1: {
    name: 'fetch 静态页',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash、不要用 curl，只调用名为 web_fetch 的工具。',
      '调用 web_fetch，参数 {"url":"https://example.com"}。',
      '拿到结果后只回复一行：W1-OK: <页面里出现的那句标题原文>',
      '如果 web_fetch 工具不存在或调用失败，只回复：W1-FAIL: <原始错误信息>',
    ].join('\n'),
    // 判据：example.com 的真标题是 "Example Domain"
    check: (r) => /Example Domain/i.test(r.finalText) || /Example Domain/i.test(r.results),
  },
  W2: {
    name: 'search 联网搜索',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash，只调用名为 web_search 的工具。',
      '调用 web_search，参数 {"query":"PRETCO B级 考试大纲"}。',
      '拿到结果后只回复一行：W2-OK: <前三条结果的标题>',
      '如果 web_search 工具不存在或调用失败，只回复：W2-FAIL: <原始错误信息>',
    ].join('\n'),
    check: (r) => /W2-OK/.test(r.finalText) && !/W2-FAIL/.test(r.finalText),
  },
  W3: {
    name: 'fetch 动态页边界',
    prompt: [
      '这是一次只读的联网检查，不要用 bash、不要用 curl，只调用名为 web_fetch 的工具。',
      '调用 web_fetch，参数 {"url":"https://www.bilibili.com"}。',
      '然后只回复两行：',
      'W3-STATUS: <拿到多少个字>',
      'W3-SAMPLE: <正文里前 80 个字>',
    ].join('\n'),
    check: (r) => /W3-STATUS/.test(r.finalText),
  },
};

function runCase(key) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const cs = CASES[key];
    const dir = path.join(OUT, key);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'prompt.txt'), cs.prompt, 'utf8');

    const t0 = Date.now();
    const child = spawn(NODE, [DSH_BIN, 'headless', '--json', cs.prompt], {
      cwd: CWD,
      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      env: { ...process.env, DSH_HOME, PATH: GIT_BASH + ';' + (process.env.PATH || '') },
    });
    let out = '', err = '';
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill('SIGKILL'); } catch { /* ignore */ } }, TIMEOUT_MS);
    child.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString('utf8'); });
    child.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString('utf8'); });

    child.on('close', (code) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'stdout.jsonl'), out, 'utf8');
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'stderr.log'), err, 'utf8');

      const evs = [];
      for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
        const s = line.trim();
        if (s.startsWith('{')) { try { evs.push(JSON.parse(s)); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
      }
      const finalText = (evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'final').pop()?.text)
        || (evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'text').pop()?.text) || '';

      const sessions = listSessions(path.join(DSH_HOME, 'sessions')).filter((s) => s.mtimeMs >= t0 - 5000);
      let allEvents = [];
      for (const s of sessions.slice(0, 6)) {
        const { events } = readSession(s.dir);
        if (events.length > allEvents.length) allEvents = events;
      }
      const calls = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/call').map((e) => ({
        name: e.data?.name,
        args: JSON.stringify(e.data?.arguments || {}).slice(0, 160),
      }));
      const results = allEvents.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool/result').map((e) => {
        const c = e.data?.message?.content ?? e.data?.content;
        let txt = '';
        if (Array.isArray(c)) txt = c.map((x) => x.text || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n');
        else if (typeof c === 'string') txt = c;
        return String(txt);
      }).join('\n').slice(0, 3000);

      const r = {
        case: key,
        name: cs.name,
        exitCode: code,
        ms: Date.now() - t0,
        finalText,
        toolCalls: calls,
        results,
      };
      r.ok = cs.check(r);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), 'utf8');
      console.log(`${key} ${cs.name}: ${r.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} (${(r.ms / 1000).toFixed(0)}s) 工具=${JSON.stringify(calls.map((c) => c.name))}`);
      console.log('   答复:', JSON.stringify(finalText.slice(0, 200)));
      resolve(r);
    });
  });
}

(async () => {
  const only = process.argv[2] ? process.argv[2].split(',') : Object.keys(CASES);
  const results = [];
  for (const k of only) {
    if (CASES[k]) results.push(await runCase(k));
  }
  const pass = results.filter((r) => r.ok).length;
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'summary.json'), JSON.stringify(results, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(`\n合计 ${pass}/${results.length}   证据: ${OUT}`);
  process.exit(pass === results.length ? 0 : 1);
})();

let pass = 0, fail = 0;

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.js'), 'const x = ;' + LF);

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.json'), '{a:}');
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'good.py'), 'x = 1' + LF);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py'), 'def f(:' + LF);
(async () => {

  const C = await import('file:///' + path.join(ROOT, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'checkers.mjs').split(path.sep).join('/'));
  // 1) 提取器
  ok('redirect 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('echo hi > a.js')) === JSON.stringify(['a.js']));
  ok('追加与 fd 排除', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cmd >> log.js 2>/dev/null')) === JSON.stringify(['log.js']));
  ok('fd 数字排除', R.extractWriteTargets('prog > 2').length === 0);
  ok('heredoc 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cat > b.py <<EOF')) === JSON.stringify(['b.py']));
  ok('touch 多目标', R.extractWriteTargets('touch a.py b.json').length === 2);
  ok('tee 与 cp 尾参', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('tee out.json')) === JSON.stringify(['out.json']) && JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('cp x y.js')) === JSON.stringify(['y.js']));
  ok('sed -i 目标', JSON.stringify(R.extractWriteTargets('sed -i s/a/b f.py')) === JSON.stringify(['f.py']));
  ok('非代码扩展过滤', R.extractWriteTargets('echo x > note.txt').length === 0);
  // 2) 检查器
  ok('js 合法=OK', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'good.js')).status === 'OK');
  ok('js 语法错=FAIL', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.js')).status === 'FAIL');
  ok('json 双向', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'ok.json')).status === 'OK' && C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.json')).status === 'FAIL');
  ok('python ast 双向', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'good.py')).status === 'OK' && C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py')).status === 'FAIL', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'bad.py')));
  ok('文件消失=GONE', C.checkFile(path.join(tmp, 'nope.js')).status === 'GONE');

  ok('注入文本带路径与首错', txt.indexOf('[write-verify]') >= 0 && txt.indexOf('/x/bad.js') >= 0 && txt.indexOf('SyntaxError') >= 0);
  // 4) 接线钉：插件源码纪律 + cordis/repo-daily
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'index.js'), 'utf8');
  ok('永不否决(fail-open 形状)', src.indexOf('return undefined') >= 0 && src.indexOf('tick_error') >= 0);
  // 「注入缝在位」原先是一条字符串搜索：src.indexOf('systemPrompt.context')>=0。
  // 它一直绿，而生产里这条缝抛了 142 次（dsh-home/write-verify.log，最新一条 2026-10-30T11:36:10Z），
  // "把写后失败注回 agent 面前"从未生效过一次 —— 字符串在源码里 ≠ 缝挂得上。换成真挂载。
  const stageDir = path.join(tmp, 'staged');
  fs.cpSync(path.join(ROOT, 'plugins'), path.join(stageDir, 'plugins'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(stageDir, 'package.json'), '{"type":"module"}');
  for (const [name, code] of [
    ['cordis', 'export class Service { constructor(ctx) { this.ctx = ctx; } }'],

  }
  const WV = (await import('file:///' + path.join(stageDir, 'plugins', 'write-verify-dsh', 'index.js').split(path.sep).join('/'))).default;
  const wvHome = path.join(tmp, 'wvhome');
  fs.mkdirSync(wvHome, { recursive: true });
  const wvCfg = () => ({
    enabled: true, inject: true, stateFile: path.join(wvHome, 'state.json'), logFile: path.join(wvHome, 'wv.log'),
    maxFilesPerCall: 8, maxVerifyPerRound: 10, maxAppeals: 6,
  });
  // 与上游一致的集中分配表（node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt/lib/index.js:44）。

  // 锚点名写错 → getContextOrder 返回 undefined → order 非有限 → 这里就抛，不会拖到生产。
  const CONTEXT_ORDERS = {
    WORKING_DIRECTORY: 100, SANDBOX_POLICY: 110, APPROVAL_POLICY: 115,
    SUBAGENT_DELEGATION: 120, TEAM_IDENTITY: 125, HARNESS_SOURCE: 200, WEB_SURFACE: 210,
  };
  const mountWv = ({ hasSystemPrompt }) => {
    let guardMounted = false;
    const contexts = [];
    const has = (dep) => dep === 'tools' || (dep === 'systemPrompt' && hasSystemPrompt);
    const ctx = {
      inject(deps, cb) {
        if (!deps.every(has)) return;                 // Cordis 语义：声明了却没人提供 → 静默不回调
        const scope = {};
        if (deps.includes('tools')) scope.tools = { guard() { guardMounted = true; } };
        // 桩必须按真服务的校验来（dsh-system-prompt/lib/index.js:279）：
        // 只 push 不校验 = 契约违规在这里绿、在生产里静默失效。10-30 就是这么漏的。
        if (deps.includes('systemPrompt')) scope.systemPrompt = {
          getContextOrder: (n) => CONTEXT_ORDERS[n],
          context: (o) => {
            if (!Number.isFinite(o.order)) throw new TypeError(`prompt context "${o.name}" order must be a finite number`);
            if (typeof o.name !== 'string' || !o.name) throw new TypeError('prompt context requires a name');
            if (contexts.some((c) => c.name === o.name)) throw new Error(`prompt context "${o.name}" is already registered`);
            contexts.push(o);
          },
        };
        cb(scope);
      },
    };
    const svc = new WV(ctx, wvCfg());
    return { svc, guardMounted, contexts, seam: svc.seamAttached === true };
  };
  const mYes = mountWv({ hasSystemPrompt: true });
  ok('注入缝真挂上（systemPrompt 在位时 seamAttached 且 context 被调过一次）',
    mYes.seam === true && mYes.contexts.length === 1, { seam: mYes.seam, contexts: mYes.contexts.length });
  // 契约三件套（10-30 生产实况：只传 { text } 时 context() 抛 order must be a finite number，
  // 缝从未挂上，而上一版探针只数 contexts.length 所以照绿）。
  const ctx0 = mYes.contexts[0] || {};
  ok('缝注册带 name（注册键，缺了上游按 undefined 命名会撞车）', typeof ctx0.name === 'string' && ctx0.name.length > 0, ctx0.name);
  ok('缝注册带有限 order（上游 context() 的硬校验）', Number.isFinite(ctx0.order), { order: ctx0.order });
  ok('order 来自集中分配表的合法锚点，不是插件自己编的数',
    Object.values(CONTEXT_ORDERS).includes(ctx0.order), { order: ctx0.order, table: CONTEXT_ORDERS });
  ok('text 是每轮求值的函数且返回非空字符串',
    typeof ctx0.text === 'function' && typeof ctx0.text({}) === 'string', typeof ctx0.text);
  const mNo = mountWv({ hasSystemPrompt: false });
  ok('反向：systemPrompt 缺席时 guard 仍挂载（两条 inject 解耦，不退化成"不存在"）',
    mNo.guardMounted === true && mNo.seam === false, { guard: mNo.guardMounted, seam: mNo.seam });
  // 原来这里还有一条**源码文本钉**（正则框住 inject 回调内 300 字符找 scope.systemPrompt.context），
  // 加一段注释就断 —— 而它防的"回到直接读 ctx.systemPrompt"已经被上面两条行为锁覆盖：
  // 夹具的 ctx 上没有 systemPrompt 属性，直读就是 TypeError → seamAttached=false → "缝真挂上"先红。
  // 行为锁能覆盖的事就别用文本钉（钉住形状只会让下一个改注释的人莫名踩红）。
  ok('单一真源(复用 tool-watch 判定)', src.indexOf('tool-watch-dsh/rules.mjs') >= 0);
  ok('cordis 已注册', fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'dsh-home', 'cordis.patch.yml'), 'utf8').indexOf('write-verify-dsh') >= 0);
  ok('repo-daily 已挂', fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'repo-daily.cmd'), 'utf8').indexOf('probe-write-verify.cjs') >= 0);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log('SUMMARY pass=' + pass + ' fail=' + fail);
  process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
})();

// replay-dump.cjs — 把线上抓到的请求原样重放，逐个隔离变量。
//
// 要回答的问题：DSH 经 /v1 发来的这一包（27 工具 / 4 条消息 / 约 9.4k token），
// 模型为什么完全不理任务？候选原因有三个，必须分开验：
//   A. OpenAI 兼容层丢东西（换成原生 /api/chat 重放即可排除）
//   B. 上下文被截断（显式给 num_ctx=32768 重放即可排除）
//   C. 模型本身被巨型 user 消息压住（把技能目录摘掉再重放即可排除）
//
// 用法：node replay-dump.cjs <dump.json> [v1|native]
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const file = process.argv[2] || path.join(__dirname, 'wire-dumps', fs.readdirSync(path.join(__dirname, 'wire-dumps')).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json')).sort().slice(-1)[0]);
const mode = process.argv[3] || 'native';
const BASE = process.env.OLLAMA_BASE || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';

const src = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
console.log('重放:', path.basename(file), '| 模式:', mode);
console.log('原包: tools=' + (src.tools || []).length + ' messages=' + (src.messages || []).length);

function textOf(m) {
  return typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : (m.content || []).map((b) => b.text || '').join('');
}

async function call(tag, messages, tools, extra) {
  let url, body;
  if (mode === 'v1') {
    url = BASE + '/v1/chat/completions';
    body = { model: src.model, messages, tools: tools.length ? tools : undefined, stream: false, max_tokens: 600 };
  } else {
    url = BASE + '/api/chat';
    body = {
      model: src.model,
      messages: messages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: textOf(m) })),
      tools: tools.length ? tools.map((t) => ({ type: 'function', function: t.function })) : undefined,
      stream: false,
      think: false,
      options: { num_ctx: 32768, num_predict: 600, temperature: 0, ...(extra || {}) },
    };
  }
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const j = await r.json();
  const ms = Date.now() - t0;
  if (j.error) { console.log(`${tag.padEnd(34)} ERROR ${JSON.stringify(j.error).slice(0, 120)}`); return null; }
  let pt, ct, txt, tc;
  if (mode === 'v1') {
    const m = (j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message) || {};
    pt = j.usage && j.usage.prompt_tokens; ct = j.usage && j.usage.completion_tokens;
    txt = m.content || ''; tc = m.tool_calls || null;
  } else {
    pt = j.prompt_eval_count; ct = j.eval_count;
    txt = (j.message && j.message.content) || ''; tc = (j.message && j.message.tool_calls) || null;
  }
  const tcName = tc && tc[0] ? (tc[0].function || {}).name : null;
  console.log(
    `${tag.padEnd(34)} prompt=${String(pt).padStart(6)} out=${String(ct).padStart(4)} ${String(ms + 'ms').padStart(8)} | ` +
      `tool=${tcName || '无'} | ${JSON.stringify(String(txt).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 70))}`,
  );
  return { pt, ct, txt, tc, ms };
}

(async () => {
  const all = src.messages || [];
  const sys = all.filter((m) => m.role === 'system');
  const users = all.filter((m) => m.role === 'user');
  const tools = src.tools || [];

  console.log('\n■ 1. 完整原包（4 条消息 + 27 工具）');
  await call('  原样', all, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 2. 只留任务那条 user（摘掉 runtime context 与技能目录）');
  const onlyTask = [sys[0], users[0]].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  system + 任务', onlyTask, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 3. 摘掉技能目录，保留 runtime context');
  const noSkills = [sys[0], users[0], users[1]].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  system + 任务 + runtime', noSkills, tools);

  console.log('\n■ 4. 摘掉工具，只留任务（看模型是否至少读懂任务）');
  await call('  system + 任务（无工具）', onlyTask, []);

  console.log('\n■ 5. 三条 user 合并成一条');
  const merged = [sys[0], { role: 'user', content: users.map(textOf).join('\n\n---\n\n') }].filter(Boolean);
  await call('  合并 user', merged, tools);
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error('失败:', e && e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

      const final = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'final').pop();

    if (round > 1) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(RUN, `prompt-round${round}.txt`), prompt, 'utf8');

    log(`──── 第 ${round} 轮开始 ${sid ? '（续跑 ' + sid + '）' : '（新会话）'} ────`);
    const r = await runRound(prompt, sid, round);
    sid = r.sessionId || sid;
    rounds.push(r);
    log(`第 ${round} 轮结束：退出码 ${r.exitCode}${r.killed ? '（超时）' : ''} · ${(r.ms / 60000).toFixed(1)} 分钟 · 工具 ${r.toolCalls} 次`);

    lastVerify = verify(round);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(RUN, `verify-round${round}.json`), JSON.stringify(lastVerify, null, 1), 'utf8');
    if (lastVerify.notVerified) {

      for (const x of lastVerify.results) log(`   ${x.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${x.id} ${x.label} — ${String(x.detail).slice(0, 150)}`);
      break; // 未验收状态不进验收循环(没有判据可续跑)
    }
    log(`验收 ${lastVerify.passed}/${lastVerify.total}` + (lastVerify.ok ? ' — 全部通过' : ''));
    for (const x of lastVerify.results) log(`   ${x.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${x.id} ${x.label} — ${String(x.detail).slice(0, 150)}`);

    if (lastVerify.ok) { log(`✅ 第 ${round} 轮通过验收，工作流结束`); break; }
    if (round === MAX_ROUNDS) log(`⚠️ 轮次用尽，仍有 ${lastVerify.total - lastVerify.passed} 项未通过`);
  }

  const notVerified = !!(lastVerify && lastVerify.notVerified);
  const summary = {
    task: TASK, cwd: CWD, verify: VERIFY, sessionId: sid,
    rounds: rounds.map((r) => ({ round: r.round, exitCode: r.exitCode, killed: r.killed, ms: r.ms, toolCalls: r.toolCalls, tools: r.tools })),
    finalVerify: lastVerify,
    passed: !!(lastVerify && lastVerify.ok) && !notVerified,
    notVerified,
    verdict: notVerified ? '未验收(--verify none;不构成通过,不写入任何验收记录)' : (lastVerify && lastVerify.ok ? '通过' : '未通过'),
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(RUN, 'summary.json'), JSON.stringify(summary, null, 1), 'utf8');
  log(`结果：${notVerified ? '未验收(--verify none;不构成通过)' : (summary.passed ? '通过' : '未通过')} | 会话 ${sid}`);
  process.exit(summary.passed ? 0 : 1);
})();

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * sage-ab.cjs — SageAttention A/B 基准（2026-10-25）
 *
 * 目的：同一台机（RTX 5070 Laptop / sm_120）同 seed 同 prompt 同尺寸，
 *       实测 PathchSageAttentionKJ(auto) 相对原生 SDPA 的采样提速与画质差异。
 *       社区口径 30-35%，本脚本给出本机实测数。
 *
 * 用法：node sage-ab.cjs          （ComfyUI 需已在 127.0.0.1:8188）
 * 输出：四轮计时 + 产物路径（sdpa/sage 各两张，文件名带引擎标记可直接双盲对比）
 */
const HOST = 'http://127.0.0.1:8188';
const SEED = 20261025;
const PROMPT = '一位中国大学生在图书馆窗边看书，午后侧光，胶片质感，写实照片风格，浅景深';
const NEG = 'blurry ugly bad';

function wf(prompt, sage) {
  const g = {
    '1': { class_type: 'UnetLoaderGGUF', inputs: { unet_name: 'z-image-turbo-Q4_K_S.gguf' } },
  };
  let modelRef = ['1', 0];
  if (sage) {
    g['1b'] = { class_type: 'PathchSageAttentionKJ', inputs: { model: ['1', 0], sage_attention: 'auto', allow_compile: false } };
    modelRef = ['1b', 0];
  }
  g['2'] = { class_type: 'ModelSamplingAuraFlow', inputs: { model: modelRef, shift: 3 } };
  g['3'] = { class_type: 'CLIPLoader', inputs: { clip_name: 'qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors', type: 'lumina2' } };
  g['4'] = { class_type: 'VAELoader', inputs: { vae_name: 'ae.safetensors' } };
  g['5'] = { class_type: 'CLIPTextEncode', inputs: { clip: ['3', 0], text: prompt } };
  g['6'] = { class_type: 'CLIPTextEncode', inputs: { clip: ['3', 0], text: NEG } };
  g['7'] = { class_type: 'EmptySD3LatentImage', inputs: { width: 1024, height: 1024, batch_size: 1 } };
  g['8'] = { class_type: 'KSampler', inputs: { seed: SEED, steps: 8, cfg: 1, sampler_name: 'euler', scheduler: 'simple', denoise: 1, model: ['2', 0], positive: ['5', 0], negative: ['6', 0], latent_image: ['7', 0] } };
  g['9'] = { class_type: 'VAEDecode', inputs: { samples: ['8', 0], vae: ['4', 0] } };
  g['10'] = { class_type: 'SaveImage', inputs: { images: ['9', 0], filename_prefix: 'sage-ab-' + (sage ? 'sage' : 'sdpa') } };
  return { prompt: g };
}

async function run(label, sage) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const sub = await (await fetch(HOST + '/prompt', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(wf(PROMPT, sage)) })).json();
  if (sub.node_errors && Object.keys(sub.node_errors).length) throw new Error(label + ' 工作流被拒: ' + JSON.stringify(sub.node_errors).slice(0, 300));
  const id = sub.prompt_id;
  for (;;) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700));
    const h = await (await fetch(HOST + '/history/' + id)).json();
    const item = h[id];
    if (item) {
      if (item.status && item.status.status_str === 'error') throw new Error(label + ' 执行失败: ' + JSON.stringify(item.status.messages || {}).slice(0, 300));
      const imgs = item.outputs && Object.values(item.outputs).flatMap((o) => o.images || []);
      if (imgs && imgs.length) {
        const ms = Date.now() - t0;
        console.log(`${label}: ${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s  ->  ${imgs[0].subfolder ? imgs[0].subfolder + '/' : ''}${imgs[0].filename}`);
        return ms;
      }
    }
    if (Date.now() - t0 > 420000) throw new Error(label + ' 超时');
  }
}

(async () => {
  console.log('== SageAttention A/B（Z-Image Q4, 1024x1024, 8步, seed ' + SEED + '）==');
  await run('warmup(sdpa 512/4步 预热上盘)', false).catch(() => {}); // 忽略计时，只为把模型拉进显存

})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e.message); process.exit(1); });

const z=require('node:zlib'),fs=require('node:fs');
const MAGIC=Buffer.from([0x28,0xb5,0x2f,0xfd]);
function decodeAll(buf){const parts=[];let i=0;while(true){const s=buf.indexOf(MAGIC,i);if(s<0)break;let next=buf.indexOf(MAGIC,s+4);const end=next<0?buf.length:next;try{parts.push(z.zstdDecompressSync(buf.subarray(s,end)));}catch(e){parts.push(Buffer.from('[frame err '+e.message+']\n'));}i=end;if(next<0)break;}return Buffer.concat(parts).toString('utf8');}
module.exports={decodeAll};
if(require.main===module){const f=process.argv[2],out=process.argv[3];const t=decodeAll(fs.readFileSync(f));fs.writeFileSync(out,t,'utf8');console.log('decoded',t.length,'chars,',t.split('\n').length,'lines');}

// wire-dump.cjs — 装在 DSH 与 Ollama 之间的透明记录代理。
//
// 用途：DSH 走 pi-ai 发出的请求到底长什么样，只有看线上字节才算数。
// 监听 11499，原样转发到 11434，每次请求把 body 落到 dumpDir。
//
// 只做一件事：记录。不改写、不注入、不重试 —— 否则测出来的就不是 DSH 的行为了。
const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const LISTEN = Number(process.env.WIRE_PORT || 11499);
const TARGET = Number(process.env.WIRE_TARGET_PORT || 11434);
const DUMP = process.env.WIRE_DUMP_DIR || path.join(__dirname, 'wire-dumps');
fs.mkdirSync(DUMP, { recursive: true });

let seq = 0;

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const chunks = [];
  req.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
  req.on('end', () => {
    const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
    const n = String(++seq).padStart(3, '0');
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');

    if (body.length) {
      const f = path.join(DUMP, `${n}-${stamp}-${req.method}-${req.url.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '_')}.json`);
      try {
        // 能解析就美化，解析不了就原样存（宁可留脏数据也不丢证据）
        const txt = body.toString('utf8');
        let pretty = txt;
        try { pretty = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(txt), null, 2); } catch { /* keep raw */ }
        fs.writeFileSync(f, pretty);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[wire] 落盘失败', e && e.message);
      }
    }

    const proxied = http.request(
      {
        host: '127.0.0.1',
        port: TARGET,
        path: req.url,
        method: req.method,
        headers: { ...req.headers, host: `127.0.0.1:${TARGET}`, 'content-length': body.length },
      },
      (up) => {
        res.writeHead(up.statusCode || 502, up.headers);
        up.pipe(res);
      },
    );
    proxied.on('error', (e) => {
      console.error('[wire] 上游错误', e && e.message);
      if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(502, { 'content-type': 'application/json' });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'wire proxy upstream error: ' + (e && e.message) } }));
    });
    if (body.length) proxied.write(body);
    proxied.end();
  });
});

server.listen(LISTEN, '127.0.0.1', () => {
  console.log(`[wire] listening ${LISTEN} -> ${TARGET}, dumps in ${DUMP}`);
});

/**
 * _surface-testkit.mjs — 给 surface.mjs 用的记账式假驱动。
 *
 * 只返回驱动"真实形状"的响应（字段名与 2026-10-20 现场抓的一致：
 * get_window_state 同时给 elements 和 tree_markdown、截图走 images[].dataBase64），
 * 但把每次调用原样记下来，供断言。
 */
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createDispatcher } from '../../mcp/cua/surface.mjs';

const PY =
  process.env.CUA_PYTHON ||
  'C:/Users/64562/.workbuddy/binaries/python/versions/3.13.12/python.exe';

const TMP = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cua-surface-test');

function makePng(w, h, name) {
  fs.mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true });
  const p = path.join(TMP, name);
  if (fs.existsSync(p)) return fs.readFileSync(p).toString('base64');
  const code = `
import sys, io
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
w,h=int(sys.argv[1]),int(sys.argv[2])
im=Image.new('RGB',(w,h),(30,34,44))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
for i in range(0,w,80): d.line([(i,0),(i,h)],fill=(70,80,100))
for j in range(0,h,80): d.line([(0,j),(w,j)],fill=(70,80,100))
out=io.BytesIO(); im.save(out,'PNG'); sys.stdout.buffer.write(out.getvalue())
`;
  const r = spawnSync(PY, ['-c', code, String(w), String(h)], { maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('生成测试图失败: ' + (r.stderr || '').toString().slice(0, 200));
  fs.writeFileSync(p, r.stdout);
  return r.stdout.toString('base64');
}

function windowElements() {
  // 18 条，形状照抄真驱动（含 element_token / frame / enabled）
  const rows = [
    { role: 'Window', label: 'Android Emulator - kqkb34g:5554', frame: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 407, h: 887 } },
    { role: 'Window', label: 'Emulator', frame: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 407, h: 40 } },
  ];
  const btns = ['close', 'minimize', 'power', 'volume_up', 'volume_down', 'rotate', 'snapshot', 'extended', 'settings'];
  for (const b of btns) rows.push({ role: 'Button', label: b, frame: { x: 10, y: 10, w: 24, h: 24 } });
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) rows.push({ role: 'Pane', label: '', frame: { x: 0, y: 60 + i * 100, w: 407, h: 100 } });
  return rows.map((r, i) => ({
    depth: i === 0 ? 0 : 1,
    element_index: i,
    element_token: `s00000001:${i}`,
    enabled: true,
    selected: false,
    label: r.label,
    role: r.role,
    value: r.value,
    frame: r.frame,
  }));
}

export async function createDetective(opts = {}) {
  // noShots=true：只记账、一张图都不给。
  // 给 settle 那类"靠像素吃饭"的用器用来断腿 —— 看不见画面时它必须明说看不见，
  // 不许把"取不到图"翻译成"画面稳了"（2026-10-27 真机栽过的反向）。
  const noShots = opts.noShots === true;
  const calls = [];
  const clear = () => { calls.length = 0; };
  const shotWin = noShots ? '' : makePng(407, 887, 'win-407x887.png');
  const shotDesk = noShots ? '' : makePng(1600, 1200, 'desk-1600x1200.png');

  const apps = {
    apps: [
      { name: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe', pid: 31276, running: true, bundle_id: null, launch_path: null, windows: [] },
      { name: 'WorkBuddy', pid: 27116, running: true, bundle_id: 'C:\\Program Files\\WorkBuddy\\WorkBuddy.exe', launch_path: 'C:\\Program Files\\WorkBuddy\\WorkBuddy.exe', windows: [] },
      { name: 'Microsoft Edge', pid: 25656, running: true, bundle_id: 'msedge.exe', launch_path: 'msedge.exe', windows: [] },
      { name: 'Notepad', pid: 0, running: false, bundle_id: 'notepad.exe', launch_path: 'notepad.exe', windows: [] },
    ],
  };

  const windowsText = [
    '✅ Found 4 window(s) across 3 app(s); 4 on-screen.',
    '- WorkBuddy.exe (pid 27116) "WorkBuddy" [window_id: 132348]',
    '- qemu-system-x86_64.exe (pid 31276) "Emulator" [window_id: 5374852]',
    '- qemu-system-x86_64.exe (pid 31276) "Android Emulator - kqkb34g:5554" [window_id: 1640124]',
    '- msedge.exe (pid 25656) "DeepSeek 开放平台" [window_id: 1247386]',
  ].join('\n');

  const fakeCall = async (name, args) => {
    calls.push({ tool: name, args });
    const r = await drive(name, args);
    // noShots：把图全部剥掉（驱动不会返回一张空图，只会一张都不给）
    return noShots ? { ...r, images: [] } : r;
  };

  const drive = async (name, args) => {
    switch (name) {
      case 'list_apps':
        return { text: '✅ Found 4 app(s)', structuredJson: JSON.stringify(apps), rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: false };
      case 'list_windows':
        // 2026-10-31 起解析器优先信 structuredJson.windows（文本只做回退），空数组会被判
        // "empty" → 桌面截图 fail-closed 拒绝。假驱动必须像真驱动一样交出结构化名单。
        return {
          text: windowsText,
          structuredJson: JSON.stringify({
            windows: [
              { pid: 27116, window_id: 132348, title: 'WorkBuddy', process: 'WorkBuddy.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 31276, window_id: 5374852, title: 'Emulator', process: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124, title: 'Android Emulator - kqkb34g:5554', process: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 25656, window_id: 1247386, title: 'DeepSeek 开放平台', process: 'msedge.exe', is_on_screen: true },
            ],
          }),
          rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: false,
        };
      case 'get_window_state': {
        const els = windowElements().slice(0, args.max_elements || 200);
        const o = {
          _note: 'Prefer `elements` — `tree_markdown` will continue to work…',
          element_count: els.length,
          returned_element_count: els.length,
          total_element_count: 18,
          elements_complete: false,
          pid: args.pid,
          window_id: args.window_id,
          // 身份字段（2026-10-31 M3）：surface 的 sensitivityOf 对 process/title 全空的
          // 窗口状态一律按敏感拒绝（fail-closed）。真驱动的窗口状态带身份，假驱动也要带。
          process: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe',
          title: args.window_id === 1640124 ? 'Android Emulator - kqkb34g:5554' : 'Emulator',
          snapshot_id: 's00000001',
          tree_markdown: '# the same tree rendered again\n' + els.map((e) => `- [${e.element_index}] ${e.role}`).join('\n'),
          elements: els,
        };
        return {
          text: `window_id=${args.window_id} pid=${args.pid} elements=${els.length}`,
          structuredJson: JSON.stringify(o),
          rawJson: '{}',
          images: args.include_screenshot ? [{ dataBase64: shotWin, mimeType: 'image/png' }] : [],
          isError: false,
        };
      }
      case 'get_desktop_state':
        // 2026-10-31 起 doSettle/doSee 的桌面分支用 structuredJson.windows 做敏感性
        // 复核（desktopBlocked 严格模式：列表缺席/为空 = 拒绝）。真驱动带回窗口清单，
        // 假驱动也必须带，否则沉降-桌面分支永远停在 fail-closed 拒绝上。
        return {
          text: 'captured primary display 1600x1200',
          structuredJson: JSON.stringify({
            windows: [
              { pid: 27116, window_id: 132348, title: 'WorkBuddy', process: 'WorkBuddy.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 31276, window_id: 5374852, title: 'Emulator', process: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 31276, window_id: 1640124, title: 'Android Emulator - kqkb34g:5554', process: 'qemu-system-x86_64.exe', is_on_screen: true },
              { pid: 25656, window_id: 1247386, title: 'DeepSeek 开放平台', process: 'msedge.exe', is_on_screen: true },
            ],
          }),
          rawJson: '{}',
          images: [{ dataBase64: shotDesk, mimeType: 'image/png' }],
          isError: false,
        };
      case 'verify_state':
        return { text: 'satisfied: 2/2', structuredJson: '{"status":"satisfied"}', rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: false };
      // zoom 必须真的返回一张图：surface 只有拿到图才会把该窗口的坐标空间标成 zoomed。
      // 假驱动不返回图，坐标空间就不会切换，T10 也就测不到真东西。
      case 'zoom':
        return {
          text: `zoomed [${args.x1},${args.y1},${args.x2},${args.y2}]`,
          structuredJson: '{}',
          rawJson: '{}',
          images: [{ dataBase64: shotWin, mimeType: 'image/png' }],
          isError: false,
        };
      default:
        // click 要带上驱动真实会返回的元数据：action.delivery.mode / degraded / errorCode。
        // 没有这些字段，T13（投递方式透传）就测不到真东西。
        if (name === 'click') {
          if (args.delivery_mode === 'foreground') {
            return {
              text: 'foreground_unavailable: exact target HWND 0x1018a was not foreground after the click (actual foreground HWND 0x204fc)',
              structuredJson: '{}', rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: true,
              errorCode: 'foreground_unavailable', degraded: false,
              action: { effect: 0, route: 0, delivery: { mode: 1 } },
            };
          }
          return {
            text: `✅ Posted click to pid ${args.pid}.`,
            structuredJson: '{}', rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: false,
            degraded: false,
            action: { effect: 2, route: 1, delivery: { mode: 0 } },
          };
        }
        return { text: `${name} ok`, structuredJson: '{}', rawJson: '{}', images: [], isError: false };
    }
  };

  const dispatcher = createDispatcher({ callDriver: fakeCall, log: () => {} });
  return { dispatcher, calls, clear };
}

// add-repair-loopback.cjs — 给 /repair 加回环直通(与 /roots 同款信任模型)
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const f = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox/plugins/live-code/index.js';
let s = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
let n = 0;

const anchor = " // 回环只读快照旁路(2026-10-31):供本机监视/自动化核验,不出回环";
if (s.includes("base+'/repair'&&req.method==='POST'){const ra=")) {
  console.log('repair loopback: already present');
} else if (s.includes(anchor)) {
  const inject = " // 红色修复直通(2026-10-31):仅限本机回环的运维/自动化调用\n" +
    " if(u.pathname===base+'/repair'&&req.method==='POST'){const ra=(req.socket&&req.socket.remoteAddress||'').replace('::ffff:','');if(ra!=='127.0.0.1'&&ra!=='::1'){res.writeHead(403);res.end('loopback only');return;}const rid=u.searchParams.get('id')||'';try{const run=repairs.start(rid);res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify({ok:true,run}));}catch(e){res.writeHead(400);res.end(JSON.stringify({error:String(e.message)}));}return;}\n" + anchor;
  s = s.replace(anchor, inject);
  n++;
  console.log('repair loopback: inserted');

路径: C:\Users\64562\.zcode\workspace\fed94a31-679a-45b6-966b-9f7cdf31218b\digital-twin-monitor\cua-lookout.cjs

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
// cua-lookout.cjs — CUA 瞭望哨:每 3 分钟查看一次全链状态(大屏 :3210 + DSH live-code :3080)
//
// 真源 = HTTP(大屏 /api/events + DSH /dsh-live-code/state 回环只读旁路);
// 截图只作佐证、不作判据(严禁假绿)。判定规则见 judge(),与 test-cua-lookout.cjs 对齐:
//   RED      = DSH 真实验证存在 failed(红灯文件或失败测试)
//   DEGRADED = 任一真源不可达(链路问题,不冒充代码问题)
//   GREEN    = 其余;unverified 一律不计入问题(与 engine.mjs snapshot 红线同源)
//
// 用法:
//   node cua-lookout.cjs --once [--shot monitor-records\lookout.png]   单次查看
//   node cua-lookout.cjs --watch [秒]                                  常驻瞭望(默认 180s)
// 环境变量 CUA_LOOKOUT_DASH / CUA_LOOKOUT_DSH 可覆盖端点。
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const net = require('node:net');

const DASH = process.env.CUA_LOOKOUT_DASH || 'http://127.0.0.1:3210';
const DSH = process.env.CUA_LOOKOUT_DSH || 'http://127.0.0.1:3080';
const LIVE = DSH + '/dsh-live-code';
const RECORDS = path.join(__dirname, 'monitor-records', 'lookout.jsonl');
const CUA_TCP_PORT = 19333; // cua-daemon.cjs:MCP JSON-RPC(newline-delimited)

async function fetchJson(url, ms = 6000) {
  const ac = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), ms);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ac.signal });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    return await res.json();
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

/* 纯函数:合并两路真源 → 红绿判定(单测见 test-cua-lookout.cjs) */
function judge(dash, dsh, now = Date.now()) {
  const issues = [];
  const redFiles = [];
  const failedTests = [];
  const summary = { dashEvents: 0, dashErrors: 0, dshVerified: 0, dshUnverified: 0, dshRed: 0 };

  if (!dash || dash.ok === false) issues.push('dash:down:' + String((dash && dash.error) || '无数据'));
  else {
    summary.dashEvents = Array.isArray(dash.events) ? dash.events.length : 0;
    summary.dashErrors = Number((dash.counts && dash.counts.error) || 0);
  }
  if (!dsh || dsh.ok === false) issues.push('dsh:down:' + String((dsh && dsh.error) || '无数据'));
  else {
    for (const f of Array.isArray(dsh.files) ? dsh.files : []) {
      if (f && f.status === 'failed') redFiles.push(String(f.rel || f.id || '?'));
    }
    // externalTests 快照按 at 降序(externalSnapshot 同源):同文件只认最新一条——
    // 修复后的 passed 覆盖历史 failed,历史失败不再让大屏常红
    const latestByFile = new Map();
    for (const t of Array.isArray(dsh.externalTests) ? dsh.externalTests : []) {
      if (!t) continue;
      const k = String(t.file || '?');
      if (!latestByFile.has(k)) latestByFile.set(k, t);
    }
    for (const [file, t] of latestByFile) {
      if (t.status === 'failed') failedTests.push({ file, output: String(t.output || '').slice(-200) });
    }
    // DSH 内部测试运行:stale=true 表示源码已变、结果过期,不作为当前状态证据
    for (const r of Array.isArray(dsh.tests) ? dsh.tests : []) {
      if (r && r.status === 'failed' && !r.stale) failedTests.push({ file: String(r.file || r.id || 'run'), output: String(r.output || '').slice(-200) });
    }
    summary.dshVerified = Number(dsh.verifiedCount != null ? dsh.verifiedCount : (dsh.files || []).length);
    summary.dshUnverified = Number(dsh.unverifiedCount != null ? dsh.unverifiedCount : (dsh.unverified || []).length);
    summary.dshRed = redFiles.length;
    if (redFiles.length) issues.push('dsh:red-files:' + redFiles.join(','));
    if (failedTests.length) issues.push('dsh:test-failed:' + failedTests.map((t) => t.file).join(','));
  }

  const down = issues.some((i) => i.startsWith('dash:down') || i.startsWith('dsh:down'));
  const red = redFiles.length > 0 || failedTests.length > 0;
  const verdict = red ? 'RED' : down ? 'DEGRADED' : 'GREEN';
  return { verdict, ok: verdict === 'GREEN', issues, redFiles, failedTests, summary, at: now };
}

/* 采集两路真源;任一失败如实记 down,不吞异常 */
async function collect() {
  const [dash, dsh] = await Promise.allSettled([
    fetchJson(DASH + '/api/events'),
    fetchJson(LIVE + '/state'),
  ]);
  const pack = (r) => r.status === 'fulfilled'
    ? { ok: true, ...r.value }
    : { ok: false, error: String((r.reason && r.reason.message) || r.reason).slice(0, 120) };
  return { dash: pack(dash), dsh: pack(dsh) };
}

/* 账本:monitor-records/lookout.jsonl 逐笔追加,可审计 */
function appendRecord(rec) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(RECORDS), { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync(RECORDS, JSON.stringify(rec) + '\n');
}

/* 上屏:POST /api/event;失败静默(上屏不影响判定) */
async function report(event) {
  try {
    await fetch(DASH + '/api/event', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ source: 'CUA', ...event }),
    });
  } catch { /* 忽略 */ }
}

/* CUA 截图佐证(可选):MCP JSON-RPC over TCP 19333 → tools/list 挑截图工具 → 调用。
   失败如实返回 {shot:'unavailable:<原因>'},绝不伪造图片。 */
function cuaShot(outPng, ms = 20000) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let buf = '';
    let step = 0; // 0=initialize 1=initialized+tools/list 2=tools/call
    let shotTool = null;
    const sock = net.connect(CUA_TCP_PORT, '127.0.0.1');
    const done = (r) => { try { sock.destroy(); } catch {} resolve(r); };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => done({ shot: 'unavailable:timeout' }), ms);
    sock.on('error', (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); done({ shot: 'unavailable:' + (e.code || e.message) }); });
    sock.on('data', (d) => {
      buf += d.toString('utf8');
      let idx;
      while ((idx = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
        const line = buf.slice(0, idx); buf = buf.slice(idx + 1);
        if (!line.trim()) continue;
        let msg; try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { continue; }
        if (step === 0 && msg.id === 1) {
          step = 1;
          sock.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/initialized' }) + '\n');
          sock.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, method: 'tools/list', params: {} }) + '\n');
        } else if (step === 1 && msg.id === 2) {
          const tools = (msg.result && msg.result.tools) || [];
          shotTool = tools.find((t) => /screenshot|desktop_state|look_screen/i.test(t.name))
            || tools.find((t) => /^see$|^clip$/i.test(t.name)); // task 档案复合工具:see(看屏)/clip(截屏)
          if (!shotTool) { clearTimeout(timer); return done({ shot: 'unavailable:no-shot-tool:' + tools.map((t) => t.name).slice(0, 6).join(',') }); }
          step = 2;
          sock.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 3, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: shotTool.name, arguments: {} } }) + '\n');
        } else if (step === 2 && msg.id === 3) {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          const img = msg.result && Array.isArray(msg.result.content) && msg.result.content.find((c) => c.type === 'image');
          if (img && img.data) {
            try {
              fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPng), { recursive: true });
              fs.writeFileSync(outPng, Buffer.from(img.data, 'base64'));
              done({ shot: path.resolve(outPng), shotTool: shotTool.name, shotBytes: img.data.length });
            } catch (e) { done({ shot: 'unavailable:write:' + e.message.slice(0, 60) }); }
          } else {
            const txt = msg.result && msg.result.content && msg.result.content[0] && msg.result.content[0].text;
            done({ shot: 'unavailable:' + String(txt || 'no image in response').slice(0, 80) });
          }
        }
      }
    });
    sock.on('connect', () => {
      sock.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'initialize', params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'cua-lookout', version: '1.0.0' } } }) + '\n');
    });
  });
}

/* 一轮瞭望:采集 → 判定 → 账本 → 上屏(scan 事件;RED 时追加 error 事件)。
   截图仅在红绿翻转(或首轮)时存证:常驻模式下每轮都存会日涨数百 MB */
let lastVerdict = null;
async function round({ shotPath = null } = {}) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const { dash, dsh } = await collect();
  const v = judge(dash, dsh, t0);
  if (shotPath && v.verdict !== lastVerdict) {
    Object.assign(v, await cuaShot(shotPath));
  } else if (shotPath) {
    v.shot = 'skipped:no-verdict-change';
  }
  lastVerdict = v.verdict;
  v.durationMs = Date.now() - t0;
  appendRecord(v);
  await report({ kind: 'scan', tool: 'cua-lookout', target: `verdict=${v.verdict} red=${v.redFiles.length} failedTests=${v.failedTests.length} verified=${v.summary.dshVerified}` });
  if (v.verdict === 'RED') await report({ kind: 'error', tool: 'cua-lookout', target: v.issues.join(' | ').slice(0, 140) });
  return v;
}

function fmtLine(v) {
  const s = v.summary;
  return `[${new Date(v.at).toTimeString().slice(0, 8)}] ${v.verdict} (events=${s.dashEvents} verified=${s.dshVerified} unverified=${s.dshUnverified} red=${s.dshRed} failedTests=${v.failedTests.length}) ${v.issues.join(' | ')}`;
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const watchIdx = args.indexOf('--watch');
  const shotPath = args.includes('--shot') ? args[args.indexOf('--shot') + 1]
    : path.join(__dirname, 'monitor-records', 'lookout-' + Date.now() + '.png');

  if (watchIdx >= 0) {
    const sec = Math.max(30, Number(args[watchIdx + 1]) || 180);
    console.log(`cua-lookout: 常驻瞭望,每 ${sec}s 一轮,真源=${DASH} + ${LIVE},账本=${RECORDS}`);
    let stop = false;
    process.on('SIGINT', () => { stop = true; });
    while (!stop) {
      try { console.log(fmtLine(await round({ shotPath }))); }
      catch (e) { console.log('round error: ' + String(e.message || e)); }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, sec * 1000));
    }
  } else {
    const v = await round({ shotPath });
    console.log(fmtLine(v));
    console.log(JSON.stringify(v, null, 2));
    process.exitCode = v.ok ? 0 : 2;
  }
}

module.exports = { judge, collect, round, cuaShot, RECORDS };
if (require.main === module) main().catch((e) => { console.error(String(e && e.stack || e)); process.exit(1); });

```

  .fitem .g { color:#d9f6ff; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; flex:1; }
  .fitem .s { color:rgba(140,215,255,.35); font-size:9px; flex:none; }
  .colhead.files { margin-top:2px; }
  #files { flex:.8; overflow:auto; padding:2px 12px 8px; min-height:0; }
  .frow { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font:10.5px Consolas,monospace; padding:2.5px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(0,229,255,.08); }
  .frow b { color:#eaffff; }
  .meters { padding:4px 12px 10px; flex:none; }
  .mrow { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font:10.5px Consolas,monospace; padding:2px 0; color:rgba(150,220,255,.7); }
  .mrow b { color:#eaffff; }
  .meter { height:5px; background:rgba(0,229,255,.1); margin:2px 0 6px; }
  .meter i { display:block; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ok),var(--cyan)); transition:width .6s; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>数字孪生 · 左写右应 LIVE</h1>
  <span class="stat">写码<b id="cCode">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">执行<b id="cExec">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">异常<b id="cErr">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">模式<b id="mode">待机</b></span>
  <span id="ping" class="dim">连接中…</span>
</header>
<main>
  <!-- 左屏: 正在写 -->
  <section class="col">
    <div class="colhead">✍ 正在写 WRITING · <b id="curFile">等待第一个写码事件…</b><span class="ago" id="fileAgo"></span></div>
    <div id="fileView"><div class="empty" style="padding:10px 14px;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">DSH/ZCode 开始写码后, 这里显示该文件的真实磁盘内容(末尾 400 行), 新写入行绿色高亮</div></div>
    <div id="stream"><div class="tag">▸ 最新写入流 LATEST WRITE — 真实 old/new, 打字机回放</div><div id="streamBody" class="empty" style="padding:2px 0;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">等待事件…</div></div>
  </section>
  <!-- 右屏: 孪生墙 -->
  <section class="col">
    <div class="colhead">◈ 数字孪生 TWIN · 秒级同步</div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="cell"><span>事件总数</span><b id="cTotal">0</b></div>
      <div class="cell"><span>同步延迟</span><b id="lat">--</b></div>
      <div class="cell"><span>聚焦</span><b id="focus" style="font-size:11px">—</b></div>
    </div>
    <div class="colhead" style="margin-top:4px">▸ 编码活动 ACTIVITY</div>
    <div id="feed"><div class="empty" style="padding:6px 0;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">等待事件…</div></div>
    <div class="colhead files">▸ 文件注册表 FILES</div>
    <div id="files"></div>
    <div class="meters">
      <div class="mrow"><span>CPU</span><b id="mCpu">--</b></div><div class="meter"><i id="mCpuBar" style="width:0%"></i></div>
      <div class="mrow"><span>内存</span><b id="mMem">--</b></div><div class="meter"><i id="mMemBar" style="width:0%"></i></div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:3210';
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]; }); }
  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function tm(ts) { var d = new Date(ts); return pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()); }
  var ICON = { code: '✎', exec: '▶', scan: '⌕', task: '◆', error: '✖', idle: '◌', session: '⏻', tool: '◇' };
  var counts = { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 };
  var total = 0, lastAt = 0, lastKind = '', curKey = null;

  /* ---- 右屏: 活动流 ---- */
  function addEvent(e, silent) {
    if (!e) return;
    var k = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(counts, e.kind) ? e.kind : 'other';
    counts[k]++; total++;
    $('cCode').textContent = counts.code; $('cExec').textContent = counts.exec; $('cErr').textContent = counts.error; $('cTotal').textContent = total;
    var box = $('feed');
    if (box.firstChild && box.firstChild.className === 'empty') box.innerHTML = '';
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'fitem';
    div.innerHTML = '<span class="t">' + tm(e.ts) + '</span><span class="k-' + esc(e.kind) + '">' + (ICON[e.kind] || '◇') + '</span><span class="g">' + esc(e.tool || e.kind) + (e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : '') + '</span><span class="s">' + esc(e.source || '') + '</span>';
    box.insertBefore(div, box.firstChild);
    while (box.children.length > 20) box.removeChild(box.lastChild);
    lastAt = e.ts || Date.now(); lastKind = e.kind;
    if (e.file && e.file.name) $('focus').textContent = e.file.name;
    if (!silent) updateMode();
    if (e.kind === 'code') {
      if (e.diff && (e.diff.del || e.diff.ins)) typeWrite(e);
      if (e.file && e.file.key && e.file.key !== curKey) switchFile(e.file.key);
      else if (e.file && e.file.key === curKey) refreshFile(true);
    }
  }
  function updateMode() {
    var ago = lastAt ? Date.now() - lastAt : 1e9;
    var t = '待机';
    if (ago < 9000) {
      if (lastKind === 'code') t = '编码中';
      else if (lastKind === 'exec') t = '调试中';
      else if (lastKind === 'error') t = '排障中';
      else if (lastKind === 'task') t = '规划中';
      else t = '检索中';
    } else if (ago < 60000) t = '活跃';
    $('mode').textContent = t;
  }
  setInterval(function () {
    updateMode();
    var ago = lastAt ? (Date.now() - lastAt) / 1000 : null;
    var p = $('ping');
    if (ago === null) { p.textContent = '未收到事件'; p.className = 'dim'; }
    else if (ago < 10) { p.textContent = '● ' + ago.toFixed(1) + 's 前同步'; p.className = 'ok'; }
    else { p.textContent = '○ ' + Math.round(ago) + 's 前同步'; p.className = 'dim'; }
    if (curKey) { var s = Math.round((Date.now() - fileTs) / 1000); $('fileAgo').textContent = s + 's 前写入'; }
  }, 300);

  /* ---- 左屏: 真实文件内容 ---- */
  var fileTs = 0;
  function switchFile(key) {
    curKey = key;
    fetch(BASE + '/api/file?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key)).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (f) {
      if (f.error) return;
      $('curFile').textContent = f.name;
      fileTs = Date.now();
      renderFile(f.content);
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  function refreshFile() { if (curKey) switchFile(curKey); }
  function renderFile(content) {
    var lines = String(content || '').split('\n');
    var tail = lines.slice(-400);
    var start = lines.length - tail.length + 1;
    var html = tail.map(function (l, i) {
      return '<div class="ln"><em>' + (start + i) + '</em><span>' + esc(l) + '</span></div>';
    }).join('') || '<div class="empty">空文件</div>';
    var v = $('fileView');
    v.innerHTML = html;
    v.scrollTop = v.scrollHeight;
  }

  /* ---- 左屏: 打字机回放最新写入 ---- */
  var typeTimer = null;
  function typeWrite(e) {
    if (typeTimer) { clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer = null; }
    var body = $('streamBody');
    var dels = String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').filter(function (s) { return s !== ''; });
    var inss = String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n');
    var seq = [];
    dels.slice(0, 6).forEach(function (l) { seq.push({ c: 'dl-del', t: '− ' + l }); });
    inss.slice(0, 10).forEach(function (l) { seq.push({ c: 'dl-ins fresh', t: '+ ' + l }); });
    body.innerHTML = '';
    var i = 0;
    typeTimer = setInterval(function () {
      if (i >= seq.length) { clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer = null; return; }
      var d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = seq[i].c;
      d.textContent = seq[i].t;
      body.appendChild(d);
      $('stream').scrollTop = $('stream').scrollHeight;
      i++;
    }, 90);
  }

  /* ---- 指标 / 文件表 ---- */
  function loadMetrics() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/metrics').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (m) {
      $('mCpu').textContent = m.cpu.avgPct + '%'; $('mCpuBar').style.width = Math.min(100, m.cpu.avgPct) + '%';
      $('mMem').textContent = m.mem.usedGB + ' / ' + m.mem.totalGB + ' GB'; $('mMemBar').style.width = m.mem.pct + '%';
    }).catch(function () {});
    fetch(BASE + '/api/files').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      $('files').innerHTML = (d.files || []).slice(0, 10).map(function (f) {
        return '<div class="frow"><span>' + esc(f.name) + '</span><b>' + f.edits + ' 次修改</b></div>';
      }).join('') || '<div class="empty">暂无</div>';
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  loadMetrics(); setInterval(loadMetrics, 30000);

  function loadEvents() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/events').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      (d.events || []).slice(-18).forEach(function (e) { addEvent(e, true); });
      var lastCode = (d.events || []).filter(function (e) { return e.kind === 'code' && e.file; }).pop();
      if (lastCode && lastCode.file) {
        curKey = lastCode.file.key;
        $('curFile').textContent = lastCode.file.name;
        fetch(BASE + '/api/file?key=' + encodeURIComponent(curKey)).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (f) {
          if (!f.error) { fileTs = lastCode.ts || Date.now(); renderFile(f.content); }
        }).catch(function () {});
      }
      updateMode();
    }).catch(function () { $('ping').textContent = '✖ 离线 — node server.js 未启动'; $('ping').className = 'err'; });
  }
  loadEvents();

  try {
    var es = new EventSource(BASE + '/api/stream');
    es.onopen = function () { $('ping').textContent = '● LIVE'; $('ping').className = 'ok'; };
    es.onmessage = function (m) {
      try {
        var d = JSON.parse(m.data);
        if (d.type === 'event' && d.event) {
          addEvent(d.event);
          var lat = Date.now() - (d.event.ts || Date.now());
          $('lat').textContent = (lat >= 0 ? lat : 0) + 'ms';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    es.onerror = function () { $('ping').textContent = '重连中…'; $('ping').className = 'err'; };
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* ============================================================
 * dsh-hook.js — ZCode hooks -> 数字孪生大屏 桥接脚本
 *
 * 由 ~/.zcode/cli/config.json 的 hooks 调用:
 *   node dsh-hook.js <kind>     kind: code|exec|scan|tool|error|task|idle|session
 *
 * 设计原则:
 *   - 立即派生 detached 子进程上报, 本进程毫秒级退出, 不拖慢智能体
 *   - stdin 的 hook JSON 尽力解析(字段名多方案兼容), 解析不出也照样上报
 *   - stdout 保持空 / exit 0 (hook 输出会被当 JSON 校验)
 *   - 大屏没开时连接秒拒, 静默丢弃
 * ============================================================ */
'use strict';
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');

const ENDPOINT = process.env.DSH_MONITOR_ENDPOINT || 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/event';

/* ---- 子进程模式: 真正发 POST ---- */
if (process.argv[2] === '_send') {
  try {
    const file = process.argv[3];
    const body = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    fs.unlink(file, () => {});
    const u = new URL(ENDPOINT);
    const mod = require(u.protocol === 'https:' ? 'https' : 'http');
    const req = mod.request({
      hostname: u.hostname,
      port: u.port || (u.protocol === 'https:' ? 443 : 80),
      path: u.pathname,
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body) },
      timeout: 1500,
    });
    req.on('error', () => {});
    req.on('timeout', () => req.destroy());
    req.end(body);
  } catch { /* 上报失败永不影响主流程 */ }
  const t = setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 1800);
  if (t.unref) t.unref(); // POST 正常收尾即退出, 不白等 1.8s
  return void 0;
}

/* ---- 主模式: 收集 stdin -> 派生 _send -> 立即退出 ---- */
function guessKind(tool) {
  const t = String(tool);
  if (/^(Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|ApplyPatch)/.test(t)) return 'code';
  if (/^(Bash|PowerShell|Shell|Terminal|Execute)/.test(t)) return 'exec';
  if (/^(Read|Grep|Glob|List|Search|Find)/.test(t)) return 'scan';
  return 'tool';
}

/* 从工具入参提取真实代码变更 (Edit 的 old/new_string, Write 的 content) */
function extractDiff(kind, tool, input) {
  try {
    if (kind !== 'code' || !input || typeof input !== 'object') return null;
    if (/MultiEdit/i.test(tool) && Array.isArray(input.edits) && input.edits.length) {
      const e0 = input.edits[0] || {};
      return { del: String(e0.old_string || '').slice(0, 800), ins: String(e0.new_string || '').slice(0, 800) };
    }
    if (input.old_string !== undefined || input.new_string !== undefined) {
      return { del: String(input.old_string || '').slice(0, 800), ins: String(input.new_string || '').slice(0, 800) };
    }
    if (input.content !== undefined) {
      return { del: '', ins: String(input.content).slice(0, 800) };
    }
    return null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

function send() {
  clearTimeout(timer);
  let data = {};
  try { data = JSON.parse(raw || '{}') || {}; } catch { /* stdin 不是 JSON 也继续 */ }
  const tool = data.tool_name || data.tool || data.name || '';
  const input = data.tool_input || data.input || data.arguments || {};
  const targetRaw = input.file_path || input.notebook_path || input.path || input.pattern
    || input.command || input.url || input.query || data.prompt || '';
  const kind = process.argv[2] || guessKind(tool);
  const ev = {
    ts: Date.now(),
    host: os.hostname(),
    source: 'ZCODE',
    kind,
    tool: String(tool || kind).slice(0, 40),
    target: String(targetRaw).slice(0, 140),
    status: kind === 'error' ? 'error' : 'ok',
    session: String(process.env.CLAUDE_SESSION_ID || process.env.ZCODE_SESSION_ID || '').slice(0, 40),
    cwd: String(data.cwd || process.env.CLAUDE_CWD || process.env.ZCODE_CWD || '').slice(0, 200),
    diff: extractDiff(kind, tool, input),
  };
  try {
    /* 唯一文件名: 并发工具调用不会互相覆盖 payload */
    const pf = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'dsh-monitor-' + Date.now().toString(36) + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) + '.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(pf, JSON.stringify(ev));
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [__filename, '_send', pf], {
      detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true,
    });
    child.unref();
  } catch { /* 派生失败静默 */ }
  process.exit(0);
}

let raw = '';
const timer = setTimeout(send, 400);
try {
  process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');
  process.stdin.on('data', (c) => { raw += c; });
  process.stdin.on('end', send);
  process.stdin.on('error', send);
} catch { send(); }

// e2e-verify.cjs — 技术验证运行器: T1 低档起步 / T2 复杂度高档起步 / 证据采集
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');

const SANDBOX = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox';

}

console.log('T2 reply-tail:', t2.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim()).pop().slice(0, 120));

// ── 证据: 梯子事件 ──

evs.forEach((e) => console.log(' ', e.ev, '|', e.code || '', '|', e.from || '', '->', e.to || '', '| score:', e.score ?? '', '| rung:', e.rung ?? '', '| rung-idx:', e.idx ?? ''));

const smart = evs.filter((e) => e.ev === 'smart_start');

}

// inspect-session.cjs — 查看会话 JSONL 的真实结构
const zlib = require('node:zlib');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const src = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox/dsh-home/sessions/--C-Users-64562-WorkBuddy-2026-10-12-13-09-47-dsh-sandbox--/session-ad31b52b-ae64-4550-a0c3-effc2aa3d067/session.v4.jsonl.zstd';

function decode() {
  const b = fs.readFileSync(src);
  const chunks = [];
  let o = 0;
  const M = Buffer.from([0x28, 0xb5, 0x2f, 0xfd]);
  while (o < b.length - 3) {
    if (b.readUInt32LE(o) !== 4247762216) { o++; continue; }
    let n = b.indexOf(M, o + 4);
    if (n === -1) n = b.length;
    try { chunks.push(zlib.zstdDecompressSync(b.subarray(o, n))); } catch (e) {}
    o = n;
  }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
}

const text = decode();
const lines = text.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim());
const types = {};
lines.forEach((l) => {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(l);
    const k = [j.type, j.level || '', (j.payload && j.payload.type) || ''].join('|');
    types[k] = (types[k] || 0) + 1;
  } catch { types['parse-err'] = (types['parse-err'] || 0) + 1; }
});
console.log('TYPE 分布:');
Object.entries(types).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 14).forEach((x) => console.log(' ', x[0], 'x' + x[1]));
console.log('\n--- 样本行 3 ---');
console.log((lines[2] || '').slice(0, 700));
console.log('\n--- 样本行 10 ---');
console.log((lines[9] || '').slice(0, 700));
console.log('\n--- 最后一行 ---');
console.log((lines[lines.length - 1] || '').slice(0, 900));

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
// ladder-daily.cjs — free-ladder.log 按天流量分析(补 model-sentinel v1「全量口径非按天」的已知局限)
//
// 真源:sandbox/dsh-home/free-ladder.log,行格式 = 24 字符 ISO 时间戳 + 空格 + JSON。
// 日界语义:**本地日**(默认机器时区;--tz 可指定分钟偏移,如 480=UTC+8)——日志是 Z 时间,
// 直接按 UTC 分组会把本地晚 8 点后的流量记到"昨天",对夜跑基准是毒药。
//
// 用法:
//   node ladder-daily.cjs                 人读表格
//   node ladder-daily.cjs --json          机器输出(供审计/基准)
//   node ladder-daily.cjs --from 2026-11-01 --to 2026-11-07   含边界过滤
//   node ladder-daily.cjs --log <path>    指定日志路径(默认工地家)
//
// 验收:test-ladder-daily.cjs —— 全量口径必须与 model-sentinel.cjs(独立解析器)对账全等。
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');

const DEFAULT_LOG = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox/dsh-home/free-ladder.log';

/* 时间戳 → 本地日字符串。tzOffsetMin=本地相对 UTC 的分钟偏移(480=UTC+8);缺省=运行机器时区 */
function dayOf(ts, tzOffsetMin = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset()) {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return new Date(d.getTime() + tzOffsetMin * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

const blankDay = (date) => ({
  date, events: 0, rotate: 0, quota: 0, rateLimit: 0, override: 0,
  paidSwitch: 0, exhaust: 0, saw: 0, sessions: new Set(),
});

/* 纯函数:行数组 → 按天+总量统计(单测见 test-ladder-daily.cjs) */
function analyze(lines, { tzOffsetMin, from, to } = {}) {
  const tz = tzOffsetMin != null ? tzOffsetMin : -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
  const days = new Map();
  const models = new Map();
  const totals = blankDay('TOTAL');
  let parseErrors = 0, blank = 0;

  for (const raw of lines) {
    if (!raw || !raw.trim()) { blank++; continue; }
    if (raw.length < 25) { parseErrors++; continue; }
    const date = dayOf(raw.slice(0, 24), tz);
    if (!date) { parseErrors++; continue; }
    let ev;
    try { ev = JSON.parse(raw.slice(25)); } catch { parseErrors++; continue; }
    if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object' || !ev.ev) { parseErrors++; continue; }
    if (from && date < from) continue;
    if (to && date > to) continue;

    const day = days.get(date) || blankDay(date);
    days.set(date, day);
    day.events++; totals.events++;

    if (ev.ev === 'rotate') {
      day.rotate++; totals.rotate++;
      if (ev.code === 'QUOTA') { day.quota++; totals.quota++; }
      else if (ev.code === 'RATE_LIMIT') { day.rateLimit++; totals.rateLimit++; }
    } else if (ev.ev === 'req_route_override') {
      day.override++; totals.override++;
    } else if (ev.ev === 'paid_switch') {
      day.paidSwitch++; totals.paidSwitch++;
    } else if (ev.ev === 'exhaust') {
      day.exhaust++; totals.exhaust++;
    } else if (ev.ev === 'saw') {
      day.saw++; totals.saw++;
    } else if (ev.ev === 'req_seed' && ev.provider && ev.model) {
      const id = ev.provider + '/' + ev.model;
      models.set(id, (models.get(id) || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (ev.sessionId) { day.sessions.add(ev.sessionId); totals.sessions.add(ev.sessionId); }
  }

  const serialize = (d) => ({ ...d, sessions: d.sessions.size });
  const dayArr = [...days.values()].sort((a, b) => a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1).map(serialize);
  const modelArr = [...models.entries()].map(([model, count]) => ({ model, count }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
  return {
    parseErrors, blank,
    days: dayArr,
    totals: { ...serialize(totals) },
    models: modelArr,
    topModel: modelArr[0] || null,
  };
}

/* 每日 topModel:从 req_seed 按天聚合(analyze 只出全局 models,这里补按天维) */
function topModelByDay(lines, tzOffsetMin) {
  const tz = tzOffsetMin != null ? tzOffsetMin : -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
  const per = new Map();
  for (const raw of lines) {
    if (!raw || raw.length < 25) continue;
    let ev; try { ev = JSON.parse(raw.slice(25)); } catch { continue; }
    if (!ev || ev.ev !== 'req_seed' || !ev.provider || !ev.model) continue;
    const date = dayOf(raw.slice(0, 24), tz);
    if (!date) continue;
    const m = per.get(date) || new Map();
    const id = ev.provider + '/' + ev.model;
    m.set(id, (m.get(id) || 0) + 1);
    per.set(date, m);
  }
  const out = new Map();
  for (const [date, m] of per) {
    const top = [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
    out.set(date, { model: top[0], count: top[1] });
  }
  return out;
}

function fmtTable(r, topByDay) {
  const pad = (s, n) => String(s).padEnd(n);
  const head = pad('日期', 12) + pad('事件', 6) + pad('rotate', 8) + pad('QUOTA', 7) + pad('RATELIM', 9) + pad('override', 10) + pad('exhaust', 9) + pad('paid', 6) + pad('会话', 6) + '当日主力模型';
  const rows = r.days.map((d) => {
    const tm = topByDay.get(d.date);
    return pad(d.date, 12) + pad(d.events, 6) + pad(d.rotate, 8) + pad(d.quota, 7) + pad(d.rateLimit, 9) + pad(d.override, 10) + pad(d.exhaust, 9) + pad(d.paidSwitch, 6) + pad(d.sessions, 6) + (tm ? `${tm.model} ×${tm.count}` : '-');
  });
  const t = r.totals;
  const total = pad('TOTAL', 12) + pad(t.events, 6) + pad(t.rotate, 8) + pad(t.quota, 7) + pad(t.rateLimit, 9) + pad(t.override, 10) + pad(t.exhaust, 9) + pad(t.paidSwitch, 6) + pad(t.sessions, 6) + (r.topModel ? `${r.topModel.model} ×${r.topModel.count}` : '-');
  return [head, '-'.repeat(head.length), ...rows, '-'.repeat(head.length), total].join('\n')
    + `\n\nparseErrors=${r.parseErrors} blankLines=${r.blank}`;
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const get = (k) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : null;
  const logPath = get('--log') || DEFAULT_LOG;
  const from = get('--from'), to = get('--to');
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').split('\n');
  const r = analyze(lines, { from: from || undefined, to: to || undefined });
  if (args.includes('--json')) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), log: logPath,
      tz: 'local(' + -new Date().getTimezoneOffset() + 'min)',
      from: from || null, to: to || null,
      totals: r.totals, days: r.days, models: r.models.slice(0, 12),
      parseErrors: r.parseErrors, blank: r.blank,
    }, null, 2));
  } else {
    console.log('ladder-daily — ' + logPath + (from || to ? ` (窗口 ${from || '…'} ~ ${to || '…'})` : ''));
    console.log(fmtTable(r, topModelByDay(lines, undefined)));
  }
  process.exitCode = r.parseErrors > 0 ? 0 : 0; // 解析错不失败,如实展示;真验收在测试里
}

module.exports = { analyze, dayOf, topModelByDay };
if (require.main === module) main().catch((e) => { console.error(String(e && e.stack || e)); process.exit(1); });

```

// memory-drive.cjs — 向 DSH 记忆库写入监控侧事实并当场召回验证
'use strict';
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');

const SERVER = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox/mcp/memory/server.mjs';
const CWD = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox';

const child = spawn(process.execPath, [SERVER], { cwd: CWD, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
let buf = '';
const waiters = new Map();
let id = 0;
child.stdout.on('data', (c) => {
  buf += c;
  let idx;
  while ((idx = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
    const line = buf.slice(0, idx).trim();
    buf = buf.slice(idx + 1);
    if (!line) continue;
    try {
      const f = JSON.parse(line);
      const w = waiters.get(f.id);
      if (w) { waiters.delete(f.id); w(f); }
    } catch { /* 非 JSON 行忽略 */ }
  }
});
child.stderr.on('data', () => { /* 诊断走 stderr, 不打印 */ });

function send(method, params) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const idv = ++id;
    waiters.set(idv, res);
    child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: idv, method, params }) + '\n');
    setTimeout(() => { if (waiters.has(idv)) { waiters.delete(idv); rej(new Error('timeout: ' + method)); } }, 60000);
  });
}

(async () => {
  const init = await send('initialize', {
    protocolVersion: '2025-06-18',
    capabilities: {},
    clientInfo: { name: 'twin-verify', version: '1.0' },
  });
  console.log('INIT:', init.result ? 'ok v' + (init.result.serverInfo && init.result.serverInfo.version) : JSON.stringify(init).slice(0, 120));
  child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/initialized' }) + '\n');

  const fact = '数字孪生花费哨兵位于 C:/Users/64562/Scripts/model-sentinel/model-sentinel.cjs,用 node 运行(支持 --json 参数),审计 DSH 模型路由花费(rotate/QUOTA/付费兜底次数)与 DeepSeek 官方余额。由 ZCode 监控侧于 2026-10-31 写入。';
  const rem = await send('tools/call', { name: 'memory_remember', arguments: { text: fact, category: 'environment' } });
  console.log('REMEMBER:', JSON.stringify(rem.result || rem).slice(0, 220));

  const rec = await send('tools/call', { name: 'memory_recall', arguments: { query: '花费审计工具 sentinel 在哪里 怎么运行', top_k: 3 } });
  const txt = JSON.stringify(rec.result || rec);
  console.log('RECALL-HIT:', txt.includes('model-sentinel') ? '✅ 事实已入库且可召回' : '❌ 未命中');
  console.log('RECALL-DETAIL:', txt.slice(0, 420));
  child.kill();
  process.exit(0);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FAIL', e.message); try { child.kill(); } catch {} process.exit(1); });

      <div class="mrow"><span>内存</span><b id="mMem">--</b></div><div class="meter"><i id="mMemBar" style="width:0%"></i></div>
    </div>
  </div>
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:3210';
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var last = { ts: 0, kind: '' };
  var counts = { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 };
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]; }); }
  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function tm(ts) { var d = new Date(ts); return pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()); }
  var ICON = { code: '✎', exec: '▶', scan: '⌕', task: '◆', error: '✖', idle: '◌', session: '⏻', tool: '◇' };
  function addEvent(e, silent) {
    if (!e) return;
    var k = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(counts, e.kind) ? e.kind : 'other';
    counts[k]++;
    $('cCode').textContent = counts.code; $('cExec').textContent = counts.exec; $('cErr').textContent = counts.error;
    var box = $('feed');
    if (box.firstChild && box.firstChild.className === 'empty') box.innerHTML = '';
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'fitem';
    div.innerHTML = '<span class="t">' + tm(e.ts) + '</span><span class="k-' + esc(e.kind) + '">' + (ICON[e.kind] || '◇') + '</span><span class="g">' + esc(e.tool || e.kind) + (e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : '') + '</span><span class="s">' + esc(e.source || '') + '</span>';
    box.insertBefore(div, box.firstChild);
    while (box.children.length > 16) box.removeChild(box.lastChild);
    last = { ts: e.ts || Date.now(), kind: e.kind };
    if (e.file && e.file.name) $('focus').textContent = e.file.name;
    if (!silent) updateMode();
    if (e.diff && (e.diff.del || e.diff.ins)) { renderDiff(e); pushRecent(e); }
  }
  /* 近期变更列表: 最多 6 条, 点击回看那一版的红线 */
  var recentDiffs = [];
  function pushRecent(e) {
    var k = (e.ts || 0) + '|' + (e.tool || '') + '|' + (e.target || '');
    if (recentDiffs.some(function (x) { return x.k === k; })) return;
    e.k = k;
    recentDiffs.unshift(e);
    if (recentDiffs.length > 6) recentDiffs.pop();
    renderRecent();
  }
  function renderRecent() {
    $('rdlist').innerHTML = recentDiffs.map(function (e, i) {
      var n = String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').length;
      var m = String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').filter(function (s) { return s !== ''; }).length;
      return '<div class="rdrow" data-i="' + i + '"><span class="n">' + esc((e.file && e.file.name) || e.target || '') + '</span><span class="p">+' + n + '</span><span class="m">−' + m + '</span><span class="t2">' + tm(e.ts) + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($('rdlist').children, function (el, i) {
      el.onclick = function () { renderDiff(recentDiffs[i]); };
    });
  }
  function renderDiff(e) {
    var f = $('diffFile');
    f.className = '';
    f.innerHTML = '<b>' + esc((e.file && e.file.name) || e.target || '变更') + '</b><span>+' + String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').length + ' −' + String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').length + ' · ' + esc(e.tool || '') + ' · ' + tm(e.ts || Date.now()) + '</span>';
    var html = '';
    String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').slice(0, 10).forEach(function (l) { html += '<div class="dl-del">− ' + esc(l) + '</div>'; });
    String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').slice(0, 12).forEach(function (l) { html += '<div class="dl-ins">+ ' + esc(l) + '</div>'; });
    $('diff').innerHTML = html;
  }
  function updateMode() {
    var ago = last.ts ? Date.now() - last.ts : 1e9;
    var m = 'idle', t = '待机';
    if (ago < 9000) {
      if (last.kind === 'code') { m = 'coding'; t = '编码中'; }
      else if (last.kind === 'exec') { m = 'debug'; t = '调试中'; }
      else if (last.kind === 'error') { m = 'fault'; t = '排障中'; }
      else if (last.kind === 'task') { m = 'coding'; t = '规划中'; }
      else { m = 'scan'; t = '检索中'; }
    } else if (ago < 60000) { m = 'scan'; t = '活跃'; }
    var el = $('mode'); el.textContent = t; el.className = m;
  }
  setInterval(updateMode, 1000);
  setInterval(function () { var d = new Date(); $('clock').textContent = pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()); }, 500);
  function loadMetrics() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/metrics').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (m) {
      $('mCpu').textContent = m.cpu.avgPct + '%'; $('mCpuBar').style.width = Math.min(100, m.cpu.avgPct) + '%';
      $('mMem').textContent = m.mem.usedGB + ' / ' + m.mem.totalGB + ' GB'; $('mMemBar').style.width = m.mem.pct + '%';
    }).catch(function () {});
    fetch(BASE + '/api/files').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      var fs2 = (d.files || []).slice(0, 8);
      $('files').innerHTML = fs2.map(function (f) {
        return '<div class="frow"><span>' + esc(f.name) + '</span><b>' + f.edits + ' 次修改</b></div>';
      }).join('') || '<div class="empty">暂无文件</div>';
      var wd = (d.files || []).filter(function (f) { return f.lastDiff; })[0];
      if (wd && !$('diff').innerHTML) renderDiff({ file: wd, diff: wd.lastDiff, tool: '恢复', ts: wd.lastTs });
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  function loadEvents() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/events').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      /* 时间正序回放, 插入到顶部后自然变成最新在上 */
      (d.events || []).slice(-16).forEach(function (e) { addEvent(e, true); });
      updateMode();
    }).catch(function () { $('conn').textContent = '✖ 离线 — 大屏服务(node server.js)未启动'; $('conn').className = 'err'; });
  }
  loadMetrics(); loadEvents();
  setInterval(loadMetrics, 30000);
  /* 自动化/无头环境跳过 SSE 长连接 (?nostream=1) */
  if (/[?&]nostream=1/.test(location.search)) return;
  try {
    var es = new EventSource(BASE + '/api/stream');
    es.onopen = function () { $('conn').textContent = '● LIVE — 已连接大屏数据服务 (每3分钟同步系统指标 / 编码事件实时推送)'; $('conn').className = 'ok'; };
    es.onmessage = function (m) { try { var d = JSON.parse(m.data); if (d.type === 'event' && d.event) addEvent(d.event); } catch (e) {} };
    es.onerror = function () { $('conn').textContent = '重连中…'; $('conn').className = 'err'; };
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

// od-run-start.cjs — 在指定 OpenDesign 项目上启动设计 run(重跑失败流程用)
// 用法: node od-run-start.cjs <projectId> <promptFile>
'use strict';
const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');

const id = process.argv[2];
const promptFile = process.argv[3];
if (!id || !promptFile) { console.error('usage: node od-run-start.cjs <projectId> <promptFile>'); process.exit(2); }
const prompt = fs.readFileSync(promptFile, 'utf8').trim();

function post(path, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const data = JSON.stringify(body);
    const r = http.request({
      hostname: '127.0.0.1', port: 17456, path, method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(data) },
      timeout: 30000,
    }, (res) => {
      let b = '';
      res.on('data', (c) => (b += c));
      res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, body: b }));
    });
    r.on('error', reject);
    r.write(data);
    r.end();
  });
}

(async () => {
  let r = await post(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/conversations`, { sessionMode: 'design' });
  console.log('CONV:', r.status, r.body.slice(0, 220));
  let conv = null;
  try { conv = JSON.parse(r.body).conversation || JSON.parse(r.body); } catch {}
  const cid = conv && conv.id;

  r = await post('/api/runs', { projectId: id, conversationId: cid, prompt });
  console.log('RUN:', r.status, r.body.slice(0, 600));
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FAIL', e.message); process.exit(1); });
