```
/* 临时脚本: 在 OpenDesign(daemon 17456) 创建监控项目并挂载内嵌大屏工件 */
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:17456';

function req(method, p, body) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const data = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : null;
    const u = new URL(BASE + p);
    const r = http.request({
      hostname: u.hostname,
      port: u.port || 80,
      path: u.pathname + u.search,
      method,
      headers: data
        ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(data) }
        : {},
      timeout: 15000,
    }, (res) => {
      let b = '';
      res.on('data', (c) => (b += c));
      res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, json: (() => { try { return JSON.parse(b); } catch { return b.slice(0, 400); } })() }));
    });
    r.on('error', reject);
    if (data) r.write(data);
    r.end();
  });
}

(async () => {
  /* 用法: node od-setup.js [已有项目id]  — 不传则新建项目 */
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(5, 16).replace('T', '-');
  let id = process.argv[2] || '';
  if (!id) {
    /* 1. 建项目 (daemon 要求客户端生成 od- 前缀的 slug id) */
    const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
    const name = `数字孪生·代码城市监控-${stamp}`;
    const pr = await req('POST', '/api/projects', { id: `od-dtw-${rand}`, name, skipDiscoveryBrief: true });
    console.log('CREATE-PROJECT', pr.status, JSON.stringify(pr.json).slice(0, 260));
    const proj = pr.json && (pr.json.project || pr.json);
    id = proj && proj.id;
    if (!id) { console.error('NO-PROJECT-ID'); process.exit(1); }
  }

  /* 2. 挂载内嵌大屏工件 (左写右应分屏版) */
  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'live.html'), 'utf8');
  const fr = await req('POST', `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/files`, {
    name: 'digital-twin.html',
    content: html,
    encoding: 'utf8',
  });
  console.log('CREATE-ARTIFACT', fr.status, JSON.stringify(fr.json).slice(0, 260));

  /* 3. 校验可读 */
  const vr = await req('GET', `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/raw/digital-twin.html`);
  console.log('VERIFY', vr.status, 'bytes:', typeof vr.json === 'string' ? vr.json.length : JSON.stringify(vr.json).length);
  console.log('PROJECT-ID:', id);

  /* 4. 同步写 DSH present 交付物(稳定绝对路径, 供 DSH 技能 digital-twin 使用) */
  const deliverable = path.join(__dirname, 'dsh-deliverable.html');
  fs.copyFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'live.html'), deliverable);
  console.log('DSH-DELIVERABLE:', deliverable);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FAIL', e.message); process.exit(1); });

// patch-default-home.cjs — 缺省家(~/.dsh)补装:智能升梯 + 梯底默认档(堵住"无 DSH_HOME 启动绕过模型池"的洞)
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const f = 'C:/Users/64562/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml';
let s = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
let n = 0;

fs.copyFileSync(f, f + '.bak-ascending-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:T]/g, '-').slice(0, 19));
console.log('backup OK');

const block = `
# ── 2026-10-31 用户令:缺省家也启用智能模型池(质量从低到高升梯,耗尽才见付费确认)──
# 根因:无 DSH_HOME 的 ad-hoc 启动落在本家,绕过工地家的模型池 → 意外直连付费档(已实际发生)。
# 本块 = 工地家同款:梯底默认档 + 11 档免费升梯 + 失败自动爬升;付费仅存于「确认付费」门。
# 免费档质量从低到高:kilo 轻量 → 魔搭 Qwen/GLM → ovh 殿后。
- insert:
    - id: agent-default-model
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
      config:
        provider: kilo-free
        model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free
- insert:
    - id: free-ladder
      name: 'dsh-plugin-free-ladder'
      config:
        ladder:
          - 'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free'
          - 'kilo-free/poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free'
          - 'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free'
          - 'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next'
          - 'ovh-free/Qwen3.5-9B'
          - 'kilo-free/recursive/flint-v1.0:free'
          - 'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B'
          - 'kilo-free/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free'
          - 'modelscope/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B'
          - 'modelscope/ZhipuAI/GLM-5.2'
          - 'ovh-free/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B'
`;

if (!s.includes('id: free-ladder') && !s.includes('agent-default-model')) {
  s = s.trimEnd() + '\n' + block;
  fs.writeFileSync(f, s);
  n++; console.log('default-home patch: applied');
} else console.log('already present — skipped');
console.log('done, changes:', n);

const ctorOld = "    ctx.inject(['tools'], (scope) => {\n      scope.tools.guard((exec) => this.observe(exec));\n    });\n  }";
const ctorNew = `    ctx.inject(['tools'], (scope) => {
      scope.tools.guard((exec) => this.observe(exec));
    });
    /** 会话事件:转发 DSH 跑过的 node 测试结果到 live-code 面板(fire-and-forget, fail-open) */
    this.calls = new Map();
    ctx.on?.('session/event', (p1, p2) => {
      try {
        const session = (p1 && p1.session) ? p1.session : p1;
        const event = (p1 && p1.event) ? p1.event : p2;
        if (!session || !event) return;
        const d = event.data || {};
        if (event.type === 'tool/call') {
          let cmd = '';
          try { const a = typeof d.arguments === 'string' ? JSON.parse(d.arguments) : (d.arguments || {}); cmd = String(a.command || a.cmd || ''); } catch { cmd = ''; }
          if (d.callId) { this.calls.set(d.callId, { name: d.name, cmd: cmd.slice(0, 300) }); if (this.calls.size > 200) { const fk = this.calls.keys().next().value; this.calls.delete(fk); } }
          return;
        }
        if (event.type !== 'tool/result') return;
        const callId = (d.message && d.message.source && d.message.source.callId) || d.toolCallId || '';
        const call = this.calls.get(callId) || {};
        const cmd = call.cmd || '';
        const text = (d.message && Array.isArray(d.message.content)) ? d.message.content.map((c) => (c && c.text) || '').join('\\n') : '';
        const isTest = /--test|\\btest-[\\w.-]+\\.c?js|\\.(test|spec)\\.[cm]?js/i.test(cmd);
        const hasSummary = /# pass \\d|# fail \\d|✅|✔|pass \\d+/i.test(text);
        if (!isTest && !hasSummary) return;
        const status = /# fail [1-9]|✖|not ok/i.test(text) ? 'failed' : /# pass \\d+|✔|passed/i.test(text) ? 'passed' : 'unknown';
        const fileM = cmd.match(/([\\w./\\\\-]+\\.(?:test|spec)\\.[cm]?js|test-[\\w.-]+\\.c?js)/i);
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          file: fileM ? fileM[1] : cmd.slice(0, 60),
          status, output: text.slice(-800), command: cmd.slice(0, 200), at: Date.now(),
        });
        const u = new URL(this.config.liveCodeTestEndpoint);

          timeout: 1000,
        });
        rq.on('error', () => {});
        rq.on('timeout', () => rq.destroy());
        rq.end(body);
      } catch { /* 静默 */ }
    });
  }`;

// patch-repair.cjs — live-code: 红色修复手段(调用 DSH headless 直接调查修复)
'use strict';
const fs = require('node:fs');
const f = 'C:/Users/64562/WorkBuddy/2026-10-12-13-09-47/dsh-sandbox/plugins/live-code/index.js';
let s = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
let n = 0;

// ① import path
if (!/import path from 'node:path';/.test(s)) {
  s = s.replace("import fs from 'node:fs';", "import fs from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';");
  n++; console.log('import path: added');
}

// ② RepairRuns 类(插在 Engine import 之后)
if (!s.includes('class RepairRuns')) {
  const anchor = "import { Engine } from './engine.mjs?types=2';";
  const cls = anchor + `

const PLUGIN_DIR = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const DSH_BIN = path.resolve(PLUGIN_DIR, '../../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js');
/** 红色修复手段: 调用 DSH headless 直接调查并修复真实失败的文件(修复会话本身也在大屏可见) */
class RepairRuns {
  constructor(engine) {
    this.engine = engine;
    this.runs = new Map();
    this.children = new Map();
  }
  start(id) {
    const f = this.engine.files.get(id);
    if (!f) throw Error('unknown file');
    if (f.status !== 'failed') throw Error('红线: 只有真实检查失败(failed)的文件才需要修复');
    if (this.children.has(id)) throw Error('该文件已有修复在运行');
    if (this.children.size >= 2) throw Error('已有 2 个修复在运行, 请稍候');
    const rel = f.rel;
    const root = this.engine.roots[f.r];
    const err = String(f.message).slice(0, 600);
    const run = { id: 'repair:' + id, file: id, rel, status: 'running', startedAt: Date.now(), output: '', error: err };
    this.runs.set(id, run);
    const task = '修复文件 ' + rel + ' 的语法错误, 使其通过 node --check。真实诊断证据(node --check 原文):\\n' + err + '\\n\\n要求: 只修这一个文件的语法, 不改业务逻辑, 不改其他文件; 修完运行 node --check ' + rel + ' 自验; 完成后一句话说明改了什么。';
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [DSH_BIN, '--profile', 'headless', task], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    this.children.set(id, child);
    let out = '';
    let ended = false;
    const finish = (status) => {
      if (ended) return;
      ended = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      run.status = status;
      run.finishedAt = Date.now();
      run.output = out.slice(-4000);
      this.children.delete(id);
      try { this.engine.refresh(f.r, f.rel, true); } catch { }
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { try { child.kill(); } catch { } }, 300000);
    child.stdout.on('data', (b) => { out = (out + b).slice(-8000); this.engine.seq++; });
    child.stderr.on('data', () => { });
    child.on('error', (e) => { run.output += String(e); finish('failed'); });
    child.on('close', (code) => finish(code === 0 ? 'passed' : 'failed'));
    return { ...run };
  }
  snapshot() { return [...this.runs.values()].sort((a, b) => b.startedAt - a.startedAt); }
}`;
  const at = s.indexOf(anchor);
  s = s.slice(0, at) + cls + s.slice(at + anchor.length);
  n++; console.log('RepairRuns: inserted');
}

// poll-reruns.cjs — 重跑监控轮询(只读)
const http = require('node:http');
function get(p) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    http.get('http://127.0.0.1:17456' + p, (r) => {
      let b = '';
      r.on('data', (c) => (b += c));
      r.on('end', () => res(b));
    }).on('error', rej);
  });
}
async function snap() {
  const out = [];
  for (const [tag, pid] of [['R1', 'od-dtw-rerun-r1'], ['R2', 'od-dtw-rerun-r2']]) {
    try {
      const d = JSON.parse(await get('/api/projects/' + pid + '/conversations'));
      const c = (d.conversations || [])[0] || {};
      const st = c.latestRun ? c.latestRun.status : 'none';
      out.push(tag + ': ' + st + ' msgs=' + c.messageCount);
    } catch (e) { out.push(tag + ': poll-err ' + e.message); }
  }
  console.log('[' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString() + '] ' + out.join('  |  '));
  return out;
}
(async () => {
  const rounds = Number(process.argv[2] || 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {
    await snap();
    if (i < rounds - 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 45000));
  }
})();

function hashStr(s) {

function drawTextSprite(sp, text) {
  const c = sp.userData.canvas;

  g.shadowBlur = 12;
  g.fillStyle = sp.userData.color;
  g.fillText(text, c.width / 2, c.height / 2);
  sp.userData.tex.needsUpdate = true;
}

function createBuilding(fi) {
  const slot = slotFor(fi.key);
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.position.set(slot[0], 0, slot[1]);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: 0x03141f, emissive: 0x00e5ff, emissiveIntensity: 0.25,
    metalness: 0.55, roughness: 0.4,

  edges.scale.setScalar(1.002);

  label.scale.set(3.0, 0.75, 1);

  };
}

function disposeBuilding(b) {

  b.label.material.dispose();
  b.body.material.dispose();

  if (bi >= 0) city.bodies.splice(bi, 1);
  city.map.delete(b.key);

function upsertBuilding(fi, live) {
  if (!renderer || !fi || !fi.key) return;

  if (!b) {
    if (city.map.size >= CITY_MAX) {
      let oldest = null, oldTs = Infinity;
      for (const x of city.map.values()) {
        const ts = x.info.lastTs || 0;
        if (ts < oldTs) { oldTs = ts; oldest = x; }
      }
      if (oldest) disposeBuilding(oldest);
    }
    b = createBuilding(fi);
    city.map.set(fi.key, b);
    city.bodies.push(b.body);
  } else {
    Object.assign(b.info, fi);
  }
  b.targetH = heightFor(b.info);
  if (live) {
    b.info.lastTs = fi.lastTs || Date.now();
    b.flash = 1;
    flashBeam(b);
    drawTextSprite(b.label, b.info.name + (b.info.edits > 1 ? ' ×' + b.info.edits : ''));

  b.beam.visible = true;
  b.beamT = 0;

function initCity() {
  buildSpiral();

      const top = ((d && d.files) || [])[0];
      setFocusFile(top ? top.key : null, false);
      /* 恢复最近一次真实代码 diff */
      const withDiff = ((d && d.files) || []).find((f) => f.lastDiff);
      if (withDiff) renderDiff({ file: withDiff, diff: withDiff.lastDiff, tool: '恢复 RESTORED', ts: withDiff.lastTs });
    })
    .catch(() => {});
}

/* ---- 同步冲击波 ---- */

        }
      }
      if (b.card && b.cardT !== undefined) {
        b.cardT += dt;
        b.card.position.set(b.group.position.x, b.curH + 2.5, b.group.position.z);
        if (b.cardT > 8) b.card.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - (b.cardT - 8) / 1.5);
        if (b.cardT > 9.5) { b.card.visible = false; b.cardT = undefined; }
      }
    }
    focusSprite.position.y = 7.1 + Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.15;

    /* 冲击波 */
    for (let i = waves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const w = waves[i];
      w.t += dt;
      if (w.t <= 0) { w.m.visible = false; continue; }
      w.m.visible = true;
      w.m.scale.setScalar(1 + w.t * 16);
      w.m.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.9 - w.t * 0.5);
      if (w.m.material.opacity <= 0) {
        scene.remove(w.m);
        w.m.geometry.dispose();
        w.m.material.dispose();
        waves.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    /* 数据环立方体 */
    for (let i = 0; i < cubeData.length; i++) {
      const d = cubeData[i];
      const y = Math.sin(t * d.sp + d.ph) * 0.45;
      _e.set(t * 0.8 + d.ph, t * 0.6, 0);
      _q.setFromEuler(_e);
      _v3.set(Math.cos(d.a) * 9.3, y, Math.sin(d.a) * 9.3);
      _s3.setScalar(0.7 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i * 1.7)));
      _m4.compose(_v3, _q, _s3);
      cubes.setMatrixAt(i, _m4);
    }
    cubes.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    haloGroup.rotation.y = t * (0.12 + activity.heat * 0.55);

    /* 尘埃上浮 */
    const dp = dustGeo.attributes.position.array;
    for (let i = 0; i < dustData.length; i++) {
      const d = dustData[i];
      d.y += d.sp * dt;
      if (d.y > 16) d.y = 0.1;
      dp[i * 3] = Math.cos(d.a + t * 0.03) * d.r;
      dp[i * 3 + 1] = d.y;
      dp[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(d.a + t * 0.03) * d.r;
    }
    dustGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

    /* 悬停拾取: 文件楼宇 */
    if (city.map.size) {
      raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(city.bodies, false);
      const key = hits.length ? hits[0].object.userData.key : null;
      if (key !== hoveredKey) {
        hoveredKey = key;
        renderer.domElement.style.cursor = key ? 'pointer' : 'default';
      }
      const el = tip();
      if (hoveredKey) {
        const b = city.map.get(hoveredKey);
        if (b) {
          const ago = Math.max(0, Math.round((nowMs - (b.info.lastTs || 0)) / 1000));
          el.style.display = 'block';
          el.style.left = Math.min(pointerClient.x + 16, innerWidth - 280) + 'px';
          el.style.top = Math.max(pointerClient.y - 12, 10) + 'px';
          el.innerHTML = `<b>${esc(b.info.name)}</b> · ${b.info.edits} 次修改 · ${fmtBytes(b.info.bytes)} · ${ago}s 前${b.info.exists ? '' : ' · 未落盘'}`;
        }
      } else el.style.display = 'none';
    }

    composer.render();
  }

  processTweens(now);
  tickCountdown();
  updateMode(now);

  frames++;
  if (now - fpsAt > 500) {
    $('fps').textContent = Math.round((frames * 1000) / (now - fpsAt));
    frames = 0;
    fpsAt = now;
  }
}

/* ============================ HUD ============================ */
function toast(msg, isErr = false) {
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'toast' + (isErr ? ' err' : '');
  d.textContent = msg;
  $('toasts').appendChild(d);
  setTimeout(() => d.classList.add('out'), 3600);
  setTimeout(() => d.remove(), 4200);
}

function setSvc(s) {
  const el = $('svc');
  el.textContent = s;
  el.className = s === 'ONLINE' ? 'ok' : s === 'SYNCING' ? 'warn' : 'err';
}

/* 数字缓动 */
const tweens = [];
function tweenNum(el, to, dec = 0, fmt = null, dur = 900) {
  const from = el._v !== undefined ? el._v : 0;
  el._v = to;
  tweens.push({ el, from, to, dec, fmt, start: performance.now(), dur });
}
function processTweens(now) {
  for (let i = tweens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const tw = tweens[i];
    let k = (now - tw.start) / tw.dur;
    if (k >= 1) { k = 1; tweens.splice(i, 1); }
    const v = tw.from + (tw.to - tw.from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3));
    tw.el.textContent = tw.fmt ? tw.fmt(v) : v.toFixed(tw.dec);
  }
}

function setGauge(arcEl, pct) {
  const p = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, pct));
  arcEl.style.strokeDasharray = `${p} 100`;
  arcEl.style.stroke = p >= 88 ? 'url(#gradCrit)' : p >= 70 ? 'url(#gradWarn)' : 'url(#gradCyan)';
}

/* CPU 核心柱 */
function buildCoreBars(n) {
  const box = $('coreBars');
  if (box.childElementCount === n) return;
  box.innerHTML = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'cbar';
    d.innerHTML = `<div class="track"><div class="fill"></div></div><em>${pad(i + 1)}</em>`;
    box.appendChild(d);
  }
}
function updateCoreBars(cpu) {
  buildCoreBars(cpu.coresPct.length);
  const bars = $('coreBars').children;
  for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
    const p = cpu.coresPct[i] ?? 0;
    const fill = bars[i].querySelector('.fill');
    fill.style.height = p + '%';
    fill.style.setProperty('--c', cssColor(p));
    bars[i].title = `CORE ${pad(i + 1)} — ${p}% · ${loadStateText(p)}`;
    bars[i].classList.toggle('focus', i === state.focus);
  }
}

/* 磁盘条 */
const diskNodes = new Map();
function renderDisks(disks) {
  const box = $('diskBars');
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const d of disks) {
    seen.add(d.drive);
    let n = diskNodes.get(d.drive);
    if (!n) {
      n = document.createElement('div');
      n.className = 'dbar';
      n.innerHTML = `<div class="dl"><span>${d.drive} 卷</span><b></b></div><div class="dt"><div class="df"></div></div>`;
      box.appendChild(n);
      diskNodes.set(d.drive, n);
    }
    n.querySelector('b').textContent = `${d.usedGB.toFixed(1)} / ${d.totalGB.toFixed(0)} GB · ${d.pct}%`;
    const f = n.querySelector('.df');
    f.style.width = d.pct + '%';
    f.style.setProperty('--c', cssColor(d.pct));
  }
  for (const [k, n] of diskNodes) {
    if (!seen.has(k)) { n.remove(); diskNodes.delete(k); }
  }
}

/* 折线图 */
function drawLine(cv, series, opts = {}) {
  const dpr = Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2);
  const W = cv.clientWidth, H = cv.clientHeight;
  if (!W || !H) return;
  if (cv.width !== Math.round(W * dpr) || cv.height !== Math.round(H * dpr)) {
    cv.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    cv.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
  }
  const g = cv.getContext('2d');
  g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  g.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,0.10)';
  g.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(0, (H * i) / 4);
    g.lineTo(W, (H * i) / 4);
    g.stroke();
  }

  const n = Math.max(...series.map((s) => s.data.length), 2);
  const max = opts.max || Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((s) => s.data)) * 1.15;

  for (const s of series) {
    if (!s.data.length) continue;
    const pts = s.data.map((v, i) => [
      (i / (n - 1)) * (W - 2) + 1,
      H - 3 - (v / max) * (H - 8),
    ]);
    if (opts.fill) {
      const grad = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      grad.addColorStop(0, s.color + '30');
      grad.addColorStop(1, s.color + '00');
      g.fillStyle = grad;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(pts[0][0], H);
      pts.forEach((p) => g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]));
      g.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], H);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();
    }
    g.strokeStyle = s.color;
    g.lineWidth = 1.6;
    g.shadowColor = s.color;
    g.shadowBlur = 6;
    g.beginPath();
    pts.forEach((p, i) => (i ? g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : g.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
    g.stroke();
    g.shadowBlur = 0;
    const lp = pts[pts.length - 1];
    g.fillStyle = s.color;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(lp[0], lp[1], 2.2, 0, 7);
    g.fill();
  }

  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,220,255,0.5)';
  g.font = '9px Consolas';
  g.fillText(opts.fmt ? opts.fmt(max) : Math.round(max) + (opts.unit || ''), 4, 10);
}

function drawCharts() {
  drawLine($('cpuHist'), [{ data: state.hist.cpu, color: '#00e5ff' }], { max: 100, unit: '%' });
  drawLine($('netChart'), [
    { data: state.hist.rx, color: '#00e5ff' },
    { data: state.hist.tx, color: '#ff2fb3' },
  ], { fmt: fmtBps, fill: true });
}

/* 滚动信息条 */
function buildTicker(m) {
  const items = [
    `主机 HOST ${m.sys.hostname}`,
    `系统 OS ${m.sys.platform} · ${m.sys.arch}`,
    `CPU ${m.sys.cpuModel} × ${m.sys.cores}`,
    `GPU ${m.sys.gpu}`,
    `内存 MEM ${m.mem.usedGB.toFixed(1)}/${m.mem.totalGB.toFixed(1)}GB (${m.mem.pct}%)`,
    ...m.disks.map((d) => `磁盘 ${d.drive} ${d.pct}%`),
    `网络 NET ↓${fmtBps(m.net.rxBps)} ↑${fmtBps(m.net.txBps)}`,
    `IP ${m.sys.ips.join(' / ') || '无外部地址'}`,
    `运行 UPTIME ${fmtUptime(m.sys.uptimeSec)}`,
    `采样周期 CYCLE ${SYNC_INTERVAL / 1000}s`,
  ];
  const html = items.map((s) => `<span>${s}</span>`).join('<i>◆</i>');
  $('tickerTrack').innerHTML = html + '<i>◆</i>' + html + '<i>◆</i>';
}

/* ---------------- 编码活动通道 (DSH / ZCODE 实时上报) ---------------- */
const activity = {
  list: [],
  counts: { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 },
  heat: 0, lastAt: 0, lastKind: '',
};
const KIND_ICON = { code: '✎', exec: '▶', scan: '⌕', task: '◆', error: '✖', idle: '◌', session: '⏻', tool: '◇' };
const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));

function addActivity(e, silent = false) {
  const ev = {
    ts: e.ts || Date.now(), kind: e.kind || 'tool', tool: e.tool || '',
    target: e.target || '', source: e.source || '',
    file: e.file || null, diff: e.diff || null,
  };
  activity.list.unshift(ev);
  if (activity.list.length > 40) activity.list.pop();
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(activity.counts, ev.kind)) activity.counts[ev.kind]++;
  else activity.counts.other++;
  activity.lastAt = ev.ts;
  activity.lastKind = ev.kind;
  const now = Date.now();
  activity.heat = Math.min(1, activity.list.filter((x) => now - x.ts < 60000).length / 30);
  renderFeed();
  if (ev.diff && (ev.diff.del || ev.diff.ins)) renderDiff(ev);
  if (silent) return;
  /* 3D 联动反应 */
  if (ev.kind === 'code' && ev.file) {
    upsertBuilding(ev.file, true);
    if (ev.diff && (ev.diff.del || ev.diff.ins)) {
      const b = city.map.get(ev.file.key);
      if (b) drawDiffCard(b, ev);
    }
  } else if (ev.kind === 'exec') spawnWave(0xffb300);
  else if (ev.kind === 'error') spawnWave(0xff3b5c);
  else if (ev.kind === 'task') { spawnWave(0x00ffa3); toast('新任务下达 NEW TASK INBOUND'); }
}

/* ---------------- 真实代码 diff 上屏 ---------------- */
function renderDiff(e) {
  const fileEl = $('diffFile');
  const body = $('diffBody');
  if (!body || !e || !e.diff) return;
  const insN = String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').length;
  const delN = String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').filter((s) => s !== '').length;
  fileEl.className = 'diffFile';
  fileEl.innerHTML = `<b>${esc((e.file && e.file.name) || e.target || '变更')}</b><span>+${insN} −${delN} · ${esc(e.tool || '')} · ${timeStr(e.ts || Date.now())}</span>`;
  const rows = [];
  for (const l of String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').slice(0, 8)) rows.push(`<div class="dl-del">− ${esc(l) || ' '}</div>`);
  for (const l of String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').slice(0, 10)) rows.push(`<div class="dl-ins">+ ${esc(l) || ' '}</div>`);
  body.innerHTML = rows.join('');
  body.scrollTop = 0;
}

/* 3D 楼宇上方的真实代码变更卡片 */
function drawDiffCard(b, e) {
  if (!b.card) {
    b.card = textSprite('', { w: 512, h: 288, font: '20px Consolas', color: '#d9f6ff' });
    b.card.scale.set(4.8, 2.7, 1);
    scene.add(b.card);
  }
  const c = b.card.userData.canvas;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  g.clearRect(0, 0, 512, 288);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(2,14,26,.92)';
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 288);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,229,255,.65)';
  g.lineWidth = 2;
  g.strokeRect(1, 1, 510, 286);
  g.font = 'bold 22px Consolas';
  g.textAlign = 'left';
  g.textBaseline = 'top';
  g.shadowColor = 'transparent';
  g.shadowBlur = 0;
  g.fillStyle = '#7fe9ff';
  g.fillText((b.info.name || '').slice(0, 30), 14, 10);
  let y = 44;
  for (const l of String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').slice(0, 5)) {
    g.fillStyle = '#ff8b9d';
    g.fillText('− ' + l.slice(0, 46), 14, y);
    y += 24;
  }
  for (const l of String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n').slice(0, 6)) {
    g.fillStyle = '#7dffc8';
    g.fillText('+ ' + l.slice(0, 46), 14, y);
    y += 24;
  }
  b.card.userData.tex.needsUpdate = true;
  b.card.visible = true;
  b.card.material.opacity = 1;
  b.cardT = 0;
}

function renderFeed() {
  const box = $('feedList');
  if (!box) return;
  box.innerHTML = activity.list.slice(0, 9).map((e) => {
    const d = new Date(e.ts);
    return `<div class="fitem k-${esc(e.kind)}"><span class="t">${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}</span><span class="k">${KIND_ICON[e.kind] || '◇'}</span><span class="tg" title="${esc(e.tool)} ${esc(e.target)}">${esc(e.tool || e.kind)}${e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : ''}</span><span class="src">${esc(e.source)}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
  $('cntCode').textContent = activity.counts.code;
  $('cntExec').textContent = activity.counts.exec;
  $('cntScan').textContent = activity.counts.scan;
  $('cntErr').textContent = activity.counts.error;
}

function initActivityStream() {
  fetch('/api/events', { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((d) => {
      for (const e of (d.events || []).slice(-14)) addActivity(e, true);
      renderFeed();
    })
    .catch(() => {});
  /* 自动化/无头环境不开 SSE 长连接(会挂住虚拟时间调度), 只拉一次历史 */
  if (navigator.webdriver || qs.has('nostream')) return;
  try {
    const es = new EventSource('/api/stream');
    es.onmessage = (m) => {
      try {
        const d = JSON.parse(m.data);
        if (d.type === 'event' && d.event) addActivity(d.event);
        else if (d.type === 'sentinel' && d.s) renderSentinel(d.s);
        else if (d.type === 'sentinel_toast') toast((d.urgent ? '⚠ ' : '🛡 ') + d.msg, !!d.urgent);
      } catch { /* 脏帧忽略 */ }
    };
  } catch { /* EventSource 不可用则跳过 */ }
}

let modeAt = 0;
function updateMode(now) {
  if (now - modeAt < 500) return;
  modeAt = now;
  const el = $('agentMode');
  const led = $('feedLed');
  const ago = activity.lastAt ? now - activity.lastAt : Infinity;
  let m, cls;
  if (ago < 9000) {
    switch (activity.lastKind) {
      case 'code': m = '编码中 CODING'; cls = 'coding'; break;
      case 'exec': m = '调试中 DEBUGGING'; cls = 'debug'; break;
      case 'error': m = '排障中 FIXING'; cls = 'fault'; break;
      case 'task': m = '规划中 PLANNING'; cls = 'coding'; break;
      default: m = '检索中 SCANNING'; cls = 'scan';
    }
  } else if (ago < 60000) { m = '活跃 ACTIVE'; cls = 'scan'; }
  else { m = '待机 IDLE'; cls = 'idle'; }
  if (el.textContent !== m) {
    el.textContent = m;
    el.className = cls;
    if (led) led.className = 'led ' + (cls === 'fault' ? 'err' : 'ok');
  }
}

/* ---------------- 事件范围过滤 ---------------- */
function applyEventFilter() {
  const fromVal = $('filterFrom').value;
  const toVal = $('filterTo').value;
  const from = fromVal === '' ? null : Number(fromVal);
  const to = toVal === '' ? null : Number(toVal);
  if (isNaN(from) && fromVal !== '') { alert('from 必须是有效的毫秒数'); return; }
  if (isNaN(to) && toVal !== '') { alert('to 必须是有效的毫秒数'); return; }
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if ($('filterFrom').value !== '') params.set('from', $('filterFrom').value);
  if ($('filterTo').value !== '') params.set('to', $('filterTo').value);
  fetch('/api/events?' + params.toString(), { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json())
    .then((d) => {
      const list = $('feedList');
      if (!list) return;

      // Update activity.list with filtered events (replace current list)
      activity.list = (d.events || []).map((e) => ({
        ts: e.ts, kind: e.kind, tool: e.tool, target: e.target, source: e.source,
        file: e.file, diff: e.diff,
      }));
      // Recalculate counts from filtered list
      activity.counts = { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 };
      for (const e of activity.list) {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(activity.counts, e.kind)) {
          activity.counts[e.kind]++;
        } else {
          activity.counts.other++;
        }
      }
      activity.lastAt = activity.list.length > 0 ? activity.list[0].ts : 0;
      activity.lastKind = activity.list.length > 0 ? activity.list[0].kind : '';

      // render the last 14 events
      const recent = (d.events || []).slice(-14);
      list.innerHTML = recent.map((e) => {
        const date = new Date(e.ts);
        return `<div class="fitem k-${esc(e.kind)}"><span class="t">${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}:${pad(date.getSeconds())}</span><span class="k">${KIND_ICON[e.kind] || '◇'}</span><span class="tg" title="${esc(e.tool)} ${esc(e.target)}">${esc(e.tool || e.kind)}${e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : ''}</span><span class="src">${esc(e.source)}</span></div>`;
      }).join('');

      // Re-render from updated activity.list so SSE downstream doesn't overwrite filter results
      renderFeed();
      $('cntCode').textContent = activity.counts.code;
      $('cntExec').textContent = activity.counts.exec;
      $('cntScan').textContent = activity.counts.scan;
      $('cntErr').textContent = activity.counts.error;
    })
    .catch((e) => console.error('事件过滤错误:', e));
}

$('filterBtn').addEventListener('click', applyEventFilter);

/* 按 Enter 错也触发过滤 */
$('filterFrom').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') applyEventFilter(); });
$('filterTo').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') applyEventFilter(); });

/* ---------------- 指标渲染 ---------------- */
function applyMetrics(m) {
  state.metrics = m;
  const { cpu, mem, sys, disks, net } = m;

  /* 仪表 */
  tweenNum($('cpuPct'), cpu.avgPct, 1);
  setGauge($('cpuArc'), cpu.avgPct);
  tweenNum($('memPct'), mem.pct, 1);
  setGauge($('memArc'), mem.pct);
  $('memUsed').textContent = mem.usedGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  $('memTotal').textContent = mem.totalGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';
  $('memFree').textContent = mem.freeGB.toFixed(1) + ' GB';

  updateCoreBars(cpu);

  $('cpuModel').textContent = sys.cpuModel;
  $('cpuModel').title = sys.cpuModel;
  $('cpuCores').textContent = sys.cores + ' 核心';
  $('cpuClock').textContent = cpu.speedMhz ? (cpu.speedMhz / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' GHz' : '--';

  renderDisks(disks);

  tweenNum($('rxBps'), net.rxBps, 0, fmtBps);
  tweenNum($('txBps'), net.txBps, 0, fmtBps);

  $('hostName').textContent = sys.hostname;
  $('osInfo').textContent = sys.platform;
  $('archInfo').textContent = sys.arch;
  $('gpuInfo').textContent = sys.gpu;
  $('gpuInfo').title = sys.gpu;
  $('ipInfo').textContent = sys.ips.join(' / ') || '无外部地址';
  $('ipInfo').title = sys.ips.join(' / ');
  $('upTime').textContent = fmtUptime(sys.uptimeSec);

  /* 历史 */
  state.hist.cpu.push(cpu.avgPct);
  state.hist.rx.push(net.rxBps);
  state.hist.tx.push(net.txBps);
  for (const k of ['cpu', 'rx', 'tx']) if (state.hist[k].length > HIST_MAX) state.hist[k].shift();
  drawCharts();

  buildTicker(m);
}

function setFocusFile(key, toastIt = true) {
  state.focus = key;
  const b = key ? city.map.get(key) : null;
  const el = $('focusFile');
  if (b) {
    drawTextSprite(focusSprite, b.info.name);
    el.textContent = `${b.info.name} · ${b.info.edits} 次修改`;
    el.className = 'ok';
    if (toastIt) toast(`已聚焦 ${b.info.name}`);
  } else {
    drawTextSprite(focusSprite, 'CODE CITY');
    el.textContent = '— 点击3D文件楼宇 —';
    el.className = 'dim';
  }
}

/* ---------------- 数据同步 (每3分钟) ---------------- */
async function doSync(manual = false) {
  if (state.syncing) return;
  state.syncing = true;
  setSvc('SYNCING');
  $('syncState').textContent = '同步中 SYNCING...';
  $('syncState').className = 'dim';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/metrics', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    const m = await r.json();
    if (m.error) throw new Error(m.error);
    applyMetrics(m);
    state.lastSyncAt = Date.now();
    setSvc('ONLINE');
    $('lastSyncTime').textContent = timeStr(state.lastSyncAt);
    $('syncState').textContent = '同步成功 OK';
    $('syncState').className = 'ok';
    if (manual) spawnWave(0xff2fb3);
    spawnWave(0x00e5ff);
    spawnWave(0x3b82f6, 0.25);
    toast((manual ? '手动同步完成 MANUAL' : '数据同步完成 DATA SYNCED') + ' · ' + timeStr(state.lastSyncAt));
  } catch (e) {
    setSvc('OFFLINE');
    $('syncState').textContent = '同步失败 FAILED';
    $('syncState').className = 'err';
    toast('数据同步失败: ' + e.message + ' · 15s 后重试', true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      state.syncing = false;
      state.nextSyncAt = Date.now();
    }, 15000);
    return;
  }
  state.syncing = false;
  state.nextSyncAt = Date.now() + SYNC_INTERVAL;
}

function tickCountdown() {
  if (!state.nextSyncAt) return;
  const rem = Math.max(0, state.nextSyncAt - Date.now());
  const frac = 1 - rem / SYNC_INTERVAL;
  $('syncArc').style.strokeDasharray = `${(frac * 100).toFixed(2)} 100`;
  const s = Math.ceil(rem / 1000);
  const txt = `${pad(Math.floor(s / 60))}:${pad(s % 60)}`;
  const cd = $('countdown');
  if (cd.textContent !== txt) cd.textContent = txt;
  if (rem === 0 && !state.syncing && state.booted) doSync();
}

/* ---------------- 哨兵智能体 (感知→大脑→权限闸门→影子提案) ---------------- */
const sentinelView = { nextAt: 0 };
function setGateLv(n, on) {
  const el = document.querySelector(`#sentinelPanel .gLv.lv${n}`);
  if (el) el.classList.toggle('on', on);
}
function renderSentinel(s) {
  if (!s || !s.dbCounts) return;
  $('sentCycles').textContent = s.cycles ?? 0;
  $('sentPeriod').textContent = (s.intervalSec || 180) + 's';
  $('sentLlm').textContent = `${(s.brain && s.brain.llmToday) || 0} 次/今日`;
  $('sentBudget').textContent = s.budget ? `${s.budget.toastLeft}/${s.budget.toastLimit}` : '--';
  const mode = $('sentMode');
  mode.textContent = s.shadowMode ? '影子 SHADOW' : '在线 LIVE';
  mode.className = 'modeTag' + (s.shadowMode ? '' : ' live');
  const bt = $('sentBrain');
  if (s.state === 'DEGRADED_RULES') { bt.textContent = '降级·固定规则'; bt.className = 'brainTag degraded'; }
  else if (s.brain && s.brain.lastGood) { bt.textContent = `免费档 ${s.brain.lastGood.split('/')[0]}`; bt.className = 'brainTag'; }
  else { bt.textContent = '待命'; bt.className = 'brainTag'; }
  /* 闸门灯: L0/L1 常开(影子只记录), L2 无授权, L3 红线禁用 */
  setGateLv(0, true); setGateLv(1, true); setGateLv(2, false); setGateLv(3, false);
  if (s.nextRunAt) sentinelView.nextAt = s.nextRunAt;
  const p = (s.recentProposals || [])[0];
  const box = $('sentProp');
  if (p) {
    const d = new Date(p.ts.endsWith('Z') ? p.ts : p.ts + 'Z');
    $('sentPropAgo').textContent = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
    const urgent = /urgent|紧急/.test(p.reason || '') || Number(p.action_level) >= 1 && /旁路/.test(p.reason || '');
    box.className = 'propCard' + (urgent ? ' urgent' : '');
    const blocked = /BLOCKED|NOT_IMPLEMENTED/.test(p.verdict);
    const gateCls = blocked ? 'gate blocked' : 'gate';
    const pending = s.pendingApproval && s.pendingApproval.proposalId === p.id;
    const approveBtn = pending
      ? `<button id="sentApprove" class="btn sent-approve" title="L3 一次性批准 · ${s.pendingApproval.expiresInSec}s 内有效">⚡ 批准本次 ${esc(s.pendingApproval.tool)} (${s.pendingApproval.expiresInSec}s)</button>`
      : '';
    box.innerHTML =
      `<div class="pf">${esc(p.fact)}</div>` +
      `<div class="pr">${esc(p.reason)}</div>` +
      `<div class="pm"><span class="lv">L${p.action_level}·${esc(p.action_tool)}</span>` +
      `<span class="${gateCls}">${esc(p.verdict)}</span>` +
      `<span>置信 ${esc(p.confidence)}</span>` +
      `<span>${p.executed ? '已执行' : '仅记录'}</span>` +
      `<span>${esc(p.brain || '')}</span></div>` + approveBtn;
    if (pending) {
      const btn = $('sentApprove');
      if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        btn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/sentinel/approve', {
            method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ proposalId: s.pendingApproval.proposalId }),
          }).then((x) => x.json());
          toast(r.ok ? `已批准并执行: ${r.tool}` : `批准失败: ${r.error || r.verdict}`, !r.ok);
        } catch (e) { toast('批准请求失败: ' + e.message, true); }
      });
    }
  }
  if (s.dshUrl) {
    const box2 = $('sentProp');
    /* 自愈地址常驻显示, 点击复制 */
    if (!/dshUrl/.test(box2.innerHTML)) {
      box2.innerHTML += `<div class="pm"><span class="gate">DSH: <a href="${esc(s.dshUrl)}" target="_blank" style="color:#7dffc8">${esc(s.dshUrl.slice(0, 34))}…</a></span></div>`;
    }
  }
  const led = $('sentLed');
  if (led) led.className = 'led ' + (s.state === 'ERROR' ? 'err' : 'ok');
}
function initSentinel() {
  fetch('/api/sentinel/state', { cache: 'no-store' })
    .then((r) => r.json()).then(renderSentinel).catch(() => {});
  /* 无 SSE 环境(自动化)用轮询兜底 */
  if (navigator.webdriver || qs.has('nostream')) {
    setInterval(() => {
      fetch('/api/sentinel/state', { cache: 'no-store' })
        .then((r) => r.json()).then(renderSentinel).catch(() => {});
    }, 15000);
  }
  /* 哨兵下轮倒计时 */
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!sentinelView.nextAt) return;
    const rem = Math.max(0, Math.round((sentinelView.nextAt - Date.now()) / 1000));
    const txt = rem >= 3600
      ? `${Math.floor(rem / 3600)}h${pad(Math.floor((rem % 3600) / 60))}m`
      : `${pad(Math.floor(rem / 60))}:${pad(rem % 60)}`;
    const el = $('sentNext');
    if (el && el.textContent !== txt) el.textContent = txt;
  }, 1000);
}

/* ---------------- 启动引导 ---------------- */
const bootLines = [
  '▸ DIGITAL TWIN OPS CORE v2.6 — BOOT SEQUENCE',
  '▸ [ OK ] 渲染内核 WEBGL2 RENDERER .......... READY',
  '▸ [ OK ] 后处理管线 BLOOM PIPELINE ......... ACTIVE',
  '▸ [ OK ] 交互系统 ORBIT / RAYCAST .......... ONLINE',
  '▸ [SYNC] 连接本地数据服务 /api/metrics ...... LINKED',
  `▸ [DATA] 采样周期 SAMPLING PERIOD .......... ${SYNC_INTERVAL / 1000}s`,
  '▸ [SENT] 哨兵智能体 SHADOW MODE ............ 巡查中',
  '▸ ✓ 系统就绪 SYSTEM ONLINE — 数据周期性自动同步',
];
async function runBoot() {
  const log = $('bootlog');
  for (let i = 0; i < bootLines.length; i++) {
    log.textContent += bootLines[i] + '\n';
    const pct = Math.round(((i + 1) / bootLines.length) * 100);
    $('bootbarFill').style.width = pct + '%';
    $('bootPct').textContent = pct + '%';
    await sleep(150 + Math.random() * 160);
  }
  await sleep(350);
  $('boot').classList.add('done');
  setTimeout(() => $('boot').remove(), 900);
  state.booted = true;
  toast('系统上线 SYSTEM ONLINE');
}

/* ---------------- 初始化 ---------------- */
function initClock() {
  const tick = () => {
    const d = new Date();
    $('clock').textContent = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
    $('date').textContent = `${d.getFullYear()}年${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}月${pad(d.getDate())}日 · 星期${'日一二三四五六'[d.getDay()]}`;
  };
  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 250);
}

window.addEventListener('error', (e) => toast('运行错误: ' + e.message, true));

initClock();
try {
  initThree();
} catch (e) {
  $('glver').textContent = '不支持';
  toast('3D 渲染初始化失败: ' + e.message, true);
}
$('histSpan').textContent = `最近 ${Math.max(1, Math.round((HIST_MAX * SYNC_INTERVAL) / 60000))} 分钟`;
$('cycleInfo').textContent = SYNC_INTERVAL >= 60000
  ? `${SYNC_INTERVAL / 1000}s / ${Math.round(SYNC_INTERVAL / 60000)}min`
  : `${SYNC_INTERVAL / 1000}s`;
$('syncNow').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!state.syncing) doSync(true);
});
animate();
runBoot();
doSync();
initActivityStream();
initCity();
initSentinel();

import {
	EventDispatcher,
	MOUSE,
	Quaternion,
	Spherical,
	TOUCH,
	Vector2,
	Vector3,
	Plane,
	Ray,
	MathUtils
} from 'three';

// OrbitControls performs orbiting, dollying (zooming), and panning.
// Unlike TrackballControls, it maintains the "up" direction object.up (+Y by default).
//
//    Orbit - left mouse / touch: one-finger move
//    Zoom - middle mouse, or mousewheel / touch: two-finger spread or squish
//    Pan - right mouse, or left mouse + ctrl/meta/shiftKey, or arrow keys / touch: two-finger move

const _changeEvent = { type: 'change' };
const _startEvent = { type: 'start' };
const _endEvent = { type: 'end' };
const _ray = new Ray();

import {
	Clock,
	HalfFloatType,
	NoBlending,
	Vector2,
	WebGLRenderTarget
} from 'three';
import { CopyShader } from '../shaders/CopyShader.js';
import { ShaderPass } from './ShaderPass.js';
import { MaskPass } from './MaskPass.js';
import { ClearMaskPass } from './MaskPass.js';

class EffectComposer {

	constructor( renderer, renderTarget ) {

		this.renderer = renderer;

		this._pixelRatio = renderer.getPixelRatio();

		if ( renderTarget === undefined ) {

			const size = renderer.getSize( new Vector2() );
			this._width = size.width;
			this._height = size.height;

			renderTarget = new WebGLRenderTarget( this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio, { type: HalfFloatType } );
			renderTarget.texture.name = 'EffectComposer.rt1';

		} else {

			this._width = renderTarget.width;
			this._height = renderTarget.height;

		}

		this.renderTarget1 = renderTarget;
		this.renderTarget2 = renderTarget.clone();
		this.renderTarget2.texture.name = 'EffectComposer.rt2';

		this.writeBuffer = this.renderTarget1;
		this.readBuffer = this.renderTarget2;

		this.renderToScreen = true;

		this.passes = [];

		this.copyPass = new ShaderPass( CopyShader );
		this.copyPass.material.blending = NoBlending;

		this.clock = new Clock();

	}

	swapBuffers() {

		const tmp = this.readBuffer;
		this.readBuffer = this.writeBuffer;
		this.writeBuffer = tmp;

	}

	addPass( pass ) {

		this.passes.push( pass );
		pass.setSize( this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio );

	}

	insertPass( pass, index ) {

		this.passes.splice( index, 0, pass );
		pass.setSize( this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio );

	}

	removePass( pass ) {

		const index = this.passes.indexOf( pass );

		if ( index !== - 1 ) {

			this.passes.splice( index, 1 );

		}

	}

	isLastEnabledPass( passIndex ) {

		for ( let i = passIndex + 1; i < this.passes.length; i ++ ) {

			if ( this.passes[ i ].enabled ) {

				return false;

			}

		}

		return true;

	}

	render( deltaTime ) {

		// deltaTime value is in seconds

		if ( deltaTime === undefined ) {

			deltaTime = this.clock.getDelta();

		}

		const currentRenderTarget = this.renderer.getRenderTarget();

		let maskActive = false;

		for ( let i = 0, il = this.passes.length; i < il; i ++ ) {

			const pass = this.passes[ i ];

			if ( pass.enabled === false ) continue;

			pass.renderToScreen = ( this.renderToScreen && this.isLastEnabledPass( i ) );
			pass.render( this.renderer, this.writeBuffer, this.readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive );

			if ( pass.needsSwap ) {

				if ( maskActive ) {

					const context = this.renderer.getContext();
					const stencil = this.renderer.state.buffers.stencil;

					//context.stencilFunc( context.NOTEQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff );
					stencil.setFunc( context.NOTEQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff );

					this.copyPass.render( this.renderer, this.writeBuffer, this.readBuffer, deltaTime );

					//context.stencilFunc( context.EQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff );
					stencil.setFunc( context.EQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff );

				}

				this.swapBuffers();

			}

			if ( MaskPass !== undefined ) {

				if ( pass instanceof MaskPass ) {

					maskActive = true;

				} else if ( pass instanceof ClearMaskPass ) {

					maskActive = false;

				}

			}

		}

		this.renderer.setRenderTarget( currentRenderTarget );

	}

	reset( renderTarget ) {

		if ( renderTarget === undefined ) {

			const size = this.renderer.getSize( new Vector2() );
			this._pixelRatio = this.renderer.getPixelRatio();
			this._width = size.width;
			this._height = size.height;

			renderTarget = this.renderTarget1.clone();
			renderTarget.setSize( this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio );

		}

		this.renderTarget1.dispose();
		this.renderTarget2.dispose();
		this.renderTarget1 = renderTarget;
		this.renderTarget2 = renderTarget.clone();

		this.writeBuffer = this.renderTarget1;
		this.readBuffer = this.renderTarget2;

	}

	setSize( width, height ) {

		this._width = width;
		this._height = height;

		const effectiveWidth = this._width * this._pixelRatio;
		const effectiveHeight = this._height * this._pixelRatio;

		this.renderTarget1.setSize( effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight );
		this.renderTarget2.setSize( effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight );

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.passes.length; i ++ ) {

			this.passes[ i ].setSize( effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight );

		}

	}

	setPixelRatio( pixelRatio ) {

		this._pixelRatio = pixelRatio;

		this.setSize( this._width, this._height );

		this.renderTarget1.dispose();
		this.renderTarget2.dispose();

import { Pass } from './Pass.js';

class MaskPass extends Pass {

	constructor( scene, camera ) {

		super();

		this.scene = scene;
		this.camera = camera;

		this.clear = true;
		this.needsSwap = false;

		this.inverse = false;

	}

	render( renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer /*, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		const context = renderer.getContext();
		const state = renderer.state;

		// don't update color or depth

		state.buffers.color.setMask( false );
		state.buffers.depth.setMask( false );

		// lock buffers

		state.buffers.color.setLocked( true );
		state.buffers.depth.setLocked( true );

		// set up stencil

		let writeValue, clearValue;

		if ( this.inverse ) {

			writeValue = 0;
			clearValue = 1;

		} else {

			writeValue = 1;
			clearValue = 0;

		}

		state.buffers.stencil.setTest( true );
		state.buffers.stencil.setOp( context.REPLACE, context.REPLACE, context.REPLACE );
		state.buffers.stencil.setFunc( context.ALWAYS, writeValue, 0xffffffff );
		state.buffers.stencil.setClear( clearValue );
		state.buffers.stencil.setLocked( true );

		// draw into the stencil buffer

		renderer.setRenderTarget( readBuffer );
		if ( this.clear ) renderer.clear();
		renderer.render( this.scene, this.camera );

		renderer.setRenderTarget( writeBuffer );
		if ( this.clear ) renderer.clear();
		renderer.render( this.scene, this.camera );

		// unlock color and depth buffer and make them writable for subsequent rendering/clearing

		state.buffers.color.setLocked( false );
		state.buffers.depth.setLocked( false );

		state.buffers.color.setMask( true );
		state.buffers.depth.setMask( true );

		// only render where stencil is set to 1

		state.buffers.stencil.setLocked( false );
		state.buffers.stencil.setFunc( context.EQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff ); // draw if == 1
		state.buffers.stencil.setOp( context.KEEP, context.KEEP, context.KEEP );
		state.buffers.stencil.setLocked( true );

	}

}

class ClearMaskPass extends Pass {

	constructor() {

		super();

		this.needsSwap = false;

	}

	render( renderer /*, writeBuffer, readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setLocked( false );
		renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest( false );

	}

}

export { MaskPass, ClearMaskPass };

import {
	ColorManagement,
	RawShaderMaterial,
	UniformsUtils,
	LinearToneMapping,
	ReinhardToneMapping,
	CineonToneMapping,
	AgXToneMapping,
	ACESFilmicToneMapping,
	SRGBTransfer
} from 'three';
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from './Pass.js';
import { OutputShader } from '../shaders/OutputShader.js';

class OutputPass extends Pass {

	constructor() {

		super();

		//

		const shader = OutputShader;

		this.uniforms = UniformsUtils.clone( shader.uniforms );

		this.material = new RawShaderMaterial( {
			name: shader.name,
			uniforms: this.uniforms,
			vertexShader: shader.vertexShader,
			fragmentShader: shader.fragmentShader
		} );

		this.fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad( this.material );

		// internal cache

		this._outputColorSpace = null;
		this._toneMapping = null;

	}

	render( renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer/*, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		this.uniforms[ 'tDiffuse' ].value = readBuffer.texture;
		this.uniforms[ 'toneMappingExposure' ].value = renderer.toneMappingExposure;

		// rebuild defines if required

		if ( this._outputColorSpace !== renderer.outputColorSpace || this._toneMapping !== renderer.toneMapping ) {

			this._outputColorSpace = renderer.outputColorSpace;
			this._toneMapping = renderer.toneMapping;

			this.material.defines = {};

			if ( ColorManagement.getTransfer( this._outputColorSpace ) === SRGBTransfer ) this.material.defines.SRGB_TRANSFER = '';

			if ( this._toneMapping === LinearToneMapping ) this.material.defines.LINEAR_TONE_MAPPING = '';
			else if ( this._toneMapping === ReinhardToneMapping ) this.material.defines.REINHARD_TONE_MAPPING = '';
			else if ( this._toneMapping === CineonToneMapping ) this.material.defines.CINEON_TONE_MAPPING = '';
			else if ( this._toneMapping === ACESFilmicToneMapping ) this.material.defines.ACES_FILMIC_TONE_MAPPING = '';
			else if ( this._toneMapping === AgXToneMapping ) this.material.defines.AGX_TONE_MAPPING = '';

			this.material.needsUpdate = true;

		}

		//

		if ( this.renderToScreen === true ) {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( null );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		} else {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( writeBuffer );
			if ( this.clear ) renderer.clear( renderer.autoClearColor, renderer.autoClearDepth, renderer.autoClearStencil );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		}

	}

	dispose() {

		this.material.dispose();
		this.fsQuad.dispose();

	}

}

export { OutputPass };

import {
	BufferGeometry,
	Float32BufferAttribute,
	OrthographicCamera,
	Mesh
} from 'three';

class Pass {

	constructor() {

		this.isPass = true;

		// if set to true, the pass is processed by the composer
		this.enabled = true;

		// if set to true, the pass indicates to swap read and write buffer after rendering
		this.needsSwap = true;

		// if set to true, the pass clears its buffer before rendering
		this.clear = false;

		// if set to true, the result of the pass is rendered to screen. This is set automatically by EffectComposer.
		this.renderToScreen = false;

	}

	setSize( /* width, height */ ) {}

	render( /* renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		console.error( 'THREE.Pass: .render() must be implemented in derived pass.' );

	}

	dispose() {}

}

// Helper for passes that need to fill the viewport with a single quad.

const _camera = new OrthographicCamera( - 1, 1, 1, - 1, 0, 1 );

// https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/pull/21358

class FullscreenTriangleGeometry extends BufferGeometry {

	constructor() {

		super();

		this.setAttribute( 'position', new Float32BufferAttribute( [ - 1, 3, 0, - 1, - 1, 0, 3, - 1, 0 ], 3 ) );
		this.setAttribute( 'uv', new Float32BufferAttribute( [ 0, 2, 0, 0, 2, 0 ], 2 ) );

	}

}

const _geometry = new FullscreenTriangleGeometry();

class FullScreenQuad {

	constructor( material ) {

		this._mesh = new Mesh( _geometry, material );

	}

	dispose() {

		this._mesh.geometry.dispose();

	}

	render( renderer ) {

		renderer.render( this._mesh, _camera );

	}

	get material() {

		return this._mesh.material;

	}

	set material( value ) {

		this._mesh.material = value;

	}

}

export { Pass, FullScreenQuad };

import {
	Color
} from 'three';
import { Pass } from './Pass.js';

class RenderPass extends Pass {

	constructor( scene, camera, overrideMaterial = null, clearColor = null, clearAlpha = null ) {

		super();

		this.scene = scene;
		this.camera = camera;

		this.overrideMaterial = overrideMaterial;

		this.clearColor = clearColor;
		this.clearAlpha = clearAlpha;

		this.clear = true;
		this.clearDepth = false;
		this.needsSwap = false;
		this._oldClearColor = new Color();

	}

	render( renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer /*, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		const oldAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
		renderer.autoClear = false;

		let oldClearAlpha, oldOverrideMaterial;

		if ( this.overrideMaterial !== null ) {

			oldOverrideMaterial = this.scene.overrideMaterial;

			this.scene.overrideMaterial = this.overrideMaterial;

		}

		if ( this.clearColor !== null ) {

			renderer.getClearColor( this._oldClearColor );
			renderer.setClearColor( this.clearColor );

		}

		if ( this.clearAlpha !== null ) {

			oldClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
			renderer.setClearAlpha( this.clearAlpha );

		}

		if ( this.clearDepth == true ) {

			renderer.clearDepth();

		}

		renderer.setRenderTarget( this.renderToScreen ? null : readBuffer );

		if ( this.clear === true ) {

			// TODO: Avoid using autoClear properties, see https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/pull/15571#issuecomment-465669600
			renderer.clear( renderer.autoClearColor, renderer.autoClearDepth, renderer.autoClearStencil );

		}

		renderer.render( this.scene, this.camera );

		// restore

		if ( this.clearColor !== null ) {

			renderer.setClearColor( this._oldClearColor );

		}

		if ( this.clearAlpha !== null ) {

			renderer.setClearAlpha( oldClearAlpha );

		}

		if ( this.overrideMaterial !== null ) {

			this.scene.overrideMaterial = oldOverrideMaterial;

		}

		renderer.autoClear = oldAutoClear;

	}

}

import {
	ShaderMaterial,
	UniformsUtils
} from 'three';
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from './Pass.js';

class ShaderPass extends Pass {

	constructor( shader, textureID ) {

		super();

		this.textureID = ( textureID !== undefined ) ? textureID : 'tDiffuse';

		if ( shader instanceof ShaderMaterial ) {

			this.uniforms = shader.uniforms;

			this.material = shader;

		} else if ( shader ) {

			this.uniforms = UniformsUtils.clone( shader.uniforms );

			this.material = new ShaderMaterial( {

				name: ( shader.name !== undefined ) ? shader.name : 'unspecified',
				defines: Object.assign( {}, shader.defines ),
				uniforms: this.uniforms,
				vertexShader: shader.vertexShader,
				fragmentShader: shader.fragmentShader

			} );

		}

		this.fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad( this.material );

	}

	render( renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer /*, deltaTime, maskActive */ ) {

		if ( this.uniforms[ this.textureID ] ) {

			this.uniforms[ this.textureID ].value = readBuffer.texture;

		}

		this.fsQuad.material = this.material;

		if ( this.renderToScreen ) {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( null );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		} else {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( writeBuffer );
			// TODO: Avoid using autoClear properties, see https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/pull/15571#issuecomment-465669600
			if ( this.clear ) renderer.clear( renderer.autoClearColor, renderer.autoClearDepth, renderer.autoClearStencil );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		}

	}

	dispose() {

		this.material.dispose();

		this.fsQuad.dispose();

	}

}

import {
	AdditiveBlending,
	Color,
	HalfFloatType,
	MeshBasicMaterial,
	ShaderMaterial,
	UniformsUtils,
	Vector2,
	Vector3,
	WebGLRenderTarget
} from 'three';
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from './Pass.js';
import { CopyShader } from '../shaders/CopyShader.js';
import { LuminosityHighPassShader } from '../shaders/LuminosityHighPassShader.js';

/**
 * UnrealBloomPass is inspired by the bloom pass of Unreal Engine. It creates a
 * mip map chain of bloom textures and blurs them with different radii. Because
 * of the weighted combination of mips, and because larger blurs are done on
 * higher mips, this effect provides good quality and performance.
 *
 * Reference:
 * - https://docs.unrealengine.com/latest/INT/Engine/Rendering/PostProcessEffects/Bloom/
 */
class UnrealBloomPass extends Pass {

	constructor( resolution, strength, radius, threshold ) {

		super();

		this.strength = ( strength !== undefined ) ? strength : 1;
		this.radius = radius;
		this.threshold = threshold;
		this.resolution = ( resolution !== undefined ) ? new Vector2( resolution.x, resolution.y ) : new Vector2( 256, 256 );

		// create color only once here, reuse it later inside the render function
		this.clearColor = new Color( 0, 0, 0 );

		// render targets
		this.renderTargetsHorizontal = [];
		this.renderTargetsVertical = [];
		this.nMips = 5;
		let resx = Math.round( this.resolution.x / 2 );
		let resy = Math.round( this.resolution.y / 2 );

		this.renderTargetBright = new WebGLRenderTarget( resx, resy, { type: HalfFloatType } );
		this.renderTargetBright.texture.name = 'UnrealBloomPass.bright';
		this.renderTargetBright.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.nMips; i ++ ) {

			const renderTargetHorizonal = new WebGLRenderTarget( resx, resy, { type: HalfFloatType } );

			renderTargetHorizonal.texture.name = 'UnrealBloomPass.h' + i;
			renderTargetHorizonal.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

			this.renderTargetsHorizontal.push( renderTargetHorizonal );

			const renderTargetVertical = new WebGLRenderTarget( resx, resy, { type: HalfFloatType } );

			renderTargetVertical.texture.name = 'UnrealBloomPass.v' + i;
			renderTargetVertical.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

			this.renderTargetsVertical.push( renderTargetVertical );

			resx = Math.round( resx / 2 );

			resy = Math.round( resy / 2 );

		}

		// luminosity high pass material

		const highPassShader = LuminosityHighPassShader;
		this.highPassUniforms = UniformsUtils.clone( highPassShader.uniforms );

		this.highPassUniforms[ 'luminosityThreshold' ].value = threshold;
		this.highPassUniforms[ 'smoothWidth' ].value = 0.01;

		this.materialHighPassFilter = new ShaderMaterial( {
			uniforms: this.highPassUniforms,
			vertexShader: highPassShader.vertexShader,
			fragmentShader: highPassShader.fragmentShader
		} );

		// gaussian blur materials

		this.separableBlurMaterials = [];
		const kernelSizeArray = [ 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 ];
		resx = Math.round( this.resolution.x / 2 );
		resy = Math.round( this.resolution.y / 2 );

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.nMips; i ++ ) {

			this.separableBlurMaterials.push( this.getSeperableBlurMaterial( kernelSizeArray[ i ] ) );

			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'invSize' ].value = new Vector2( 1 / resx, 1 / resy );

			resx = Math.round( resx / 2 );

			resy = Math.round( resy / 2 );

		}

		// composite material

		this.compositeMaterial = this.getCompositeMaterial( this.nMips );
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'blurTexture1' ].value = this.renderTargetsVertical[ 0 ].texture;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'blurTexture2' ].value = this.renderTargetsVertical[ 1 ].texture;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'blurTexture3' ].value = this.renderTargetsVertical[ 2 ].texture;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'blurTexture4' ].value = this.renderTargetsVertical[ 3 ].texture;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'blurTexture5' ].value = this.renderTargetsVertical[ 4 ].texture;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomStrength' ].value = strength;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomRadius' ].value = 0.1;

		const bloomFactors = [ 1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2 ];
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomFactors' ].value = bloomFactors;
		this.bloomTintColors = [ new Vector3( 1, 1, 1 ), new Vector3( 1, 1, 1 ), new Vector3( 1, 1, 1 ), new Vector3( 1, 1, 1 ), new Vector3( 1, 1, 1 ) ];
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomTintColors' ].value = this.bloomTintColors;

		// blend material

		const copyShader = CopyShader;

		this.copyUniforms = UniformsUtils.clone( copyShader.uniforms );

		this.blendMaterial = new ShaderMaterial( {
			uniforms: this.copyUniforms,
			vertexShader: copyShader.vertexShader,
			fragmentShader: copyShader.fragmentShader,
			blending: AdditiveBlending,
			depthTest: false,
			depthWrite: false,
			transparent: true
		} );

		this.enabled = true;
		this.needsSwap = false;

		this._oldClearColor = new Color();
		this.oldClearAlpha = 1;

		this.basic = new MeshBasicMaterial();

		this.fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad( null );

	}

	dispose() {

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.renderTargetsHorizontal.length; i ++ ) {

			this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ i ].dispose();

		}

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.renderTargetsVertical.length; i ++ ) {

			this.renderTargetsVertical[ i ].dispose();

		}

		this.renderTargetBright.dispose();

		//

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.separableBlurMaterials.length; i ++ ) {

			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].dispose();

		}

		this.compositeMaterial.dispose();
		this.blendMaterial.dispose();
		this.basic.dispose();

		//

		this.fsQuad.dispose();

	}

	setSize( width, height ) {

		let resx = Math.round( width / 2 );
		let resy = Math.round( height / 2 );

		this.renderTargetBright.setSize( resx, resy );

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.nMips; i ++ ) {

			this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ i ].setSize( resx, resy );
			this.renderTargetsVertical[ i ].setSize( resx, resy );

			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'invSize' ].value = new Vector2( 1 / resx, 1 / resy );

			resx = Math.round( resx / 2 );
			resy = Math.round( resy / 2 );

		}

	}

	render( renderer, writeBuffer, readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive ) {

		renderer.getClearColor( this._oldClearColor );
		this.oldClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
		const oldAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
		renderer.autoClear = false;

		renderer.setClearColor( this.clearColor, 0 );

		if ( maskActive ) renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest( false );

		// Render input to screen

		if ( this.renderToScreen ) {

			this.fsQuad.material = this.basic;
			this.basic.map = readBuffer.texture;

			renderer.setRenderTarget( null );
			renderer.clear();
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		}

		// 1. Extract Bright Areas

		this.highPassUniforms[ 'tDiffuse' ].value = readBuffer.texture;
		this.highPassUniforms[ 'luminosityThreshold' ].value = this.threshold;
		this.fsQuad.material = this.materialHighPassFilter;

		renderer.setRenderTarget( this.renderTargetBright );
		renderer.clear();
		this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		// 2. Blur All the mips progressively

		let inputRenderTarget = this.renderTargetBright;

		for ( let i = 0; i < this.nMips; i ++ ) {

			this.fsQuad.material = this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ];

			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'colorTexture' ].value = inputRenderTarget.texture;
			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'direction' ].value = UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionX;
			renderer.setRenderTarget( this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ i ] );
			renderer.clear();
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'colorTexture' ].value = this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ i ].texture;
			this.separableBlurMaterials[ i ].uniforms[ 'direction' ].value = UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionY;
			renderer.setRenderTarget( this.renderTargetsVertical[ i ] );
			renderer.clear();
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

			inputRenderTarget = this.renderTargetsVertical[ i ];

		}

		// Composite All the mips

		this.fsQuad.material = this.compositeMaterial;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomStrength' ].value = this.strength;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomRadius' ].value = this.radius;
		this.compositeMaterial.uniforms[ 'bloomTintColors' ].value = this.bloomTintColors;

		renderer.setRenderTarget( this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ 0 ] );
		renderer.clear();
		this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		// Blend it additively over the input texture

		this.fsQuad.material = this.blendMaterial;
		this.copyUniforms[ 'tDiffuse' ].value = this.renderTargetsHorizontal[ 0 ].texture;

		if ( maskActive ) renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest( true );

		if ( this.renderToScreen ) {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( null );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		} else {

			renderer.setRenderTarget( readBuffer );
			this.fsQuad.render( renderer );

		}

		// Restore renderer settings

		renderer.setClearColor( this._oldClearColor, this.oldClearAlpha );
		renderer.autoClear = oldAutoClear;

	}

	getSeperableBlurMaterial( kernelRadius ) {

		const coefficients = [];

		for ( let i = 0; i < kernelRadius; i ++ ) {

			coefficients.push( 0.39894 * Math.exp( - 0.5 * i * i / ( kernelRadius * kernelRadius ) ) / kernelRadius );

		}

		return new ShaderMaterial( {

			defines: {
				'KERNEL_RADIUS': kernelRadius
			},

			uniforms: {
				'colorTexture': { value: null },
				'invSize': { value: new Vector2( 0.5, 0.5 ) }, // inverse texture size
				'direction': { value: new Vector2( 0.5, 0.5 ) },
				'gaussianCoefficients': { value: coefficients } // precomputed Gaussian coefficients
			},

			vertexShader:
				`varying vec2 vUv;
				void main() {
					vUv = uv;
					gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );
				}`,

			fragmentShader:
				`#include <common>
				varying vec2 vUv;
				uniform sampler2D colorTexture;
				uniform vec2 invSize;
				uniform vec2 direction;
				uniform float gaussianCoefficients[KERNEL_RADIUS];

				void main() {
					float weightSum = gaussianCoefficients[0];
					vec3 diffuseSum = texture2D( colorTexture, vUv ).rgb * weightSum;
					for( int i = 1; i < KERNEL_RADIUS; i ++ ) {
						float x = float(i);
						float w = gaussianCoefficients[i];
						vec2 uvOffset = direction * invSize * x;
						vec3 sample1 = texture2D( colorTexture, vUv + uvOffset ).rgb;
						vec3 sample2 = texture2D( colorTexture, vUv - uvOffset ).rgb;
						diffuseSum += (sample1 + sample2) * w;
						weightSum += 2.0 * w;
					}
					gl_FragColor = vec4(diffuseSum/weightSum, 1.0);
				}`
		} );

	}

	getCompositeMaterial( nMips ) {

		return new ShaderMaterial( {

			defines: {
				'NUM_MIPS': nMips
			},

			uniforms: {
				'blurTexture1': { value: null },
				'blurTexture2': { value: null },
				'blurTexture3': { value: null },
				'blurTexture4': { value: null },
				'blurTexture5': { value: null },
				'bloomStrength': { value: 1.0 },
				'bloomFactors': { value: null },
				'bloomTintColors': { value: null },
				'bloomRadius': { value: 0.0 }
			},

			vertexShader:
				`varying vec2 vUv;
				void main() {
					vUv = uv;
					gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );
				}`,

			fragmentShader:
				`varying vec2 vUv;
				uniform sampler2D blurTexture1;
				uniform sampler2D blurTexture2;
				uniform sampler2D blurTexture3;
				uniform sampler2D blurTexture4;
				uniform sampler2D blurTexture5;
				uniform float bloomStrength;
				uniform float bloomRadius;
				uniform float bloomFactors[NUM_MIPS];
				uniform vec3 bloomTintColors[NUM_MIPS];

				float lerpBloomFactor(const in float factor) {
					float mirrorFactor = 1.2 - factor;
					return mix(factor, mirrorFactor, bloomRadius);
				}

				void main() {
					gl_FragColor = bloomStrength * ( lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[0]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[0], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture1, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[1]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[1], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture2, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[2]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[2], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture3, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[3]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[3], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture4, vUv) +
						lerpBloomFactor(bloomFactors[4]) * vec4(bloomTintColors[4], 1.0) * texture2D(blurTexture5, vUv) );
				}`
		} );

	}

}

UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionX = new Vector2( 1.0, 0.0 );
UnrealBloomPass.BlurDirectionY = new Vector2( 0.0, 1.0 );

export { UnrealBloomPass };

/**
 * Full-screen textured quad shader
 */

const CopyShader = {

	name: 'CopyShader',

	uniforms: {

		'tDiffuse': { value: null },
		'opacity': { value: 1.0 }

	},

	vertexShader: /* glsl */`

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,

	fragmentShader: /* glsl */`

		uniform float opacity;

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );
			gl_FragColor = opacity * texel;


		}`

};

export { CopyShader };

```

import {
	Color
} from 'three';

/**
 * Luminosity
 * http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luminosity
 */

const LuminosityHighPassShader = {

	name: 'LuminosityHighPassShader',

	shaderID: 'luminosityHighPass',

	uniforms: {

		'tDiffuse': { value: null },
		'luminosityThreshold': { value: 1.0 },
		'smoothWidth': { value: 1.0 },
		'defaultColor': { value: new Color( 0x000000 ) },
		'defaultOpacity': { value: 0.0 }

	},

	vertexShader: /* glsl */`

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;

			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,

	fragmentShader: /* glsl */`

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
		uniform vec3 defaultColor;
		uniform float defaultOpacity;
		uniform float luminosityThreshold;
		uniform float smoothWidth;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );

			vec3 luma = vec3( 0.299, 0.587, 0.114 );

			float v = dot( texel.xyz, luma );

			vec4 outputColor = vec4( defaultColor.rgb, defaultOpacity );

			float alpha = smoothstep( luminosityThreshold, luminosityThreshold + smoothWidth, v );

			gl_FragColor = mix( outputColor, texel, alpha );

		}`

};

export { LuminosityHighPassShader };

```

const OutputShader = {

	name: 'OutputShader',

	uniforms: {

		'tDiffuse': { value: null },
		'toneMappingExposure': { value: 1 }

	},

	vertexShader: /* glsl */`
		precision highp float;

		uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
		uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;

		attribute vec3 position;
		attribute vec2 uv;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,

	fragmentShader: /* glsl */`
	
		precision highp float;

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;

		#include <tonemapping_pars_fragment>
		#include <colorspace_pars_fragment>

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			gl_FragColor = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );

			// tone mapping

			#ifdef LINEAR_TONE_MAPPING

				gl_FragColor.rgb = LinearToneMapping( gl_FragColor.rgb );

			#elif defined( REINHARD_TONE_MAPPING )

				gl_FragColor.rgb = ReinhardToneMapping( gl_FragColor.rgb );

			#elif defined( CINEON_TONE_MAPPING )

				gl_FragColor.rgb = OptimizedCineonToneMapping( gl_FragColor.rgb );

			#elif defined( ACES_FILMIC_TONE_MAPPING )

				gl_FragColor.rgb = ACESFilmicToneMapping( gl_FragColor.rgb );

			#elif defined( AGX_TONE_MAPPING )

				gl_FragColor.rgb = AgXToneMapping( gl_FragColor.rgb );

			#endif

			// color space

			#ifdef SRGB_TRANSFER

				gl_FragColor = sRGBTransferOETF( gl_FragColor );

			#endif

		}`

};

export { OutputShader };

```

  .frow { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font:10.5px Consolas,monospace; padding:2.5px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(0,229,255,.08); }
  .frow b { color:#eaffff; }
  .meters { padding:4px 12px 10px; flex:none; }
  .mrow { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font:10.5px Consolas,monospace; padding:2px 0; color:rgba(150,220,255,.7); }
  .mrow b { color:#eaffff; }
  .meter { height:5px; background:rgba(0,229,255,.1); margin:2px 0 6px; }
  .meter i { display:block; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ok),var(--cyan)); transition:width .6s; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>数字孪生 · 左写右应 LIVE</h1>
  <span class="stat">写码<b id="cCode">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">执行<b id="cExec">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">异常<b id="cErr">0</b></span>
  <span class="stat">模式<b id="mode">待机</b></span>
  <span id="ping" class="dim">连接中…</span>
</header>
<main>
  <!-- 左屏: 正在写 -->
  <section class="col">
    <div class="colhead">✍ 正在写 WRITING · <b id="curFile">等待第一个写码事件…</b><span class="ago" id="fileAgo"></span></div>
    <div id="fileView"><div class="empty" style="padding:10px 14px;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">DSH/ZCode 开始写码后, 这里显示该文件的真实磁盘内容(末尾 400 行), 新写入行绿色高亮</div></div>
    <div id="stream"><div class="tag">▸ 最新写入流 LATEST WRITE — 真实 old/new, 打字机回放</div><div id="streamBody" class="empty" style="padding:2px 0;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">等待事件…</div></div>
  </section>
  <!-- 右屏: 孪生墙 -->
  <section class="col">
    <div class="colhead">◈ 数字孪生 TWIN · 秒级同步</div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="cell"><span>事件总数</span><b id="cTotal">0</b></div>
      <div class="cell"><span>同步延迟</span><b id="lat">--</b></div>
      <div class="cell"><span>聚焦</span><b id="focus" style="font-size:11px">—</b></div>
    </div>
    <div class="colhead" style="margin-top:4px">▸ 编码活动 ACTIVITY</div>
    <div id="feed"><div class="empty" style="padding:6px 0;font:10px Consolas;color:rgba(150,220,255,.4)">等待事件…</div></div>
    <div class="colhead files">▸ 文件注册表 FILES</div>
    <div id="files"></div>
    <div class="meters">
      <div class="mrow"><span>CPU</span><b id="mCpu">--</b></div><div class="meter"><i id="mCpuBar" style="width:0%"></i></div>
      <div class="mrow"><span>内存</span><b id="mMem">--</b></div><div class="meter"><i id="mMemBar" style="width:0%"></i></div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>
<script>
(function () {
  var BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:3210';
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]; }); }
  function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n; }
  function tm(ts) { var d = new Date(ts); return pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()); }
  var ICON = { code: '✎', exec: '▶', scan: '⌕', task: '◆', error: '✖', idle: '◌', session: '⏻', tool: '◇' };
  var counts = { code: 0, exec: 0, scan: 0, error: 0, task: 0, other: 0 };
  var total = 0, lastAt = 0, lastKind = '', curKey = null;

  /* ---- 右屏: 活动流 ---- */
  function addEvent(e, silent) {
    if (!e) return;
    var k = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(counts, e.kind) ? e.kind : 'other';
    counts[k]++; total++;
    $('cCode').textContent = counts.code; $('cExec').textContent = counts.exec; $('cErr').textContent = counts.error; $('cTotal').textContent = total;
    var box = $('feed');
    if (box.firstChild && box.firstChild.className === 'empty') box.innerHTML = '';
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'fitem';
    div.innerHTML = '<span class="t">' + tm(e.ts) + '</span><span class="k-' + esc(e.kind) + '">' + (ICON[e.kind] || '◇') + '</span><span class="g">' + esc(e.tool || e.kind) + (e.target ? ' · ' + esc(e.target) : '') + '</span><span class="s">' + esc(e.source || '') + '</span>';
    box.insertBefore(div, box.firstChild);
    while (box.children.length > 20) box.removeChild(box.lastChild);
    lastAt = e.ts || Date.now(); lastKind = e.kind;
    if (e.file && e.file.name) $('focus').textContent = e.file.name;
    if (!silent) updateMode();
    if (e.kind === 'code') {
      if (e.diff && (e.diff.del || e.diff.ins)) typeWrite(e);
      if (e.file && e.file.key && e.file.key !== curKey) switchFile(e.file.key);
      else if (e.file && e.file.key === curKey) refreshFile(true);
    }
  }
  function updateMode() {
    var ago = lastAt ? Date.now() - lastAt : 1e9;
    var t = '待机';
    if (ago < 9000) {
      if (lastKind === 'code') t = '编码中';
      else if (lastKind === 'exec') t = '调试中';
      else if (lastKind === 'error') t = '排障中';
      else if (lastKind === 'task') t = '规划中';
      else t = '检索中';
    } else if (ago < 60000) t = '活跃';
    $('mode').textContent = t;
  }
  setInterval(function () {
    updateMode();
    var ago = lastAt ? (Date.now() - lastAt) / 1000 : null;
    var p = $('ping');
    if (ago === null) { p.textContent = '未收到事件'; p.className = 'dim'; }
    else if (ago < 10) { p.textContent = '● ' + ago.toFixed(1) + 's 前同步'; p.className = 'ok'; }
    else { p.textContent = '○ ' + Math.round(ago) + 's 前同步'; p.className = 'dim'; }
    if (curKey) { var s = Math.round((Date.now() - fileTs) / 1000); $('fileAgo').textContent = s + 's 前写入'; }
  }, 300);

  /* ---- 左屏: 真实文件内容 ---- */
  var fileTs = 0;
  function switchFile(key) {
    curKey = key;
    fetch(BASE + '/api/file?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key)).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (f) {
      if (f.error) return;
      $('curFile').textContent = f.name;
      fileTs = Date.now();
      renderFile(f.content);
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  function refreshFile() { if (curKey) switchFile(curKey); }
  function renderFile(content) {
    var lines = String(content || '').split('\n');
    var tail = lines.slice(-400);
    var start = lines.length - tail.length + 1;
    var html = tail.map(function (l, i) {
      return '<div class="ln"><em>' + (start + i) + '</em><span>' + esc(l) + '</span></div>';
    }).join('') || '<div class="empty">空文件</div>';
    var v = $('fileView');
    v.innerHTML = html;
    v.scrollTop = v.scrollHeight;
  }

  /* ---- 左屏: 打字机回放最新写入 ---- */
  var typeTimer = null;
  function typeWrite(e) {
    if (typeTimer) { clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer = null; }
    var body = $('streamBody');
    var dels = String(e.diff.del || '').split('\n').filter(function (s) { return s !== ''; });
    var inss = String(e.diff.ins || '').split('\n');
    var seq = [];
    dels.slice(0, 6).forEach(function (l) { seq.push({ c: 'dl-del', t: '− ' + l }); });
    inss.slice(0, 10).forEach(function (l) { seq.push({ c: 'dl-ins fresh', t: '+ ' + l }); });
    body.innerHTML = '';
    var i = 0;
    typeTimer = setInterval(function () {
      if (i >= seq.length) { clearInterval(typeTimer); typeTimer = null; return; }
      var d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = seq[i].c;
      d.textContent = seq[i].t;
      body.appendChild(d);
      $('stream').scrollTop = $('stream').scrollHeight;
      i++;
    }, 90);
  }

  /* ---- 指标 / 文件表 ---- */
  function loadMetrics() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/metrics').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (m) {
      $('mCpu').textContent = m.cpu.avgPct + '%'; $('mCpuBar').style.width = Math.min(100, m.cpu.avgPct) + '%';
      $('mMem').textContent = m.mem.usedGB + ' / ' + m.mem.totalGB + ' GB'; $('mMemBar').style.width = m.mem.pct + '%';
    }).catch(function () {});
    fetch(BASE + '/api/files').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      $('files').innerHTML = (d.files || []).slice(0, 10).map(function (f) {
        return '<div class="frow"><span>' + esc(f.name) + '</span><b>' + f.edits + ' 次修改</b></div>';
      }).join('') || '<div class="empty">暂无</div>';
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  loadMetrics(); setInterval(loadMetrics, 30000);

  function loadEvents() {
    fetch(BASE + '/api/events').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      (d.events || []).slice(-18).forEach(function (e) { addEvent(e, true); });
      var lastCode = (d.events || []).filter(function (e) { return e.kind === 'code' && e.file; }).pop();
      if (lastCode && lastCode.file) {
        curKey = lastCode.file.key;
        $('curFile').textContent = lastCode.file.name;
        fetch(BASE + '/api/file?key=' + encodeURIComponent(curKey)).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (f) {
          if (!f.error) { fileTs = lastCode.ts || Date.now(); renderFile(f.content); }
        }).catch(function () {});
      }
      updateMode();
    }).catch(function () { $('ping').textContent = '✖ 离线 — node server.js 未启动'; $('ping').className = 'err'; });
  }
  loadEvents();
  /* 自动化/无头环境跳过 SSE 长连接 (?nostream=1) */
  if (/[?&]nostream=1/.test(location.search)) return;

  try {
    var es = new EventSource(BASE + '/api/stream');
    es.onopen = function () { $('ping').textContent = '● LIVE'; $('ping').className = 'ok'; };
    es.onmessage = function (m) {
      try {
        var d = JSON.parse(m.data);
        if (d.type === 'event' && d.event) {
          addEvent(d.event);
          var lat = Date.now() - (d.event.ts || Date.now());
          $('lat').textContent = (lat >= 0 ? lat : 0) + 'ms';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    es.onerror = function () { $('ping').textContent = '重连中…'; $('ping').className = 'err'; };
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
